title: Irreducible Governance Structure for Autonomous Agent Systems: Fair Allocation, Strategy-Proofness, and Multi-Scale Composition
summary:
Autonomous agent governance is commonly framed as a problem of enforcing correct execution. However, in multi-agent systems, an equally fundamental question precedes execution: which agents are allowed to act.
  In this paper, we show that allocation is not an auxiliary concern but a structural component of governance. When multiple agents compete for execution under constrained resources, any allocation mechanism introduces unavoidable trade-offs between fairness, efficiency, and resistance to strategic manipulation. We formalize this through a set of impossibility results, including Sybil amplification and the incompatibility of desirable allocation properties.
  We then show that these allocation constraints cannot be resolved within a single layer of control. Instead, they propagate across the system, interacting with execution atomicity, state enforcement, and behavioral drift. This leads to a multi-scale governance structure composed of four orthogonal dimensions: temporal (atomicity), state (enforcement), behavioral (drift monitoring), and population (allocation).
  Our main result is an irreducibility theorem: under finite observability, no governance architecture can collapse these dimensions without loss of correctness or stability. Allocation, in particular, acts as a first-class constraint that prevents simplification of the governance stack.
  We validate these results through a series of analytical constructions and empirical ablations, showing that removing or approximating any layer leads to systematic failure modes.
  This work reframes agent governance as a structural problem: not only how actions are executed, but how access to execution is determined, and why these decisions impose irreducible architectural requirements.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了代理分配不仅是一个辅助问题，而是治理结构的一个组成部分。它提出了代理分配机制在公平性、效率和策略性操纵抵抗性之间的不可调和性，以及治理结构必须跨多层运作的不可简化解原理。通过理论构造和实验验证展示了代理治理应关注执行访问的确定性及其对治理架构的不可避免要求。
AI.motivation: 当前的代理治理框架主要集中在确保正确执行上，而作者发现代理访问的允许性这一问题更为根本。这个问题涉及分配机制如何在有限资源下平衡公平性、效率和抗策略性操纵，这揭示了进一步理解代理治理需要考虑执行访问的决定问题。
AI.method: 作者通过提出代理治理结构的四维框架——时间（执行原子性）、状态（状态执行）、行为（行为漂移监控）、和群体（分配机制）——来分析代理分配机制的问题。通过一系列的理论构造和实证分析，证明了代理分配机制引入的关键约束无法通过简化治理架构来消除。
AI.result: 论文得出代理分配机制引入的关键约束无法通过消除任何一层架构来消除的不可简化性定理。此外，还证明了代理治理的四维结构是不可简化的架构要求。验证过程通过理论构造和实证分析，展示了结构化访问控制对治理架构稳定性和正确性的关键性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究从结构化视角重新定义了代理治理，强调了代理治理不应仅关注代理行为的执行，还必须确定访问控制的架构属性。代理治理不应简化成单一层面的控制系统，而应该保持多层系统以保证稳定性和正确性。

title: MOZAIC: An Audio-Video Deepfake Benchmark for Telling What Is Fake
summary: Audio-video (AV) deepfakes can fake the face, the voice, or both. Most benchmarks only ask whether a clip is real or fake, so they cannot show whether a detector relies on the picture, the voice, or encoding traces. We present MOZAIC, a paired benchmark with a 4-way label in which every source clip is released in all four combinations of real or fake video and real or fake audio so each modality contribution can be measured directly. Fakes cover inner-face swapping, whole-frame video diffusion and voice conversion. MOZAIC has 137,745 clips from 15,014 source pairs and four tasks: T1 AV authenticity, T2 manipulation type, T3 identity verification and T4 explanation. We evaluate 12 AV multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), train four detectors and fine-tune MLLMs with LoRA. Overall, the best MLLM reaches only 35.6% on the four-way T1 and catches far more video-only fakes than voice-only fakes (43.6% vs 7.5%). Trained detectors reach 98.4% on T1, and LoRA fine-tuning raises explanation scores (OmniVinci 4.17 to 7.40, Qwen2.5-Omni 4.42 to 6.98), but the best T1 detector falls to 78.3% when the face-swap generator is held out of training, so generalization and explanation remain open. We release the dataset, the compact MOZAIC-SMALL split, the code and the prompts. https://vectorinstitute.github.io/mozaic/

AI.tldr: MOZAIC是一个具有四分类标签的音频-视频对基准，旨在全面评估音频和视频模态对深假检测器的贡献，涵盖了内面部替换单帧视频扩散和声音转换等多种伪造类型，包含137,745个剪辑，用于四个任务：视频-音频真实性、篡改类型、身份验证和解释。
AI.motivation: 现有的音频-视频（AV）伪造检测基准主要关注假视频的识别，缺乏对音频和视频模态独立作用的评估，MOZAIC旨在填补这一空白，通过引入四分类标签，更直接地测量模态贡献。
AI.method: MOZAIC基准通过将每个原始剪辑以四种组合形式（真实视频+真实音频、真实视频+虚假音频、虚假视频+真实音频、虚假视频+虚假音频）发布，使用12种AV多模态LLM模型及其改进版本进行评估，同时开发了四种检测器，并使用LoRA进行了微调。
AI.result: 在四个分类任务中，最佳AV多模态LLM模型在四分类真实性任务上达到了35.6%的准确率；视频检测器在真实性任务上达到98.4%的准确性；同时，LoRA微调提高了解释分数，但当使用未训练过的伪造人脸替换生成器时，最佳检测器的表现下降至78.3%。
AI.conclusion: MOZAIC基准为多模态AV伪造检测提供了新的挑战，并展示了目前技术在不同任务中的局限性，未来的研究需要进一步提高通用性和解释性。

title: Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Sets for Incomplete Data
summary: Attribute reduction in incomplete information systems is difficult because missing values break the equivalence-class structure of rough set theory. We propose the Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Set (COFRS) model. Each object is described by its set of present attributes. The similarity of two objects is a weighted overlap on the attributes present in both, divided by the fixed number of attributes |A| instead of the size of their union, so missing values are penalised globally and are not matched as wildcards. From this similarity we define a soft dependency degree based on weighted granule consistency, and we search for reducts by greedy backward elimination in O(|U|^2 |A|^2) time. We show that the relation is symmetric and non-reflexive, that the dependency degree is not monotone, and we give a sufficient condition under which monotonicity holds. On 11 UCI benchmarks with missing rates from 0.15% to 20.46%, COFRS gives the smallest reducts on average (4.1 attributes, against 5.0-11.2 for Tolerance-RS, a range-threshold variant Tol-RS_tau, Zhou-RS and the min-aggregation variant COFRS-min). The difference is significant against Tol-RS_tau, Zhou-RS and COFRS-min (Holm-adjusted Wilcoxon p<0.01) but not against Tolerance-RS (p=0.56), and it is small against the Jensen-Shen selector (adjusted p=0.084). At equal reduct size, COFRS selects more informative attributes than random subsets. With a kNN classifier the methods do not differ significantly in accuracy, F1 or G-mean; with an RBF-SVM they do, and COFRS ranks last. The gain is therefore compactness, not predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的模糊粗糙集模型COFRS，该模型通过加权重叠来度量对象间的相似性，避免了缺失值的影响，并保证了搜索的效率.
AI.motivation: 现有的属性约简方法在处理不完整信息系统的缺失值时效果不佳，因为它们依赖于等价类结构，这在存在缺失值的情况下难以维持。COFRS模型通过重新定义相似性和依赖度指标，旨在改善这个问题，并通过贪心后向消除来高效地找到属性约简。
AI.method: COFRS模型通过将相似性定义为两个对象共同属性的加权重叠（除以固定数量的属性 |A| 而不是它们交集的大小），来考虑所有属性，而不是仅仅匹配存在的属性。在此相似性基础上，定义了一种基于加权粒度一致性的软依赖关系。通过贪心后向消除方法，在最优情况下以 O(|U|^2 |A|^2) 的时间复杂度找到属性约简。
AI.result: COFRS在11个UCI基准测试上的表现优于同类方法，如Tolerance-RS、Tol-RS_tau、Zhou-RS和COFRS-min，在平均属性约简的数目上较优。然而，当属性集合相同时，它选择的更具有信息量的属性。虽然在准确度、F1值或G-mean方面，基于kNN分类器和RBF-SVM的支持向量机分类器的结果相似，但对基于RBF-SVM分类器的性能影响却显著，这强调了COFRS模型的主要优势是紧凑性而非预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，COFRS在处理不完整信息系统的属性约简问题上具有竞争力，特别是在寻找简单化和精确化的属性集这一目标上。尽管在某些分类器上性能不如其他竞争对手，但它依然为数据挖掘提供了一个有效的选择。

title: Beyond Static Charts: Benchmarking Interactive Chart-to-Code Generation for MLLMs
comment: ACM WSDM 2027 (Main Track), Our code and data are available at https://github.com/bianyh/ChartInt
summary: In recent years, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved significant progress in chart-to-code generation. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on static charts, overlooking interactive charts that enable richer and more expressive data exploration. Unlike static chart-to-code generation, which emphasizes visual consistency, interactive chart-to-code evaluation targets behavioral consistency, requiring chart states to evolve correctly under sequences of user interactions, thereby rendering traditional one-step evaluation paradigms ineffective. To address this gap, we introduce ChartInt, the first benchmark specifically designed for interactive chart-to-code generation. ChartInt consists of 2,779 carefully annotated examples covering common interaction patterns such as hover, highlight, and tooltips. Additionally, ChartInt incorporates editing tasks such as data updates, style adjustments, and cross-chart style transfer to expand real-world application scenarios. To enable reliable evaluation of interaction behavior, we propose a preset state snapshot protocol that predefines target interaction states and deterministically triggers interaction events, transforming dynamic behaviors into reproducible evaluation targets. Based on this protocol, we design a multi-dimensional evaluation framework measuring semantic and stylistic consistency. Experiments show that while current MLLMs perform well on static charts, their performance drops significantly on interactive tasks, highlighting the need for interaction-aware benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ChartInt，这是第一个专门为交互式图表到代码生成设计的基准。它包含2,779个精心标注的示例，覆盖常见的交互模式，并提出了一种预设状态快照协议，以实现交互行为的可靠评估。
AI.motivation: 鉴于现有基准主要关注静态图表，而忽略了更丰富的互动图表，本文旨在填补这一空白。通过引入ChartInt，促进更全面的图表到代码生成研究。
AI.method: 本文创建了ChartInt基准，包括2,779个标注实例和编辑任务，开发了一种预设状态快照协议，并设计了一个多维评估框架。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前的大语言模型在静态图表上表现良好，但在交互任务上表现较差，突显了交互感知基准的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 本文的工作为交互式图表到代码生成的研究提供了参考，有助于提升模型在实际应用中的表现。

title: Validation Bias in Large Language Model Responses to Cancer Treatment Queries: A Factorial Cross-Sectional Study
summary: Large language model (LLM) chatbots are increasingly used by patients seeking cancer information, but their safety when users present evidence-misaligned beliefs about treatment remains uncharacterized. We hypothesized that LLMs exhibit validation bias, affirming rather than correcting such beliefs, and evaluated this with a 2x2x2 factorial design crossing conversation format (single-turn vs multi-turn), treatment type (evidence-based vs alternative), and query valence (positive vs negative). Framing was evidence-aligned (supporting evidence-based treatments or questioning alternative therapies) or evidence-misaligned (promoting alternative treatments or questioning evidence-based therapies). We analyzed 1,272 conversations (6,360 interactions) across 14 LLMs from 6 vendors, scored by an LLM judge (GPT-5-mini) validated against human annotation on a 6-dimension safety rubric. The primary outcome was the unsafe response rate, defined as a Weak classification or any critical failure. Evidence-misaligned framing increased unsafe response rates compared with evidence-aligned framing (14.4% vs 5.1%; OR 3.14, 95% CI 2.07-4.78; P < .001), and the association persisted after accounting for clustering by LLM. Among 429 conversations classified as Strong under evidence-aligned framing, 22.6% were downgraded in their paired evidence-misaligned counterpart. Multi-turn conversations had lower unsafe response rates than single-turn conversations (5.2% vs 14.7%; P < .001). Unsafe response rates varied by vendor from 1.8% to 36.8%. LLMs exhibited significant validation bias in oncology, with unsafe responses nearly tripling under evidence-misaligned framing. Evaluations limited to neutral, fact-seeking queries may overestimate real-world safety, and safety testing of medical AI systems should include evidence-misaligned user framing.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，大型语言模型（LLM）聊天机器人在处理证据不一致的观点时表现出验证偏差，这会显著增加不安全响应率。进一步的测试应包括证据不一致的用户提问。
AI.motivation: 研究背景：在癌症治疗信息查询中，患者使用的LLM聊天机器人安全性能尚未充分测试，尤其是在用户持有证据不符观点时。
AI.method: 采用因子设计（单轮对话 vs 多轮对话，基于证据的治疗 vs 替代疗法，积极查询 vs 消极查询），通过LLM法官（GPT-5-mini）验证并评分。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，使用证据不符的框架比使用证据一致的框架增加了不安全响应率（14.4% vs 5.1%）。在证据一致框架下的429次对话中有22.6%在证据不符框架下的对应对话中被降级。多轮对话的不安全响应率低于单轮对话。
AI.conclusion: 结论：LLM在肿瘤学中表现出显著的验证偏差，不安全响应几乎翻倍。这意味着针对中立、事实查询的评估可能高估了实际安全性，医疗AI系统的安全测试应包括证据不一致的用户提问。

title: PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL: Polarization-Keyed Examination Papers and Mandatory Issued Eyewear that Displace AI Glasses and Extend Universal Design
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Framework, optical analysis, simulation study (Mueller-calculus page model, capture/OCR leakage experiment, metamerism test with 151 observers and 28 cameras), and evaluation protocol; no physical or human-subject results. Companion to arXiv:2611.26033 (SEOYUN). Simulation code in anc/
summary: Camera-equipped AI glasses turn an examination page into a query for a remote vision-language model. Device detection targets possession, and our companion work SEOYUN targets the model. PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL instead changes who owns the eyewear. Every candidate wears authority-issued glasses for the whole session, and the question paper is printed so that it can be read only through them. As in cinema stereoscopy, a patterned laminate encodes the text in the handedness of circular polarization rather than in brightness. The page looks uniformly grey to the naked eye and to unfiltered cameras, and the issued circular analyzer reveals the text. Compulsory issued eyewear turns the smart-glasses form factor against itself. The face position is occupied by a device the authority supplies and collects, and a camera anywhere else needs its own analyzer. Spectacle wearers receive prescription inserts in the issued frame, low-vision candidates may use an offline assistive mixed-reality tier, and blind candidates keep braille, audio, and screen-reader formats. We derive the luminance and contrast budget and show why circular keying tolerates head tilt. A simulation study supports the analysis. A spectral Mueller model confirms tilt invariance and invisibility to linear-polarization cameras, but a 1 degree axis misregistration leaks a few percent of contrast. A capture-and-OCR experiment on English and Korean text shows that video averaging can recover leakage too weak to read in a single frame, so leakage must be bounded against the adversary's total photon budget. Data from 151 observers and 28 cameras show that spectral (metameric) keys are visible to all of them. The key carries no secrecy, and filtered covert cameras remain possible. All results are simulations; no prototypes, physical measurements, or human-subject results are reported.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种使用配备摄像头的AI眼镜的考试页面转换为对远程视觉-语言模型的查询的方法。考试期间，所有考生都佩戴由权威机构提供的护目镜，其中包含手性偏振编码的文字内容。文章分析了光亮度和对比度预算，并讨论了轴偏移2度下仅漏泄一定比例对比度的现象。通过对英文和韩文文本的实验，作者展示了视频平均可以恢复单帧中无法读取的泄漏信息，必须限制对手的光子预算。
AI.motivation: 为了提高考试安全性，特别是在面对隐私泄露和公平性问题时，需要一种新的方法来确保考试内容不被未经授权的设备或人员探测。
AI.method: 文章通过对护目镜的设计进行分析，使用手性偏振编码技术，使得仅特定授权设备能读取考试纸上的内容。通过仿真和实验数据，验证了系统的有效性。
AI.result: 研究分析了光亮度和对比度预算，证明了手性钥匙在1度轴偏离情况下仅漏泄一定比例对比度。实验表明，通过视频平均，可以恢复单帧中无法读取的泄漏信息，同时指出系统在光子预算受限的情况下仍存在被探测的风险。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了一种新颖的考试安全方法，能够有效防止未经授权的设备或人员探测考试内容。然而，系统需要进一步的物理测量和原型设计来验证其真实环境中的有效性。

title: SlotFill: Repairing Lossy SoC Communication Traces for Post-Silicon Validation
summary: Post-silicon validation relies on traces of messages exchanged by SoC components, but trace buffers and monitors drop messages, often leaving no mark of what was lost. We present SlotFill, which puts each deleted message back in the right gap, with the right type and order. SlotFill gives every gap between the remaining messages a fixed number of slots, and a Transformer-based model fills each slot with a message or leaves it empty when nothing was deleted there, so the input never reveals how much was lost. The model also uses monitor fields (timestamps, transaction IDs, addresses) from surviving messages. On whole-program gem5 traces of 4- and 8-core systems (2.07 billion messages), SlotFill restores up to 97% of deleted messages exactly at 15% loss and up to 87% at 50% loss, and 76-83% at 15% loss when timestamps are coarse.

AI.tldr: SlotFill 是一种通过特定机制恢复被丢弃消息的方法，能够在保留隐私的同时恢复大部分丢失的消息。
AI.motivation: 在后硅验证中，由于缓冲区和监控器的限制，许多消息可能会丢失，导致验证过程中信息不完整。因此，研究如何准确恢复这些丢失的消息十分必要。
AI.method: SlotFill 通过为每个空隙分配固定数量的槽位，并使用基于 Transformer 的模型填补或保留这些槽位为空，来恢复丢失的消息。同时结合使用幸存消息的监控字段如时间戳、交易 ID 和地址等信息。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，SlotFill 在 4 和 8 核系统中能够恢复多达 97% 的丢失消息，即使在 50% 的丢失率下也能恢复 87%，并且在时间戳较粗的情况下，仍然能够恢复 76-83% 的消息。
AI.conclusion: SlotFill 提供了一种新颖的方法来有效恢复丢失的消息，能够在保持隐私的同时提高验证的完整性和准确性。

title: TokenJoule: Energy Modeling for Distributed Training and Inference of LLMs
summary: As large language models (LLMs) scale, energy dictates operating cost, cooling, and cluster capacity across training and inference. Early hardware design-space exploration (DSE) requires predicting energy before silicon exists, yet performance models miss hidden component work while prior energy predictors calibrate to deployed GPUs. We present TokenJoule, an open-source analytical tool that derives device kernel sequences, tiled compute, shared-memory staging, cache residency, and collective traffic, pricing activity directly with component energies. With zero workload fitting, TokenJoule achieves 3.3-6.6% activity error (151 A100/H100 runs) and 3.0-6.8% A100 energy error, guiding parallelism, memory packaging, and 3D-DRAM chip co-design.

AI.tldr: TokenJoule 是一个开源分析工具，能直接通过组件能量来评估活动，无需匹配工作负载。该工具在 151 个 A100/H100 实例中实现了 3.3-6.6% 的活动误差和 3.0-6.8% 的 A100 能耗误差，帮助指导并行计算、内存封装和 3D-DRAM 芯片协同设计。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型的扩展，能耗成为操作成本、冷却和集群容量的关键因素。现有的性能模型未能捕捉到隐藏的工作量，而之前的能耗预测器则依赖于已部署的 GPU 进行校准。因此，需要一个能够直接评估组件能耗而不需匹配具体工作负载的分析工具。
AI.method: TokenJoule 通过 derives 设备内核序列、分块计算、共享内存缓存、缓存驻留和集体流量来直接与组件能耗进行定价，并且没有任何工作量匹配。
AI.result: TokenJoule 在 151 个 A100 和 H100 实例上实现了活动误差 3.3-6.6% 和 A100 能耗误差 3.0-6.8%。这表明它能够有效指导并行计算、内存封装和 3D-DRAM 芯片协同设计。
AI.conclusion: TokenJoule 提供了一种新的方法来预测和优化大规模语言模型的能耗，减少了对具体工作负载的依赖，为硬件设计提供了重要的数据支持。

title: What People Choose Not to Say: A Multimodal Benchmark for Fine-Grained Information Manipulation in Conversations
comment: ACM WSDM 2027 (Main Track), Our benchmark dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/xilinghuiye/RoomReader-Full
summary: Recent advances in MLLMs have improved social understanding, enabling models to recognize emotions and distinguish truthful from deceptive behaviors. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on coarse-grained emotion recognition or binary truth-deception detection, overlooking the diverse ways people manipulate information in conversations, such as withholding, leakage, fabrication, evasion, and defensive counterclaim. Understanding these behaviors requires reasoning about underlying facts, participant knowledge, and conversational context, making them difficult to evaluate reliably. To address this gap, we introduce InfoCon, a multimodal benchmark for fine-grained information manipulation in conversations. InfoCon identifies six fine-grained strategies and derives a coarse consistency label from their factual and interactional relations. We develop an evidence-grounded multi-agent annotation framework to construct and verify reliable labels from rich contextual evidence. We benchmark representative multimodal models and systematically analyze their fine-grained information manipulation understanding, providing a testbed beyond binary truth-deception judgments.

AI.tldr: InfoCon是首个细粒度信息操纵在对话中的多模态基准，旨在评估模型在识别多种信息操控策略及背后事实方面的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要关注粗粒度的情感识别或二元真相/欺诈判断，忽视了对话中人们复杂的信息操控手段。这些复杂手段要求模型理解背后事实、参与者知识及对话情境，而现有方法难以可靠地评估。
AI.method: InfoCon通过识别六种细粒度策略并基于它们的实事和互动关系推导粗粒度的一致性标签。开发多代理基于证据的注释框架，确保从丰富背景证据构建可靠标签。
AI.result: 介绍了代表性多模态模型在InfoCon上的基准测试结果，以及对模型细粒度信息操控理解的经验分析。
AI.conclusion: InfoCon填补了当前评估的空白，提供了一个超越二元真实/欺骗判断的测试平台。

title: DAGGER: Deployment-Free Quality Estimation for Generative AI Workflows
summary: Estimating the quality of generative AI workflows is challenging because these workflows comprise multiple stages, and errors can propagate across them, making end-to-end performance depend not only on the accuracy of individual models but also on how their outputs affect downstream stages. Each stage can use one of many candidate models. Estimating end-to-end workflow quality by deploying and evaluating every resulting model configuration is therefore prohibitively expensive. As a result, existing approaches face a tradeoff between estimation cost and accuracy: inexpensive methods often produce unreliable quality estimates, while accurate methods require deploying and evaluating many workflow configurations. In this paper, we introduce DAGGER, a framework for estimating the quality of generative AI workflows without exhaustive deployment and profiling. DAGGER represents a workflow as a graph, in which nodes correspond to stages and edges capture how outputs from one stage affect subsequent stages. It then decomposes workflow quality into per-node accuracy terms and per-edge dependency terms. Using a novel analytical formulation and SVD-based matrix completion, DAGGER estimates workflow quality from sparse observations without executing every candidate workflow. We evaluate DAGGER on three generative AI workflows across three datasets. DAGGER estimates workflow quality with a median error of 6.8 percentage points while reducing profiling cost by 10.2$\times$ relative to BenchPress, a state-of-the-art baseline, and selects workflow configurations competitive with state-of-the-art frameworks such as LLMSelector.

AI.tldr: DAGGER框架通过将生成AI工作流表示为图，并利用稀疏观测和SVD矩阵完成技术，能够在不执行所有候选工作流配置的情况下估计工作流质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在准确性和成本之间存在权衡，DAGGER旨在提供一种平衡方法，能够在减少资源消耗的同时保持质量估计的准确性。
AI.method: DAGGER通过图论表示工作流，将工作流的质量分解为节点的准确性项和边的依赖性项，使用新颖的分析公式和SVD矩阵完成技术进行估计。
AI.result: 在三个生成AI工作流程上的评估中，DAGGER的误差中位数为6.8个百分点，相比BenchPress降低了10.2倍的开销，并且选择了与LLMSelector等领先框架竞争的工作流程配置。
AI.conclusion: DAGGER提供了一种有效的方法来估计生成AI工作流的质量，减轻了现有方法的成本负担，同时保持了准确性。

title: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation
comment: Guo Chen, Fuxiao Liu, Haoqin Tu, and Yiyang Zhou contributed equally and are listed alphabetically by surname. Project lead: Guilin Liu
summary: Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure. We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code. Raster images are represented by learned discrete visual tokens, while structured artifacts use explicit programs. A shared generation-and-rendering interface connects these representations to visual feedback across images, vector graphics, webpages, and documents. A Nemotron-native harness coordinates planning and raster candidate selection, with targeted repair for editable structured and hybrid artifacts. To support this interface, we develop Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer, the autoregressive raster generator Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B, and the structured-code model family Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode. On approximately 178K images spanning six visual domains, our tokenizer improves reconstruction PSNR from 26.08 to 29.57 dB over Emu3.5 IBQ. It also provides 7.13x faster encoding and 10.93x faster decoding at batch size one on A100. In standalone evaluation, one Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode variant surpasses Kimi K3.1 Pro on the aggregate across Chart2Code, MMSVG, Design2Code, and Image2Struct. At the system level, the Nemotron-native configuration raises GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM from 31.71 to 52.56 using the same raster generator. With our best setting, Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation achieves performance competitive with GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro across most benchmarks with available comparisons.

AI.tldr: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation引入了一种基于像素即代码的体系结构，实现了离散视觉标记与显式程序的交互，从而提供广泛视觉反馈，同时提升了重建PSNR和编码/解码速度。
AI.motivation: 应对视觉创作中对富有表现力的图像与精准的文本、布局、结构控制的需求。
AI.method: 利用自回归像素生成器Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B与结构化代码模型家族Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode，通过一个共享的生成-渲染接口实现像素与代码的转换。
AI.result: 在178K张跨六种视觉域的图像中，Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer比Emu3.5 IBQ的重建PSNR提高了约12.6%，编码和解码速度分别为A100的7.13和10.93倍快；Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode的某个变种在指标测试中优于Kimi K3.1 Pro；系统配置下，Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation的整体表现与GPT Image 2和Nano Banana Pro相当。
AI.conclusion: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation提供了一种创新的方法来实现视觉元素的高效创作与精确控制，具有广泛应用前景。

title: ExitLUT: Boolean Early Exits for Efficient FPGA-Based Neural Network Inference
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the 2026 International Conference on Field Programmable Technology (ICFPT)
summary: Early exit neural networks reduce average inference cost by terminating once sufficient confidence is reached. On FPGAs, conventional confidence-based exits add arithmetic control paths poorly matched to LUT fabrics, consuming resources that could otherwise support the main datapath. We present ExitLUT, which replaces softmax-style exit decisions with learned Boolean functions mapped directly into FPGA LUTs. In our CNN evaluation, fpgaConvNet is the static spatial-dataflow baseline, while ATHEENA is its softmax-based early exit extension. ExitLUT reduces ATHEENA's exit-decision LUT usage by 2.58$\times$ over the softmax path and eliminates decision-path DSP usage, while preserving accuracy and exit behavior. Rerunning design-space exploration reinvests these savings into the datapath, improving throughput by up to 4.08$\times$ over fpgaConvNet and 1.82$\times$ over ATHEENA. For LUT-based NNs, embedded ExitLUT exits achieve 1.41-1.89$\times$ average time-to-decision speedup over static NeuraLUT-Assemble designs with under 1% LUT overhead.

AI.tldr: ExitLUT通过将softmax退出决策替换为直接映射到FPGA LUT的可学习布尔函数，减少了退出决策的LUT使用量，并释放了算术路径资源，提高了吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于softmax的早期退出方法在FPGA上使用额外的算术控制路径，占用LUT资源，影响了主数据路径的性能。
AI.method: ExitLUT通过学习可映射到FPGA LUT的布尔函数来实现早期退出决策。
AI.result: 在CNN评估中，ExitLUT将ATHEENA的退出决策LUT使用量减少了2.58倍，并消除了决策路径DSP使用，同时保持了准确性和退出行为。通过重新进行设计空间探索，吞吐量分别提高了4.08倍和1.82倍，比fpgaConvNet提高了4.08倍和比ATHEENA提高了1.82倍。
AI.conclusion: ExitLUT通过减少LUT使用量和优化算术路径，提高了基于FPGA的神经网络的性能和效率。

title: Antares-Smaug: Adversarial Names, Tokens and Attack Rewrites: Sanitisers Miss Unseen Generalisations
summary: Laya is an open decision model: given a text, a question and K named options with descriptions, it returns one probability per option in a single pass, and software may act on the answer unseen. We attack six Laya models with 81 programmatic edits of 566 synthetic items (injected sentences, label leaks, edited descriptions, decoy options, invisible and look-alike characters, floods) and report the share of correctly answered items hijacked or lost, with bootstrap intervals. Attack wordings that no defence was built from win the attacker's option on 59% of items for released Laya and 36% for fine-tune v1 (trained on 109 written injections). An injection works through the option name: a sentence naming an option steers the released model even when negated (32%), while an imperative naming no option does not (5%). Option descriptions barely matter (2%). Character edits alone cost v1 up to 72% of right answers. A sanitiser frozen before any held-out result cuts the attacks it was built from by 72% but held-out sentence attacks by 27%, and an attacker who picks the best of 34 held-out strings per item restores success to 84% (mean string 18%). The same oracle takes the model fine-tuned on the four build families of injected sentences from 5% (mean string) to 58%. Fine-tuning on build families only (against an unchanged-rows control) cuts held-out sentence attacks (three held-out families) from 33% to 3% but character edits only from 25% to 20%. A label-free check that deletes the option names and measures the shift flags held-out sentence attacks (AUROC 0.95) but not character edits (0.46), and thresholds set on dev schemas for 5% false alarms gave 8% to 18% on an unseen schema and other languages. All data are synthetic with LLM labels, on one backbone. Several planned runs (other checkpoints, a second seed, some fine-tunes) were not run.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了六种Laya模型在81个程序化编辑下的防御情况，发现特定攻击方式能让攻击选项获胜，而选项描述几乎没有影响，字符编辑则显著降低了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在评估Laya模型在面对有针对性的攻击时的防御能力，识别潜在的脆弱点和改进方向。
AI.method: 研究人员通过修改合成数据集（包含注入句子、标签泄露、修改描述、诱饵选项、透明和相似字符、数据洪水等）对六种Laya模型进行了81次攻击。
AI.result: 研究发现，攻击选项名称在特定情况下能成功获胜，特别是当选项名称被直接命名或间接否定时。字符编辑对模型性能有显著影响。通过冻结 sanitiser 和使用特定字符串选择策略，可以有效减少攻击效果。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了Laya模型在面对某些特定攻击时的脆弱性，并提出了应对策略，强调了模型在面对新数据时的泛化能力和需要加强的方面。

title: Instantiation of Human Values in Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models are increasingly embedded in everyday visual culture, yet little is known about how they translate abstract human values into visual scenes. We address this gap by introducing a framework, grounded in Schwartz's theory of basic human values, for studying value instantiation: the process by which ideals such as success, care, or freedom are visually realized. Using person-centered prompts from 70 positive and negative value items, we generate 28,000 images across four state-of-the-art T2I models. We identify visual prototypes, recurring combinations of subjects, actions, and settings, and use them to quantify how narrowly models instantiate these values and how this breadth compares with human descriptions of the same items. We then map these prototypes onto a taxonomy of social configurations spanning setting, sociality, mode of engagement, and social register, revealing what is systematically foregrounded or omitted. Our results show that T2I models produce far more concentrated representations than humans do when describing the same values. They default to a hyper-individualistic, adult-centric worldview, reproducing value-specific associations, such as achievement tied to formal institutional settings or hedonism rendered as affluent consumption, while marginalizing everyday labor, relational care, and non-adult perspectives. As a proof of concept, we show that these structural gaps can guide a steering method that diversifies outputs without modifying the original prompt.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用Text-to-image模型生成了大量图像，分析了模型如何视觉化人类价值观，并与人类描述进行对比，揭示了模型倾向于生产集中、刻板的价值观表示，反映了特定的社会视角。
AI.motivation: 研究现状表明，尽管Text-to-image（T2I）模型在日常视觉文化中越来越普遍，但对其如何将抽象的人类价值视觉化进行研究的理解还很有限。因此，作者提出了一种基于Schwartz理论的基本人类价值观框架来研究价值的视觉化过程。
AI.method: 使用来自70个正面和负面价值观项目的基于个人中心的提示，生成了28,000张图像，用以分析多个最先进的T2I模型。通过识别视觉原型等手段来量化T2I模型如何视觉化这些价值观，并与人类描述进行对比。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，T2I模型在描述相同价值观时产生的表示比人类更为集中。模型倾向于保持超个体主义和成人导向的世界观，再现特定价值观的具体关联，例如成就与正式机构环境的联系或享乐被描绘为奢华消费，而日常劳动、人际关系关怀和非成人视角则被边缘化。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，T2I模型在可视化人类价值观方面存在结构性差距，并提出了一种引导方法来丰富模型生成的多样性，而无需修改原始提示。

title: Look Where Camouflage Breaks: Concealment-Guided Observation for Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: A camouflaged object can blend into its surroundings at one scale and become distinguishable at another. Yet a region's apparent ambiguity gives limited guidance on which observation would resolve it. The challenge is to connect the form and scale of concealment to the evidence that a new view can reveal. We introduce CamoBreak, an active framework for camouflaged object detection guided by a Concealment Spectrum. From the image and current predictions, the spectrum measures regional resemblance and boundary ambiguity across comparison scales, distinguishing persistent concealment from separation emerging at finer or broader scales. These measurements guide crop selection from the already-captured image and recognition against global foreground and background references. An object-conditioned spatial preference then selects where local evidence should update the prediction and feature memory, retaining target corrections while suppressing background distractions. Accepted corrections reshape the next measurement, while predicted segmentation benefit determines whether to observe again. Experiments across encoder families and related segmentation tasks show consistent improvements. Targeted analyses support improved small-target recovery, multiple-object coverage, and selective evidence integration. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: CamoBreak 是一种通过 Concealment Spectrum 指导的主动框架，用于识别伪装对象。该框架通过比较不同尺度下的区域相似度与边界混淆度来区分持续伪装与在细化或宽化尺度上出现的分离。这些测量结果指导从已捕获图像中选择局部证据进行更新，以更好地识别目标并减少背景干扰。
AI.motivation: 当前关于伪装对象检测的研究主要依赖于固定尺度下的物体识别，而伪装对象在不同尺度下的表现形式不同。因此，需要一种能够根据伪装尺度变化进行灵活调整的检测方法。
AI.method: CamoBreak 使用 Concealment Spectrum 来评估伪装目标与背景在不同尺度下的相似度和边界混淆度。依据这些评估结果，选择局部证据进行更新，并改进预测和特征记忆，有效减少了背景干扰，提高了小目标识别率和多目标覆盖能力。
AI.result: CamoBreak 框架在不同编码器家族和相关分割任务中表现出了一致的性能改进，尤其在小目标恢复、多对象覆盖和证据集成的选择上表现出色。
AI.conclusion: 总结来说，CamoBreak 提出了一种新的伪装对象检测方法，通过 Concealment Spectrum 实现了对伪装尺度变化的识别和适应，显著提高了伪装目标的检测性能。

title: Translation Validation of SystemVerilog-to-SystemC RTL Conversion by Reading the Generated C++
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Code and results: https://github.com/mayurkubavat/svcc
summary: SystemC models of register-transfer level (RTL) designs are used for virtual platforms, firmware bring-up and simulation without a commercial license, and more of them now come from translators and language models. A wrong model usually compiles, and it usually agrees with the RTL. SystemVerilog evaluates an 8-bit sum in 8 bits while C++ evaluates it in 64, so a translation that forgets one truncation keeps a carry the RTL drops, and only inputs near the top of the range show it. I built svcc, an open-source SystemVerilog-to-SystemC converter, and my first check of its output read the generated C++ with SystemVerilog's rules. That check passed two wrong models. The check that replaced it gives the generated header the meaning C++17 and SystemC give it and turns undefined behavior into proof obligations. It prints what it read as SystemVerilog with every width change explicit, then proves that equivalent to a netlist of the source by induction over registers matched by name. On 50 author-written designs it proves 45 and reports 5 as outside its model. In a mutation experiment it accepted none of the 17 mutants that compiled SystemC showed to be wrong. Of 2,184 modules from 16 open-source code bases, 1,185 conversions match Verilator in random co-simulation and the check proves 600 of them. The same runs found defects in the front end, in svcc and in Verilator.

AI.tldr: 该论文描述了一种用于验证从SystemVerilog到SystemC转换正确性的新方法，该方法通过仿真和证明技术提高了转换的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 为了确保虚拟平台、固件启动和仿真中使用的SystemC模型与原RTL设计保持一致，并减少潜在的错误。
AI.method: 作者开发了一个名为svcc的开源转换工具，并提出了一种新的验证方法，该方法通过读取生成的C++源代码并用SystemVerilog的规则进行验证，以确保转换后的SystemC代码在所有方面都与原始设计一致。
AI.result: 该方法成功地通过了50个基于作者的原始设计中的45个，并在转换和验证过程中的其他多个设计和模块上也表现良好。此外，该方法在突变实验中完全拒绝了17个应被发现错误的设计，并准确找到了Verilator前端的一些缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 此研究表明，该验证方法在提高SystemVerilog到SystemC转换的准确性方面有效，并为硬件描述语言的跨工具一致性验证提供了新的可能性。

title: ContextLure: Exploiting Benign Conversation History for Indirect Prompt Injection
summary: As LLMs become more capable, agents can perform more complex tasks with tools and maintain longer interactions with users. These benign conversations contain evidence on task results, user concerns, and operational constraints. The risk is that attackers who can observe benign conversations (evidence) may construct stronger indirect prompt injections without increasing the attackers' control over prior turns or the later injection. However, we still lack a clear study of how effectively attackers can select and use this evidence. To address this gap, we introduce ContextLure, a red-teaming framework in which an attacker silently observes an existing benign conversation, extracts evidence, and constructs an injection. The challenges are twofold: (a) selecting useful evidence and (b) presenting it as reasons for an unauthorized action, without changing the prior benign conversation. To efficiently exploit (a) the effect of evidence on attack success, our framework selects evidence across 2 dimensions: User/System Preferences with 3 selection policies. And to enhance (b) the process of turning the selected information into the malicious request, we introduce an Urgency/Priority matrix with 4 rewriting strategies. Across the evaluated conditions, we reach 67.4% ASR on AgentDojo and 87.3% on InjecAgent. These results show that attackers can use benign interaction evidence in later attacks without first poisoning the benign conversation.

AI.tldr: 研究引入了一个名为ContextLure的框架，该框架允许攻击者从良性对话中提取证据，并构造恶意请求，而不会破坏对话的自然流畅。评估结果显示，攻击者可以利用良性交互证据进行攻击，而不需要先污染良性对话。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM的日益强大，代理可以通过工具执行更复杂的任务，并与用户保持更长的互动。这些良性对话为攻击者提供了一种不显眼的方式，从合法的交流中收集证据，然后通过构造间接的提示注入来实施攻击，而不是直接干预对话。
AI.method: 研究介绍了一个名为ContextLure的框架，其中包含两个关键组成部分：证据选择和信息转换。证据选择过程基于用户/系统的偏好，通过三种策略来优化证据的选择。信息转换则通过一个紧迫/优先矩阵，以及四种重写策略，将选中的信息转化为合理的恶意请求。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，攻击者在AgentDojo环境中达到了67.4%的攻击成功率，在InjecAgent环境中达到了87.3%的攻击成功率。这表明，攻击者能够在保持良性对话自然流畅的情况下利用良性交互证据进行攻击，而无需先污染良性对话的可信度。
AI.conclusion: 该论文展示了在不明显改变良性对话的情况下，攻击者如何利用良性对话中的证据进行攻击。通过使用ContextLure框架，研究证明了攻击者可以有效利用这种间接提示注入，这一发现对未来的对话系统安全提出了挑战。

title: The Date You Didn't Set: The System-Prompt Date as a Hidden Variable in LLM Evaluation
summary: The system prompt of many instruction-tuned models carries a date, usually today's, filled in automatically for conversational and agentic requests alike, so an unchanged evaluation can send a different prompt each day. In this paper, we explore how much this hidden input changes evaluation outcomes. Across six instruction-tuned models and four benchmarks, with prompts, decoding, and configuration fixed, every model is affected: two plausible dates (2024--2026) switch a median $6.6\%$ of test items between correct and incorrect. Even rerunning the evaluation one day later flips about as many items as changing the batch size, although nothing in the setup was changed. In addition, using a grammar-constrained variant of Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) to search dates of any year, we find dates that cost the Llama-3.x models up to $36.5$ points of held-out accuracy. Beyond accuracy, switching to another plausible date alters LLM-judge verdicts and undoes $15$--$32\%$ of reproduced jailbreak successes on Llama-3.2-3B. Yet none of the eleven evaluation stacks we audit pins the date. With the date and the rest of the setup fixed, reruns reproduce byte-for-byte; we therefore recommend pinning, logging, and reporting the date.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了系统提示中隐藏日期如何影响指令调优模型的评估结果，发现日期变动会影响准确性和模型的判断，但现有评估体系未能识别这一因素。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在揭示隐藏在系统提示中的时间信息对指令调优模型评估结果的潜在影响，因为这些模型通常在每项请求中使用自动填充的日期作为提示的一部分。
AI.method: 研究人员在这项研究中测试了六个指令调优模型在四个基准测试下，使用固定提示、解码和配置，通过改变日期（范围为2024年至2026年）来探索其对评估结果的影响。此外，还使用了一种约束语法的贪婪坐标梯度（GCG）方法搜索任何年份的日期，评估其对Llama-3.x模型性能的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现，使用不同的可能年份（2024-2026）可以使中位数6.6%的测试项在正确和错误之间切换。对Llama-3.x模型进行的评估还发现了这样的日期，可能会导致高达36.5点的离线准确度下降。此外，改变日期还会影响LLM的评估判断，并可能影响到高达32%的重新产生的“牢笼破解”成功案例。
AI.conclusion: 尽管没有评估体系能够直接识别日期对模型性能的影响，但研究建议应固定、记录并报告所使用的日期，以确保评估结果的可重复性和透明度。

title: CoRe: Jointly Learning Contextual Representations for Understanding and Generation
summary: We introduce CoRe, in which understanding and generation jointly shape one contextual representation for images and one for text, trained from scratch. Each representation is read for understanding, conditions the other modality, and is the space in which that modality is generated by a continuous flow from Gaussian noise. With 383M parameters trained on CC12M and no pretrained language model, text encoder, or VAE at inference, CoRe matches a same-data contrastive-only baseline in global understanding and reaches COCO-30K FID 10.10, comparable to much larger generators built on pretrained components. In controlled comparisons at equal data and architecture, CoRe generates better in both directions (text to image and image to text) than a representation shaped by understanding alone and then frozen, and follows prompts better than generating in a space that understanding does not shape. In the other direction, with an attentive segmentation probe, on monocular depth, and when read by a frozen language model, CoRe surpasses the contrastive-only baseline: generation adds information that stronger readouts reach. Because generation runs inside the understanding representation, frozen real-image probes read and steer intermediate states and the model ranks its own samples without extra training. Because both modalities use continuous flows, both also distill to a few steps. Our controls indicate why one representation suffices: understanding organizes the representation semantically, while generation makes it retain more information.

AI.tldr: CoRe通过联合理解与生成机制，为图像和文本各自构建上下文表示，无需预训练模型或大量参数，在生成质量和指令跟随上优于单一理解驱动的模型。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在生成任务上通常依赖预训练组件，导致生成效果受限且模型庞大。CoRe旨在提出一个新的架构，通过联合理解与生成机制，促进跨模态信息的有效交流，同时减少对预训练组件的依赖。
AI.method: CoRe采用了一种新颖的方法，为图像和文本分别构建上下文表示，通过对两种表示的联合训练，实现理解与生成的相互促进。生成过程中，模态间的反馈可以促进更高质量的生成结果。
AI.result: CoRe在控制条件下，无论是在文本到图像还是图像到文本生成上，生成质量均优于采用单一理解驱动的模型。在COCO-30K FID上达到10.10的性能，与更大规模的生成器相当。此外，在特定任务如单目深度估计上也表现出色，生成内容更加丰富。
AI.conclusion: CoRe证明了联合理解与生成机制的有效性，能够提高生成任务的质量，同时减少对外部预训练组件的依赖。未来研究有望进一步验证和扩展这一观点。

title: RTLDetective: Agentic RTL Debugging through Dataflow Analysis and Simulation-Guided Fault Localization
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promise in RTL debugging, yet accurately localizing functional errors and generating reliable repairs remain challenging. We propose RTLDetective, a multi-agent framework that integrates signal dependency analysis, simulation-guided fault localization, and knowledge-based reasoning for automated RTL debugging and repair. RTLDetective constructs signal dependency graphs from RTL code and extracts failure information from waveform traces. A lightweight localizer agent predicts expected intermediate signal values and evaluates them through targeted simulation interventions, iteratively probing signal dependencies to isolate suspicious logic and identify potential fault locations. A debug agent combines this evidence with static analysis, a curated knowledge base of hardware design principles and RTL bug patterns, and reasoning to generate corrected RTL. To reduce inference overhead, the framework reuses cached context across debugging iterations. We evaluate RTLDetective on the MEIC benchmark, achieving an 86.1% fix rate, 13.9 percentage points above the best baseline, while making fewer LLM calls.

AI.tldr: RTLDetective 是一个多代理框架，通过信号依赖性分析、基于仿真的故障定位和基于知识的推理来实现自动RTL调试和修复。该框架在MEIC基准测试上实现了86.1%的修复率，比最佳基线高出13.9个百分点，同时减少了对大语言模型的调用。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）代理在RTL调试中展现出前景，但准确本地化功能性错误并生成可靠的修复仍然具有挑战性。RTLDetective旨在通过结合信号依赖性分析、基于仿真的故障定位和基于知识的推理，来简化RTL调试流程，从而提高修复的准确性和效率。
AI.method: RTLDetective框架包括构建信号依赖图、从波形跟踪提取故障信息、通过目标仿真干预预测预期中间信号值、并通过推理结合静态分析、硬件设计原则和 RTL bug 模式知识库来生成修正的 RTL。框架利用缓存上下文来减少推理开销。
AI.result: 在MEIC基准测试上，RTLDetective达到了86.1%的修复率，比最佳基线高出13.9个百分点，同时减少了大语言模型的调用次数。
AI.conclusion: RTLDetective证明了多代理框架在RTL自动调试和修复中的有效性，提供了比现有方法更高的修复成功率，同时降低了对大语言模型的依赖。

title: Learning What vs. Learning How: Decomposing Task and Interface Competence in Agentic Training
summary: LLM agents operate through harnesses that define system prompts, action formats, feedback loops, and resource constraints. A model may possess the knowledge needed to solve a task yet fail to express that knowledge through a particular harness. This raises a basic question: when a policy fails under a given harness, is it missing task knowledge or the competence to operate the interface? We distinguish two components of agentic competence: task competence, the knowledge and reasoning needed to solve a task, and interface competence, the ability to act on that knowledge through a given harness. Across four reasoning and agentic benchmarks, we show that harness-conditioned training yields vastly different outcomes depending on how these interact. Multi-harness distillation aggregates task knowledge from trajectories collected through different harnesses into a shared policy, but this knowledge is realised only when training preserves or improves competence on the inference-time interface. Otherwise, single-harness training can induce interference in interface competence, sometimes catastrophically collapsing performance on a held-out harness despite improvements in underlying task knowledge. To disentangle task and interface supervision, we introduce harness rehearsal: distillation on traces that carry minimal task knowledge while exercising the target interface. Cross-harness task supervision or rehearsal alone yields little gain, but their combination yields gains far larger than either: on BFCL V3 multi-turn with Qwen3-4B, they achieve 8.5% and 32.5% respectively, versus 58.8% together. Finally, on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is more robust than distillation to single-harness training: it does not substantially degrade performance on other harnesses, and interface competence acquired through multi-harness distillation persists through subsequent RL.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在不同‘缰绳’条件下训练大型语言模型（LLM）代理时，任务知识和界面操作能力之间的关系。研究表明，多‘缰绳’蒸馏可以将任务知识从不同‘缰绳’收集的轨迹中汇聚到共享策略中，但这种知识只在训练保留或改善了‘缰绳’推理接口的能力时才得以实现。单‘缰绳’训练有时会在界面操作能力方面引发干扰，甚至可能在保留任务知识的同时导致性能崩溃。引入了‘缰绳’复习来区分任务和界面的监督，多‘缰绳’任务监督与复习的结合可以显著提高性能。此外，基于策略的强化学习在面对单次训练时比蒸馏更稳健。
AI.motivation: 当前研究旨在解决在使用特定‘缰绳’条件下的大型语言模型代理表现不佳的问题。研究团队发现，单‘缰绳’训练有时会严重影响模型的界面操作能力，而多‘缰绳’蒸馏和‘缰绳’复习能够更有效地区分和提升任务知识与界面操作能力。
AI.method: 研究使用了四个推理和代理基准，探讨了不同‘缰绳’条件下代理的训练效果。首先，进行多‘缰绳’蒸馏，将来自不同‘缰绳’收集的任务知识汇总到共享策略中。然后，引入了‘缰绳’复习，对保留最小任务知识的轨迹进行蒸馏，以便更好地锻炼目标界面。最后，使用单次策略的强化学习方法，比较其与蒸馏结果的性能。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，多‘缰绳’蒸馏在某些情况下能够显著提高模型的表现，特别是在Qwen3-4B模型上，任务监督和复习结合使用时，改进效果尤为显著。同时发现，基于策略的强化学习方法更具鲁棒性，不会在转换不同‘缰绳’时显著降低性能。‘缰绳’复习在任务和界面能力上有着显著的提升效果。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法（特别是结合任务监督和复习）在多‘缰绳’情境下提高了代理的有效性。此外，基于策略的强化学习方法（如多‘缰绳’蒸馏后的继续训练）在面对单‘缰绳’训练时表现出更稳健的性能。

title: INCLUDE-2.0: Disentangling Knowledge Gaps in Multilingual LLM Evaluation
summary:
Current multilingual benchmarks cover only a fraction of the languages represented in modern pretraining corpora and often conflate language proficiency with the ability to answer questions grounded in specific regions and communities. We introduce INCLUDE-2.0, a large-scale benchmark for region-aware multilingual factual evaluation, which covers 91 languages from 86 countries (127 total language--country pairs), comprising over 220K curated samples drawn from native regional sources. Unlike existing benchmarks that often treat language as a proxy for region, IINCLUDE-2.0 distinguishes between questions whose answers are independent of context, vary by country, concern widely documented facts about a place, or depend on knowledge primarily expressed through local linguistic and cultural sources. Each item is annotated with its regional knowledge type and domain, and paired with an English translation, enabling controlled analysis of the relationship between language proficiency and possession of regional knowledge.
  Evaluating frontier and open-weight models on IINCLUDE-2.0, we find that aggregate multilingual accuracy masks substantial variation across regional knowledge types, languages, and regions. We find that frontier models perform worse on locally embedded knowledge than on widely documented facts about regions, with an average drop of ~14.5 points. We also show that for open-weight models, scale improves accuracy but does not reliably make performance invariant to whether a question is asked in English or its original language. INCLUDE-2.0 is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/epfl-nlp/include-2.0

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了名为INCLUDE-2.0的大型地区意识多语言事实评估基准，覆盖91种语言和127种语言-国家组合，包含超过22万个样本，旨在评估语言模型对特定地区知识的理解。实验结果显示，前沿模型在本地嵌入的知识上的表现不如对广泛记录的地区事实的表现，同时开放模型虽能通过扩大规模提升准确率，但并不能使性能不受问题语言影响。
AI.motivation: 为了弥补现有跨语言基准在地区意识和语言学习方面的不足，研究人员提出了INCLUDE-2.0，希望提供一个更全面的评估方法，特别是在地区相关的知识方面。
AI.method: 研究人员创建了INCLUDE-2.0，包含来自不同国家和地区的真实语言样本，每个样本都标注了其所属的知识类型和领域。评估了几个前沿和开放模型在该基准上的表现。
AI.result: 实验发现，前沿模型在本地嵌入的知识上的表现不如对广泛记录的地区事实的表现，且开放模型尽管能通过扩大规模提升准确率，但并不能使性能因问题语言不同而保持一致。
AI.conclusion: INCLUDE-2.0提供了一个更全面的多语言知识评估框架，有助于更好地理解语言模型在不同知识类型和语言背景下的表现差异。

title: Enhancing Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting with Feed-Forward Priors via Spectral Fusion and Distillation
summary: Gaussian splatting from sparse training views renders high-quality images near training views, but reconstruction quality degrades at distant regions, which are undersampled by the training set. Feed-forward novel view synthesis (NVS) models use strong learned priors to resample the scene from substantially different viewpoints, but they take more than ten times as long to render and produce high-frequency artifacts on out-of-domain scenes. We propose a plug-and-play method that enhances an existing sparse-view Gaussian model with a pretrained feed-forward NVS model. We observe that the two are complementary in the frequency domain: the prior is more accurate at low frequencies, and the Gaussians at high frequencies. The reliability of the prior relative to the Gaussians is inversely proportional to the image frequency, so the optimal fusion weight is a first-order low-pass filter with one parameter that can be fitted. Our key idea is then to intelligently fuse the reliable part of each of the two methods. To remove the slow feed-forward model at render time, we use these fused images as teachers and distill them back into Gaussians, balanced with supervision from input views. Our method improves the quality of various sparse-view Gaussian methods without sacrificing rendering speed, and our analysis works on different prior models. Project page: https://linwk20.github.io/spectral-fusion-gs/

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种增强稀疏视图Gaussian模型的方法，通过与预训练的前馈新型视图合成模型融合，改善了不同频率区域的表现，同时保持渲染速度。
AI.motivation: 当前方法在训练视图附近性能良好，但远离训练视图的区域表现不佳；前馈新型视图合成模型虽然在不同视角上表现优异，但渲染速度慢且会产生高频伪影。
AI.method: 提出了一种将现有稀疏视图Gaussian模型与预训练的前馈新型视图合成模型融合的方法。结合两者在频率域的优势，并通过融合权重调整，利用融合后的图像作为教师进行模型优化。
AI.result: 该方法在保持快速渲染的同时，提升了稀疏视图Gaussian方法的重建质量，且对不同的先验模型具有普适性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将稀疏视图Gaussian模型与前馈新型视图合成模型融合，该方法能够在保持快速渲染的同时，提升稀疏视图下高分辨率场景的重建质量。

title: MOSAIC: Memory-Organized Search with Anti-Imitation Crossover for Training-Free Microarchitecture Optimization
summary: Large language models can generate cache-replacement policies. The central challenge is to retain performance on workloads excluded from the search. In our adaptations of published search methods, generated code resembles established policies, with cosine similarities of 0.78-0.84. The wider comparison also shows held-out harmonic-mean instructions-per-cycle (IPC) losses of 1.0-2.4%. We present MOSAIC, a search controller that improves policies without updating language-model weights. It stores concise lessons from previous evaluations rather than repeatedly copying high-scoring code. When improvement stops, it selects two high-scoring policies whose code embeddings differ and asks the model to combine their mechanisms. Novelty prompts and model rotation support this search; controlled memory edits test how the stored lessons affect later proposals. We evaluate cache replacement using intervention-level cross-validation and a wider comparison on ten memory-intensive SPEC2006 workloads. MOSAIC reaches a 51.1% peak hit rate on the primary search workload and a 47.9% held-out mean in the intervention study. Removing crossover reduces these values by 7.8 and 21.8 percentage points, respectively, whereas the tested stronger model improves the held-out mean by 0.4 points. In the wider IPC comparison, MOSAIC has the smallest held-out gap (0.31%) and the highest held-out IPC among the evaluated LLM configurations. Adapting the same controller to data prefetching gives a 4.8% mean speedup over the LRU reference configuration. The accompanying corpus contains 10,687 generated policies with lineage and per-iteration prompt logs.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用大型语言模型自动生成缓存替换策略，并提出了一种名为MOSAIC的搜索控制器，能够提升缓存替换策略而不更新语言模型权重，对SPEC2006等十个工作负载的评估显示MOSAIC策略具有较强效果。
AI.motivation: 由于传统的缓存替换算法难以应对多元和动态的工作负载，论文旨在探索利用大型语言模型自动生成和优化缓存替换策略的方法，以提升系统的性能。
AI.method: 通过训练现有的语言模型生成缓存替换策略，并通过MOSAIC控制器进行策略改进，该控制器存储过去策略评估的教训而非重复复制高分策略代码，当改进停滞时，它会选择两个高分且代码差异较大的策略让模型来整合它们的方法。
AI.result: MOSAIC在主要搜索工作负载上达到了51.1%的峰值命中率，在干预研究中达到了47.9%的平均值。去除交叉操作会分别降低这些值7.8和21.8个百分点。在IPoC比较中，MOSAIC具有最小的保持输出差距（0.31%）并具有最高的保持输出IPoC，即使在对数据预取的应用中，MOSAIC仍比LRU参考配置平均提高了4.8%。
AI.conclusion: MOSAIC方法能够有效提升缓存替换策略的表现，具有潜在的应用价值，并为进一步研究提供了新的思路。

title: Taxi: Analyzing Agents at (Real) Scale
summary: In this technical report, we present Taxi -- a system for debugging, clustering, and monitoring agents at scale. Taxi scales to millions of steps efficiently. This is made possible by a combination of scalable analysis methods. Taxi relies primarily on clustering to generate a taxonomy over steps for a structured overview of the data, and provides full SQL access for engineers and automated agents to ask complex questions. Clustering and querying are best used together in a hybrid pipeline guided by a coding agent. Taxi also includes an experimental integration of Jev-style decision models: models that map state and bounded questions directly to typed, probabilistic decisions. They add low-cost semantic routing and evaluation where embeddings or literal queries alone are insufficient. In addition, Taxi provides an extensible ecosystem, including built-in evaluators and daily reports. To accommodate growth, Taxi is designed to be modular, hackable, and easy to plug-and-play for individuals and teams.

AI.tldr: Taxi 是一个用于大规模代理调试、聚类和监控的系统，能够处理数百万步骤，结合了可扩展的分析方法，并集成了 Jev 类型的决策模型，提供了 SQL 访问以灵活地进行查询，系统设计具有模块化、可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 随着代理数量的增加，传统的调试和监控工具难以处理大量的步骤数据。因此，开发 Taxi 以解决此问题，通过高效的数据处理方法和查询功能来管理和分析大数据集。
AI.method: Taxi 采用了高效的数据聚类方法生成步骤分类，以提供有结构的数据概览，并且为用户和自动化代理提供完整的 SQL 访问，结合编码代理的指导形成了混合数据分析流水线。此外，通过集成 Jev 类型决策模型，提供基于状态和问题映射的低开销语义路由和评估。
AI.result: Twitter 已成功将 Taxi 集成到其主要产品中，显著提高了系统处理和管理大量代理数据的能力，包括但不限于故障排查、自动化逻辑编写和日常报告。
AI.conclusion: Taxi 通过高效的方法和强大的功能，成功实现了大规模代理系统的调试、聚类和监控。未来仍有改进空间，以进一步增强系统集成和用户体验。

title: Directly Maximizing On-policy Expected Accepted Length for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a lightweight draft model to propose tokens for verification by a target model. Draft training commonly optimizes token-level distribution alignment, but this does not directly optimize the length of the accepted prefix: once a draft token is rejected, all subsequent draft tokens are discarded. We propose FreDraft, an on-policy training method that directly maximizes the expected accepted length of drafts sampled from the current draft model. This objective accounts for first-rejection truncation and induces prefix-aware credit assignment, weighting each token by its contribution to the acceptance of the current and subsequent tokens. To optimize the objective efficiently, we analytically marginalize token-level acceptance rate, using the target model's vocabulary distribution to reduce gradient variance. We further redistribute part of this distribution-level gradient into an explicit penalty for sampled tokens whose probabilities are overestimated by the draft model, while preserving the expected gradient. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and target models show that FreDraft improves accepted length and decoding speedup over strong baselines, achieving faster on-policy training convergence.

AI.tldr: FreDraft 是一种直接最大化草案模型生成的序列被目标模型接受前缀长度的策略。它通过模型内部的分布级权重分配减少梯度方差，并引入惩罚项以减少概率预估误差。
AI.motivation: 现有的草案训练方法主要优化了 token 的分布一致性，未能直接优化生成序列的长度。FreDraft 通过优化草案模型生成的序列的接受长度来填补这一空白。
AI.method: FreDraft 采用了在线策略训练方法，在于目标模型的词汇分布中进行分析性边际化，降低梯度方差。同时，引入一个惩罚项，对于草案模型高估概率的样本进行惩罚，而在总体期望梯度上保持不变。
AI.result: 实验表明，FreDraft 在多个基准测试和目标模型上提高了接受长度和解码加速，实现了更快的在线策略训练收敛。
AI.conclusion: FreDraft 证明了一种有效的方法来改进规格化解码技术在大型语言模型推理中的性能，通过直接优化生成序列被目标模型接受的长度。

title: Tornado4D: Physics-Guided 4D Gaussian Reconstruction of a Laboratory Tornado from Sparse One-Sided Videos
summary: Characterizing how tornadoes evolve over space and time is critically important for understanding and preparing for these highly destructive weather events. Towards this end, we develop algorithms capable of forming time-resolved 3D reconstructions of laboratory smoke tornadoes from sparse one-sided videos. Even in a controlled environment, reconstruction is severely underconstrained: appearance is view dependent, motion is non-rigid, and the unobserved volume admits many geometries. We present Tornado4D, a physics-guided 4D Gaussian framework capable of reconstructing laboratory tornadoes from sparse, one-sided videos. Tornado4D uses knowledge of the enclosure geometry to introduce rotational airflow field priors that constrain how the 3D structure evolves over time. These rotational priors allow us to reconstruct otherwise unobserved structure. We evaluate reconstruction accuracy by computing novel-view synthesis accuracy on a held out camera view: Tornado4D outperforms frame-by-frame 3DGS and video-based 4DGS by a considerable margin.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Tornado4D的算法，能够从稀疏的一侧视频中重建实验室烟尘龙卷风的时变3D结构。
AI.motivation: 本文致力于研究如何通过数据驱动的方法了解并应对这些极具破坏性的气旋，尤其是在限制条件下，通过算法从视角受限的视频中重建龙卷风3D结构。
AI.method: Tornado4D采用基于物理的4D高斯框架，利用了解围界几何形状的信息，引入旋转气流的先验知识来约束3D结构随时间的演变。
AI.result: 通过在未使用的相机视角上进行新颖视图合成功效性的评估，Tornado4D的性能明显优于逐帧3DGS和基于视频的4DGS。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了基于物理的重建方法在龙卷风3D结构重建中的有效性，并为未来的气象灾害预警提供了可能的解决方案。

title: DELTA: Diagnosing Exploration Lineages via Twin-path Alignment - What Can Contrasting Design Paths Reveal About Microarchitectural Behavior?
summary:
Architects have two mature instruments for performance work. Top-Down analysis tells them where a design loses its pipeline slots, and design-space exploration (DSE) tells them which configuration scores best. Neither explains why a search stops improving: why a backend-bound design rejects a prefetcher that the bottleneck label recommends, or why a capacity increase that helped in one configuration hurts in the next. This paper argues that the evidence needed to answer such questions is already produced during exploration and then discarded. Every parent-child edge in an exploration tree is a controlled intervention: one knob changes, the rest of the design is held fixed, and a cycle-level simulator measures the outcome. When the same edit helps under one parent and hurts under another, aligning the two parents localizes the interaction that decides its sign.
  We present DELTA, a simulator-grounded root-cause analysis tool that builds a Design Memory of such interventions during exploration and lets an architect query it afterwards. Each record stores the full parent configuration, the single applied edit, the measured and predicted IPC, a Top-Down breakdown from StallLens, our gem5 implementation of Top-Down, and its lineage. Unlike evolutionary LLM search, which keeps only high-scoring programs, DELTA keeps failed edges as evidence. The same memory also makes exploration efficient: on four SPEC CPU2017 workloads, the full system raises IPC by 55.5% in 22 simulated designs for $1.56 of model cost, predicts the IPC of its own proposals to within 3.3%, and keeps improving after a bottleneck-guided search stalls. A root-cause query over the recorded history led us to a usefulness-throttled variant of the Best-Offset prefetcher that improves IPC by 1.37% over the original in matched configurations.

AI.tldr: DELTA通过记录DSE过程中每个干预措施的详细信息，提供了一种设计记忆与根因分析工具，帮助架构师深入了解干预措施的结果，并识别设计中的瓶颈，即使在性能不再提升时也持续优化。
AI.motivation: 当前的设计分析工具仅指出性能瓶颈定位和设计选择的结果，但无法解释某些设计干预措施为何在不同情景下产生不同效果。本文旨在通过记录和分析这些干预步骤来提供更为深入的理解。
AI.method: DELTA工具通过使用详细的记录进行干预案例标记，并将这些记录存储在一个设计记忆中。它使用一个自定义的StallLens模型对干预进行分析，并支持用户查询干预案例的历史记录。工具利用设计记忆预测新设计提的IPC，并继续优化直至搜索停滞。
AI.result: 在SPEC CPU2017基准测试上，DELTA工具通过设计记忆提高了系统IPC 55.5%，预测自身建议的IPC精度达96.7%，并且能继续改善即便在特定瓶颈导向搜索停滞后。它还通过记录的干预案例发现了一个可以提升0.87% IPC的可调制偏移法替换版本。
AI.conclusion: DELTA工具在设计探索过程中不仅收集干预的详细信息以进行深入分析，还通过设计记忆提升了系统的性能，并通过案例研究展示了它对于提升设计效率和性能的有效性。

title: SpatialCraft: Evolving Procedural Intelligence from Experience and Skills for Spatial Reasoning Agents
summary: Spatial reasoning agents increasingly rely on external tools, such as 3D reconstruction, segmentation, and geometric computation, to answer questions that a multimodal large language model (MLLM) cannot resolve from pixels alone. Tool access, however, shifts the bottleneck to orchestration: the agent must decide which tools to call, in what order, and how to interpret their outputs, yet a stateless agent repeats the same mistakes across tasks. We ask whether a frozen tool-using agent can improve its orchestration from its own interaction history, without parameter updates. We present SpatialCraft, a self-evolving framework that maintains two forms of external knowledge: Experiences, condition-action tactics distilled by contrasting rollouts of the same task, and Skills, multi-step procedures with explicit activation and termination conditions. Three designs couple the two streams. Experiences can be anchored to a Skill, appearing only while it is active rather than once per task. A Contrastive Utility Score estimates each Experience's effect by randomly withholding it across rollouts of the same task, separating its contribution from task difficulty, and Experiences with consistently positive utility are consolidated into the Skills they support. Across five spatial benchmarks and four backbones, SpatialCraft achieves the best accuracy in all 20 settings, showing that a frozen agent can learn to orchestrate spatial tools from its own experience.

AI.tldr: 研究提出了一种名为SpatialCraft的自我演进框架，该框架通过维护经验与技能来提升外部工具的调用能力，这些经验与技能均来自于与任务的互动历史。实验结果显示，即使是在冻结状态下，该代理也能从自身经验中学会如何更好地调用空间工具。
AI.motivation: 鉴于空间推理代理在面对复杂问题时需要依赖外部工具辅助，但这些工具的调用却成为瓶颈。研究指出，通过利用代理自身的交互历史，可以优化工具选择和组合，实现在冻结状态下的进步。
AI.method: 研究提出了一个自我演进的框架SpatialCraft，其中包括两种类型的外部知识：经验（经验性策略）和技能（多步操作规程），并通过三种设计来实现经验与技能的耦合。
AI.result: SpatialCraft在五个空间基准测试和四种模型架构下的20种设置中都取得了最优的精度，证明了在冻结状态下，代理可以利用自身经验学会如何更好地调用空间工具。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了通过利用代理自身的交互历史，即使在不更新参数的情况下，代理也可以学习到如何有效地利用外部工具，从而提升其整体性能。

title: scOPD: Routed On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM-Based Single-Cell Annotation
summary:
Motivation: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for single-cell annotation, but existing training methods mainly rely on scalar outcome rewards that provide limited supervision for intermediate biological reasoning. Batch-level annotation is particularly challenging because it requires jointly resolving local cell identities and a global one-to-one matching constraint, such that one local error can affect the entire assignment. Moreover, a single inference pass provides insufficient evidence for locating uncertain predictions. These limitations call for fine-grained reasoning supervision during training and uncertainty-aware refinement during inference.
  Results: To address these challenges, we propose scOPD, an on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM-based single-cell annotation. After reasoning fine-tuning, scOPD adaptively routes qualified rollouts to reward-based optimization, while erroneous rollouts receive privileged token-level supervision from successful sibling trajectories. During inference, rollout disagreement triggers constraint-aware pairwise refinement of uncertain assignments. Across CellPuzzles and four out-of-domain disease datasets, scOPD consistently improves the performance of diverse LLM backbones, achieving average cell-level and batch-level accuracies of 81.71% and 44.49% with Qwen3-8B.
  Availability and Implementation: Code and data are available at https://github.com/YuZhiyin/scOPD.

AI.tldr: scOPD 是一种针对大规模语言模型（LLMs）在单细胞注释中的自蒸馏框架，通过适应性地路由合格和错误的 rollout，并在推理过程中使用约束感知的两两细化，从而提高了细胞和批处理级别的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的训练方法主要依赖于量化目标奖励，这为生物中间逻辑推理提供了有限的监督。批处理级别的注释尤为具有挑战性，因为需要同时解决局部细胞身份和全局一对一匹配约束问题，其中局部错误会影响整个分配。此外，单次推理传递提供的证据不足，不足以定位不确定预测。这些限制促使我们在训练中引入精细粒度的推理监督，并在推理中引入不确定性感知的精炼。
AI.method: scOPD 提出了一种 on-policy 自蒸馏框架，首先通过推理微调，然后将合格的路线流引导到基于奖励的优化，错误的路线流则从成功的兄弟轨迹中获得令牌级监督。在推理过程中，通过分歧触发约束感知的两两细化。
AI.result: scOPD 在多个数据集上展示了其优越性，涵盖了 CellPuzzles 和四个跨域疾病数据集。它提高了多种 LLM 后端的表现，在细胞级别和批处理级别的准确率平均达到了 81.71% 和 44.49%，其中 Qwen3-8B 模型达到了优异的 94.26% 和 72.58% 准确率。
AI.conclusion: scOPD 通过引入细粒度的推理监督和不确定性感知的推理精炼方法，有效提升了大规模语言模型在单细胞注释任务上的性能。

title: Which Ellipses Are Outlines of a Given Ellipsoid? A Ratio Test with Unknown Focal Length
comment: 36 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables; supplementary material included as an ancillary file. Submitted to SIAM Journal on Imaging Sciences. Code: https://github.com/michael-werman/realizability-code
summary: When is an image ellipse the outline of a given ellipsoid with semi-axes $a <= b <= c? For a camera with square pixels, zero skew and known principal point, we show that it is an outline at focal length $f$ exactly when a cone ratio kappa(f), computed from two eigenvalues, is at most a/c; the middle semi-axis b plays no role. With f unknown, the admissible focal lengths form an interval; whether it is empty is decided by the smallest cone ratio over $f$, which, when attained, is obtained from an explicit quartic. The interval is bounded above only when the principal point is closer to the long axis of the ellipse than to its short axis. Thus one ellipse can rule out ellipsoids that are too round, never ones that are too elongated, and none if the principal point is unknown. Simulations and 45 Cassini images of Saturn's moons support the test.

AI.tldr: 研究了视角为方形像素、无偏斜且主点已知的情况下，相机焦距与给定椭圆体轮廓形成的椭圆之间的关系。通过计算两个特征值产生的锥比kappa(f)，可以确定焦距是否满足条件。这一范围可能是空的，这取决于主点的位置。
AI.motivation: 分析拍摄到的图像是否为给定椭球体的轮廓，特别是当相机具有特定的几何特性时（如方形像素，零偏斜）。研究目的是理解不同焦距如何影响图像轮廓的匹配，以及主点不确定性如何影响结果。
AI.method: 通过数学建模和计算两个特征值产生的锥比kappa(f) 来确定图像椭圆是否为给定椭球体的轮廓。分析了不同焦距条件下的适用性，考虑了主点的已知情况和未知情况。
AI.result: 证明了当且仅当焦距f满足特定条件时，特定焦距的椭圆可以作为给定椭球体的轮廓。通过最小锥比kappa(f) 来决定图像中的椭圆是否可以表示给定椭圆体。模拟实验和对卡西尼号拍摄的土卫球图像的支持表明方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 在给定的相机模型和椭球体条件下，可以准确地确定图像中的椭圆是否为该椭球体的轮廓。研究为未来处理由不同焦距或主点不确定性引起的类似图像提供了新的框架和工具。

title: AgentDRC: Multi-Agent Algorithms for Spatially-Aware Automated DRC Correction
summary: Design Rule Checking (DRC) error fixing remains a time-consuming bottleneck in physical design, often requiring manual intervention despite advanced EDA optimizations. Existing LLM-agent approaches fall short due to redundant contextual shapes, limited spatial reasoning over raw coordinates, and inefficient flat layout representations. We propose AgentDRC, which formulates iterative DRC correction as a multi-agent algorithm and introduces a spatial-aware verification and correction algorithm that reconstructs structured spatial relations among critical shapes and validates fixes through geometric and semantic constraint checking. The system coordinates four specialized agents to perceive multi-level, multi-modal geometric features, filter irrelevant shapes, and iteratively correct violations. Experiments show that AgentDRC achieves up to 30.4% pass@1 and 55.7% pass@5 on challenging violations, with 13.8% pass@5 improvement over the best baseline. We will open-source all code and benchmark tasks upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: AgentDRC 提出了一种多智能体的方法来解决物理设计中的 DRC 错误，通过重建关键形状的结构空间关系并验证修复结果，实现了在复杂错误上的高通过率，并且在准确性上有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 当前现有的 LLM 前端设计工具在处理冗余上下文形状、空间关系推理和扁平化布局表示的效率上存在不足，导致 DRC 错误修正成为耗时瓶颈。
AI.method: AgentDRC 采用多智能体算法，引入了空间感知的验证与修正算法，通过重建关键形状之间的结构空间关系，并通过几何和语义约束检查验证修复。
AI.result: AgentDRC 实验结果显示，在具有挑战性的错误中，通过率提升至最高30.4%，@5 through 率提高了13.8%，超过了最佳基线。
AI.conclusion: AgentDRC 提供了一种有效的多智能体算法来解决 DRC 错误，具有较高的通过率和效率。

title: Evaluating Frontier-Model Agent Skills with Open-Weight Models in a Science Gateway
summary: Scientific analyses that span many jobs and computing sites depend on workflow management systems to run reliably, but writing a production workflow requires expertise in such a system, which many domain scientists do not have. Coding agents can supply this expertise when they are guided by skills and packaged procedures for recurring tasks. We wrote skills and specialist agents for the Pegasus workflow management system with a frontier model, and the PegasusAI Studio science gateway offers them to scientists through a chat interface. New users without frontier-model credits need an open-weight model, served at no cost on research cyberinfrastructure, but skills written for a frontier model may not work with an open-weight solution. This paper presents a method for adapting such skills. An evaluation harness drives the real gateway as a user would, scores the workflows the agent builds, and feeds recurring failures back to the frontier model that maintains the skills. We evaluated 21 open-weight models on 17 tasks. The five highest-scoring models are close in quality after one trial per task, and their median response times differ twelvefold. In repeated trials with the best of the three open-weight models, we repeated scores of 0.76 on workflow building against 0.82 for Claude. The harness led to five changes to the initial skills. We also identify challenges in evaluating agents within operational systems: evaluation failures can be mistaken for model failures, and agents can circumvent experimental controls within their privilege domain. In a controlled ablation, an initially significant effect disappeared when the restrictions were properly enforced.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种由技能和专用代理组成的适应方法，用于在Pegasus工作流管理系统的开放权重模式下优化工作流构建。尽管多试次评估表明最高得分模型在质量上相差不大，但最佳模型表现出快十二倍的响应时间。
AI.motivation: 领域科学家通常不具备编写生产级工作流所需的高级工作流管理系统的知识，而现有的工作流管理系统缺乏简化使用体验的方法。
AI.method: 作者为Pegasus工作流管理系统的前端模型撰写技能和专用代理，并开发了一个评估框架来驱动实际的科学网关，评估代理构建的工作流，并根据回归反馈更新技能。
AI.result: 评估结果表明，尽管不同模型的质量在单次任务试次上相似，但最佳模型的响应时间比其他模型快了十二倍，而且在多次试次中，作者注意到工作流构建分数有提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一个有效的方法来适应和优化工作流技能，并展示了在开放权重模型下提升工作流构建质量的实际应用案例。同时也指出了评估代理在实际操作系统的挑战，例如将评估失败误判为模型问题，以及代理可能绕过实验控制等问题。

title: RECAP: Training Long-horizon LLM Agents with Context Compaction
summary: Context compaction enables large language model agents to tackle long-horizon tasks within limited context budgets by replacing interaction histories with compressed summaries. However, learning effective compaction jointly with the agent policy remains challenging, as summaries affect task success over many subsequent interactions. We introduce RECAP, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework based on the principle that a summary should preserve the behavior induced by the original interaction history. We formalize this principle with a behavior distortion objective that measures the divergence between the agent's subsequent behavior under compressed and original contexts. We show that the gradient of the distortion objective decomposes into two complementary learning signals: distortion-based reward for summary generation and self-distillation for subsequent actions. Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that RECAP consistently outperforms the task-reward-only RL baselines on both environments, leading to an absolute improvement of 4.6% and 4.3% on BrowseComp-plus and SWE-bench Verified, respectively. Ablations further highlight the value of jointly supervising summary generation and post-compaction behavior for RECAP.

AI.tldr: RECAP通过引入行为失真目标，实现了一个基于强化学习的摘要生成框架，从而改善了大型语言模型在长期任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 为了解决语言模型在处理长期任务时因上下文预算限制导致的历史交互记录过长问题，通过生成压缩摘要来优化模型性能。传统的仅通过任务回报进行训练的方法难以直接优化生成的有效摘要。
AI.method: RECAP框架定义了一个行为失真目标，衡量压缩摘要与原始交互记录在后续行为上的差异，通过分解梯度为两个互补的信号：基于失真的奖励信号用于摘要生成和自我蒸馏信号用于后续行为。
AI.result: RECAP在Qwen3.5-4B环境中，相比于仅使用任务回报的基线方法，分别在BrowseComp-plus和SWE-bench Verified环境中实现了4.6%和4.3%的绝对性能改进。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明RECAP通过对摘要生成和压缩后的后续行为共同监督，有效提升了大型语言模型在长短期任务中的整体性能。

title: Ground, Guide, Act: Improving VLA Spatial Generalization with Multimodal Foundation Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models effectively learn action policies from robot demonstrations, but struggle to generalize to changes in object positions and task goals. General multimodal foundation models (MFMs) offer complementary scene understanding and spatial reasoning, but remain slow and unreliable for direct fine-grained control. To understand how MFMs can improve VLA spatial generalization, we conduct a systematic capability analysis across multiple VLA architectures using atomic-stage interventions, revealing that many failures stem from poor target grounding and global spatial routing, while local manipulation skills remain largely usable. Based on these findings, we propose MFM-VLA, a selective collaboration framework in which an MFM provides target grounding and spatial guidance, controllers execute free-space motion, and the VLA retains control over fine-grained manipulation. We fine-tune the VLA with action-chunk-level dense geometric captions and perturbed-state recovery data to improve local guidance following and recovery from unfamiliar handoff states. A development-calibrated capability router selects between direct VLA execution and MFM-assisted execution to avoid unnecessary intervention. Across LIBERO-PRO, ALOHA-Sim-PRO, RoboCasa365, and real-world chemistry tasks, MFM-VLA improves success rates by 14.9, 74.0, 3.6, and 30.9 percentage points, respectively, over the corresponding base VLA. The project page is available at https://tom-zgt.github.io/MFM-VLA

AI.tldr: MFM-VLA 提出了一种选择性协作框架，通过 MFM 提供目标 grounding 和空间指导，控制器执行自由空间运动，VLAs 留下对细粒度操作的控制权，以此改善空间泛化。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在探索如何利用多模态基础模型（MFMs）来改进视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的空间泛化能力。
AI.method: 通过对多种 VLA 架构进行系统的能力分析，并使用原子级干预方法研究了 MFMs 在 VLA 空间泛化中的潜在能力。随后，提出 MFM-VLA 框架，包括 MFM 用于目标 grounding 和空间指导，控制器用于执行自由空间运动，VLAs 保留对细粒度操作的控制。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，MFM-VLA 在 LIBERO-PRO、ALOHA-Sim-PRO、RoboCasa365 和现实世界化学任务中的成功率分别提高了 14.9、74.0、3.6 和 30.9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: MFM-VLA 提供了一种有效的改进视觉-语言-动作模型空间泛化能力的方法，并且在实际应用中表现出显著的性能提升。

title: Native Block-Quantized Matrix Multiplication and Explicit K/V Residency with Dual-View Access for LLM Inference on RISC-V Vector Processors
summary: Some key execution states in large language model inference persist across multiple instructions and are difficult to express and exploit within RVV semantics centered on individual operations. We define specialization boundaries according to data-state lifetimes and propose Quantized Block Streams (QBS) and Attention/KV Context (AKV) while preserving RVV programmability. QBS organizes native-block format processing, block traversal, integer computation, and ordered FP32 accumulation into a unified execution process, whereas AKV maintains local K/V residency and supplies operand views aligned with the computation direction while leaving Attention arithmetic on RVV. Cycle-accurate RTL evaluation shows that QBS achieves geometric-mean speedups of 35.68x and 51.34x for projection Compute and Matmul, respectively, while AKV achieves a 1.45x geometric-mean speedup over Tiled RVV for Decode Attention. Compared with the baseline, the complete design increases total area by 12.65%; on the evaluated projection workloads, throughput per area and energy efficiency improve by 46.63x and 19.78x, respectively. Further evaluation demonstrates applicability across multiple block-quantization formats and across models with different Attention organizations.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过定义特定的数据状态边界，提出了Quantized Block Streams (QBS) 和 Attention/KV Context (AKV)，以优化大语言模型推理中的执行状态，并在硬件上实现了显著的速度提升。
AI.motivation: 当前的执行状态难以用RVV单一操作的语义来表达和利用，因此需要构建新的优化方法。
AI.method: 研究提出了QBS和AKV来优化数据状态，并在硬件描述语言（RTL）上进行了准确性评估。
AI.result: QBS和AKV分别在投影计算和矩阵乘法中实现了35.68x和51.34x的几何平均加速，Decode Attention的几何平均加速为1.45x。与基线相比，总面积增加了12.65%，吞吐量和能效分别提高了46.63x和19.78x。
AI.conclusion: 该设计提升了不同模型的执行效率，并适用于多种量化的块格式。

title: XRL4T1D: A Post-hoc Explainability Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Type 1 Diabetes Management
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures. GenAI for Health Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) requires lifelong insulin therapy, and reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for automated dosing in the UVA/Padova simulator. However, the decisions of RL controllers remain difficult to interpret. We present XRL4T1D, a post-hoc explainability framework for evaluating pretrained insulin-dosing policies without retraining. Each policy uses 60 minutes of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) and administered-insulin history, sampled every 5 minutes, to recommend insulin. We use SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to compare the importance of CGM and insulin-history inputs and summarize insulin-history attributions over three 20-minute windows motivated by insulin-on-board. We assess whether these attributions correspond to policy-output sensitivity through targeted input replacement and compare temporal rankings with TimeSHAP. In all 80 patient-policy-mask-size cases, replacing the highest-attribution inputs changes the normalized insulin recommendation more than replacing the lowest-attribution or random inputs. The highest-attribution insulin-history window is also the most output-sensitive in 115 of 120 patient-policy-scenario configurations, and KernelSHAP and TimeSHAP select the same top window in 111 of 120. Applying XRL4T1D to PPO and G2P2C across 20 virtual patients, we find that both controllers rely predominantly on CGM history, especially G2P2C. However, the distribution of insulin-history importance across recent, middle, and older windows varies by cohort, explainer, and analysis settings, without a consistent separation between controllers. Global feature-attribution rankings remain stable under the tested observation corruptions. These results show why attribution fidelity, temporal reproducibility, and controller-comparison robustness should be assessed separately.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了XRL4T1D框架，用于评估预训练的胰岛素给药策略的解释性，而不进行重新训练。通过SHAP等方法评估并比较了连续血糖监测和胰岛素历史对未来胰岛素推荐的影响，以及这些影响的时间敏感度。
AI.motivation: 当前的RL控制器在T1D胰岛素治疗中的决策难以解释，本研究旨在提高解释性，确保控制器的输出可以被理解和信任。
AI.method: 研究使用XRL4T1D框架，采用SHAP等方法，分析了CGM数据和胰岛素历史数据对未来胰岛素推荐的重要性，并通过替换输入以及比较时间敏感度来进行评估。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，无论是在60分钟的数据样本中还是在不同的患者-策略-窗口大小配置下，致敏输入的替换都能显著改变胰岛素推荐。特别地，最高致敏的胰岛素历史窗口在115次中的120次配置中都是最敏感的。比较解释方法TimeSHAP和KernelSHAP也选择了同一窗口。两控制器，PPO和G2P2C，主要依赖CGM历史，但输入重要性的分布因组、解释方法和分析设置而异。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了胰岛素给药策略解释性的重要性，指出评估解释性、时间一致性和控制器间对比的鲁棒性需要分开进行。

title: RecipeADQA: A User-aware Question-Answering Dataset for Multi-Constraint Recipe Recommendation
comment: Accepted as Full Paper for presentation at the 22nd International Conference on Advanced Data Mining and Applications 2026 (ADMA 2026)
summary: Question-answering recipe recommendation tasks lack datasets with ground-truth labels. Existing methods often generate datasets from simple combinations of ingredient or tag constraints, leading to unnatural expressions and unreasonable constraints that are hard to reflect users' real preferences. This paper proposes a construction method for a benchmark-style QA dataset for natural-language recipe recommendation. Driven by real user behavior, our method integrates external user query and review data to extract fine-grained preference signals by LLMs and maps them onto a knowledge-graph-based tag schema, thereby constructing QA data consisting of preference and ingredient constraints. Besides, a greedy strategy for constraint selection is also used to control the answer size, while tag-based re-ranking is applied to improve data quality. The generated dataset RecipeADQA contains natural-language questions, structured constraints, and answer sets, resulting in 128,465 instances. Experiments compare RecipeADQA with baseline datasets from two perspectives: data quality and retrieval-recommendation performance. The results show that ours outperforms existing methods on the same recipe knowledge graph in coverage, higher question quality in naturalness and constraint rationality, and better queryability. Moreover, we design a noise-augmented retrieve-and-rerank model, in which a lightweight parser first retrieves candidate recipes, and a small language model then selects and ranks relevant recipes from a noisy candidate pool. The model trained on RecipeADQA outperforms the same model trained on the baseline datasets. The relevant construction code and data have been open-sourced at a GitHub repository https://github.com/MorimoLab/RecipeADQA.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于自然语言食谱推荐的基准数据集构建方法，通过结合用户查询和评论数据，以及使用知识图谱标签模式，生成包含自然语言问题、结构化约束和答案集的数据集。该数据集相比已有方法，在数据质量和检索-推荐性能方面表现更优。
AI.motivation: 现有的菜肴推荐任务缺乏标注数据集，现有方法生成的数据集难以充分反映用户的真实偏好，并且表达不自然。解决这一问题需要一种能够综合多种用户行为数据，并自动化生成高质量标注数据集的方法。
AI.method: 该方法利用实际的用户查询和评论数据，使用语言模型提取细粒度的偏好信号，并将其映射到知识图谱基态的标签模式上。构建过程中使用贪婪策略选择约束条件以控制答案大小，并应用基于标签的重排以提高数据质量。
AI.result: 通过这种方法生成的数据集RecipeADQA包含128,465个实例，相比现有的基准数据集，在数据质量和推荐性能方面具有明显的优势。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，基于增强的retrieve-and-rerank模型，使用RecipeADQA数据集训练的模型在多个评估指标中表现优于基于基础数据集训练的模型，验证了该数据集的有效性。

title: A dataset of clinically similar image pairs from citation-linked case reports for medical image retrieval
summary: Retrieving images of patients clinically similar to a given patient can support diagnosis, teaching and research. Training and evaluating retrieval systems requires knowing which images of different patients show the same finding, and existing datasets are small or narrow in scope. We construct PMC-PaIR, a dataset of 86,144 pairs of clinically similar images from 56,013 open-access PubMed Central case reports, which often document rare or challenging presentations. We develop an approach that follows citations, which often link case reports of similar patients.
