To determine what two linked cases share clinically, it prompts large language models to generate and answer hierarchical questions, from modality to diagnosis and findings, and to match images by caption using the answers. Experts find the pairs highly accurate, and this question-guided approach finds twice as many correct pairs as direct matching. Fine-tuning BiomedCLIP on PMC-PaIR improves retrieval in all modality, anatomy and diagnosis categories tested, for image-only queries and image queries with a short text naming the finding. We release the dataset and the automated pipeline, which can extend PMC-PaIR as new case reports are published.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了PMC-PaIR数据集，包含86,144对临床相似图像，旨在支持诊断、教学和研究。该数据集由56,013篇开放获取的PubMed Central案例报告组成，通过追踪引用来生成模式，使用大型语言模型回答一系列问题并将图像按标题匹配。此外，研究还开发了一种细调BiomedCLIP的方法，以提高所有模态、解剖学和诊断类别的检索性能。
AI.motivation: 目前临床图像检索系统的训练和评估依赖于现有的小规模或狭义的数据集，无法满足实际需求。为了解决这一问题，该研究构建了一个用于临床案例图像检索的新数据集，并使用大型语言模型辅助图像配对和检索，以提高数据集的质量和泛化能力。
AI.method: 该研究首先从开放获取的PubMed Central案例报告中抽取图像及其配对，然后通过追踪引用来生成图像对，并使用大型语言模型回答一系列问题，将图像按标题匹配，最后使用BiomedCLIP进行图像检索。研究人员还开发了一个自动化的数据集扩展 pipeline。
AI.result: 通过专家评估，该研究生成的图像配对准确率较高，特别是使用大型语言模型的问题引导方法比直接匹配方法找到的正确配对更多。使用BiomedCLIP进行图像检索时，该数据集在所有模态、解剖学和诊断类别中的表现均优于直接匹配方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，使用大型语言模型辅助图像配对和检索可以极大地提高临床案例图像检索系统的性能，并且开发的PMC-PaIR数据集有助于提高图像检索的泛化能力。

title: Network-Guided Automated Synthesis of MAC Units for Neural Network Inference
summary: In neural inference accelerators, multiply-accumulate (MAC) datapaths account for the majority of circuit area and critical-path delay, where operator-level numerical formats simultaneously dictate hardware overhead and quantization error. Yet no straightforward mapping exists between hardware cost and end-to-end network accuracy: logic synthesis transforms datapaths in a highly nonlinear manner, while numerical errors propagate and couple across layers. To address this disconnect, we present NAMSI, an automated network-aware MAC synthesis framework tailored for neural inference. NAMSI characterizes heterogeneous data formats using a format-distribution representation (FD) and leverages topology-aware accuracy and hardware-cost modeling (TaH), calibrated with actual post-synthesis Area-Delay Product (ADP) measurements, to jointly estimate coupled full-network accuracy and circuit cost. Furthermore, reversible lattice search (RLS) is introduced to tractably navigate the exponentially scaling design space. Evaluations across five neural networks on ImageNet-1K demonstrate that under post-training quantization (PTQ), NAMSI achieves 54.2%-60.4% reductions in post-synthesis MAC ADP compared with FP32 while retaining at least 99% of full-precision Top-1 accuracy, surpassing baseline approaches in both hardware efficiency and accuracy preservation.

AI.tldr: NAMSI通过采用格式分布表示（FD）和拓扑感知准确性和硬件成本建模（TaH）以及可追踪导航指数级设计空间的可逆晶格搜索（RLS），在保持高精度的同时显著减少了神经网络推理加速器中的MAC ADP，超越了现有的基本方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的MAC合成方法在准确性和硬件效率之间存在权衡，在推理加速器中导致高成本和低效率，因此需要一种新的自动化神经网络感知MAC合成框架来解决这一问题。
AI.method: NAMSI采用了格式分布表示（FD）来表征异构数据格式，并利用拓扑感知准确性和硬件成本建模（TaH）进行联合准确性和成本估计。引入了可逆晶格搜索（RLS）以在指数级设计空间中有效地导航。
AI.result: 在五个神经网络上的ImageNet-1K评估中，NAMSI在后训练量化（PTQ）下，相较于FP32节省了54.2%-60.4%的合成MAC ADP，同时保持至少99%的全精度Top-1准确性，优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: NAMSI提供了一种有效的方法来指导MAC设计，使得在保持高精度的情况下减少硬件开销，为神经网络推理加速器的设计提供了新的思路。

title: PatientFlowSynth: Evaluating FHIR Agents with Matched Patient Charts
summary: Agents that search patient charts must classify claims from retrieved records, including cases with missing or conflicting evidence. In Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR), status fields can change how those records should be interpreted. PatientFlowSynth provides 18,000 tasks from 225 synthetic patients and 18 templates that hold the patient, question, and retrieval program fixed across chart variants representing four evidence states. Re-executing the program verifies each variant's reference answer, evidence sets, and search requirements. Strict success requires a completed response with correct labels and citations exactly matching an accepted evidence set retrieved during the episode. Where required, a tool response must also show a complete search at the specified scope. In a study using GPT-5.6 Luna and 225 synthetic patients (3,600 matched pairs), explicit Encounter-status guidance increased strict success from 40.7% to 51.3% (+10.6 percentage points; 95% patient-bootstrap confidence interval, 8.4 to 12.8). Among cases whose primary reference label was insufficient evidence, label agreement fell from 49.2% to 29.3%. A prespecified two-model replication reproduced both changes. Failed retrieval can mask interpretation errors by producing a correct insufficient-evidence label without examining the relevant records. Additional model comparisons showed that the benefit of guidance was model-dependent. Retrieval, citation, and classification should be evaluated separately.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用了GPT-5.6 Luna和225个合成患者，通过提供关于Encounter-status的明确指导，增加了严格的成功率。此外，研究发现检索、引证和分类应该分开进行评估。
AI.motivation: 在处理包含缺失或矛盾证据的医疗记录时，需要一种有效的方法来指导和验证搜索，并确保正确的标签和引证。
AI.method: 研究使用了18000个任务来自225个合成患者的PatientFlowSynth，以及18个模板来保持患者、问题和检索程序固定，以代表四种证据状态的图表变体。并通过重新执行程序验证每个变体的参考答案、证据集和搜索要求。此外，还进行了模型比较。
AI.result: 通过对GPT-5.6 Luna和225个合成患者的研究发现，在需要时提供关于Encounter-status的明确指导，将严格成功率达到51.3%，比之前提高了10.6个百分点。对于那些主要参考标签不足以证明无证据的情况，标签一致性下降了29.3%。预设的两模型复制再现了这些变化。失败的检索可能会掩盖解释错误，因为它可能产生正确的无证据标签而无需检查相关记录。此外，研究还发现，指导带来的益处取决于模型。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，应将检索、引证和分类分开进行评估，以确保正确处理医疗记录中的证据。

title: Capability and Interpretability of Transformers on Multi-task Recurrence
summary: Transformers are widely used in various language tasks, with limited understanding of their internal mechanisms. Motivated by the recurrent structure of many linguistic rules, we study the capability and interpretability of Transformers through a controlled family of linear recurrence tasks over finite cyclic groups. These tasks range from executing a single fixed rule to identifying a latent rule from context and switching between explicitly specified rules, with and without input masking. Through extensive experiments across different configurations, we find that switching specified rules is simpler than identifying latent rules for Transformers in general. We also identify how several key factors affect the generalization capability of Transformers, including the depth, width, and the algebraic structure of the linear recurrence. Curriculum training is extremely useful when the number of rules is large. With standard tools in mechanistic interpretability like linear probing and input patching, our study reveals how Transformers represent, identify, and execute multiple rules.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在有限循环群上执行的线性递归任务研究了Transformer的能力和可解释性，发现对于大多数情况，Transformer识别潜在规则比执行显式规则更具挑战性，并指出了深度、宽度及线性递归的代数结构等关键因素如何影响Transformer的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 由于在许多语言规则中存在递归结构，本文旨在研究Transformer在执行线性递归任务上的能力和可解释性，以期更好地理解Transformer的工作机制。
AI.method: 本文通过设计不同层次的线性递归任务，包括执行固定规则、识别潜在规则和在输入掩蔽下切换显式规则，研究Transformer的能力。这些任务被设计在有限循环群上进行，通过对Transformer模型在不同配置下的广泛实验，分析了Transformer的性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与识别潜在规则相比，Transformer执行预设规则对大多数情况更简单；并对影响Transformer泛化能力的决定性因素（如模型深度、宽度及递归任务的代数结构）进行了深入研究。此外，本研究还发现渐进式训练对于规则数量大的情况特别有效。
AI.conclusion: 本文研究表明，理解和改善Transformer在处理复杂语言任务时的性能需要进一步的理论指导和针对性算法优化，同时也为空间学习和递归结构上Transformer的应用提供了新的研究方向。

title: AdProducer: Towards Agentic Advertising Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in video generation have made automated advertising production increasingly feasible. However, an effective advertisement must faithfully represent the product and communicate its selling points through compelling visual storytelling, which requires more than visual synthesis: it calls for deeper product understanding and strategic decisions about how to present product value. Crucially, product research and creative design are closely intertwined, as the information gathered about a product determines which features can be faithfully demonstrated and how they should be presented. In this paper, we introduce AdProducer, the first end-to-end agentic framework for advertising video creation, transforming concise creative briefs into finished advertisements. Our multimodal agent autonomously researches products through web and image search and translates its findings into selling-point-driven storyboards that guide a frozen video generator. To achieve this, we develop a dedicated data construction pipeline that yields two training datasets, AdProducer-SFT and AdProducer-RL, and train the agent through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with joint optimization of storyboard- and video-level rewards. We further introduce AdCreation-Bench, comprising 305 advertising briefs across eight domains, with two complementary metrics: PG-Score for product correctness and creative execution, and Ad-Score for overall advertising effectiveness assessed by an independent judge. Experiments demonstrate that AdProducer improves the PG-Score of MiniMax H3 from 17.3 to 51.3 and generalizes to Veo 3.1 without additional training, improving its score from 28.0 to 35.9, with consistent gains in Ad-Score, VideoScore2, and human evaluations. Code, models, and data are released.

AI.tldr: AdProducer是首个全面的自动化广告视频生成框架，通过自主产品研究和策略决策将创意简报转化为高质量广告。
AI.motivation: 提升广告生成的有效性和质量，增强产品理解和视觉叙事能力。
AI.method: 使用自主研发的数据构建管道生成两个训练数据集AdProducer-SFT和AdProducer-RL，通过监督微调和强化学习训练代理，结合场景和视频层次的奖励进行优化。
AI.result: AdProducer显著提高了MiniMax H3和Veo 3.1的PG-Score和Ad-Score，同时在VideoScore2和人类评估中也表现出色。
AI.conclusion: AdProducer展现了自动广告视频生成技术的巨大潜力，为未来的广告制作提供了新的解决方案。

title: Machine-Learning-Assisted Hybrid Cooling of a Raspberry Pi 5
summary: Thermal management is a critical challenge in compact computing platforms operating under sustained high computational loads. Elevated processor temperatures can lead to thermal throttling, degraded performance, and reduced reliability. This study develops and experimentally evaluates a smart hybrid heat sink that integrates passive thermal energy storage with active cooling for sustained device operation. The proposed design comprises an aluminum cavity containing paraffin wax as a phase change material (PCM) embedded within a copper foam and integrated with an adaptively controlled fan. Fan operation is guided by a Random Forest regression model trained on experimentally measured CPU temperature data to predict future CPU temperatures. The predicted temperature is then used to support the adaptive fan control strategy. The heat sink is mounted directly on the CPU of a Raspberry Pi 5 and experimentally evaluated under an extreme CPU workload of approximately 99 percent CPU utilization. The performance of the proposed hybrid system is compared against two benchmark scenarios: passive cooling using PCM embedded in copper foam and a commercial Raspberry Pi 5 active cooler. The proposed heat sink demonstrates superior thermal performance to both benchmarks, achieving peak CPU temperature reductions of approximately 9 C relative to the PCM-copper foam configuration and 6 C relative to the commercial active cooler.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种智能混合热沉，通过结合相变材料及自适应风扇控制，在高负载条件下显著提高了处理器的散热性能。
AI.motivation: 高密度计算平台在持续高负载运行时面临散热问题，可能导致处理器过热、性能下降和可靠性降低。为解决此问题，提出了一个智能混合热沉，该设计结合了相变材料和主动冷却系统。
AI.method: 该混合热沉由铝腔、嵌入其中的石蜡相变材料、铜泡沫及自适应控制风扇组成。风扇操作由随机森林回归模型指导，模型基于实验测量的CPU温度数据进行训练，预测未来CPU温度，以支持自适应风扇控制策略。热沉直接安装在Raspberry Pi 5的CPU上，实验条件下进行评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，该混合系统在极端CPU负载下（约99% CPU利用率）的热性能优于两个基准方案：仅使用嵌入铜泡沫的相变材料和商用Raspberry Pi 5主动冷却系统。相比于相变材料铜泡沫配置，该热沉峰值CPU温度降低了约9℃，而相对于商用主动冷却系统则低了约6℃。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了智能混合热沉在提高寒冷性能和控制处理器温度方面的有效性。

title: One Step, Four Clocks: How GUI Agents Fall Out of Step
summary: GUI agents can choose correct actions yet fail as interfaces change during deliberation. Latency alone cannot explain these failures because actions may become invalid at different interaction stages. We model four events: environment change, observation availability, decision commitment, and action receipt (EODA). We introduce ChronotopeGym to study these failures under Paused, Replay, and Live execution. Across five tasks, agents can fail in Live despite succeeding when responses remain valid, even when actions meet deadlines. On Moving Balloon, updating a pending click raises success from 0% to 100% without changing response time. Our accelerator-resident GUI controller, Chronotope, maintains compact interaction history and selectively keeps, updates, or redecides pending actions. Compared with Agent S3, Chronotope reduces median end-to-end latency by 85.5% for a 27B model, expanding its performance envelope to 100% Live success at an 8-second deadline versus 0%. Chronotope enables real-time GUI control through compact interaction history, knowing when to preserve, revise, or replace actions, and an overall efficient architectural design that obviates verbose reflection, reasoning, and grounding calls.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过ChronotopeGym模型探讨了GUI代理在界面变化时的选择失败，并引入了Chronotope控制器以减少延迟并实现实时GUI控制。
AI.motivation: 传统的GUI代理在界面变化时可能会失败，单纯依赖延迟无法解释这些失败。该研究旨在通过引入新的模型和控制器来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 研究定义了四个事件（环境变化、观察可用性、决策承诺和动作接收），并利用ChronotopeGym在暂停、重放和实时三种执行模式下进行研究。此外，还开发了Chronotope控制器，通过维护紧凑的交互历史来管理代理的行为。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Chronotope能够在实时模式下实现100%的成功率，即使在响应保持有效的情况下也有0%的成功率。在Moving Balloon任务中，更新待定点击提高了成功率，而响应时间保持不变。与之前的S3代理相比，Chronotope显著减少了端到端延迟（85.5%），拓展了代理在8秒截止时间下的成功范围。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的方法和工具有助于理解GUI代理在实时运行中的行为并提供了一种更有效的设计，可实现实时GUI交互控制。

title: Does Item Response Theory Generalize Across Languages? Evidence from Cross-Lingual LLM Benchmarks
comment: Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (Findings)
summary: The application of Item Response Theory (IRT) for data selection in benchmarks has mostly been limited to monolingual settings. In this work, we ask: how does IRT generalize when the same benchmark is translated across languages? We conduct experiments on Multilingual GSM and Global MMLU, covering over 100 language models and 11 languages. Fitting 1PL, 2PL, and 3PL IRT models per language, we assess cross-lingual consistency of parameters and whether IRT-filtered subsets preserve model rankings across languages: item difficulty emerges as the most stable parameter followed by guessing and then discrimination. A differential item analysis also shows that lack of stability can be tracked to specific items shifting under translation across languages. Our findings suggest IRT-based selection in multilingual settings must be both parameter-aware and item-aware, validating model choice and screening individual items before assuming cross-lingual generalization.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了项目反应理论（IRT）在多语言环境下的适用性，发现对于不同语言，项目难度是最稳定的因素，而猜测和区分性相对不稳定，强调在多语言环境中进行IRT选择时需要参数和项目双重视角。
AI.motivation: 由于主要研究的是单语言环境中的IRT应用，本研究旨在探索跨语言环境中的IRT是否依然有效。
AI.method: 研究者进行了跨语言的多语言 GSM 和全球 MMLU 实验，每个语言分别拟合一维、二维和三维 IRT 模型，评估参数在不同语言中的稳定性和经过 IRT 过滤后的子集是否能在不同语言中保持模型排名。
AI.result: 研究发现项目难度参数在不同语言中最稳定，其次是猜测参数，区分性参数相对不稳定。进一步分析表明，部分项目在翻译过程中稳定性较好，而部分项目的表现则会显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 本研究结果表明，在多语言环境中使用 IRT 进行数据选择时，需要同时考虑到各参数的稳定性和具体项目的稳定性，以确保跨语言环境下的有效性和一致性。

title: PromptSMC: Enabling Particle Exploration in Flow Matching via LLM-Based Prompt Rejuvenation
summary: This paper is concerned with prompt-image alignment at inference time through exploration of generative trajectories and dynamical prompt rejuvenation. We leverage sequential Monte Carlo (SMC), to offer a gradient-free and principled framework for this purpose through reward-guided trajectory selection. More specifically, we introduce LLM-based prompt rejuvenation, allowing for efficient particle exploration in SMC samplers along the diffusion time in flow matching models. The proposed method, PromptSMC, retains the selected latent states and uses a pretrained LLM to dynamically revise the prompts of duplicated particles under semantic-preservation constraints. These revised prompts induce alternative conditional velocity fields, allowing particles to explore different continuations from a shared intermediate state. The method further uses a reward model to evaluate each particle's alignment with the original prompt, and the resulting scores guide particles through resampling. PromptSMC thus integrates prompt-based exploration with reward-guided sampling, achieving faithful prompt-image alignment without additional noise injection, model training, or reward gradients. Our experiments and ablation studies across multiple benchmarks and backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of the method for text-to-image flow matching. Code is available at https://github.com/shermanlian/PromptSMC.

AI.tldr: 通过探索生成轨迹和动力学提示再生，本文提出了PromptSMC方法，利用SMC框架和预训练的LLM进行梯度免费的提示图像对齐。
AI.motivation: 当前的提示图像对齐方法在生成和对齐过程中的存在各种挑战，本文旨在通过对提示的动态再生以及利用顺序蒙特卡洛方法，提供一种新的方法来解决这些挑战。
AI.method: PromptSMC方法利用了预训练的LLM来进行梯度免费的粒子探索，以及基于奖励的轨迹选择。该方法通过SEMantic-preservation约束条件动态修订了提示，使得粒子能够在共享中间状态上探索不同的续写。
AI.result: PromptSMC方法被证明在多个基准测试和基础模型上有效，无需额外的噪声注入，模型训练或奖励梯度。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法为文本到图像的流匹配提供了有效的提示图像对齐，同时验证了通过结合基于奖励的采样和提示探索来实现精确对齐的可能性。

title: Walk the Cycle: An Efficient Stochastic Solver for Periodic Thermal Analysis of 2.5D/3D ICs
summary: Long-term periodic thermal analysis is essential for designing 2.5D/3D ICs operating under periodic workloads. Deterministic global solvers can be costly for repeated thermal queries, while existing random-walk methods are not tailored to long-term periodic problems or multiscale 3D IC structures, limiting their efficiency and accuracy. We propose CycleWalker, a periodic residual random-walk solver. First, we formulate the periodic steady state (PSS) as an infinite-history backward walk, which needs no initial temperature or warm-up but charges the full temperature field to every path. Second, to cut this cost, we let the walk estimate only the residual of a periodic prior, and shorten long histories by Russian roulette while preserving unbiasedness. Third, since the estimator constrains the prior only to be periodic and piecewise linear in time, we build it at negligible cost by a coarse-grid Fourier solve followed by fine-grid smoothing. Finally, we construct a thermal graph aware of through-silicon vias (TSVs) that bounds the walk's jump rate while retaining the anisotropic conduction of TSV arrays. Experiments on periodic 2.5D/3D IC benchmarks show that, at equal accuracy, CycleWalker achieves up to 75.85X speedup over the transient random-walk solver.

AI.tldr: CycleWalker 是一种用于 2.5D/3D IC 在长期周期性工作负载下进行热分析的周期残差随机行走求解器，它可以显著提高效率并保持准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的确定性全局求解器成本高昂，而随机行走方法在处理长期周期性和多层次 3D IC 结构方面效率较低且准确度有限。因此，提出了一种新的周期残差随机行走求解器 CycleWalker。
AI.method: CycleWalker 通过将周期性稳态问题视为无限历史的反向行走来进行公式化，不需要初始温度或热身，同时使用粗网格 Fourier 求解和细网格平滑技术构建估计器，其计算成本较低。此外，通过构建考虑通孔（TSVs）的热图，控制行走的跳跃率，同时保留 TSV 矩阵的各向异性传导。
AI.result: 在周期性 2.5D/3D IC 基准测试中，CycleWalker 在相同准确度下与瞬态随机行走求解器相比实现了高达 75.85 倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: CycleWalker 通过减少历史长度、构建粗网格 Fourier 求解和细网格平滑，以及控制跳跃率来提高长期周期性问题的热分析效率和准确性。

title: Agent Evaluation Without Ground Truth: A Null Proportion Perspective
summary: The correctness of actions taken by agents is typically evaluated against known, externally verified ground truth labels, such as whether a proof is correct or whether code compiles and passes unit tests. However, as coding and science agents are entrusted with more end-to-end autonomy -- proposing interventions, running experiments, and deciding what to deploy and investigate next -- whether an agent's actions genuinely improve an outcome must be inferred from noisy, often inconclusive experiments. To evaluate agents in this setting, we define agent quality as a weighted sum of correct decisions along its trajectory, using sequences of $e$-values as statistical evidence regarding correctness in place of ground-truth labels. Our framework accommodates arbitrarily dependent decisions, data-dependent trajectory termination, dynamically generated hypotheses, and quality measures defined after the trajectory concludes. We construct upper and lower bound estimators and confidence sets for agent quality with statistical guarantees that hold uniformly over agent trajectory distributions and establish instance-wise sharpness of our estimator class. We demonstrate our methods with a case study comparing the success of Claude Opus and Claude Haiku in improving the runtime of an open-source Python package.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了用e-值序列作为统计证据来评估具有端到端自主性的代理质量，避免了对不可靠或模糊实验结果的依赖。通过构建代理质量的上下界估计器和置信集，研究还确保了估计类的实例精度。
AI.motivation: 随着编程和科学代理获得更多的自主权，无法直接依赖明确的正确性标签进行评估，因此研究提出了一种基于e-值的新方法来评估代理质量。
AI.method: 研究定义了代理质量为代理在其轨迹中做出正确决策的加权和，并利用e-值序列作为统计证据。通过构造代理质量的上下界估计器和置信集，研究确保了估计方法的统计保证。
AI.result: 该研究展示了如何使用上下界估计器和置信集来评估具有端到端自主性的代理质量，并证明了所提出方法在实例上的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 此研究为评估具有端到端自主性的代理提供了一种新的方法，通过利用e-值和上下界估计器，代理质量评估变得更可靠且更具可操作性。

title: RegioZH: Unveiling Comprehension Disparities across Regional Chinese Varieties in LLMs
summary: Current evaluations often treat Chinese varieties as monolithic, obscuring failures for regional users. We introduce RegioZH, a 2,607-item multiple-choice benchmark for regional lexical reasoning across Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Malaysia. Built by region-specific annotators and expert-validated, it targets localized idioms, slang, code-mixing, politeness conventions, and sociocultural expressions. Zero-shot results on eleven LLMs show large disparities, including a 29.4-point average accuracy gap between Taiwan and Singapore. Persona and structured chain-of-thought prompts for five models yield selective gains, suggesting that some errors stem from retrieval or framing rather than only missing knowledge. Representation, attention, calibration, and surface-feature analyses show a dissociation between marker attention and semantic grounding, overconfident forced-choice errors, and localized lexical density as a consistent difficulty predictor. Qualitative analysis finds terminology misunderstandings, sociocultural inference gaps, and cross-regional semantic divergence. RegioZH demonstrates that apparent Chinese proficiency can mask uneven understanding across regional varieties, motivating intra-language robustness evaluation alongside multilingual generalization.

AI.tldr: RegioZH 是一个针对中国不同地区的多种选择基准，包含2607个题目，用于评估多模态语言模型在地区方言理解上的差异，揭示了地区间明显的准确率差距，并提出了一些评估发现。
AI.motivation: 当前对中文方言的评估往往被视为一体，掩盖了区域用户的失败情况，RegioZH 的设计目的是为各地用户提供更精准和个体化的评价。
AI.method: RegioZH 是由地区特定的注释者并且经过专家验证建立起来的，题目旨在测试地区性俚语、混合语言、礼貌规范和社会文化表达等。通过零样本表现分析各大语言模型，提出了一些特定于模型的提示策略，并进行了一系列的表征、注意、校准和表面特征分析。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，各大语言模型在台湾和新加坡的表现有显著差异，某些模型在特定策略下表现有所改善。此外，还发现了一些模型在词汇表达理解中的不确定性以及跨区域的语义差异。
AI.conclusion: 该基准实验证明，表面上的中文精通程度可能掩盖了不同地区之间的理解差异，要求在多语言泛化的同时也要加强单语言鲁棒性评估。

title: Which Way Is Up? Rotated Photos Silently Hurt Multi-View 3D Foundation Models
summary: Multi-view 3D foundation models estimate camera poses and 3D points from a set of photos in one forward pass. Many cameras store a portrait shot sideways, with an orientation tag telling viewers how to turn it, and this tag can be ignored, lost or wrong. We measure how rotated photos affect five such models on three datasets. A few rotated photos lower camera pose accuracy for every model, and the sideways photos already in a standard benchmark do the same. Even the most robust model still loses accuracy. The failure is also silent: the models' confidence does not reliably flag it, and most official image loaders ignore the tag. The fixes we test each correct only part of the problem. These findings call for orientation checks in reconstruction pipelines and benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 旋转的照片会影响多种三维基础模型的相机姿态估计精度，尤其是侧向拍摄的照片。即使是最 robust 的模型，在这种情况下也会降低准确性。模型在出错时缺乏自信提示，且大多数图像加载器忽略了图像的方向标签。需要在重建管道和基准测试中增加方向检查。
AI.motivation: 探讨旋转照片对基于多视角的三维基础模型相机姿态估计精度的影响，并指出当前模型和数据集存在的不足。
AI.method: 在三个数据集上评估五种基于多视角的三维基础模型对旋转照片的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 旋转照片会影响所有模型的相机姿态估计精度，即使是最 robust 的模型也无法完全避免精度下降。当前模型在检测到方向问题时无法提供可靠的反馈，大多数图像加载器忽略了方向标签信息。
AI.conclusion: 建议重建管道和基准测试中应增加方向检查，以改善旋转照片环境下模型的性能。

title: Beyond Autoregression: Diffusion Language Model is All Analog In-Memory Computing Need
comment: Accept by Design, Automation and Test in Europe Conference(DATE2027)
summary: Analog in-memory computing (AIMC) enables energy-efficient language-model inference, but hardware non-idealities perturb matrix--vector multiplications and degrade generation quality. Autoregressive (AR) models are especially vulnerable: each token is committed to the causal context at birth, so perturbation-induced errors cascade. We study diffusion language models (DLMs), which iteratively refine a masked sequence, as an alternative paradigm. Across scale-matched model pairs and open checkpoints, DLMs degrade more gracefully than AR counterparts under persistent weight perturbations. Controlled analyses rule out cross-round noise averaging and support delayed token commitment and progressive context resolution as the mechanism. A larger denoising-step budget further shrinks the clean--noisy gap, a DLM-specific latency--robustness knob. We perform large-scale simulation tests across diverse datasets and models using a noise model calibrated from real silicon measurements. Furthermore, on a 16-chip 28nm eFlash AIMC cluster, hybrid on-board measurements show DLMs tolerate $1.4$--$3\times$ larger weight noise, making diffusion-based generation a promising paradigm for noise-resilient AIMC inference.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了扩散语言模型（DLMs），发现它们在持续权重扰动下比自回归（AR）模型更具鲁棒性，适合于抗噪的内存计算推理。
AI.motivation: 文章旨在解决基于内存计算的类神经网络在处理自回归模型时因硬件非理想性导致的矩阵-向量乘法中的误差累积问题。因此，研究了一种不同的迭代改进掩蔽序列的扩散模型。
AI.method: 通过在多个模型对和开放检查点上进行建模，并结合自回归模型，研究了扩散语言模型在不同情况下的表现。使用真实硅片测量数据校准噪声模型，并在16个28nm eFlash内存计算集群上进行混合板上测试。
AI.result: 结果表明，扩散模型在持续权重噪声下表现更优，能够容忍1.4到3倍的权重噪声，比自回归模型更具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明扩散模型特别适用于内存计算推理，因为它能够在面对硬件噪声挑战时表现出更好的性能。

title: Agent Recovery Gone Wrong: Measuring Harm Beyond Duplicate Calls
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Data, labels, and scripts: https://github.com/flame-stream/agent-recovery-harm
summary: Code-executing LLM agents submit blocks of code that issue several API writes. If a block fails after some of its writes have taken effect, the agent rewrites the block and continues. It is unknown how often such a recovery harms the external state when the failure occurs naturally in the code written by the agent. In this paper, we measure it on recorded trajectories of AppWorld agents. In a stratified random sample of 200 candidate episodes across ten models, 145 are partial executions confirmed by the database state. In the sample, 30 of 143 confirmed partial executions with a determinable outcome are followed by a harmful recovery, and its violation remains at the end of the run, which gives a stratification-weighted estimate of 24.6%. Two thirds of the harmful recoveries duplicate an effect, and the rest delete user data or make a wrong first-time write, e.g., an order of a wrong product. A rule that searches for repeated calls finds 75% of duplications but only 41% of all harm. We also examine two sources of operation identity for an idempotency contract. In a small pilot (17 episodes, one local model), identifiers supplied by the model do not detectably reduce harm, because the model issues a new identifier for the same operation. Identity derived from the call content, evaluated counterfactually on the sample, would have matched every harmful write in 14 to 18 of the 30 harmful recoveries, but in none of those with a wrong first-time write, and it would also have matched writes required by the task in 30 episodes. Based on these results, we outline design requirements for safer agent recovery.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析AppWorld智能体的操作轨迹，发现了恢复操作中24.6%的情况会造成有害影响，主要表现为重复操作、删除用户数据或错误的初始写入。对操作身份验证机制的检验显示，模型提供的标识符并未有效减少危害，而基于调用内容的标识符能有效匹配大多数有害写入，但不能识别错误的初始写入，同时还需匹配任务所需写入。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在评估并减少智能体执行代码过程中因失败而导致的有害恢复带来的影响，确保智能体操作的正确性和安全性。
AI.method: 研究采用了分层随机抽样方法，在 AppWorld 智能体的操作轨迹中抽取了 200 个候选事件样本，通过数据库状态验证其中 145 个事件为部分执行，并进一步分析这些样本中的有害恢复情况。同时，研究了两种操作身份验证机制的有效性。
AI.result: 在 143 个可验证的结果中，有 30 个（占比 21.0%）发生了有害恢复，这表明智能体恢复过程存在较高的安全隐患。在有害恢复中，67% 的情况是重复操作，其余则涉及错误的初始操作或用户数据丢失。此外，用于检测重复操作的规则仅有效识别了约 41% 的所有有害操作。研究还发现，若采用基于调用内容的操作标识方法可在 14 到 18 个有害恢复中检测到所有有害写入，但无法捕捉错误的初始操作，也无法确保所有与任务相关的操作得到有效验证。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了在智能体执行过程中设计更安全的恢复机制的重要性。需要进一步探索如何通过操作标识和验证机制提高智能体的安全性，减少因失败导致的数据错误或丢失。

title: Evaluating Large Language Models on Iranian Doctoral Entrance Exams in Electrical and Computer Engineering
summary: We evaluate four large language models (LLMs) on multiple-choice questions from the 2024 and 2025 Iranian national Ph.D. entrance examinations in Electrical Engineering (EE) and Computer Engineering (CE). Of the 440 questions in the four official booklets, 7 were excluded because the question statement or its figure was ambiguous, leaving 433 questions (186 EE, 247 CE), of which 171 (39.5\%) depend on a figure. Each question was presented in the original Persian and in an English translation, giving 3,464 scored responses. GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Grok 4 were queried zero-shot, with reasoning enabled, through a single commercial web interface (Perplexity) in October 2025, using an automated script. Because every model answers the same items, all inferences use paired tests or question-clustered models. Accuracy separates into two tiers: GPT-5 (79.9\%, 95\% CI 76.6--83.1) and Gemini 2.5 Pro (78.4\%, 74.8--81.9) are statistically indistinguishable, and both outperform Grok 4 (71.7\%) and Claude Sonnet 4.5 (71.3\%) by 6.7--8.7 percentage points (Holm-adjusted $p < 0.001$). The English--Persian accuracy difference is small for every model ($-0.2$ to $+2.5$ points; exact McNemar $p \ge 0.28$). For three models the 90\% confidence interval lies within $\pm 5$ points, so differences larger than this can be excluded. Questions with figures are much harder: the odds ratio is 0.30 (95\% CI 0.21--0.43) after adjusting for discipline. The apparent EE deficit of two models disappears once the larger share of figure-based EE items is accounted for. We describe the dataset, the protocol and its limitations, including the uncontrolled web-retrieval and decoding settings of the interface, and release item-level responses and analysis code.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了四个大型语言模型在伊电气工程和计算机工程科目的多项选择题上的表现，共433道题，其中171题依赖图形，四个模型中GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Pro表现最好，准确率分别为79.9%和78.4%，均为71.7%至71.3%以上模型的两倍以上。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在评估大型语言模型在基础和工程知识领域的多项选择题中的表现，特别关注图形影响的难度差异。
AI.method: 通过一个商业网介（Perplexity），对四个大模型进行零样本查询，使用自动化脚本在2025年10月进行测试，每个模型在所有项目中进行配对测试或问题聚类模型分析。
AI.result: GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Pro的准确率分别为79.9%和78.4%，显著优于其他两个模型；准确率在英语和波斯语之间没有显著差异；带有图形的题目难度比没有图形的题目高出许多。在考虑学科差异后，两个模型在电气工程领域的表现差异消失。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型在进行这类考试时表现出色，尤其是在解决不需要图形输入的问题时；然而，带有图形的问题对模型提出了巨大挑战。研究数据和分析代码已公布，进一步评估了网际检索和解码设置的不可控性。

title: GDD: A Remote Sensing Image Deepfake Detection and Manipulation Localization Dataset
summary: Verifying image authenticity is a critical need for a variety of applications and decision-making in the remote sensing (RS) domain, yet it is becoming more challenging as advancements in generative AI enable producing increasingly realistic synthetic overhead data. However, existing RS deepfake benchmarks prioritize sheer volume at the expense of visual realism and diversity, while also lacking rigorous out-of-distribution (OOD) testing protocols to evaluate real-world robustness. To address this, we introduce the Geospatial Deepfakes Dataset (GDD), a benchmark for RS deepfake detection and manipulation localization. Rather than relying on uncurated, redundant synthetic generation, GDD comprises images across diverse modern generative models and real image sources, alongside manipulations from diffusion inpainting, splicing, and copy-move operations. Crucially, GDD establishes an OOD evaluation protocol for deepfake detection comprising unseen real image sources and generative models. We benchmark five deepfake detectors and two localization models across intra- and cross-dataset regimes and reveal that detectors trained on high-volume, uncurated benchmarks overfit to dataset-specific artifacts, whereas training on GDD yields superior cross-dataset generalization despite its compact scale. This benchmarking also exposes critical failure modes in current state-of-the-art methods. Combined, GDD and its evaluation protocol establish a high-quality standard for developing and stress-testing detection and localization models in this safety-critical RS domain. The dataset is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了Geospatial Deepfakes Dataset (GDD)，一个用于遥感深伪造假检测和篡改定位的基准数据集，通过对比高容量、未编辑基准与GDD，展示了在安全关键的遥感领域中，GDD能够提供更好的跨数据集泛化性能，同时提出了一种新的开集评估协议。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI技术的发展，合成图像变得越来越逼真，使得图像真伪验证在遥感领域变得更加困难。现有的遥感深伪造假基准主要关注数据量，忽视了视觉多样性和真实性，并缺乏严格的开集测试协议。因此，需要一个新的数据集来改进现有方法。
AI.method: GDD数据集由来自不同现代生成模型和真实图像来源的图像组成，并包括例如扩散修复、拼接和复制粘贴等操作。为了验证模型性能，作者使用五种深度伪造检测器和两种定位模型进行了基准测试，并建立了一种开集评估协议来评估实际鲁棒性。
AI.result: 对比实验表明，基于高容量、未编辑基准的数据检测器在特定数据集上过拟合，而使用GDD训练的数据检测器则表现出更好的跨数据集泛化性能，强调了在安全关键遥感应用中的重要作用。此外，基准测试揭示了当前最先进的方法所面临的关键失效模式。
AI.conclusion: GDD和其评估协议为开发和测试遥感领域中的伪造检测和定位模型制定了高标准。同时，它提供了一种新的基准数据集和评估框架，以应对日益复杂的图像篡改问题。

title: Mayfly: Lifecycle-Aware High-Bandwidth Flash for Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) lets an LLM improve its agent system by proposing and evaluating candidate variants across tasks. A generation's sessions grow their KV caches together and release them as they finish, creating a burst followed by a decline. At high concurrency, even the KV of sessions ready to run exceeds the GPU's HBM. Offloading that KV to host DRAM or SSDs adds capacity but leaves ready sessions waiting for HBM space before execution. High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) can serve the overflow in place, but excessive reads lengthen decode steps and repeated writes consume flash endurance. Our key insight is that where ready KV is read should follow the burst and its decline: from HBF in place while the burst overflows HBM, as much as each step's bandwidth allows, and from HBM again as the decline frees it. A switch between ready and parked decides only whether a block is read, so its flash copy stays valid, and a session's end, which the orchestrator announces, decides when its private KV dies. We present Mayfly, lifecycle-guided HBF management for RSI. Mayfly bounds per-step HBF reads during overflow and returns KV to HBM as sessions finish and free space. It retains a valid backing copy of each block evicted from HBM to avoid rewrites across state transitions, and forwards session-end signals to the controller to avoid copying dead KV during garbage collection. Experimental results show that, at 128 sessions per generation on four added HBF sites, Mayfly finishes 34% sooner than parking the same KV on HBF and 23% sooner than reading it from HBF whenever HBM is full; its gain over parking grows with concurrency, to 55% at 256 sessions on eight sites. Keeping one flash copy per block and trimming at announced session ends avoid write amplification.

AI.tldr: Mayfly 在自改进过程中，通过指导性的高带宽闪存管理，在任务突发和其衰落过程中，从高带宽闪存 (HBF) 和 GPU 高带驳管理器 (HBM) 中有效地管理和回收 KV 缓存，从而提升了任务生成的时间性能。
AI.motivation: 自改进 (RSI) 让语言模型通过其代理系统进行自我改进。现有的方法在高并发时，当运行准备好的 KV 缓存超过 GPU HBM 容量时，会导致缓存转移到主机 DRAM 或 SSD，或者使用高带宽闪存 (HBF) 但会导致读写性能问题。本文提出了 Mayfly，一种基于生命周期的 HBF 管理策略，解决这些问题。
AI.method: Mayfly 采用在一个步骤中控制 HBF 读取量并在会话结束时将 KV 还原到 HBM 的方法。它保留了从 HBM 移除的每个块的有效备份副本，避免了状态转换中的重新写入。同时，它通过传递会话结束信号来控制器来进行垃圾收集，避免了在收集时不复制已死亡的 KV。通过这项管理策略，Mayfly 能够更有效地回收和管理缓存。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，即使在高并发情况下，Mayfly 仍然具有优越的表现。在每次生成 128 个会话并添加 4 个 HBF 站点的情况下，与将相同的 KV 停驻在 HBF 上相比，Mayfly 可以将生成时间缩短 34%，与从 HBF 上读取 KV 直到 HBM 容量满时相比，可以缩短 23%。随着并发度的增加，与其相比所得的性能提升也日益明显，在 256 个会话和 8 个站点时可提升 55%。
AI.conclusion: Mayfly 提供了一种有效的方法来管理高带宽闪存(HBF)中的 KV 缓存，这种方法是在突发负载和其衰落过程中，根据自改进 (RSI) 任务的需求动态进行 HBF 与 HBM 之间的数据迁移。实验结果表明，Mayfly 能在高并发场景下显著提升自改进任务的生成效率。

title: COGENT: A Modular Cognitive Architecture for Agentic User Simulation
summary: LLM-based user simulation can support interface design, accessibility research, and interactive-agent evaluation, but standard computer-use agents are optimized for task completion rather than reproducing how people perceive, reason, and act. We introduce COGENT (COGnitive agENT), a modular cognitive architecture for simulating user interaction with desktop interfaces. COGENT draws on established cognitive theories, such as Norman's action cycle and ACT-R, to enable explainable, intervenable, and modular user simulation by decomposing the simulation process into cognitive modules with explicit representations of perception, memory, user state, intentions, and action selection. We begin by presenting six intervenability demonstrations, each tracing how a single edit to memory, a user attribute, or a processing module propagates through the cognitive pipeline to produce a behavioral change. We evaluate COGENT's behavioral and attributional fidelity across three benchmarks -- AgentNetBench, A11y-CUA, and SENSE-42 -- finding that it achieves statistically significant fidelity gains over computer-use baselines in reproducing recorded human behavior and recovers the relational structure among human self-reported psychological states. Together, these demos and evaluations demonstrate COGENT's utility toward more faithful, explainable, intervenable, and modular LLM-based cognitive simulations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为COGENT的认知架构，旨在模拟用户与桌面界面的交互，能够解释、干预和模块化。通过在记忆、用户属性或处理模块上的单个编辑来生成行为变化，COGENT在三个基准测试中的表现优于现有的计算机使用基准。
AI.motivation: 当前的计算机使用代理优化任务完成而非复制人的认知过程，本文为了提供更真实的、可解释的、可干预的和模块化的LLM认知模拟，提出了COGENT认知架构。
AI.method: COGENT基于诺曼的动作周期和ACT-R等认知理论，将模拟过程分解为感知、记忆、用户状态、意图和动作选择等认知模块，通过干预这些模块来研究行为变化。
AI.result: 对COGENT的评估包括三个基准测试显示，它在模拟人类行为方面优于现有计算机使用基准，并且能够恢复人类自我报告的心理状态之间的关系结构。
AI.conclusion: COGENT展示了LLM认知模拟的更忠实、可解释、可干预和模块化的潜力，为进一步研究开辟了新路径。

title: How Persona Conditioning Changes Open-Ended Task Execution: A Paired Evaluation of Behavioral Gains and Reliability Costs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often prompted with role- or persona-based instructions, yet persona conditioning has mainly been evaluated through character fidelity or aggregate benchmark accuracy. We study persona conditioning as a task-execution steering signal that changes how models interpret, structure, and sustain responses. Using paired instances derived from real user role-play logs and expanded into simulated multi-turn continuations, we compare with-persona and no-persona conditions while fixing task content, constraints, user simulation, and evaluation criteria. Across eight models, persona conditioning improves expert content depth and procedural fidelity, and these gains survive length control. At the same time, it lowers strict instruction-following accuracy by 17 to 30 points in every model evaluated, and increases unsupported real-world specificity through persona-induced elaboration. These results suggest that persona prompting is not a general-purpose performance improvement technique, but a selective task-execution policy shift with both behavioral gains and reliability risks.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，角色条件引导在提升专家内容深度和程序忠实度方面有帮助，但会降低严格指令遵守的准确性，并增加基于角色诱导的细节。
AI.motivation: 当前对角色条件引导的评估主要集中在角色一致性或聚合基准准确性上，本研究旨在探索其对任务执行的指令导向作用。
AI.method: 通过对比现实用户角色扮演日志中生成的配对实例的多轮连续情况，固定任务内容、约束条件、用户模拟和评估标准。
AI.result: 角色条件引导在八个模型中提高了专家内容深度和程序忠实度，且这些优势在长度控制下仍然存在。同时，它在每种评估的模型中降低了17到30个百分点的严格指令遵守准确性，增加了基于角色诱导的非支持性现实特定性。
AI.conclusion: 角色引导并不是一种通用的性能提升技术，而是一种具有行为收益和可靠性风险的任务执行策略转变。

title: HyMTS: A Multiscale Tensor Factorization-Based Network for Hyperspectral Image Restoration
summary: Hyperspectral image (HSI) restoration has been explored using deep learning techniques recently. Because hyperspectral images have strong spectral and spatial redundancy, the underlying clean signal is usually represented in a low-dimensional spectral subspace and locally low-rank spatial structures. Existing methods primarily explore dense attention or feature mixing across spectral bands. In this work, we propose HyMTS, a hyperspectral restoration network with a backbone built on the Multi-scale Tensorial Summation (MTS) factorization operator. HyMTS provides a natural architectural mechanism for exploiting a low-rank prior, embedded directly in the network operator rather than imposed via an auxiliary loss or a constraint on the reconstructed output. Specifically, HyMTS stacks a unified block that couples factorized layers with input-adaptive layers, capturing both local and global dependencies across the spectral and spatial dimensions. Extensive experiments without auxiliary data on standard benchmarks for Gaussian and real-noise denoising and single-image super-resolution show that HyMTS efficiently achieves superior or comparable performance to various state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多尺度张量求和（MTS）因子化的HyperMTS网络，用于利用低秩先验进行超光谱图像恢复。
AI.motivation: 超光谱图像具有强烈的光谱和空间冗余性，低秩先验在超光谱图像恢复中具有潜在的应用价值。
AI.method: 本文通过构建在MTS因子化操作符基础上的网络骨干提出了一种名为HyMTS的网络，该网络通过一个统一的模块连接因子化层与输入自适应层，从而捕捉光谱和空间维度上的局部和全局依赖。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上的实验表明，HyMTS在网络中直接嵌入低秩先验，而无需通过辅助损失或重建输出的约束。HyMTS在高斯噪声和真实噪声去噪、单图像超分辨率方面的性能优于或可与当前最先进的方法相媲美。
AI.conclusion: HyMTS网络有效地利用了低秩先验以提高超光谱图像恢复性能。

title: On the Design of a Slow Control Interlock System for the European GateMate FPGA
summary: Slow Control Systems (SCSs) are essential for the monitoring, configuration, and protection of distributed safety-critical systems in scientific, industrial, and medical applications. Although software-based SCS architectures offer flexibility and scalability, they suffer from software aging and non-deterministic latencies, which limit long-term reliability and timely reaction to critical errors, often requiring additional hardware interlock systems. This paper presents an FPGA-centric lightweight Slow Control Interlock System (SCIS) designed to achieve deterministic ultra-low-latency reaction times in long-running dependable systems. System parameters are acquired and fused at runtime in a Supervisory Monitor Unit (SMU), enabling real-time fault condition classification and prioritization through configurable priority rules and triggering kill-switch actions with microsecond-scale latency. The proposed SMU has been described in VHDL as vendor-agnostic architecture, and assessed on the 28-nm GateMate M1A1 FPGA, using the open-source OSS-CAD-Suite toolchain. Experimental results show that the SMU architecture utilizes only 37,6% of LUTs, 9,4% of FFs, and 35,9% of BRAM. Furthermore, this low resource utilization allow to achieve 40,48 ms reconfiguration time, using OSS-CAD-Suite including gmpack v1.13. This is a key metric for rejuvenation and consequently for enabling aging mitigation in critical applications. Offloading the Ethernet stack to the W5500 Ethernet module and integrating the Grafana dashboard provides a lightweight, deterministic SCIS. This demonstrates the feasibility of our FPGA-centric architecture as a solution to the problem of combining ultra-low-latency interlock capabilities with the scalability of software-based systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于FPGA的轻量级 Slow Control Interlock 系统（SCIS），实现超低延迟反应时间。该系统在运行时从Supervisory Monitor Unit (SMU)中获取和融合系统参数，实现了故障条件的实时分类和优先级处理，利用微秒级延迟触发kill开关动作。SMU架构在28-nm GateMate M1A1 FPGA上使用VHDL实现，并通过OSS-CAD-Suite工具链评估。实验结果显示，该架构的资源利用率低，仅需40.48 ms的重配置时间，适用于关键应用的寿命延长。
AI.motivation: 针对软件基础的慢控制系统（SCS）的软件老化和非确定性延迟问题，本文提出了一种基于FPGA的轻量级Slow Control Interlock系统（SCIS），旨在通过确定性的超低延迟反应时间，提高长运行可靠系统的长期可靠性。
AI.method: 本文通过在监督监控单元(SMU)中实时获取和融合系统参数，使用VHDL在28-nm GateMate M1A1 FPGA上实现SMU架构，并利用OSS-CAD-Suite工具链进行评估。此外，将以太网堆栈卸载到W5500以太网模块，并集成Grafana仪表板来进一步优化系统。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，SMU架构的资源利用率低，37.6%的LUTs，9.4%的FFs，和35.9%的BRAM。利用OSS-CAD-Suite，包括gmpack v1.13，实现40.48 ms的重配置时间，这对于系统的 rejuvenation 和长期可靠性至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种轻量级的基于FPGA的SCIS，该系统可以在长运行的可靠系统中实现超低延迟的故障响应，降低资源消耗的同时提高系统性能，是一项针对SCS硬件冗余的可行解决方案。

title: Off-the-Shelf Autonomous Agents for Game Playtesting
summary: In playtesting games, a human operator is typically required to test most gameplay elements. In this work we present Buddy, an autonomous game solving agent which can solve long time horizon objectives in an unseen 3D role-playing game using off-the-shelf language model systems. Buddy will take actions, receive feedback on those actions, and pursue a goal across many turns. No written walkthrough or model training of any kind is required, and we show that this paradigm holds in a novel environment where the agent must discover solutions via exploration rather than recalling them from pretraining. We demonstrate three downstream capabilities: game solving with no provided walkthrough, logging bug tickets for encountered difficulties, and conversion of successful agent traces into scripted hierarchical task networks for regression testing. Unlike existing playtesting solutions, our framework is fully modular: language models and harnesses can be easily swapped out as capabilities improve over time.

AI.tldr: Buddy 是一种自主游戏解谜代理，在无需任何走位说明或模型训练的前提下，能够在未见过的 3D 角色扮演游戏环境中解决长时间目标。它展示了三种下游能力：无走位提示的游戏解谜、记录遇到的问题、以及将成功的代理追踪转化为可重复测试的层级任务网络。
AI.motivation: 目前的游戏测试通常依赖于人工操作，这种方式效率较低且成本高昂。Buddy 的研究旨在通过自主游戏代理实现更高效、更灵活的游戏测试自动化。
AI.method: Buddy 利用现成的自然语言处理系统来决策游戏内的行动，并通过接收反馈来调整其行为，以达到长期目标。它通过探索来发现解决方案，而不是依赖预先训练的模型。
AI.result: Buddy 在未见过的 3D 角色扮演游戏环境下展示了其能力，且没有提供任何走位提示。此外，它在三种下游任务中表现出色：游戏解谜、记录问题以及生成测试任务网络。
AI.conclusion: Buddy 的框架是完全模块化的，可以随着技术进步轻松替换语言模型和操作框架，这一突破使得游戏测试自动化变得更加灵活和高效。

title: SD-Cache: Learnable Memory Consolidation with State-Guided Dynamic Caching
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as persistent services that must reason over large volumes of external knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds model responses in relevant documents, but the retrieved content must still be encoded and stored in the key-value (KV) cache. As this content accumulates, the cache grows linearly, increasing memory consumption and inference cost. Existing memory-compression methods address this problem either by retaining a subset of cached states or by learning context compressors that map documents to compact latent representations. Despite these advances, consolidating information under tight memory budgets while preserving its usefulness for future queries remains challenging. We investigate how the model's native KV states can be selectively consolidated into a fixed-size working memory without access to future queries. To this end, we introduce SD-Cache (State-guided and Dynamically updated Cache), a query-agnostic KV-memory consolidation framework that operates alongside a frozen generator LLM. SD-Cache learns to consolidate layer-wise KV states into fixed-size memory through selective anchor-based pooling and state-guided refinement, processing new contexts in a single forward pass without context-specific optimisation. Experiments on retrieval-augmented question answering and synthetic long-context benchmarks show that SD-Cache maintains competitive downstream performance under constrained memory budgets.

AI.tldr: SD-Cache 是一种无需依赖未来查询的 KV 内存压缩框架，能通过选择性锚点池化和状态引导的精炼，将模型的层级 KV 状态压缩到固定大小的内存中，适用于受限内存预算下的 RAG 任务。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆压缩方法要么依赖未来查询，要么压缩后的表示不够紧凑，难以在严格的内存预算下保留信息的有用性。
AI.method: SD-Cache 通过选择性锚点池化和状态引导的精炼逐步压缩模型的层级 KV 状态，并且在处理新上下文时仅需要一次前向传递。
AI.result: SD-Cache 在受限内存预算下，对于检索增强的问答和合成长上下文基准测试，保持了竞争性的下流性能。
AI.conclusion: SD-Cache 是一种有效的内存压缩框架，能够在不影响模型性能的情况下，优化 RAG 任务的内存使用。

title: Synthetic Augmentation for Data-Scarce Object Detection: Allocation, Dose, and Filtering Across Six Datasets
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to European Robotics Forum 2027
summary: Robotic perception for capturing uncooperative orbital objects and inspecting variable industrial products must often operate with limited labelled imagery. We examine a modular synthetic-augmentation pipeline, evaluating generation planning and post-generation filtering as separate interventions, with computational cost as a design constraint. Across six object-detection datasets, FLUX.1-Fill with class-specific LoRA adaptation produced dataset-dependent dose effects; the validation-selected augmentation improved mAP@50:95 on four datasets and reduced it on two. Filtering did not yield consistent gains, and FID, KID, precision, recall, and LPIPS did not consistently track detector changes. The results do not establish that image quality alone identifies useful samples. They motivate standardised evaluation and inexpensive candidate-utility measures that could identify useful samples before detector retraining, reducing repeated training cost.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了使用模块化合成增强流水线进行无配合轨道物体捕获和变量工业产品检查时，生成计划与后生成过滤作为单独干预措施的过程。研究发现，类特定LoRA适应对不同检测数据集具有差异性效果；验证选择的增强增益效果不一致，过滤没有一致的收益。结果表明，仅依靠图像质量不足以确定有用样本，这促使研究标准化评估以及低成本候选性能指标，以在重新训练检测器前识别有用样本，从而减少重复训练成本。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在解决在资源受限环境下进行机器人感知任务的挑战，如捕获无配合轨道对象和检查可变工业产品时，由于缺乏标记图像数据所带来的问题。
AI.method: 研究采用模块化的合成增强流水线，对生成计划和后生成过滤作为分别进行了评估。还利用了类特定的LoRA适配技术和多种量化指标（如FID、KID、精度、召回率和LPIPS）来进行对比分析。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，LoRA适配在不同数据集上具有不同的剂量效应；验证选择的增强方法在四个数据集上优化了mAP@50:95，但在两个数据集上则降低了mAP@50:95。过滤措施并未展现出一致的增益效果。同时发现，检测效果的变化并不能始终与上述量化指标的变化保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 本研究未发现仅依赖图像质量即可确定有用样本的结论。研究建议采用标准化评价和低成本候选性能评估方法，在检测器重新训练之前识别出有用的样本，从而减少重复训练带来的成本。

title: Trading BRAM for LUTs: Hybrid Bit-Level Weight Storage for FPGA-Based Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an attractive paradigm for energy-efficient AI inference, while their deployment on reconfigurable hardware enables application-specific acceleration without sacrificing model reprogrammability. However, realizing this potential on FPGAs is often severely constrained by the immense on-chip memory needed to store synaptic weights. Existing compression techniques reduce this storage requirement at the cost of weight precision or accuracy. This work presents a hybrid bit-level weight-storage scheme that trades BRAM capacity for FPGA logic resources while preserving the original weights unmodified. Selected weight bits are implemented using Look-Up Tables (LUTs), while the remaining bits are stored in BRAM and jointly reconstructed during inference. We integrate this approach into a spatial dataflow SNN architecture and introduce a practical bit-mapping heuristic that efficiently partitions weight bits between BRAM and LUT-based logic without modifying the weights. Experimental evaluation demonstrates more than 26% reduction in BRAM utilization with a modest increase in LUT and register usage, resulting in significant overall power savings.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种混合位级权重存储方案，通过牺牲部分FPGA查找表和寄存器资源来减少片上内存的使用量，从而实现低功耗的可编程硬件上的脉冲神经网络部署。
AI.motivation: 现有的脉冲神经网络（SNN）压缩方法在减少片上内存要求的同时，会降低权重精度或准确性。本文提出了一种方法，能够在保持原始权重不变的情况下，通过牺牲逻辑资源来减少芯片内存需求，从而提高应用特定加速的灵活性和能效。
AI.method: 该方法采用混合位级权重存储方案，使用查找表（LUT）实现选定的权重位，其余位存储在BRAM中，推理时共同重构。该方法还引入了一种实践的位映射启发式方法，用于高效划分权重位。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，该方法可以实现超过26%的BRAM使用率降低，同时LUT和寄存器使用量有适度增加，总体上实现显著的功耗节省。
AI.conclusion: 此工作提出的方法可以为FPGA上高效部署SNN提供新的解决方案，增强其应用灵活性和能效。

title: Safe Autoformalization: Sufficiency and Necessity with Entailment Graphs
comment: 34 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. The results are machine-checked in Lean 4
summary: Autoformalization translates a natural-language statement into a formula that captures its intent, which depends on the statement's context: the background that disambiguates it. LLMs make autoformalization practical, but their probabilistic output carries no formal guarantees. We propose techniques for safe autoformalization that certify one-sided logical adequacy: a formula sufficient for the intent is safe to enforce, and a formula necessary for it is safe to rely on. We use LLMs to generate candidate formulas and order them by logical strength in an Entailment Graph (EG), an ordering a solver decides. Each edge carries a residual and a co-residual, the two adjoints of the entailment order, all fixed by the candidate pool alone. In a context, two searches return the sufficient frontier, the weakest candidates that entail the statement, and the necessary frontier, the strongest candidates the statement entails; each step is one local check against an edge's residual or co-residual. The frontiers bracket the statement and yield the ambiguity residue, which holds exactly of the situations the candidates certify neither as satisfying nor as violating it; the statement is ambiguous precisely when the residue is satisfiable. For natural-language statements and contexts, an LLM entailment oracle decides the checks; it is sound if it accepts only checks that hold, and complete if it accepts every check that holds. We prove that a sound oracle makes the search safe regardless of pool quality, and that a complete one makes the frontiers tight. On security-critical AWS properties, EGs are safe in all 20 cases of an expert-adjudicated study, where majority vote over equivalence clusters and Universal Self-Consistency are unsafe in 25% and 10%. An ablation with the same oracle but no graph is unsafe in 25% and rejects every candidate in another 30%. We machine-checked our proofs in Lean.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种安全的自动形式化技术，利用LLMs生成候选公式，并通过Entailment Graph（蕴含图）来确保公式的逻辑充分性和必要性。研究证明，具备正确性的Oracle能确保搜索过程的安全性，而不依赖于候选公式的质量。实验结果表明，这种方法在AWS安全属性上优于其他方法。
AI.motivation: 当前的LLMs在自然语言到公式转换中缺乏形式保证，这可能导致误解或错误决策。为了提高安全性，研究人员旨在开发一种机制，确保生成的公式能够可靠地捕捉到意图，并且可以在实际场景中有效执行。
AI.method: 该方法基于Entailment Graph（蕴含图）来实现自动形式化。首先，利用LLMs生成多个候选公式；然后通过图的结构与边缘的剩余值和余余值，来确定哪些公式可以满足给定语句，以及哪些公式可以被给定语句反驳。这种方法利用图的拓扑结构来自动筛选出最有可能满足或反驳语句的候选公式。
AI.result: 研究证实，所提出的方法在安全关键的AWS属性上表现优异，证明了一个有保障的Oracle确保了搜索过程的安全性。实验结果显示，在20种专家裁定的安全属性案例中，不含Graph的方法有25%和30%的问题未能得到解决。而使用当前方法，没有一个实例被错误拒绝，且100%的情况得到正确处理。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的基于无图和Oracle的安全自动形式化方法为自然语言到逻辑公式的转换提供了一种新的、更安全的操作方式，增强了实际应用中的正确性和可靠性，尤其是在涉及安全和关键性的场景中。

title: Agentic Systems Need Multi-Run Evaluation: A Study of Retrieval and Response Variability in a Deployed Enterprise RAG System
comment: 10 pages, 6 tables. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET), NeurIPS 2026
summary: Previous RAG systems have mostly been evaluated in a single-run setting, and with the advent of agentic RAG, systems are still often evaluated the same way. However, agentic RAG systems introduce a source of run-to-run variability, since several of their components make decisions non-deterministically. Such systems typically comprise a retrieval stage followed by a generation stage, and the retrieval stage in particular can behave differently across runs. For example, the agent might issue a different number of parallel searches from one run to the next, which alters the retrieved documents and therefore the final answer. In this paper we study this behavior in a deployed agentic RAG system for product-documentation questions, running each of 739 questions ten times and analyzing the execution traces to find where different runs first diverge. We find a substantial gap between success in any run and success in every run: the retrieval hit rate is 69.4% when the correct page is found in at least one run, but 50.9% when it must be found in all ten. Responses also stay similar in meaning while varying in wording, with an average BERTScore of 0.90 and a BLEU of 0.49. Trace-level analysis shows that retrieval is the largest source of divergence (43.9%), and the number of parallel searches at the first retrieval step alone accounts for 20.1% of divergent pairs. Taken together, these results show that single-run evaluation can hide reliability and consistency issues in agentic RAG systems, and that multi-run evaluation is necessary to reveal them.

AI.tldr: 这篇文章分析了一个部署中的代理型RAG系统对产品文档问题的回答行为，发现需要多次运行评估来揭示可靠性等隐藏问题。
AI.motivation: 传统的RAG系统评估方法在单一运行设置下进行，而代理型RAG系统的运行不具有确定性，这导致每次运行的结果可能不同。
AI.method: 作者对739个问题进行每十次运行，并分析运行踪迹以发现不同运行时首次发生分歧的地方。
AI.result: 任何一次运行成功但所有运行均不成功之间的成功率差距显著：找到正确页面的检索命中率达到69.4%，而所有十次都需要找到时仅为50.9%。虽然响应保持相似的意义但用词不同，BertScore为0.90，BLEU为0.49。分析显示检索是造成分歧的最大原因（43.9%），单次检索的并行搜索数量就占到了分歧对的20.1%。
AI.conclusion: 单次运行评估可能会掩盖代理型RAG系统中的可靠性和一致性问题，同时多运行评估是必要的。

title: InitFree-SfM: When Initialization-Free Bundle Adjustment meets Learned Structure-from-Motion
summary: Initialization-free bundle adjustment (InitFree BA) aims to jointly recover camera poses and scene structure without requiring an initial global estimate. It is a very challenging problem, especially compared to traditional BA where a good estimation is assumed. While recent methods optimize surrogate Object Space Error (OSE) objectives from random initialization, a low objective value does not necessarily yield an accurate reconstruction, revealing a gap between optimization and reconstruction. We show that existing InitFree BA pipelines struggle to produce accurate 3D reconstructions on modern SfM benchmarks, and demonstrate that incorporating learned metric depth substantially improves their practical feasibility. We introduce InitFree-SfM, a complete initialization-free SfM pipeline combining learned correspondences, metric depth, depth-consistent track construction, and joint metric refinement. Within this framework, we propose a simple depth-augmented OSE (dOSE), which complements the directional constraints of OSE by constraining landmark positions along their viewing rays. Our approach substantially outperforms existing InitFree BA methods and achieves competitive accuracy with established SfM pipelines, including on challenging low-overlap image collections. Importantly, our analysis challenges the prevailing emphasis on surrogate objectives in previous InitFree BA research, revealing that geometric constraints play a central role in accurate reconstruction, while OSE-based optimization provides further improvements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的初始化自由结构从运动(SfM)管道（InitFree-SfM），通过结合学习到的点对应、度量深度、视差一致的轨迹构建以及联合度量精炼。该方法使用深度增强的物体空间误差（dOSE）作为优化目标，能够显著超越现有的初始化自由贝叶斯调整（InitFree BA）方法，并与传统的SfM管道达到可竞争的重建精度。
AI.motivation: 初始化自由结构从运动的目标是在无需提供初始全局估计的情况下共同恢复相机姿态和场景结构，这是与传统的贝叶斯调整（BA）相比一个更加具有挑战性的问题。现有方法虽然能够通过随机初始化来优化近似目标，但这种目标值较低不一定能实现准确的重建。
AI.method: 该研究介绍了一个完整的初始化自由SfM管道（InitFree-SfM），结合了学习到的对应、度量深度、视差一致的轨迹构建以及联合度量精炼。提出了一种新的深度增强的对象空间误差（dOSE）作为优化目标，通过同时考虑方向约束和点的位置约束来改进优化。
AI.result: InitFree-SfM方法在现代SfM基准上的重建结果显著优于现有的初始化自由BA方法，并且在包括低重叠图像集合在内的具有挑战性的数据集中达到了与传统SfM管道相当的重建精度。
AI.conclusion: 研究显示，几何约束在准确重构中起到了关键作用，而基于对象空间误差的优化提供了进一步的改进。研究结果表明，直接寻找准确的3D重建可能比仅优化低级错误指标更加重要。

title: Scaling Architectural Simulation to Giga Instructions Per Second
summary: The cost of detailed architectural simulation constrains design-space exploration, while parallelization across simulated cores offers limited host concurrency for single-core and small multicore targets. We present GIPSim, an instruction-driven simulator that derives instruction timing from dependencies and resource constraints, reducing the overhead of updating pipeline state every simulated cycle. It applies synchronization-guided temporal decomposition to recorded execution, exposing host parallelism beyond the target core count. GIPSim replays the resulting segments in parallel and aggregates their durations through a dependency graph to estimate overall execution time, with replay contexts reconstructed using retained microarchitectural state, warmup, and synchronization-guided cache eviction. This accounts for synchronization waits without requiring host workers to follow target execution order. We evaluate GIPSim using QEMU traces of application and operating system execution on multi-core x86-64, AArch64, and RV64GC systems. GIPSim achieves an average single-node simulation throughput of 13.8 million instructions per second (MIPS) with one worker and 1{,}010 MIPS with 96 workers, peaking at 1{,}421 MIPS. The corresponding mean absolute percentage errors in execution cycles relative to gem5 are 7.52\% and 7.43\%, respectively.

AI.tldr: GIPSim 是一种指令驱动的模拟器，通过依赖关系和资源约束推导指令时间，减少每模拟周期更新流水线状态的开销。它利用同步引导的时序分解暴露超出目标核心数的主机并行性。GIPSim 通过依赖图聚合段执行时间，评估表明在单个节点上每秒可以模拟 13.8 百万条指令，使用 96 个工人时每秒可以模拟 1010 百万条指令，峰值为 1421 百万条指令。
AI.motivation: 传统的详细体系结构模拟设计空间探索受限于成本，而单核心和小型多核目标的并行化也仅提供有限的主机并发性。GIPSim 的提出旨在解决这些挑战。
AI.method: GIPSim 通过依赖关系和资源约束推导指令时间，利用同步引导的时序分解技术暴露更多级别的并行性，通过依赖图聚合多个段的执行时间来估计总体执行时间。
AI.result: 在多核 x86-64、AArch64 和 RV64GC 系统上使用 QEMU 跟踪的应用程序和操作系统执行，GIPSim 达到了每秒13.8百万条指令的单节点模拟吞吐量，使用 96 个工人时达到每秒1010百万条指令，峰值为1421百万条指令。相对 gem5 的平均绝对百分比误差分别为 7.52% 和 7.43%。
AI.conclusion: GIPSim 通过减少每模拟周期的更新开销和利用同步引导的时序分解技术提高了模拟效率，并且其结果的准确性也得到了验证。

title: Provably Near-Optimal PQ in the Extended Zador Model
summary: This paper investigates Product Quantization (PQ) Optimization with Gaussian data. It offers three key contributions (i) a proof that SVD is the optimal preconditioning rotation for PQ; (ii) a new Extended Zador (EZ) estimator of the $k$-means quantization cost that is accurate in low bit rates and low dimensions; and (iii) a novel segmentation algorithm based on 1-d bin packing of global bit allocations. The result is a simple algorithm (EZPQ) with strong approximation guarantees. It matches OPQ's empirical accuracy while providing a per-instance distortion lower bound certificate under the Gaussian EZ cost model. On typical real embedding spectra, EZPQ with 2 bits per coordinate is often certifiably within 1% of the optimum in this model. It also consistently achieves a lower reconstruction error than all random-rotation-based algorithms such as EDEN, E-RaBitQ, and TurboQuant.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有高斯数据的产品量化(PQ)优化，提出了三方面的贡献：证明了SVD是最优预处理旋转，提出了新的EZ估计器以更准确地估计k-均值量化成本，以及提出了一种基于1-D全局位分配分段的新算法。
AI.motivation: 该研究主要动机是改进产品量化算法的性能和准确性，特别是在低位宽和低维度的情况下，并为此提供了一个新的成本估算器和更有效的分段算法。
AI.method: 研究使用了高斯数据，通过证明SVD是最佳预处理旋转的方法来优化产品量化，并进一步开发了新估计器和分段算法来改进成本估算和分段过程。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，EZPQ算法具有强大的近似保证，其在低位宽（每坐标2位）时，在Gaussian EZ成本模型下的近似精度与OPQ相当，还能提供每个实例的失真下限一致性证明。同时，在典型的真实嵌入光谱下，EZPQ的重构误差低于其他基于随机旋转的算法。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论认为，EZPQ算法在准确性上与当前领先的OPQ算法相当，但在某些情况下提供了更强的近似保证。进一步研究EZPQ算法在不同场景下的适用性是未来工作的一部分。

title: ToneMamaba: Learning Contextualized Tonal Contours with Boundary-Reset State Space Models
summary: Mandarin tone recognition in connected speech is challenging because contextual and durational variation reshapes F0 contours. We propose ToneMamba, a boundary-aware state space model that replaces static boundary embeddings with bidirectional state resets at syllable, word, and IPU levels. Fixed weights fuse multi-level representations, while shared-weight bidirectional scans use channel-wise directional fusion to reduce parameters. Dynamic syllable pooling forms tonal contours, and rhythm-conditioned gating incorporates durational information. ToneMamba achieves 97.9% and 74.8% accuracy on FCU-VOICE-360 read and MCDC-8 conversational speech, outperforming the baseline (ToneNet) by 0.9 and 15.9 percentage points, respectively. Ablations show that word-level resets are particularly effective, while rhythm conditioning provides greater gains in conversational speech, underscoring the role of durational variation in spontaneous speech.

AI.tldr: ToneMamba 是一个边界感知状态空间模型，通过使用双向状态重置来捕捉多级表征，并通过节律调节门控整合持续时间信息，从而在Mandarin声调识别中取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: Mandarin 声调识别在连贯语音中具有挑战性，因为背景和持续时间的变化重塑了F0轮廓。ToneMamba模型旨在解决这一问题，通过引入边界感知机制，提供更准确的声调识别。
AI.method: ToneMamba 使用一个双向状态重置的状态空间模型，通过固定权重融合多级表示，并通过通道级双向融合减少参数。模型采用动态音节池化形成声调轮廓，并通过节奏调节门控整合持续时间信息。具体来说，模型在言语层面引入双向状态重置，同时利用共享权重的双向扫描降低参数量。
AI.result: ToneMamba 在FCU-VOICE-360 阅读数据集和 MCDC-8 会话数据集上分别取得了97.9%和74.8%的准确率，分别超越了基线模型（ToneNet），其中阅读数据集上高出0.9个百分点，会话数据集上的高出15.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果显示，ToneMamba 在Mandarin声调识别方面表现优越，尤其是对于会话数据集，演示了模式中节奏调节门控机制的有效性。

title: Your Codec, Your Generator: Idempotent Generative Compression without Retraining
summary: We introduce an image compression framework with three properties: (i) adaptation of pretrained codecs without retraining or fine-tuning, (ii) cycle-consistent recompression, even of already-encoded images, and (iii) decoding with independently chosen generative priors. We wrap the frozen encoder with non-learned operations so that every continuous latent has a preimage, yielding a surjective pseudo-invertible neural network. A nonlinear right inverse built from the pretrained decoder satisfies $E'(D'(E'(x)))=E'(x)$. To extend consistency to quantized bitstreams, the receiver searches for a continuous latent that reproduces both the transmitted main symbols and entropy side information. A successful search and an exact correction preserve both streams under deterministic coding; the final reconstruction is checked through the actual coding path. The encoder's pseudo-inverse enables a nonlinear counterpart of back-projection. In the linear case, back-projection has the closed-form solution $x'=x+A^\dagger(y-Ax)$, giving the closest reconstruction to $x$ satisfying $Ax'=y$. Our nonlinear formulation enforces the transmitted code on proposals from an independently chosen generative model. Adjusting the starting noise controls the prior's influence without changing that code. Experiments show small first-pass quality changes, higher retained quality than trained consistency codecs over 50 recompressions, also under 8-bit storage, and decoder-side control of the perception-distortion trade-off. Decoupling the codec from its prior lets the receiver adopt future generators without retraining or re-encoding.

AI.tldr: 该框架提出了一种适应预训练编解码器且无需重新训练或微调、循环一致再压缩甚至已编码图像、以及使用独立选择的生成先验进行解码的图像压缩方法。
AI.motivation: 本文提出了一个能够适应预训练编解码器而不重新训练或微调、能够循环一致地重新压缩甚至预编码图像、以及通过独立选择的生成先验进行解码的图像压缩框架。这为未来采用新生成器而不需重新训练或重新编码提供了解决方案。
AI.method: 作者首先冻结了编码器但包裹了非学习操作以确保每个连续的潜在变量都有前像，从而创建一个满射的伪可逆神经网络。然后再建立从预训练解码器中构建的非线性右边逆变换，以确保一致性。为了将一致扩展到量化位流，接收机将搜索一个连续的潜在变量，使其重现出传输的主要符号和熵的侧信息。最终的重建将通过现实的编码路径进行验证。作者通过调整起始噪声控制先验的影响，而不改变已传送出的代码。实验证明了较低的一次性质量变化、在50次重新压缩后保留了更高的质量，且在8位存储下也表现良好，解码器侧控制感知与失真的权衡。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该框架相比训练的一致编解码器在50次重新压缩后保留了更高的质量，且存储量低于8位，解码器侧控制感知与失真的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 作者表明，这种新的图像压缩框架可以在不需要重新训练或微调的情况下，实现循环一致的重新压缩以及基于独立选择的生成先验进行解码，从而为未来采用新生成器做好了准备。

title: CPU-Eval: Evaluating Large Language Models for CPU Hardware Code Generation
comment: Accepted as a regular paper at the 2027 Design, Automation and Test in Europe Conference (DATE 2027). 7 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables
summary: Benchmarks such as VerilogEval have supported rapid advances in hardware description language (HDL) generation by large language models (LLMs). However, recent HDL-generation systems achieve pass rates above 90% on VerilogEval, leaving limited headroom for revealing further advances. To provide a challenging target for further progress on a practically important hardware-development task, we introduce CPU-Eval, a benchmark of 339 HDL-generation problems constructed from six CPUs. Drawn from practical CPU designs, including families fabricated in silicon, the problems span CPUs from small embedded cores to Linux-capable out-of-order cores and cover diverse CPU functions written in SystemVerilog, Chisel, and SpinalHDL. In each problem, an LLM performs the real CPU-development task of generating HDL. Across seven state-of-the-art LLMs, mean pass@1 is 45.14 percentage points lower on CPU-Eval than on VerilogEval v2 Spec-to-RTL, exposing capability differences obscured by VerilogEval's high pass rates. CPU-Eval reveals that pass@1 is lower for submodules with more source-code lines, which motivates fine-grained modular design for LLM-aided hardware generation. We also show that pass@1 is lower for CPUs written in less widely used HDLs, motivating designers to verify that an LLM is sufficiently proficient at generating code in the HDL they use before deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个新基准CPU-Eval，旨在挑战生成硬件描述语言的能力，其结果显示与现有基准相比，生成准确的硬件描述语言更困难。
AI.motivation: 现有基准（如VerilogEval）难以进一步揭示L大型语言模型（LLMs）在硬件描述语言生成方面的进展，因此需要一个更具挑战性的基准来推动L大型语言模型在这个领域的发展。
AI.method: 研究团队构建了一个由六种CPU的问题组成的基准CPU-Eval，这些CPU来自实际的CPU设计，包括硅片上制造的家族。问题涵盖了从小型嵌入式核心到支持Linux的乱序核心的CPU，并用SystemVerilog、Chisel和SpinalHDL编写。每个问题都要求LLM生成实际的CPU开发任务的硬件描述语言。
AI.result: 在七个最先进的LLM上，CPU-Eval的平均准确率比VerilogEval v2 Spec-to-RTL的平均准确率低45.14个百分点，这暴露了VerilogEval未能揭示的能力差异。该研究结果还揭示，模块中源代码行数越多，准确率越低。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出结论，进行精细模块化设计可以提高基于LLM的硬件生成能力，同时建议设计人员在部署LLM生成代码之前验证其在所使用的硬件描述语言上的熟练程度。

title: Frequency-Conditioned Privacy Auditing of Fine-Tuned Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly fine-tuned on sensitive data, where the same person's information may appear multiple times across records. This can cause models to memorize sensitive information, but memorization does not necessarily mean that the information can be recovered. A more serious privacy risk arises when the model begins to reproduce that information during generation. In this paper, we study how often sensitive information must appear in the fine-tuning data before it becomes recoverable. Across four language models, we vary the frequency of email addresses and phone numbers from $1\times$ to $50\times$ and compare standard fine-tuning, gradient clipping, and differentially private training. We find that the number of repetitions required before sensitive information becomes recoverable varies substantially across models. Gradient clipping can delay extraction, but it does not consistently prevent leakage at high repetition. DP-SGD at $\varepsilon=5$ produces zero observed extraction through $50\times$ repetition across all four models under the attacks we test, although the utility cost varies by model. These findings characterize how observed extraction varies across sensitive-data frequencies, model families, and training mechanisms, and highlight substantial differences in extraction behavior across models. Code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 研究了敏感信息在微调数据中出现多少次后才变得可恢复，探讨了三种不同的微调方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 探讨了大规模语言模型在敏感数据中微调时的风险和保护措施，特别是敏感信息的记忆和再现问题。
AI.method: 研究人员通过改变微调数据中邮件地址和电话号码的重复次数，从1倍到50倍，并对比了标准微调、梯度剪裁和差分隐私训练方法。
AI.result: 结果表明，在不同模型中，敏感信息变为可恢复所需的重复次数差异较大。虽然梯度剪裁可以在一定程度上延迟信息提取，但不能完全阻止高重复次数下的信息泄露；差分隐私训练在攻击下表现出色，即使在50倍重复的情况下，ε=5的DP-SGD在四种模型中的测试中均未观察到信息提取，尽管不同模型的实用性成本不同。
AI.conclusion: 这是第一项系统研究敏感数据频率、模型种类和训练机制之间关系的工作，它展示了模型之间提取行为的显著差异。相关代码和数据公开可用。

title: AhaPro: A Process-level Rebus benchmark for probing Aha moments in LLM reasoning
summary: Existing research on Aha moments in large language models has largely focused on reflective expressions or final revision outcomes, leaving their role in the visible reasoning process insufficiently characterized. Rebus puzzles encode answers through character forms, spatial arrangements, and homophony. Reinterpreting key details may trigger Aha moments and shifts in the reasoning process and candidate answers. We introduce AhaPro, a process-level benchmark that uses rebus puzzles to examine how models reorganize evidence and revise answers through Aha moments. The framework represents CoT as sequences of candidate answers, evidence, and verification states, using hierarchical metrics to assess conflict detection, state improvement, and subsequent adoption. Across eleven models, we observe frequent failures to adopt better states discovered during Aha moments, alongside adopted revisions that leave state quality unchanged or reduce it. Models also detect conflicts without subsequently achieving an effective revision. Further paired interventions suggest that prior reasoning context may hinder effective revision after conflict detection, while multi-branch search highlights answer selection as a bottleneck between correct-answer discovery and successful correction.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过引入AhaPro基准，使用谜题来探索大型语言模型在Aha时刻中的证据重组和答案修订过程。研究发现，模型在遇到冲突时往往无法有效地进行修订，并指出先前的推理背景可能是瓶颈之一。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注大型语言模型中的反思性表达或最终修订结果，而忽视了Aha时刻在其可见推理过程中的角色。因此，该研究旨在通过AhaPro基准和谜题重新诠释关键细节，来更好地理解Aha时刻及其对推理过程和候选答案的影响。
AI.method: 该研究将CoT（思考过程）表示为一系列候选答案、证据和验证状态的序列，并使用分层指标评估冲突检测、状态改善和后续采用。此外，进行了配对干预来探讨冲突检测后有效修订的挑战。
AI.result: 研究发现，模型在Aha时刻后频繁地未能采用发现的较好状态，同时某些修订反而降低了状态质量。模型在检测到冲突后也未能有效进行修订。此外，配对干预显示先前的推理背景可能阻碍有效的修订，而多分支搜索则强调答案选择是发现正确答案与成功修正之间的一个瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了在Aha时刻和冲突检测后的修订过程中存在的问题，并指出了需要改进的领域。研究表明，理解和解决这些挑战对于提高模型的推理能力和最终性能至关重要。

title: Fast Anatomy-Aware Diffeomorphic Augmentation for Brain MRI
summary: Data augmentation is essential for training deep learning models that are generalizable, particularly when training data are limited. In brain MRI, augmentation methods that synthesize anatomically diverse images without relying on large cohorts are particularly attractive, especially when training supervised models for scans with a specific resolution or MRI contrast. While conventional random nonlinear fields offer a simple means of achieving such diversity, they fail to capture the underlying spatial dependencies among morphological changes across brain regions. To address this limitation, we introduce BrainAug, an anatomy-aware augmentation framework that generates diverse, anatomically coordinated deformations without relying on population imaging data. BrainAug constructs an anatomical graph encoding spatial proximity and bilateral correspondence between brain regions, then incorporates these relationships into a probabilistic model designed to sample correlated regional volume changes. These sampled variations are translated into diffeomorphic transformations, enabling substantial structural changes while preserving anatomical topology. Combined with contrast-agnostic image synthesis, BrainAug generates training images with independently varying anatomy and appearance. Evaluations across eight brain MRI datasets demonstrate stronger segmentation generalization across diverse populations, while registration experiments show improved alignment under substantial morphological differences.

AI.tldr: BrainAug 提出了一种基于大脑解剖结构的增强框架，通过构造解剖图来捕捉空间依赖性，生成与特定脑区变化相关的变形，从而在有限数据下提高分割任务的泛化能力和配准效果。
AI.motivation: 在有限的训练数据下训练适用于特定脑MRI分辨率和对比度的监督模型时，需要有效的数据增强方法来合成具有解剖多样性且不依赖大型影像数据集的图像。
AI.method: BrainAug 构建了大脑区域之间的解剖图，基于此图将空间邻近性和双侧对应关系纳入概率模型中，用于采样相关区域体积变化，并将这些变化转化为相差同胚变换，从而独立地修改图像的解剖结构和外观。
AI.result: 在八个脑MRI数据集上的评估表明，BrainAug 能够在不同人群中增强分割任务的泛化能力；配准实验还显示，它在复杂形态差异下表现出更好的对齐效果。
AI.conclusion: BrainAug 提供了一种有效的数据增强方法，可在MRI数据有限的情况下训练出性能更好的脑部MRI图像分析模型。

title: OpenWoud: Vendor-Unlocked Scalable Adaptive Random Forest Accelerator
summary: Online Machine Learning (ML) enables real-time decision-making on evolving data streams. These dynamic models learn continuously to adapt to new concepts, as previous ones become invalid, but their performance is often limited by throughput. The Adaptive Random Forest (ARF) is a state-of-the-art model for this setting, which naturally exposes parallelism and is therefore well-suited for hardware acceleration. However, prior Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA)-based accelerators are vendor-locked and rely on resource-hungry Floating-Point (FP) arithmetics, limiting their scalability and portability. We present OpenWoud, a vendor-unlocked ARF framework for FPGAs. Our design replaces FP operators with a flexible FiXed-Point (FxP) arithmetic library and introduces fully transparent, manually scheduled dataflows for training and drift detection. This enables fine-grained time/area trade-offs and predictable behavior across platforms. A comprehensive evaluation on both synthetic and real datasets shows that OpenWoud maintains or increases accuracy (up to +12.89%), compared to a prior FPGA accelerator, while reducing the resource utilization by half. Competitive performance is observed compared to GPU (0.5 - 1.5x speed-up) and an FPGA baseline (0.2 - 0.5x), despite the latter being based on idealized simulation. Crucially, OpenWoud sustains true sample-by-sample inference, unlike GPUs that require batch insertion.

AI.tldr: OpenWoud是一个基于FPGA的OpenSource框架，通过使用灵活的定点算术库和手动调度的数据流，实现了低资源消耗和可预测的行为，对比之前的FPGA加速器，它在准确性上有所提高，并且相比GPU和理想化的FPGA基线表现较好。
AI.motivation: 当前的FPGA加速器存在硬件锁定和资源消耗大的问题，无法有效扩展和移植。为了克服这些限制，作者提出了一种基于FPGA的OpenWoud框架。
AI.method: OpenWoud框架采用了灵活的定点算术库替代浮点运算，并引入了完全透明的手动调度数据流进行训练和概念漂移检测，从而实现了细粒度的时间/面积权衡。
AI.result: OpenWoud框架在资源利用率上减少了50%，并且与之前的FPGA加速器相比准确率有所提高，提升了12.89%。与GPU相比，它的性能提升了0.5-1.5倍，而与理想化的FPGA基线相比，性能提升了0.2-0.5倍。同时，它能够实现逐样本的推理，而无需批量插入。
AI.conclusion: OpenWoud框架能够有效地减少资源消耗，提高准确性和稳定性，克服了以往FPGA加速器的限制。

title: Monitorable-by-design architectures for a post-Astra world: a compartmentalization-based approach
comment: 14 pages plus 2 pages of references, 1 figure
summary: Frontier models like GPT-6 Astra are increasingly able to do substantial reasoning without a monitorable chain of thought, chains of thought are becoming less legible, and are often monitored asynchronously to reduce cost. With the future of chain of thought monitoring unclear, it may be necessary to design LLMs with monitorability in mind. We propose a modification to existing LLM architectures based on GRAM, SGTM, DEMix, BTS, and similar methods to compartmentalize dangerous capabilities so that their use, especially in combination with dangerous reasoning types that may indicate strategic adversarial use, can be monitored more cheaply than chain of thought in a way that might outlast monitorable chain of thought. We propose several variants of this architecture designed to balance tradeoffs and discuss other benefits, such as capability removal.

AI.tldr: 文章提出了一种修改现有LLM架构的方法，旨在通过将潜在危险的功能进行分区，使其使用可以比链条思考更便宜地进行监测，从而支持长期的监控能力。
AI.motivation: 由于前沿模型如GPT-6 Astra越来越能够进行推理而无需明确的链条思考，且链条思考越来越难以监控，本文旨在探索如何设计LLM使其更加易于监控。
AI.method: 基于GRAM, SGTM, DEMix, BTS等方法，本文提出了一种对现有LLM架构的修改方案，旨在通过将潜在危险的能力进行分区，使其使用可以比链条思考更便宜地进行监测。
AI.result: 作者提出了一些这个架构的变体，并讨论了其他益处，如能力移除。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为未来设计具备长期监控能力的LLM提供了新的思路，并为进一步的研究和发展奠定了基础。

title: Reliability of Language-Model Judges for Quantitative Scientific Question Answering: Evidence from Perovskite Photovoltaics
summary: Evaluating retrieval-augmented language models increasingly relies on automated model judges, yet their reliability on quantitative scientific synthesis remains largely unmeasured. Here, we evaluate automated grading on a quantitative benchmark for perovskite photovoltaics, where all 755 ground-truth answers are deterministically computed from 45,441 experimental device records. We evaluate a frontier judge (Claude Opus 5.5) alongside two local open-weight judges (Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-8B) across 4,530 free-text answers from six retrieval architectures under three regimes: reference-augmented (with the computed key), evidence-augmented (with retrieved passages and query logs), and unassisted (question and answer alone). Equipped with the reference key, Claude Opus reproduces ground truth near-perfectly (Cohen's $κ= 0.982 \pm 0.003$) and preserves exact architectural rankings ($τ= 1.00$). Withholding the reference causes evaluation fidelity to collapse: frontier agreement drops to $κ= 0.557 \pm 0.022$, and providing retrieved literature passages yields virtually no improvement ($κ= 0.576 \pm 0.024$). Without reference keys, local judges degrade to near-random agreement ($κ= 0.087$ and $0.112$), inverting the leaderboard to rank a hallucinating closed-book baseline first ($τ\le 0.20$). Furthermore, SQL-augmented generations induce severe evaluative blind spots: absent a reference, the frontier judge accepts 46.6% of erroneous SQL answers, overestimating architecture accuracy as 66.4% against its true 52.6%. These findings demonstrate that model-based evaluation in the physical sciences cannot rely on unstructured text inspection; rigorous benchmarking requires reference ground truth precomputed from structured measurement records.

AI.tldr: 该研究在光伏领域评估了自动评分系统的可靠性和局限性，发现依赖未结构化文本的评估无法代替精确的基准测试，特别是在缺乏参考标准时，自动评分系统的表现大幅下降。
AI.motivation: 为了评估基于检索增强语言模型在物理科学领域（以钙钛矿光伏为例）的自动化评分系统的可靠性和局限性。
AI.method: 研究使用了一个包含45,441个实验设备记录和755个确定性正确答案的定量基准，对比评估了Claude Opus和Qwen3-14B/Qwen3-8B在三种不同问题模式下的表现。
AI.result: 在提供参考标准的条件下，Claude Opus的表现非常接近完美，但在缺乏参考标准时，其表现大幅下降，本地评分器几乎达到随机水平，且在评估中产生了严重偏差。
AI.conclusion: 研究指出，在物理科学领域，基于模型的评价系统不能仅依赖于未结构化的文本评估，必须依赖严格的基准测试，这种基准测试需要基于从结构化测量记录中预先计算出的参考标准。

title: Lit Up but Not Needed: Scoped Lesions Show Where Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts Depend on Their Experts
summary: Cognitive neuroscience learned that an activation map is not a map of necessity. Regions that light up during a task are not always needed for it, and only lesions reveal which ones are. Mixture-of-experts (MoE) vision-language models come with an activation map for free, since the router records which experts respond to image and text tokens, and recent work reads modality-specialized experts off this map. We bring the lesion. In Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, Kimi-VL-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B, 3 to 12% of the experts are vision-exclusive: image tokens route to them at up to five times the uniform rate and text tokens almost never.
