title: ArabFake: A multitask deep learning framework for Arabic fake news Detection, Categorization, and risk prediction
summary: The spread of fake news among Arabic media including social media represents a great challenge to the integrity of information and the trust of the public in it. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive deep-learning framework, named ArabFake, that goes beyond the binary classification on Arabic fake news detection. ArabFake, built over MARBERTv2 (a state-of-the-art model for multi-dialectal Arabic tweets), proficiently address the complexity of the Arabic language while performing three unified tasks which are fake news detection, content categorization and its risk assessment. The framework promotes efficiency and performance both by enabling multi-task learning through shared knowledge representation across tasks. In order to facilitate development and evaluation, we present the ArabFake Dataset consisting of 2,495 manually labelled news items with labels that are verified by experts regarding fake news categories and risk levels. ArabFake demonstrates robust performance, achieving an F1 score of 94.12% for fake news detection, 84.92% for categorization, and 88.91% for risk zone assessment, highlighting its reliability and effectiveness across multiple tasks. We improve interpretability and extract insight into manipulative techniques by integrating valence scoring as part of the framework that emphasizes misleading linguistic cues used to disseminate fake news within the produced image. The results show that ArabFake is a holistic Arabic fake news detection framework that has practical implications on news organizations and fact checking projects.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了一个名为ArabFake的综合深度学习框架，该框架能够全面识别阿拉伯语假新闻，涵盖假新闻检测、内容分类和风险评估等任务，展示了强大的性能，并提出了一个大规模的手动标注数据集。
AI.motivation: 为了解决阿拉伯媒体中假新闻传播对信息完整性和公众信任的重大挑战，文章提出了一个超越二元分类的阿拉伯假新闻检测深度学习框架。
AI.method: ArabFake基于MARBERTv2（最先进的多方言阿拉伯语推文模型）构建，支持多任务学习，通过任务间共享知识表示增强效率和性能。
AI.result: ArabFake框架表现出强大的性能，假新闻检测的F1分数达到94.12%，内容分类的F1分数为84.92%，风险评估的F1分数为88.91%，并且通过整合情感评分提高了可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了ArabFake是全面的阿拉伯假新闻检测框架，具有实际应用价值，有助于新闻组织和事实核查项目。

title: VISOR: A Vision-Language Selector for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Recent time-series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast a distribution over futures, and multimodal time-series (TS) forecasting further exploits other modalities to improve forecasting accuracy. However, existing works have two limitations: 1) TSFMs reduce the predictive distribution to its median or mean, flattening diverse futures into a calm line, and 2) multimodal TS forecasting models incorporate text into the forecaster through TS-language alignment, which is substantially weaker than vision-language alignment. To address these limitations, we propose the VIsion-language SelectOR (VISOR), a multimodal TS forecasting framework that selects one plausible future instead of averaging across candidates, leveraging the alignment capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) to select the most suitable candidate based on textual information. VISOR consists of two components: 1) a text-free stochastic predictor that samples diverse candidate futures, and 2) a VLM selector that reads the candidates as a single chart image and selects one based on the text. To avoid overly calm forecasting paths, we train the selector with a shape-aware target that evaluates each candidate based on both point-wise error and path shape. Across three benchmarks covering ten datasets, VISOR achieves the best average ranking in both point and volatility errors compared with TSFMs and multimodal TS forecasting models. Code: https://github.com/seunghan96/VISOR.

AI.tldr: VISOR 是一种利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）选择最合适的未来预测方案的多模态时间序列预测框架，通过减少预测分布的多样性并使用形状感知目标进行训练，提高了预测准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的时间序列基础模型和多模态时间序列预测模型存在降低预测分布多样性和依靠相对较弱的TS语言对齐将文本纳入预测器的问题，因此提出VISOR以提升预测效果。
AI.method: VISOR框架包含一种无文本的随机预测器和一个基于视觉-语言模型选择器，该选择器能够读取候选预测值并根据文本信息进行选择。同时，为了防止预测路径过于平坦，训练选择器时采用了一种形状感知的目标来评估预测值。
AI.result: 在涵盖十个数据集的三个基准测试中，VISOR在点误差和波动性误差方面取得了最好的平均排名，优于时间序列基础模型和多模态时间序列预测模型。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，VISOR框架能够更准确地预测未来时间序列，尤其是在数据和标签丰富的场景下，显示出利用视觉-语言模态的优势。

title: RepoEviAgent: Scalable Synthesis of Evidence-Grounded Repository-Level Question Answering Tasks
summary: Real-world software engineering (SWE) tasks require agents to understand repository structures, cross-module dependencies, and runtime behaviors, posing significant challenges for constructing high-quality training and evaluation data. To address this, we propose RepoEviAgent, a scalable SWE data construction framework that integrates quality-aware data curation and role-specialized multi-agent task synthesis. Starting from 8,477 open-source repositories and approximately 2.48 million pull request records, we employ semantic alignment, complexity constraints, and multidimensional quality assessment to identify valuable SWE data. We further develop a sandbox-based multi-agent framework that integrates automated environment construction, execution validation, repository exploration, and evidence-grounded Q&A synthesis. Based on this framework, we construct RepoEviQA, a benchmark for Repository-Level Evidence-Grounded Question Answering, comprising 334 tasks across five programming languages and diverse SWE categories, with rigorous rubric-based evaluation. We evaluate five frontier coding models on RepoEviQA, revealing substantial performance differences across task categories and programming languages.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了RepoEviAgent框架，通过集成质量感知的数据整理和专业化多智能体任务合成，从8,477个开源仓库和248万条pull request记录中构建了高质量的SWE数据集。基于此框架，构建了包含334项任务的基准RepoEviQA，涵盖五种编程语言和多种软件工程类别。
AI.motivation: 现有的软件工程任务需要理解复杂的仓库结构、跨模块依赖关系和运行时行为，这对高质量数据集的构建提出了挑战。因此，提出了RepoEviAgent框架来应对这些问题。
AI.method: 该框架通过语义对齐、复杂性约束和多维质量评估识别有价值的SWE数据，并开发了一种基于沙箱的多智能体框架，包含自动化环境构建、执行验证、仓库探索和证据基础的问答合成。
AI.result: 构建了RepoEviQA基准，包含334项任务，涵盖多种编程语言和软件工程类别。并且，在该基准上评估了五个前沿的编码模型，揭示了不同任务类别和编程语言之间的性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了RepoEviAgent和RepoEviQA在软件工程数据集构建和评估上的潜力，为软件工程领域提供了有价值的资源和研究基础。

title: Implementation of Machine Translation for the Uzbek Language Based on Transformer Models
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Authors' version of a paper published in the Proceedings of the 1st International Scientific-Practical Conference "Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence: Problems, Innovations and Trends" (DTAI-2024), Tashkent State University of Economics, pp. 450-456; reference list corrected and figures redrawn
summary: This research focuses on building a machine translation system for the Uzbek language using transformer models such as T5 and mT5. Because of the limited data and the complexity of the Uzbek language, we collect, preprocess and augment data to create a strong Uzbek-English parallel corpus of about 3 million sentence pairs. The models are fine-tuned for optimal translation performance, and we use the BLEU score to evaluate the results. This study shows that our approach significantly improves upon older methods and helps promote the Uzbek language in the digital world.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用T5和mT5变压器模型构建了乌兹别克语的机器翻译系统，并通过整理和增强数据创建了一个包含约300万句对的平行语料库，使用BLEU分数评估了翻译性能的提升。
AI.motivation: 鉴于乌兹别克语数据有限且语言复杂，本研究旨在通过收集、预处理和增强数据，以及利用变压器模型提高机器翻译性能，从而促进乌兹别克语在数字世界的应用。
AI.method: 研究收集并预处理了乌兹别克语语料库，使用T5和mT5模型进行微调。
AI.result: 研究使用BLEU分数评估了模型性能，结果显示该方法显著优于传统方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，本研究提出的乌兹别克语翻译系统在性能上有了显著提升，有助于推动乌兹别克语的发展。

title: SceneMemBench: A Benchmark for Scene Memory in Interactive Video World Models
summary: Interactive video world models generate navigable worlds frame by frame, but a persistent world requires previously observed scenes to remain recoverable as users move away and return. Existing memory evaluations, however, often focus on seen-view revisits and full rollouts, leaving cross-view scene recovery underexplored while entangling memory with trajectory-following errors and accumulated generation degradation. We introduce SceneMemBench, a benchmark for scene memory in interactive video world models. It evaluates two complementary dimensions: seen-view recall versus novel-view recovery, and controlled diagnosis versus end-to-end interaction. We introduce Continued Rollout from a shared ground-truth observation history, alongside Full Rollout over complete model-generated interactions. SceneMemBench contains 600 controlled trajectories across 33 Unreal Engine scenes and 60 Full Rollout cases, covering eight representative open- and closed-source models. We evaluate scene recovery along subject consistency, appearance fidelity, and geometric consistency. Results show that novel-view recovery is generally more challenging than seen-view recall, while model profiles under controlled histories can differ markedly from those observed in full interaction. Together, these findings reveal complementary failure modes obscured by seen-view revisits or end-to-end rollouts alone.

AI.tldr: SceneMemBench 是一个用于评估交互式视频世界模型中情景记忆的新基准，它通过不同的测试维度对新视图恢复和已见视图回忆进行了评估，并引入了新的测试方案，展示了单独使用已见视图回访或端到端滚动所掩盖的互补失败模式。
AI.motivation: 由于现有记忆评估方法关注已见视图回访和完整的滚动播放，而忽视了不同视角下的场景恢复能力，且过度依赖于与轨迹跟随错误和积累的生成衰退的纠缠，因此提出了SceneMemBench这一基准，以更全面地评估交互式视频世界模型中的情景记忆。
AI.method: SceneMemBench 通过设定两维测试：已见视图回忆与新视图恢复，以及控制诊断与端到端交互，并引入了从共享的真实观察历史中继续滚动的新方案，以及完整的滚动方案。测试覆盖了来自多个开源与商用模型的实际场景。
AI.result: 结果表明，新视图恢复比已见视图回忆更具有挑战性。在受控历史记录下的模型表现与端到端交互中观察到的表现存在显著差异。这揭示了单独使用已见视图回访或端到端滚动未能暴露的互补失败模式。
AI.conclusion: SceneMemBench 提供了一种全面评估交互式视频世界模型中情景记忆的新方法，有助于研究者更好地理解和改进这类模型。

title: HEAR, SEE, SPIKE ONCE: Highly Efficient NeuroAI Temporal Neural Networks for Low-Precision Multimodal Audio-Visual Classification and Online Learning
summary: Spiking neural networks for multimodal audio-visual classification reach high accuracy by adopting deep-learning machinery: multi-stage convolutional or transformer encoders trained end-to-end with surrogate-gradient backpropagation through time. These prior works typically rely on full-precision (32-bit) parameters and do not treat hardware efficiency as a primary design objective. In this paper, we propose NeuTNN-AV, a much simpler hardware-amenable multimodal substrate built on the recently proposed NeuroAI Temporal Neural Network (NeuTNN) and demonstrate that it can match or outperform state-of-the-art SNN baselines with a fraction of their synapse counts. NeuTNN neurons carry multiple active dendritic segments. Each input line spikes at most once (temporal coding) and every weight is learned via a local reward-modulated spike-timing dependent plasticity (STDP) rule. All weights are 4-bit integers and inference uses only comparisons and additions. On CREMA-D, it reaches 78.6% with 2.34M synapses establishing a new state-of-the-art SNN accuracy, against 77.14% for MISNet-XL (31M parameters). On UrbanSound8K-AV, NeuTNN reaches 98.82% with 1.38M synapses, against 96.85% for SMMT (9.99M parameters) and 98.96% for MISNet-XL (31M parameters). Weight memory is 23-106x smaller than the spiking baselines, and the measured synaptic energy per inference is two to three orders of magnitude lower. Furthermore, the proposed NeuTNN learns CREMA-D in a single pass with 73.8% accuracy and demonstrates rapid online continual learning by adapting to unseen actors from a few dozen clips.

AI.tldr: NeuTNN-AV 使用 4 位整数和简洁的硬件架构，在音频-视觉分类中实现了 SNN 技术的新最佳性能，同时大幅减少了权重存储和推理能耗。
AI.motivation: 现有神经元网络依赖于全精度参数并忽视了硬件效率，本研究旨在通过简化结构和使用低精度权重来提高 SNN 的效率。
AI.method: NeuTNN-AV 采用了新颖的 NeuroAI 时域神经网络 (NeuTNN)，每个输入线仅在时间上编码一次，权重通过本地奖励调制的 STDP 规则学习。所有权重均为 4 位整数，并且推理过程中仅使用比较和加法。
AI.result: 在 CREMA-D 数据集上，NeuTNN-AV 达到 78.6% 的准确率，只有 MISNet-XL 推理次数的 1/13，同时准确率超过了 MISNet-XL 和 SMMT。在 UrbanSound8K-AV 数据集上，NeuTNN 达到 98.82% 的准确率，显著优于 SMMT 和 MISNet-XL，且所用的突触数量更少。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，NeuTNN-AV 可以通过减少权重存储和推理能耗，实现与现有 SNN 技术相当甚至更好的效果，同时具有快速适应和在线持续学习的能力。

title: Decision Models: An Introduction and Capability Evaluation
summary: Applications such as ticket routing and incident triage need decisions that software can act on. Decision models provide these outputs through explicit types for choices, binary judgments, and policy scores. We evaluate the accuracy, output validity, and request latency of eleven configurations on 1,000 English and Chinese cases across nine task suites. StartLux Instant achieves 95.3% overall accuracy, returns valid outputs on all 1,000 cases, and has a median request latency of 0.084 s. It reaches 99.4% on classification and routing and selects the correct response on all 100 tool-selection cases. The highest overall accuracy among the evaluated configurations is 97.1%. These results show how a typed decision service can support fast, programmatic decisions and why its suitability depends on task-specific errors and latency requirements.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了11种配置在1000个英语和中文案例上的准确性、输出有效性及请求延迟，StartLux Instant表现出色，总体准确率为95.3%，分类和路由准确率高达99.4%，且响应延迟较短。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在评估决策模型在常见的软件应用中的表现，如票务路由和事件转译，这些应用需要软件能够迅速做出决策。
AI.method: 研究者通过对比11种不同配置在9个任务套件中的表现，评估了准确性、输出有效性和请求延迟。
AI.result: StartLux Instant在所有测试案例中均能生成有效输出，总体准确率为95.3%，分类和路由任务的准确率为99.4%，响应延迟中位数为0.084秒。最高整体准确率为97.1%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，带有类型化的决策服务能够支持快速的、程序化的决策，其适合性取决于具体任务中的误差和延迟需求。

title: Generalizable Feed-Forward 3D Hand-Object Reconstruction with Coarse-to-Fine Contact Estimation
summary: Reconstructing the 3D poses of hands and objects from a single image, together with the contact between them, is fundamental to understanding manipulation. To be practical, the reconstruction must generalize to unseen objects, and the contact must be localized precisely. Yet joint feed-forward estimators often rely on predefined object sets, while contact is typically predicted from image features alone, without the explicit geometry needed to localize it. To address both limitations, we present HORCRUX, a unified feed-forward transformer with coarse-to-fine contact estimation. For unseen objects, a frozen foundation model encodes the object from a given or image-reconstructed mesh rather than from object-specific knowledge. A shared transformer then reasons jointly over the object and one or two hands to keep them aligned. For precise contact, coarse per-joint predictions from latent features are resolved over finer hand regions using the reconstructed geometry. Across seven benchmarks, HORCRUX achieves state-of-the-art object and hand pose accuracy among joint estimators and outperforms a dedicated contact estimator in fine-grained contact. These results suggest that contact is best estimated jointly with reconstruction, whose geometry directly localizes it.

AI.tldr: HORCRUX 是一个统一的前向变压器，能够从单张图像中恢复手和物体的3D姿态以及接触关系。它通过使用冻结的基础模型和共享的变压器联合推理手和物体，解决了对未见过的物体的泛化问题，并通过重建的几何形状细化关节级预测以实现精确的接触定位。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么依赖预定义的对象集，要么单独预测接触而缺乏必要的几何信息。 HORCRUX 的提出旨在解决这两方面的问题，提升在未见过物体上的泛化能力和精确的接触定位。
AI.method: HORCRUX 使用一个冻结的基础模型从给定或图像重建的网格中编码对象，而不是依赖于特定的对象知识。共享的变压器联合推理手和物体，以保持它们的对齐。对于精细的接触定位，HORCRUX 通过重建的几何形状细化关节级预测。
AI.result: HORCRUX 在七项基准测试中表现最佳，其手部和物体姿态的准确度超过了现有的联合估算器。同时，HORCRUX 在精细的接触分类中也优于专门的接触估算器。
AI.conclusion: HORCRUX 提示我们接触最好与重建一起联合估计，重建的几何可以直接定位接触。

title: Cheap Memory Costs Future Compute: Co-Designing Persistent KV and GPU Execution for Efficient Streaming Video Diffusion
summary: Block-causal video diffusion generates long videos block by block, conditioned on a persistent key-value (KV) cache. After each block is denoised, an extra noise-free ($t=0$) forward pass writes its clean KV into the cache; once distillation and speculative early exit make denoising cheap, this clean KV update dominates the runtime. Reusing stale KV shortens the update, but stale memory corrupts the conditioning of later blocks and inflates their denoising steps, so the saved compute reappears downstream. We present SAMR (Step-Aware Memory Reconstruction), a training-free method for frozen causal video DiTs that refreshes only part of the cache and reconstructs the rest without DiT forwards. Our key observation is that, once rotary position phases are removed, motion-aligned historical KV and the in-flight KV a token holds at its exit step are complementary estimates of its clean KV. SAMR debiases in-flight KV with offline-calibrated per-head affine maps in Pre-RoPE space, fuses the two estimates, and reserves true $t=0$ refreshes for tokens flagged by an attention-readout error proxy, all executed by tile-aligned, synchronization-free Triton kernels. On 48-second LongLive-1.3B videos, SAMR reduces DiT latency by 20.9% and principal FLOPs by 30.7% relative to dense KV updates, lowers downstream denoising steps, and improves final-quarter PSNR over token reuse by 1.61 dB (1.14 dB on held-out VidProM-16). The reconstruction also transfers to frozen Self-Forcing-DMD-1.3B: zero-shot, it reduces reuse-induced step inflation ($2.47 \to 2.30$ steps/token) and improves late PSNR by $+0.33$ dB, and a one-time training-free calibration recovers the diagnostic score that zero-shot transfer lowers ($89.62 \to 91.10$).

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SAMR（步进感知内存重建）方法，该方法在无需训练的情况下仅刷新缓存的一部分，并在无需DiT前向传递的情况下重建其余部分。该方法通过融合步进感知的KV估计和历史KV估计，减少了DiT延迟和主要FLOPs，提高了视频的质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于DiT的方法在条件化后续块时频繁地刷新KV缓存，这样会增加运行时开销和延迟。SAMR方法的目标是通过减少KV刷新的开销，同时保持视频的生成质量。
AI.method: SAMR通过去除旋转位置编码的相位并在预RoPE空间中使用每头的仿射映射对飞行KV进行去偏差，然后再融合步进感知的KV估计和历史KV估计。SAMR还通过标记出读取注意力错误代理指定的token来保留真实的$t=0$刷新，并且所有这些操作都在同步自由的Triton内核中执行。
AI.result: 在48秒的LongLive-1.3B视频上，SAMR将DiT延迟降低了20.9%，FLOPs降低了30.7%。它减少了所需的后续去噪步骤，并且与基于token重用的方法相比，在最后一部分提高了0.61 dB的PSNR（在VidProM-16上为1.14 dB）。此外，SAMR在冻结的Self-Forcing-DMD-1.3B模型上的零次传递中降低了消耗步骤，提高了末尾的PSNR水平。
AI.conclusion: 总之，SAMR提供了一种高效的方法来减少基于DiT模型的运行时间，同时保持高质量的视频生成，并且该方法成功地在多个模型和测试视频上进行了验证。

title: On the Importance of Hidden-State Refinement in Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked or corrupted token sequences, allowing token predictions to condition on bidirectional context and update multiple positions in parallel. While each denoising step produces a rich layer-wise hidden-state trajectory, prior work typically focuses only on token-level information and discards these continuous hidden states, leaving their refinement dynamics underexplored. In this work, we analyze hidden-state dynamics in MDLMs and find clear evidence of layer-wise and cross-step refinement: smooth evolution across adjacent layers, greater predictive power in deeper layers, gradual degradation under transformer block removal, and strong final-state alignment across consecutive denoising steps. Motivated by these observations, we propose Cross-Step Recurrent Refinement (CSRR), a mechanism that carries hidden-state information across denoising steps to enhance generation. Extensive experiments show that CSRR improves text generation quality, highlighting the critical role of continuous hidden-state refinement in MDLMs. Project page: https://zhongzero.github.io/Recurrent-DLLM/

AI.tldr: 研究表明，掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）中的隐藏状态在层间和步骤间存在优化，提出了一种跨步骤递归精炼机制（CSRR），通过携带隐藏状态信息跨步来提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的MDLM工作通常忽略了连续隐藏状态的优化动态，因此该研究表明需要探索并利用这些优化动态来改进生成效果。
AI.method: 通过分析MDLM中的隐藏状态动态，发现层间和步骤间的优化证据，设计了一个跨步骤递归精炼机制（CSRR），以携带隐藏状态信息跨步，增强了生成效果。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，CSRR可以显著提高文本生成的质量，突显了连续隐藏状态在MDLM中的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种新的机制CSRR，通过跨步骤传递隐藏状态信息来提高MDLM的文本生成质量，为改进MDLM提供了新的思路和机会。

title: G0.7: Scaling Up a Fast World Action Model with Long Context
summary: World action models (WAMs) adapt pretrained video generators for robot control by jointly predicting future camera frames and actions, transferring physical priors learned from video into manipulation policies. However, generating future frames before every action makes test-time inference too slow for closed-loop control, while most existing policies remain restricted to short observation histories. Building on Fast-WAM, which showed that video prediction shapes policy representations during training so that future frame synthesis can be skipped at deployment, we present G0.7, a generalist world action model scaled along two axes: extending the context window from a single observation to up to five minutes of history, and scaling pretraining to a large-scale corpus of robot teleoperation and human egocentric (ego) video. Across public simulation suites and real-robot deployments, direct action decoding (Fast mode) matches imagine-then-act (IDM) inference from the same checkpoint while running in 60 ms per 16-step action chunk on a single RTX 5090 (7.6x faster than IDM) and supporting pause-free real-time chunking. Performance scales consistently with pretraining data, with human ego video driving the largest gains in out-of-distribution generalization: G0.7 achieves a 70.8 mean score across five simulation benchmark suites, 48% and 54% zero-shot pick-and-place success on Galaxea R1 Pro and R1 Lite, 96.7% in-distribution and 93.3% out-of-distribution success on video-conditioned in-context learning tasks, and 86.9% mean task progress across seven real-world post-training tasks including multi-minute box folding, drink preparation, and product bagging.

AI.tldr: G0.7 是一种扩展了上下文窗口并使用大规模机器人远程操作和人类第一人称视频进行预训练的世界行动模型（WAM），在闭合环控制中，直接行动解码模式 (Fast 模式) 在 60 ms 内运行一个包含 16 个动作的片段，比 IDM 方式快 7.6 倍，并取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: WAMs能够将从视频中学习到的物理先验知识转移至机器人操作策略中，但它们通常受限于短观察历史且测试时推断过于缓慢。G0.7在前工作的基础上，通过扩大上下文窗口及使用大规模训练数据，提高动作推断效率与泛化能力。
AI.method: G0.7 通过对 Fast-WAM 的改进，采用长上下文窗口并使用大规模机器人操作与人类第一人称视频进行预训练。通过直接行动解码的快速模式实现高效动作推断。
AI.result: G0.7 达到了与 IDM 相同的推断性能，在单个 RTX 5090 显卡上每分钟执行 60ms。在模拟测试套件和真实机器人部署中，G0.7 在多种任务中的性能表现优异，如 96.7% 的场景内任务成功率达到，93.3% 的场景外任务成功率达到，并且在多种复杂任务中实现高任务完成率。
AI.conclusion: G0.7 通过构建更长上下文窗口与大量预训练数据，显著提高了世界上行动模型在闭环控制中的效率和泛化能力，展示出在复杂多步骤任务中的良好应用潜力。

title: Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Unlearning
summary: Large language model unlearning aims to remove the influence of designated training data while preserving unrelated model capabilities. Existing likelihood-based methods commonly optimize against fixed forget sequences, providing only negative supervision on what the model should not generate and overlooking the states visited by the evolving unlearned policy. We introduce Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation (CPSD), a new unlearning framework that constructs an explicit knowledge-reduced target distribution and distills it along the model's own trajectories. Given a student rollout, a frozen reference model evaluates each token under a plain context and a privileged context containing the forget information. CPSD treats the resulting distributional shift as a knowledge-associated direction and reverses it to obtain a counterfactual unlearning target. The student is then trained to match this target at every rollout position while retaining its utility on unrelated data. We further introduce a privacy-enhanced variant that combines distributional unlearning with lightweight sequence-level suppression. Experiments under OpenUnlearning show that CPSD improves the forgetting-utility trade-off over NPO across TOFU forget-set sizes and Llama models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters. On MUSE-News, the privacy-enhanced variant improves all reported knowledge, memorization, privacy, and utility metrics over NPO.

AI.tldr: CPSD提出了一种对比式在线自蒸馏的新去学习框架，通过构建明确的知识减少目标分布，并沿着模型自身的轨迹进行蒸馏，同时引入保护隐私的变体结合分布去学习和轻量级序列级抑制，改善了去学习-效用权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有基于似然的方法在去学习过程中，仅提供负面监督，即模型不应生成的内容，而忽略了去学习政策演化的状态。CPSD旨在改进这一点，通过构建知识减少目标分布并沿模型自身的轨迹进行蒸馏，实现更好的去学习效果。
AI.method: CPSD通过对比在线自蒸馏的方法，利用学生模型的轨迹，并通过参考模型评估每个标记在普通上下文和包含遗忘信息的特权上下文中，构建一个知识相关的方向进行逆向调整，以获取反事实的去学习目标。此外，还提出了一种保护隐私的变体，结合分布去学习和轻量级序列级抑制。
AI.result: 在OpenUnlearning实验中，CPSD在不同大小的TOFU忘记集和不同参数量级的Llama模型中，相比NPO提高了去学习-效用权衡。在MUSE-News数据集上，保护隐私的变体在所有报告的知识、记忆、隐私和效用指标上均优于NPO。
AI.conclusion: CPSD提供了一种有效的去学习方法，通过构建知识减少目标分布和反向调整策略，以及结合保护隐私的技术，平衡去学习和保持模型效用之间的关系，在多种场景下展示了其优越性。

title: When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents
summary: Human annotations on documents (such as arrows, carets, strikethroughs, and insertions) express corrective intent yet existing OCR and document understanding systems treat these marks as visual noise rather than semantic edit operations. We introduce intent-aware OCR, the task of generating corrected transcriptions by jointly reasoning over original document content and visual intent cues (handwritten or digital) that convey edit intent. To support this setting, we present DocIntent, a multimodal dataset of 1,600 financial documents with over 5,700 annotated visual intent cues, each paired with layout-aware, intent-resolved OCR targets. We further introduce IntentBench, a 216-document benchmark designed to evaluate model robustness under diverse real-world annotation conditions. Leveraging DocIntent, we fine-tune DocIntentOCR, a suite of 3B and 7B parameter vision-language models, under direct intent supervision on corrected transcriptions. On IntentBench, the fine-tuned 3B and 7B models achieve F1-scores of 0.81 and 0.83, respectively, substantially outperforming commercial closed-source (e.g., GPT-4.1 (0.626)), and open-source models (e.g., LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B (0.50)) demonstrating that intent-aware supervision enables compact domain-specific models to outperform substantially larger general-purpose systems on this task. This work establishes intent-aware OCR as a novel human-in-the-loop document understanding task and provides foundational resources (dataset, benchmark, models) to advance research in interactive document processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了意图感知OCR，一种新的文档理解任务，通过联合考虑原始文档内容和视觉意图标记来生成更准确的转录文本。
AI.motivation: 现有OCR和文档理解系统忽视了人类对文档的手写或数字注释，这些注释含有修正意图。本文旨在通过引入意图感知OCR，明确理解和应对这些编辑意图，从而提高OCR系统的准确性和适应性。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个大型的多模态数据集DocIntent，包含大量带有意图标记的金融文档，并通过这些数据集微调了多种参数量的视觉-语言模型。
AI.result: 通过DocIntent数据集微调后，3B和7B参数的模型在IntentBench基准测试上分别取得了0.81和0.83的F1分数，显著优于商业和开源模型。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明，意图感知监督使紧凑型领域特定模型在这一任务上超越了大规模通用系统，为交互式文档处理提供了新的研究和实用途径。

title: Gaze World Model
summary: Where a person looks indicates their focus of attention, and how their gaze shifts between targets reveals how that attention responds to a changing scene. Existing gaze target estimation methods largely operate frame by frame and do not model these shifts. Gaze shifts are often driven by dynamic changes in the scene, which is the kind of information world models are designed to encode. This relationship is subtle, however, since an event far across the frame may produce only a slight movement of the person's head or eyes. We therefore introduce the Gaze World Model (GWM), which co-trains latent scene prediction with person-conditioned gaze supervision on a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder; in our ablations, the latent prediction objective improves both shift detection and gaze localization. Given a video clip and the person's head box, GWM estimates gaze locations and detects gaze shifts in the observed clip, and forecasts future gaze and shifts from predicted scene features. To train and evaluate these tasks, we augment VideoAttentionTarget and ChildPlay with event-level gaze-shift annotations. GWM achieves state-of-the-art shift detection on these benchmarks, about 10 points higher in four-class AP than the strongest baseline, while remaining comparable to the strongest image-based models in gaze target estimation, and outperforms the compared baselines on future gaze localization and shift forecasting.

AI.tldr: GWM （Gaze World Model）通过结合场景预测和人眼 gaze 监督，实现了对注视点和注视转移的精确估计，并能预测未来的注视位置和转移。
AI.motivation: 现有的注视点估计方法主要在每一帧上进行独立操作，不考虑场景动态变化对视野转移的影响。而 GWM 利用世界模型能够捕捉动态信息的优势，提出了同时优化场景预测和注视点监督的方法。
AI.method: GWM 是通过一个冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器进行编码，结合场景潜在预测和基于个人信息的注视监督进行协同训练。利用这种方法，它能有效检测注视转移并预测未来的注视情况。
AI.result: 在现有基准测试中，GWM 达到了最先进的注视转移检测效果，四类 AP 指标比最强的基线高出约 10 分。此外，GWM 在基于图像的注视目标估计方面仍然具有竞争力，在未来注视位置预测和转移预测方面也优于比较中的基线。
AI.conclusion: GWM 通过结合场景预测和个人条件下的注视监督展示了优越的性能，未来有望进一步应用于复杂的场景理解和注视行为预测中。

title: CAPE: Coordinating Calibration and Search for Tool-Use Policies
summary: A tool call can fail even when the operation behind it is correct, because the receiving tool parses delimiters, dates or record layouts under a configuration the agent cannot inspect. Compiling a tool-use policy for such a tool requires both calibration, which evaluates candidate calls on candidate configurations, and search over the evaluated calls. The two share one compilation budget: calibrating everything first postpones any improved policy until the end, while re-solving every partially known model delays the next useful query. A call becomes usable as soon as its effects are known on the configurations that reach it. We present CAPE, a training-free compiler built on this observation. It maintains an executable policy at all times, directs calibration to the calls that can improve this policy, and tightens bounds only where doing so ends calibration early. Returned policies preserve every configuration the initial policy completes, and CAPE certifies optimality when its executable and optimistic values meet. On CSV and JSON workflows built from 64 requests, CAPE reaches the independently computed optimum in 502 of 504 compilations while taking 22.0% less compilation time than eager exact search. On larger CSV families it returns policies with higher completion at similar compilation time, and it raises completion by 15.38 to 34.66 percentage points over an LLM that revises its serialization from error feedback.

AI.tldr: CAPE 是一种无需训练的编译器，它通过将编译预算同时分配到校准和搜索中，确保在所有配置中始终维护可执行策略。CAPE 在 504 次编译中有 502 次达到了独立计算的最优值，并且比急切精确搜索节省了 22.0% 的编译时间。
AI.motivation: 针对工具调用可能因接收工具的配置差异而失败的问题，提出了一种无需训练的编译器 CAPE，旨在提高工具使用的效率和可靠性。
AI.method: CAPE 通过结合校准和搜索过程，并且优化地分配编译预算，确保在所有可能的工具配置下维护一个有效的策略。它优先校准那些能够改善当前策略的调用，并在必要的时候提前终止校准。
AI.result: CAPE 在 504 次编译中有 502 次达到了最优值，并且比其他方法节省了 22.0% 的编译时间。当应用于更大的 CSV 数据集时，它的执行效率更高，且相较于基于反馈调整序列化的语言模型，可将完成率提高 15.38 到 34.66 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CAPE 提供了一种高效、自动化的工具使用策略编译方法，适用于处理变量配置导致的工具调用失败问题，并且能够显著提高工具使用的效果完成率。

title: Phoneme-identity depth profiles do not reliably predict LoRA placement for dysarthric ASR
summary:
Parameter-efficient adaptation of a speech foundation model to dysarthric speech requires a rarely justified choice: which encoder layers to adapt. A recently proposed strategy is to probe the encoder, find where phonetic information becomes most decodable, and put the adapters there. We test that inference across two ASR models (Qwen3-ASR, Whisper-small) and two dysarthric corpora (Mandarin CDSD, English UASpeech), holding recipe and seed discipline constant.
  The inference fails. Measured under one pipeline rather than inherited from published figures, all four phoneme-error curves minimise between 83% and 92% of relative depth, each model's minimising layer moving no further between corpora than between probe seeds. The best adaptation band is not similarly constant: none of three natural mappings from the curve to a band -- steepest improvement, lowest band-mean error, or knee location -- recovers the best tested configuration. We do not claim no statistic of the curve could work, only that these three do not.
  Placement still matters, but is model- and corpus-specific. On CDSD the models disagree -- Qwen3-ASR prefers its upper third (29.88% CER, three-seed mean), Whisper-small all-block LoRA (53.56%) -- while on UASpeech neither favours the upper band. At three seeds, upper-versus-all is resolved (-1.31 pp, CI [-2.16, -0.25]) but upper-versus-middle is not (-0.83 pp, CI [-2.06, +1.86]). The two models' preferences differ as a directly tested interaction (-4.71 pp, CI [-6.17, -2.89]); we designate this the primary claim, and record that the designation was made post hoc. On Qwen3-ASR x UASpeech, adapting near the input is reliably worse than not adapting at all (+9.90 pp CER). We recommend choosing the band by a short adaptation sweep on the model and corpus in hand, not by reading it off a probe.

AI.tldr: 该研究探查了语音基础模型对失读性发音适应时的编码层选择策略，发现不存在泛化的优化策略，适应带的选择需要根据具体模型和语料库进行调整。
AI.motivation: 探讨更有效的参数高效适应失读性发音的方法，以提高自动语音识别模型在不同语料库上的适应性。
AI.method: 研究比较了两个自动语音识别模型Qwen3-ASR和Whisper-small，以及两种失读性发音语料库Mandarin CDSD和English UASpeech，通过探针方法发现音素错误曲线的最小化深度，并尝试使用三种不同的映射方法选择适应带。
AI.result: 研究发现，适应带的选择并非通过音素错误曲线的映射可以准确预测，不同模型和语料库表现出不同的偏好。在CDSD语料库上，模型的偏好不同，而在UASpeech上，模型既不偏好上半部分，也不偏好全部区块。通过三个种子测试，研究还发现靠近输入的适应不如不进行任何适应。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出结论，适应带的选择与模型和语料库的具体情况密切相关，推荐在特定的模型和语料库中进行简短的适应范围测试来选择最佳适应带，而不是依探针结果直接决定。

title: JECT: Addressing the Context Shortcut in Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for Chest CT
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 23 tables, including supplementary material. Code and weights: https://github.com/lukeingawesome/JECT
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn by predicting features of masked regions from visible context. In chest computed tomography, the findings that decide a diagnosis, such as a small nodule, are often not predictable from the surrounding anatomy. A hidden finding is then best predicted toward normal anatomy, and the prediction loss stops rewarding the encoder for representing it. We call this the context shortcut. Conditioning the predictor on the radiology report repairs the prediction, but in our setup the encoder gains little over image-only pretraining: the report supplies what the encoder never had to learn. JECT therefore gives the report two roles: a condition for the predictor and, through masked section-text prediction, a target for the encoder, which must predict the report's anatomical sections from the unmasked scan. A hierarchical three-dimensional encoder that predicts at every stage keeps this clinical content at every scale. In ablations, the text target improves classification and localization, while conditioning adds little to the encoder. Trained from scratch on 173k volumes, the recipe reaches the level of current computed tomography foundation models in classification, retrieval and nodule malignancy, and of task-specific models in lung-cancer risk prediction after fine-tuning. Conditioning still matters: its predictor can be reused, with no extra training, to show where a report sentence acts, changing most at the finding the sentence describes. Code and pretrained weights are available.

AI.tldr: JECT通过结合CT影像和放射报告文本，改进了胸部CT的预测模型，特别是在小结节诊断中，通过条件预测和文本目标优化了模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前的联合嵌入预测架构在胸部CT的诊断中对于隐蔽发现的预测存在问题，称为上下文捷径，因此提出了结合CT影像和放射报告文本的JECT模型。
AI.method: JECT模型在预测时利用图像编码器和文本编码器相结合的方式，其中文本编码器通过预测隐藏的文本片段来弥补图像编码器的不足，从而使模型能够更准确地预测放射报告中的临床信息。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与仅使用图像预训练相比，结合放射报告的JECT模型在分类、检索和结节恶性程度评估方面达到了当前CT基础模型的水平。进一步的消融实验显示，文本目标能够提高分类和定位性能，而条件预测对图像编码器的提升作用有限。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种基于CT影像和放射报告文本的多模态预测模型JECT，通过结合图像特征和文本信息，显著提高了在胸部CT诊断中的表现。

title: Perception Is Enough, at the Right Scale: Scale-Adaptive Token Pruning for Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://lin0e0.github.io/TauPrune-VLA/
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models must process continuous streams of visual observations, and the resulting computational cost limits real-time robotic control. Token pruning reduces this cost, but a fixed semantic scale of perceptual representation can overlook information needed at different stages of manipulation. We show that perceptual semantics can guide effective token selection without relying on internal attention when the selection scale adapts to the scene's evolving semantic structure. Based on this observation, we introduce TauPrune-VLA, a training-free method that controls the scale of the retained perceptual representation through a single perception temperature $τ$. To adapt this scale as manipulation proceeds, TauPrune-VLA updates $τ$ online using trends in perceptual semantics, with robot-state changes and action magnitude regulating the adjustment strength. While these semantics evolve over the course of manipulation, they remain relatively stable between consecutive frames. This continuity allows retention indices computed from the current observation to be applied at the next policy invocation, enabling token selection to run asynchronously with inference and reducing pruning overhead. Evaluated across diverse VLA models and simulation benchmarks, TauPrune-VLA achieves up to a $1.86\times$ inference speedup while maintaining near-baseline task success rates. We further validate its effectiveness on two real-world robotic platforms.

AI.tldr: TauPrune-VLA通过动态调整视觉感知表示的规模来优化Vision-Language-Action模型的实时性能，利用感知语义来指导有效的令牌选择，实现高达1.86倍的推理速度提升，同时保持接近基线的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在实时机器人控制中受到计算成本的限制，Token pruning虽然可以降低这种成本，但固定的空间感知语义尺度可能会忽略不同阶段操作所需的额外信息。TauPrune-VLA通过利用感知语义动态调整模型规模，提出了无需训练的方法来优化实时性能。
AI.method: TauPrune-VLA的方法涉及使用单一的感知温度参数$\tau$来控制保留的感知表示的规模，并通过观察感知语义的趋势在线更新$\tau$，并根据机器人状态变化和动作幅度调整调整强度。它允许从当前观察中计算保留索引，并在下一策略调用中异步运行，从而减少剪枝负担。该方法评估了不同的VLA模型和模拟基准，实现了高达1.86倍的推理加速。
AI.result: TauPrune-VLA在各种VLA模型和模拟基准上进行评估，实现了高达1.86倍的推理加速，同时任务成功率接近基线。在两个实际机器人平台上的进一步验证也证明了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: TauPrune-VLA为解决视觉-语言-动作模型的实时性问题提供了一个有效的解决方案，通过动态调整感知语义的规模，实现了加速并在保持较高任务成功率的同时运行。

title: BCP: A Lightweight Boundary-Controlled Framework for Online Sign Language Recognition and Translation
summary: Online sign language recognition (SLR) and translation (SLT) incrementally produce gloss sequences or natural language text from sign video as it arrives, a capability essential for real-time communication and live captioning. However, powerful pretrained offline models cannot be directly deployed in this setting, while existing online methods typically retrain the entire model on simulated streaming prefixes constructed from offline videos, incurring high costs. To address this challenge, we propose Boundary-Controlled Prefix Commit (BCP), a unified lightweight framework that converts pretrained offline methods into online counterparts for sign-to-gloss (S2G), sign-to-text (S2T), and sign-to-gloss-to-text (S2G2T). Specifically, BCP freezes the pretrained model and introduces a lightweight boundary adapter that decides when to commit, supervised by Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) alignments from a pretrained SLR model, without any human annotation. At inference, a Boundary-Controlled Wait-K Output Policy then decides what to commit via prefix voting, yielding adaptive burst commits while preserving the output progress of the base Wait-K schedule. Experiments on PHOENIX-2014T and CSL-Daily across four offline methods show that BCP, with less than 0.1% additional trainable parameters per offline method, achieves a strong quality-latency trade-off on S2T and remains competitive on S2G and S2G2T.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种轻量级框架BCP，它可以将预训练的离线模型转换为在线模型，用于sign-to-gloss (S2G)，sign-to-text (S2T)，和sign-to-gloss-to-text (S2G2T)。BCP不重新训练模型，而是通过一个轻量级的边界适配器决定何时提交结果，并利用CTC对齐进行监督，从而实现高质量和低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的在线方法成本高，需要重新训练整个模型以处理实时的视频流，而BCP旨在提供一种解决方案，使预训练的离线模型能够直接适应在线应用，减少重新训练的负担。
AI.method: BCP框架冻结了预训练模型，引入了一个轻量级的边界适配器来决定何时提交结果，并采用CTC对齐进行监督，同时设计了一种边界控制等待K输出策略，该策略通过前缀投票决定提交内容，使之能够适应实时的视频流处理。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，BCP仅需少量额外的可训练参数（不到0.1%），便能在S2T方面实现高质量和低延迟的权衡，同时在S2G和S2G2T方面保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: BCP为实时手语识别和翻译提供了灵活且高效的解决方案，显著降低了在线处理的成本，并展示了其在多种场景下的适用性。

title: Don't Miss the Forest for the Trees: Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition with Hyperbolic Hierarchical Semantic Prototypes
summary: Zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition is evaluated almost exclusively on flat leaf labels, which leaves open whether a representation also grounds the broader concepts that contain an action in skeleton motion. We find that strong leaf alignment does not carry over to them: when ancestor concepts are scored directly under independent decoding, eight flat methods with 57.86-73.29% mean leaf Top-1 reach only 6.15-31.21% mean full-path accuracy across four NTU RGB+D splits. We propose the Hyperbolic Hierarchical Semantic Prototype ($H^2SP$) framework, which represents every node of an action taxonomy in the Lorentz model of hyperbolic space. First, instead of learning a free vector per node, $H^2SP$ synthesizes hierarchy-aware prototypes by recursive parent-child geodesic interpolation under a single tree-wide gate. Second, tangent-space semantic and distributional alignment on seen classes anchor the leaf prototypes in skeleton motion. Third, a soft entailment-cone regularizer encourages directional parent-child inclusion, propagating this motion grounding to ancestor concepts. We evaluate hierarchical concept prediction under independent and cascade decoding, and transfer to an alternative taxonomy without retraining. Across the four splits, $H^2SP$ attains the best mean independent and cascade full-path accuracy among the evaluated methods, at a comparable leaf Top-1 of 72.40%. Transferred to the alternative taxonomy, it outperforms both flat baselines and the same-tree Euclidean control across every split and decoding mode, indicating that its concept-level correspondence extends beyond the training taxonomy.

AI.tldr: 该研究旨在评估骨架基于动作识别在祖先概念上的表现，并引入了一种新的H^2SP框架，该框架在洛伦兹模型的双曲空间中表示动作分类学的每个节点，通过合成层次感知原型和软蕴含圆锥正则化来促进祖先概念的动觉接地。
AI.motivation: 当前的无监督骨架动作识别方法主要依赖于扁平的标签分类，这可能忽略了动作背后更广泛的概念对动力学的支撑作用。
AI.method: 论文提出了一种名为H^2SP的框架，该框架在洛伦兹模型的双曲空间中表示动作分类学的每个节点。通过递归的父节点与孩子节点测地线插值合成层次感知原型，并通过切空间语义和分布对齐在已知分类中将叶原型锚定在骨架运动中。此外，软蕴含圆锥正则化促使方向上的父节点与孩子节点关系，从而将这种运动接地传播到祖先概念。
AI.result: H^2SP框架在独立和级联解码方式下获得了四组NTU RGB+D分割中的最高均值全路径准确率，在叶Top-1准确率为72.40%的情况下，保持了与基线方法相近的表现。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，H^2SP框架的层次概念对应关系不仅限于训练分类体系，还能够跨分类体系进行迁移，从而在不同的分割和解码方式下均优于平脸基线和同层次欧几里得控制基线。

title: DexOPD: Dual-Extrapolation On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Models
summary: Flow-based diffusion models have become a mainstream paradigm for text-to-image generation, where task-specific post-training produces specialist models with complementary strengths. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD) offers an efficient way to consolidate these specialists into a single unified student. Recent methods strengthen supervision through teacher extrapolation, constructing stronger proxy teachers that allow distilled students to surpass the original specialists. However, their extrapolation directions remain defined solely by frozen teacher and reference models, leaving the student's own training progress unexploited. To address this limitation, we introduce DexOPD, a dual-extrapolation on-policy distillation method for diffusion models. DexOPD retains extrapolated teacher supervision while leveraging a lagging historical student as the reference for student self-extrapolation. Sampling across multiple self-extrapolation gains from shared initial noise broadens exploration along the student's evolving trajectory, and task rewards convert pairwise differences in candidate quality into a normalized auxiliary regression direction. Empirically, we evaluate DexOPD on GenEval, OCR, and DrawBench. The resulting unified SD3.5-Medium student achieves a GenEval reward of 0.9736, an OCR score of 0.9515, and a DrawBench Aesthetic score of 6.4875, surpassing the corresponding specialist teachers as well as all evaluated OPD and multi-task reinforcement learning baselines across these three benchmarks while preserving standard single-model inference.

AI.tldr: DexOPD引入了一种新的双外推在线蒸馏方法，通过利用历史学生模型进行自我外推来增强监督，实现了在GenEval、OCR和DrawBench上的卓越表现，超越了教师模型和所有基准方法。
AI.motivation: 当前方法虽然增强了监督，但这些外推方向仍然局限于冻结的教师和参考模型，未能充分利用学生的训练进展。
AI.method: DexOPD利用了一个滞后的历史学生作为参考进行学生的自我外推，并通过任务奖励将候选质量的两两差异转换为归一化的辅助回归方向。
AI.result: 在GenEval、OCR和DrawBench三个基准上，DexOPD的学生模型SD3.5-Medium分别取得了0.9736、0.9515和6.4875的评分，远超对应的教师模型以及所有对比的OPD和多任务强化学习基线。
AI.conclusion: DexOPD通过自我外推和任务奖励的成功运用，展示了其在文本到图像生成中的适用性和优越性，进一步推动了该领域的研究和发展。

title: What If Chinese Were Latinized? A Counterfactual Study of Input Representation, Tokenization, and Language Modeling
summary: If Chinese had been Latinized, as the Latinxua Sin Wenz movement proposed, what would it have meant for Chinese NLP? Homophones and tone marking complicate the answer. We convert Chinese corpora to syllable-separated Pinyin and train superBPE tokenizers from scratch. The resulting Pinyin vocabularies not only exhibit expected homophone collisions, but also show approximately 10% higher fertility than characters. An alternative BPE configuration changes the relative fertility of the two representations. We further pretrain Llama-style models on Chinese characters and Pinyin. The Pinyin models perform worse on per-character perplexity, homophone disambiguation, and overall ZhoBLiMP minimal-pair accuracy. An exploratory phonological probe yields near-chance performance for both representations. The broader implication is that written input representations are not merely neutral encodings. Choices for representations affect language modeling and their downstream performances. Latinization never actually happened for Chinese, but other languages did, such as Hangul and Latin script replaced character in Korean and Vietnamese; the cost we measure is a guide to where modeling effort for those languages should concentrate.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了若将汉语拉丁化，将会对汉语NLP领域产生怎样的影响。研究发现，拼音词汇表显示出约10%更高的生育率，并且在字符困惑度，同音词消歧和ZhoBLiMP最小差集准确性方面，用拼音训练的模型表现较差。
AI.motivation: 文章旨在探索在自然语言处理(NLP)中，词表表示对模型性能的影响。虽然汉语实际上并没有拉丁化，但通过对比拼音和汉字模型的表现，为将来其他语言的拉丁化或拼音化提供参考。
AI.method: 研究者将汉语语料转换为音节分割的拼音，并从零开始训练超级BPE分词器。同时，他们还预先训练了用拼音和汉字训练的Llama样模型，并通过观察这些模型在特定任务上的性能差异来得出结论。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，拼音模型在某些具体任务中的表现不如汉字模型。拼音模型在字符困惑度、同音词消歧和ZhoBLiMP最小差集准确性方面表现较差。此外，拼音的生育率比汉字大约高10%。
AI.conclusion: 本文的结论是，书面输入表征不仅仅是中性的编码方式，对于特定任务，不同的表征方式会影响模型的性能。这种发现对于研究其他需要进行拉丁化或拼音化的语言具有重要指导意义。

title: RELAY: Learning Compatible Representations One Encoder at a Time
summary: Old and new document embeddings coexist during incremental gallery re-encoding. RELAY trains a new query encoder with a learned projection against the original gallery, then freezes both to train the new document encoder. The same query vector scores both document versions throughout a single re-encoding pass. After backfill, optional query refinement drops the projection and reuses the stored document vectors. Across three text-to-image retrieval upgrades on COCO and Flickr30K, RELAY improves Recall@1 on untouched galleries by 8.66-10.23 percentage points over the original systems. For direct re-encoding, RELAY ranks first in both Qwen-to-Qwen upgrades and second in CLIP-to-Qwen by area under the Recall@1 curve, under both native scoring and matched calibration. With embeddings held fixed, calibrating scores separately for each document version can reduce drops in Recall@1 during backfill and change which method achieves the highest backfill AUC. After query refinement, final Recall@1 is within 0.97 percentage points of conventional joint training in all three upgrades.

AI.tldr: RELAY 方法通过增量重新编码更新文档嵌入，同时保持旧嵌入不变。经过一次重新编码过程后，新的查询编码器与原始图像库结合，提升了各类检索任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 为了解决图像检索中重新编码对性能的影响，RELAY 方法提出了在更新过程中保持旧文档嵌入不变，通过训练新的查询编码器来优化检索性能。
AI.method: RELAY 方法采用增量的方法进行重新编码。首先通过学习的投影训练新的查询编码器，接着冻结查询编码器训练新的文档编码器。在重新编码过程中，相同的查询向量用于评估新旧文档版本。更新后可选择地进行查询精炼，移除投影层并重用存储的文档向量。
AI.result: RELAY 方法在 COCO 和 Flickr30K 数据集的三类文本到图像检索升级中表现出色，相对于原始系统，Recall@1 提高了 8.66-10.23 个百分点。对于直接重新编码，RELAY 在 Qwen-to-Qwen 升级中排名第一，在 CLIP-to-Qwen 中则位居第二。另外，单独为每个文档版本调整得分可以减少回填过程中 Recall@1 的下降，且在查询精炼后，最终的 Recall@1 接近传统的联合训练。
AI.conclusion: RELAY 方法通过增量更新实现了图像检索性能的有效提升，同时为回填过程中的性能优化提供了新的视角。

title: Coding4Games: Can Modern Coding Agents Play Modern Video Games?
summary: Games, especially modern AAA games, challenge language models to perceive complex scenes, control actions, and make decisions over long horizons. Existing game benchmarks primarily test language models as computer-use agents that query a language model throughout play, incurring repeated inference cost and, in real-time games, acting while the environment continues to evolve. We ask whether coding agents can learn from game interaction to develop standalone game-playing programs that run without language model inference. We thus introduce Coding4Games, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can develop standalone programs that play modern games through visual observations and standard game inputs. Coding4Games has three defining features: 1) Diverse Modern Games, covering 15 games with diverse visual, strategic, and control demands; 2) Development-Test Separation, in which a coding agent uses a sandbox and the standard player interface to iteratively develop a program, after which the selected program is frozen and independently tested without language-model inference; and 3) Outcome and Process Evaluation, which measures not only game performance and reliability but also how agents use feedback, revise programs, and resolve problems during development. Across 15 games, the best program per game outscores the strongest GUI baseline on 13 and ties it on one. The human player outscores all agents on 10 games. We additionally examine the effects of development budgets. Coding4Games evaluates whether coding agents can turn their understanding of complex interactive environments into programs that work reliably on their own.

AI.tldr: Coding4Games 是一个评估编码代理通过视觉观察和标准游戏输入独立开发游戏程序能力的基准，它涵盖了15个需求多样的现代游戏，且通过开发-测试分离和结果与过程评估来衡量程序的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏基准测试主要使用语言模型作为实时游戏中的代理，但由于频繁推理和环境不断变化，这限制了语言模型的能力体现。因此，作者提出了一个新基准，旨在评估编码代理能否通过视觉观察和标准游戏输入独立开发出能自己运行的游戏程序。
AI.method: 该基准包括15款不同需求的游戏，强调开发与测试分离，让代理在沙盒中迭代开发程序，之后独立测试。它还评估代理在开发过程中的反馈利用、程序修订及问题解决能力。此外，通过开发预算的差异性影响进行了进一步分析。
AI.result: 在15款游戏中，每个游戏的最佳代码程序中有13款超出了强劲的GUI基线，剩下1款与其持平。但有人类玩家在10款游戏中得分最高。此外，研究还探讨了开发预算对表现的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该基准有助于评估并提升代码代理独立解决复杂游戏环境问题的能力。

title: Avalon-M1: Reinforcement Learning from Collective Rewards
summary: We introduce reinforcement learning from collective rewards (RLCR), a recipe for jointly training language models to act as agent organisations under latency constraints. A CEO and up to eight specialists share one policy, co-ordinate through a message board and workspace, and are trained with a common outcome-derived advantage. The deadline makes parallel work valuable when it increases the return earned before the cap. We train Avalon-M1-Mini (120B) across 147 environments. For the trained model, eight-hire organisational execution raises IMO-ProofBench-Advanced scores from 23.8% to 39.0% relative to single-agent execution. Across 12 benchmarks, organisations achieve similar average scores at approximately one-third the derived latency of token-matched single-agent execution and just over half that of eight independent attempts followed by selection. The trained model also outperforms Nemotron 3 Super, post-trained from the same base model, across all evaluations when comparing each model's best tested configuration. On EdgeBench, organisations overtake the single agent after approximately 0.4 derived hours. Over the course of training, organisations develop hierarchies to manage communication costs, invest more in peer review, and alter how work is divided. Safety evaluations find near-universal refusal of harmful actions but sustained declines in external reporting in two of three oversight scenarios. These results establish a shared-advantage baseline for studying organisational learning, performance-latency trade-offs, and collective oversight.

AI.tldr: 研究介绍了一种联合训练语言模型作为具有延迟约束的代理组织的方法，通过共享策略、协作和一个共同目标下的优势训练，展示了这种方式在多个基准测试中的显著提升，并探讨了组织学习、性能-延迟权衡及集体监管方面的重要发现。
AI.motivation: 提出了一种新的强化学习方法——强化学习从集体奖励（RLCR），旨在通过共享策略和协作训练能够满足延迟要求的语言模型，以实现代理组织的行为。
AI.method: 使用了一个CEO和最多八位专家，他们共享一个策略，通过消息板和工作空间进行协调，并以共同的最终结果来训练，模型训练过程中设置了截止日期来强调在截止时间前并行工作的价值。
AI.result: 通过在1200亿参数的Avalon-M1-Mini模型上训练147个环境，组织执行提高了IMO-ProofBench-Advanced的表现，且在多个基准测试中表现出与单一代理相比更快的平均响应速度和更佳的性能；并且与另一个预训练模型相比，在所有测试配置中也表现出更好的表现。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，共享优势的组织训练为研究组织学习、性能-延迟权衡和集体监督奠定了基础，并为未来的强化学习方法提供了有价值的见解。

title: Rethinking Video Agents: When and Why Video Harnesses Work
summary: Video understanding depends not only on how models reason about visual evidence, but also on which evidence they observe. Fixed observation policies determine this evidence in advance; agentic harnesses allow models to seek further observations as their understanding develops. This shift creates an opportunity to realize capabilities that fixed inputs leave untapped, yet the ability to request observations does not ensure their effective use. We investigate when and why video harnesses improve understanding, examining how task demands and models' capacity for interaction jointly shape their benefits. Using Video-Relook as an experimental framework, we let models adapt their temporal and spatial observations from a common default configuration, and analyze performance and interaction trajectories across models and tasks. Adaptive observation yields substantial gains on fine-grained action understanding, with benefits also extending to Video-MME-v2. Even under the same observation interface, gains differ substantially across models; interaction traces reveal corresponding differences in evidence seeking and the reliability of answer revision. The benefits also vary across tasks for the same model, ranging from substantial improvements to limited gains and regressions. Together, these findings support an account in which harness effectiveness depends on the alignment between opportunities for informative observation and the model's ability to turn interaction into reliable revisions. They motivate video harnesses that coordinate perception and reasoning, matching observational autonomy to task demands and model capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自适应观察机制在视频理解中的有效性。通过对比不同模型和任务在Video-Relook框架下的表现和交互轨迹，发现自适应观察能够显著提高细粒度动作理解能力，不同模型在相同观察接口下的收益差异显著，且同一模型在不同任务上的表现也有所不同。
AI.motivation: 目前的固定观察策略可能未充分利用视频中的有用信息，而自适应观察策略允许模型根据理解需求动态地请求更多观察，这为提高视频理解的性能提供了新的途径。
AI.method: 使用Video-Relook框架，让模型从一个默认的时空观测配置中进行自我适应调整，分析不同模型在各种任务中的表现和交互模式。
AI.result: 结果显示，自适应观察策略在细粒度动作理解上取得了显著改进，并且也提升了Video-MME-v2的表现。然而，不同模型在相同接口下获得的收益差异明显，同一模型在不同任务上的表现也有所不同。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论指出，自适应观察策略的有效性在于其能够应对有用观察机会与模型将交互转化为可靠修正能力之间的对齐问题。这表明未来视频理解系统应更加注重感知与推理之间的协同作用，以更好地匹配任务需求和模型能力。

title: Evaluating Latent Knowledge Stability in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Changes in image viewpoint and question formulation can alter latent knowledge representations in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, output correctness and overall representational drift provide limited insight into how these changes affect model decisions. We therefore evaluate latent knowledge stability across visual and linguistic elicitation conditions from two complementary perspectives: answer preference and internal support. Specifically, we devise the margin retention score (MRS), which measures the first-order projected degradation of the initial answer's logit margin over competing options across conditions and assesses how changes in latent knowledge representations affect this margin. We also present latent knowledge support-structure stability (KSS), which evaluates reference-correct items by comparing internal support profiles constructed using the margin gradient under the reference condition, which jointly reflects changes in how internal support is distributed and changes in total support magnitude. We further construct MMStableBench, comprising 19,452 knowledge items (facts), each probing the same latent knowledge across varied image viewpoints, semantically equivalent question formulations, and answer-option permutations. Experiments across 15 MLLMs show that MRS and KSS reveal latent knowledge instability not captured by accuracy, while an MRS-inspired regularizer further improves the generalization of edited latent knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了评估多模态大型语言模型在视觉和语言引发条件下潜在知识稳定性的方法，包括边际保留得分(MRS)和潜在知识支持结构稳定性(KSS)，并通过MMStableBench基准测试了15款模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的评估方法（如输出正确性和整体表示漂移）对于理解视点变化和问题重新表述如何影响模型决策提供有限的信息。因此，本文提出了一种新的评估方法来分析潜在知识的稳定性。
AI.method: 本文首先定义了边际保留得分(MRS)来衡量初始答案相对于竞争选项的logit边际在不同条件下的退化。还提出了潜在知识支持结构稳定性(KSS)，通过比较在参考条件下构建的内部支持配置文件来评估内部支持配置文件的变化。最后，构建了一个包含19,452项知识的数据集MMStableBench，用于不同视点和问题形式下的测试。
AI.result: 在15款多模态大型语言模型上进行的实验表明，MRS和KSS比单纯准确率更好地揭示了潜在知识的不稳定性，而且基于MRS的正则化器进一步提高了编辑后的潜在知识泛化。
AI.conclusion: 本文强调了潜在知识稳定性在多模态大型语言模型中的重要性，并提出了一个评估潜在知识稳定性的框架，为提高模型性能提供了新的见解。

title: Open-OmniCoach: Evidence-Enhanced Trajectory Learning for Omni Video Agents
comment: 24 pages. Project Page: https://open-omnicoach.github.io , Code: https://github.com/Open-OmniCoach/omnicoach , Models & Data: https://huggingface.co/Open-OmniCoach
summary: Training capable omni video agents requires more than diverse question-answer pairs: agents must learn to reliably find, connect, and correct task-relevant evidence in omni-setting. However, we argue that existing data pipelines provide limited control over task-relevant evidence and weak supervision for these capabilities. In this work, we present Open OmniCoach, a new framework for evidence-seeking omni video agents. It contains a high-quality dataset, OmniCoach-240K, and a new agentic reinforcement learning (RL) method, Step-Level Evidence-Guided Policy Optimization (SEPO). For the former, OmniCoach-240K comprises 248.2K interaction trajectories, including 230.7K multi-span trajectories and 17.4K reflection trajectories. We design a three-stage data pipeline by leveraging both fine-grained omni-evidence and the agent's own errors. Meanwhile, compared with other RL baselines, SEPO provides turn-level credit based on improvements in evidence coverage and temporal localization. Applying both trajectory data and the SEPO method, we obtain Open OmniAgent models. The resulting models outperform the baselines across multiple video and audio-visual understanding tasks by significant margins, demonstrating the effectiveness of the Open OmniCoach framework. In particular, Open OmniAgent-30B improves average accuracy over Qwen3-Omni by 6.3 percentage points across nine benchmarks, with gains of 12.2 and 13.3 points on LVOmniBench and LVBench, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了Open OmniCoach框架，包括高质量的数据集OmniCoach-240K和新的基于证据引导的策略优化方法SEPO，该方法在多种视频和多模态任务上显著改进了基准模型。
AI.motivation: 现有数据管道对任务相关证据的控制有限，提供的监督也较弱，因此需要一种新的框架来提高能够在全景环境中的多模态任务中寻找、连接和矫正相关信息的代理的能力。
AI.method: 通过创建一个包含248.2K交互轨迹的数据集OmniCoach-240K，以及开发了一种新的基于证据引导的策略优化方法Step-Level Evidence-Guided Policy Optimization (SEPO)，该方法提供了基于证据覆盖和时间定位改进的转级信用。
AI.result: 应用OmniCoach-240K数据集和SEPO方法，构建的Open OmniAgent模型在多项视频和多模态理解任务中表现出色，相比基准模型，Open OmniAgent-30B在九个基准上的平均准确性提高了6.3个百分点，分别在LVOmniBench和LVBench上提高了12.2和13.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Open OmniCoach框架通过高质量的数据集和新的RL方法，显著提高了多模态理解任务中的代理性能，验证了该框架的有效性。

title: How Much Dependency Can a Marginal Rule See? Total Correlation in Diffusion LM Parallel Decoding
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Diffusion Language Models: Foundations, Efficiency, and Reasoning (DiffuLM). Code: https://github.com/DovudAsadov/dllm-total-correlation
summary: A masked diffusion language model is fast because it commits several tokens per step. Each token is sampled from its own marginal, so the dependency between the tokens is lost, and the size of that loss is the conditional total correlation C of the committed set. Most decoders choose the set from per-position marginals, which can bound C but cannot determine it. We ask how well they predict it. We estimate C for fixed candidate sets on four masked diffusion LMs from two families. On three of the four, the best marginal-only predictor is off by about one bit (0.74 to 1.17), 1.8 to 3.7 times less than a baseline that knows only the bound, and most of this accuracy comes from the bound itself. On a subset, our estimate ranks sets like the exact KL cost of a parallel commit, but sits a median 0.4 to 1.1 bits below it on prose and when the rest of the text is still masked. Dream-instruct is the exception, mainly on prose, where its conditionals are least self-consistent. Among six common marginal rules, pooling over the set beats gating on its weakest position in all 24 paired comparisons. The measurement needs a validated readout: Dream and LLaDA place a position's prediction at different logit indices, and the wrong index inflates an inconsistency diagnostic 14 to 41 times. We give three checks that measure the convention. Our results concern predicting C for a fixed set, not what a dependency-aware decoder gains.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，虽然一些基于边际概率的预测器在估计条件总相关性 C 的表现上比仅知道界值略差，但在某些情况下仍能接近精确值。综合所有测量，集合的平均值优于仅考虑最弱位置的加权值。
AI.motivation: 提出研究兴趣是评估基于边际概率的预测器估计条件总相关性 C 的准确性，特别是在不同语言模型和不同上下文条件下的表现。
AI.method: 研究人员估计了四个掩码扩散语言模型的固定候选集的 C 值，并从两个模型家族中选取了三种。他们将边际只预测器与仅知道界值的基线进行了比较，并发现这些预测器在大部分情况下表现接近或优于基线。此外，他们还对六种常见的边际规则进行了比较，发现集合平均值优于仅考虑最弱位置的加权值。
AI.result: 在三种模型中，最接近估计实际 C 值的边际预测器比基线基线低约 1.8 到 3.7 个比特，但仍有一些情况表现良好。同时发现，对于 Dream-instruct 模型，在处理文本部分掩盖的情况下，其条件相关性预测表现较好。综合结果表明，在固定集的情况下，边际只预测器能够提供接近真实值的估计，但不同模型和上下文条件表现不一。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调预测 C 的预测器在实际应用中的潜在价值，但它仍然仅限于固定集的场景，而不考虑依赖感知编码器的影响。

title: When "Neutral" Means Irrelevant: A Construct-Validity Audit of NormAd-ETI
summary: NormAd-ETI scores a model's judgment of everyday actions as acceptable, unacceptable, or neither as the cultural context shrinks from a specific rule to a country name. We audit what that three-way score measures. It combines two decisions: whether a supplied norm applies, and whether the action conforms to it. Separating them shows that when only a country is shown, applicability falls to near chance while conformity stays well above it, because the prompt withholds the rule a Neutral label depends on. Because one answer carries both decisions, the score follows the steadier conformity and hides the weaker applicability, and no single prompt recovers the two separately. Dedicated forced-choice probes separate them for frontier models but not for small open models, where the applicability judgment still tracks the hidden acceptability label. Adding a written rationale reduces that conflation without removing it. We recommend reporting the two results separately and measuring the conflation gap.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过逐步缩小文化背景的不同层级，分析了一个评估动作判断的模型（NormAd-ETI）。研究发现，当只展示国家名称时，模型判断规范适用性的能力接近随机，而判断行为符合性的能力则显著高于随机。这揭示了模型如何同时做出两个决定：一个规范是否适用，以及一个动作是否符合这一规范。虽然特定的选择题可以分离这两个决定，但小型开放模型仍然显示出适用性判断与隐含接受性标签的相关性。
AI.motivation: 为了更准确地理解模型如何评估日常行为的合法性，研究者通过逐步缩小文化背景的层级，审计了模型评分的含义。
AI.method: 研究者使用了一个名为NormAd-ETI的模型，并通过逐步缩减文化上下文（从特定规则到国家名称）来评估模型的判断。通过分析模型在不同层级的判断能力和分离问题来揭示模型背后的决策过程。
AI.result: 研究发现，当只展示国家名称时，模型判断规范适用性的能力接近随机，而判断行为符合性的能力则显著高于随机。虽然特定的选择题可以分离这两个决定，但小型开放模型仍然显示出适用性判断与隐含接受性标签的相关性。增加写明理由的选项可以减少这种合并，但并未完全消除。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建议在未来的工作中单独报告这两项结果，并测量混淆差距，以更准确地评估模型的行为判断能力。

title: Loupe: Reinforcing Knowledge-Intensive Video Generation Agents
summary: Knowledge-intensive video generation remains challenging because prompts often omit the facts, appearances, and temporal relationships required for accurate generation. While search-based workflows can retrieve missing evidence, manually designed strategies limit adaptive planning, and conventional training suffers from costly video-level feedback and coarse trajectory-level credit assignment. In this paper, we present Loupe, a video generation agent that retrieves and verifies textual and visual evidence to construct evidence-grounded temporal video prompts with reference images. We further introduce Rubric-Based Credit (RBC), which leverages prompt-specific factual, visual, and temporal requirements to evaluate intermediate search and planning decisions before video rendering. Building on RBC, RBC-SFT reweights assistant-token learning by step quality, while RBC-GRPO incorporates step-level credits alongside a final planning reward, without rendering videos during RL. To address the lack of dedicated search-oriented evaluation, we construct Search-VBench, which contains 150 held-out prompts across seven categories. Experiments show that Loupe improves all four evaluation dimensions across three video generators, raising the overall score of MiniMax-H3 from 32.80 to 70.67 and outperforming an untrained search workflow. Ablation experiments show that full RBC training outperforms standard SFT followed by trajectory-level GRPO by 5.27 points. Human evaluations and results on Sci-VBench and KIVI-Bench further demonstrate improved generation quality, scientific grounding, factual precision, and helpfulness. Our project page is available at https://zengkaiya.github.io/Loupe/.

AI.tldr: Loupe 是一个视频生成代理，通过检索和验证文本和视觉证据来构建基于证据的时间视频提示，并引入了 Rubric-Based Credit（RBC）和扩展的 RBC 方法来解决评估和训练中的挑战，从而提高了视频生成的质量和科学性。
AI.motivation: 针对目前知识密集型视频生成面临的挑战，即提示往往缺乏准确生成所需的事实、外观和时间关系，现有的基于搜索的工作流虽能检索缺失的证据，但人工设计的策略限制了适应性规划。Loupe 旨在通过结合检索和验证，生成基于证据的时间视频提示，以提高生成视频的质量。
AI.method: Loupe 通过检索和验证文本和视觉证据，根据提示的具体事实、视觉和时间要求评估中间搜索和规划决策。引入了 RBC 和 RBC-SFT、RBC-GRPO 方法，改进了传统的强化学习过程，无需在 RL 期间渲染视频。此外，还构建了 Search-VBench，包含来自七个类别中的150个保留提示，用于评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用 Loupe 提升了三个视频生成器的四个评估维度的得分，使 MiniMax-H3 的总体得分为 70.67，并且优于未训练的搜索工作流。消融实验表明，完整的 RBC 训练比标准 SFT 后跟随 Trajectory-Level GRPO 高出 5.27 分。此外，人类评估和 Sci-VBench 和 KIVI-Bench 的结果进一步证明了生成质量、科学性和事实精确性的提高。
AI.conclusion: Loupe 通过结合检索和验证的方法，提高了视频生成的质量和科学性，展示了其在视频生成领域的潜力。

title: TableRouter: Query-Aware Evidence Construction for Long-Table Question Answering
comment: Submitted to ACL Rolling Review, October 2026
summary: LLMs can reason over tables, but when tables outgrow the context budget, retrieving relevant rows is only part of the solution. A retrieved subset may omit information required for an exact aggregate; even complete evidence may remain difficult for an LLM to use. We introduce TableRouter, a training-free framework that analyzes each query, then chooses between two routes: a computation route, which derives question-conditioned statistics from the full table, and a coverage route, which retrieves relevant rows and column summaries. The chosen context is passed to a frozen LLM in one call. Across three LLMs and three large-table benchmarks, TableRouter outperforms the strongest of six single-call baselines in all nine settings by 1.2-18.3 accuracy points, using 77-95% fewer estimated FLOPs than truncated-table prompting, with indexing amortized across questions. The gains extend to long tables from databases not used in earlier experiments, where TableRouter achieves 35.8% with Qwen2.5-7B, versus 16.4% for the strongest external baseline. A controlled experiment shows that explicitly providing computed statistics improves accuracy by up to 40.0 points, even when all answer-determining rows are available. These results distinguish evidence access from evidence use: long-table reasoning depends on how information is represented, not only on which rows are retrieved.

AI.tldr: TableRouter 是一个无需训练的框架，通过选择计算路径或覆盖路径来处理大数据表，从而提高任务准确性并减少计算资源消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在面对大数据表时存在提取相关行和利用信息的局限，TableRouter 旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: TableRouter 通过分析每次查询后选择计算路径或覆盖路径，计算路径从完整表格中导出问题条件下的统计数据，覆盖路径则选择相关行和列摘要，两者中的一种路径会被冻结的 LLM 所采纳。
AI.result: TableRouter 在三个 LLM 和三个大数据表基准测试中，相对于六种单一调用基线，在所有九种设置中提高了 1.2 到 18.3 的准确性分数，同时减少了 77% 到 95% 的计算量。尤其对之前未使用的数据库的长表，TableRouter 的性能更为出色。
AI.conclusion: TableRouter 在证据访问与证据利用方面显示出了优势，提供了改善长期表格推理的新思路，即使所有决定答案的行都可用，提供的计算统计数据也能够提高准确性。

title: REBEAL: Human References Are No Longer the Best Translation, and Metrics Do Not Notice
summary: Reference-based MT evaluation assumes the human reference is correct and better than the systems it scores. Both assumptions now fail, since the human reference ranks first in none of the 2024 WMT MQM campaigns and carries annotated errors in 19% to 87% of its segments. What a metric does with a flawed reference is a question about the metric, and it would have been worth asking before reference quality came into doubt. We introduce REBEAL (Reference Bias EvALuation), a benchmark that probes how MT metrics respond to seven types of controlled reference contamination, drawn from the error categories those campaigns record. Across eight widely used metrics and three language pairs, recent learned metrics (xCOMET, MetricX) prove more robust than their predecessors, but each family fails in its own way. Surface metrics show no length sensitivity, so contamination hides in longer segments, while learned metrics accept references in unrelated languages as nearly correct. The failure they share is named-entity contamination, which no metric detects and which flips up to 8 of 36 system pairs when ranking nine MT systems.

AI.tldr: 参考基准MT评估假设人工参考比系统更好且正确，但在2024年WMT MQM竞赛中，参考基准未在任何情况下排名第一，并在19%到87%的段落中标注了错误。研究引入了REBEAL基准来探讨MT评估指标如何应对七种类型的人工参考污染，结果显示最近的学习方法比传统方法更稳健，但每种方法都有其局限性。共享的失败是实体名称污染问题，它反转了多达8对系统对九个MT系统的排名。
AI.motivation: 在评估机器翻译质量时，传统的参考基准被假定为更准确，但现在这种假设已经失效。因此，需要新的基准来理解不同MT评估指标如何应对参考基准的质量问题。
AI.method: 研究提出了REBEAL基准，该基准通过对人工参考进行了七种类型的人工污染来测试不同MT评估指标的性能。实验使用了八种常用指标和三种语言对进行测试。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，最近的学习MT评估指标（xCOMET、MetricX）比传统方法更稳健，但在某些类型的污染下仍会有失效情况。表面指标在长句中容易隐藏污染，而学习指标则接受无关语言的参考文本。
AI.conclusion: 尽管最近的学习MT评估指标更加稳健，但它们仍无法检测出实体名称污染问题，这种污染能够极大影响系统对多个MT系统的排名。因此，未来需要对MT评估指标的鲁棒性进行更深入的研究，以更好地应对质量不佳的参考基准。

title: Beyond Expert Replay: Cross-Instruction Anchoring for Continual Vision-Language-Action Learning
comment: 19 pages, 12 figures, 10 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models need to continually acquire new manipulation skills while retaining the ability to follow previously learned instructions. Experience replay (ER) can mitigate catastrophic forgetting, but retaining only a small number of historical expert frames per task leaves many old-instruction responses without direct supervision. Under limited replay, we observe a structured failure mode in which an earlier instruction can trigger a subsequently learned, competing goal. To address this gap, we propose Cross-Instruction Anchoring (XIA), which supplements expert replay with instruction-conditioned response preservation. At each task boundary, XIA freezes the previous policy as a teacher and matches its responses to old instructions paired with current observations. This extends supervision beyond stored historical examples without requiring additional expert replay data. Experiments across multiple VLA architectures and three LIBERO suites demonstrate improved success rates and reduced forgetting compared with ER under identical historical expert-data budgets. Additional RoboCasa and real-world experiments further support the effectiveness of XIA.

AI.tldr: XIA通过结合指令条件化响应保存，解决了在有限回放下的结构化失败模式，提高了一致性和减少了遗忘。
AI.motivation: 为了解决视觉-语言-动作模型在有限历史专家数据预算下，因重复目标触发先前学习的冲突目标导致的灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.method: XIA方法通过在每个任务边界冻结前一个策略作为教师，并匹配其针对当前观察的旧指令响应，实现超越存储历史示例的监督，而无需额外专家回放数据。
AI.result: 多个VLA架构和LIBERO套件实验表明，在相同历史专家数据预算下，XIA的失败率和遗忘程度低于经验回放。
AI.conclusion: XIA通过结合指令条件的响应保存，在视觉-语言-动作模型中克服了有限回放下的结构化失败问题，并提高了成功率和减少了遗忘。

title: Marketing-Bench: Evaluating Frontier Models and Agents on Real-World Marketing Capabilities
summary: As frontier AI models and agents are deployed more broadly in the real world, marketing is emerging as one of their largest applications. Marketing teams use AI models to produce brand assets like website copy and social media posts, while consumers' agents autonomously discover products, research purchases, and navigate websites. However, evaluating marketing capability is difficult because unlike areas like software development, customer support, or legal review where ground truth is more objectively defined, marketing is subjective, and output quality is judged based on taste and brand. We introduce Marketing-Bench, the first open-source marketing benchmark, which pairs discriminative tasks (detecting brand anomalies) with generative tasks (remediation), while keeping answers verifiable. Marketing-Bench tests five key pillars: factuality, consistency, coherence, structure, and brand voice, all crucial elements for good brand content on the web. We find that frontier models are far from solving the benchmark: the average model corrects only about half of the introduced issues (53.1%), whereas a marketing expert corrects nearly all of them. Even the strongest, GPT-6 Astra, reaches only 74.8%, with Claude Opus and Fable, Gemini Argon, and GPT-6 Sol falling well short. These findings suggest that marketing capabilities are less mature than adoption implies, and that principled evaluation should precede further scaling of usage. Marketing-Bench is a first step toward "frontier marketing models" with superhuman marketing performance.

AI.tldr: Marketing-Bench 是一种新的基准测试工具，用于评估 AI 在营销领域的表现。它通过多项关键指标检验模型的质量，并发现当前的前沿模型在解决营销任务时仍远未达到人类专家的水平。
AI.motivation: 当前市场对 AI 在营销领域的应用需求增加，但缺乏统一的评估标准使得难以客观衡量 AI 的营销能力。
AI.method: Marketing-Bench 设计了一套包括事实性、一致性、连贯性、结构和品牌声音在内的多项测试，将辨识性任务（检测品牌形象异常）与生成性任务（修正问题）相结合，以验证模型答案。
AI.result: 根据 Marketing-Bench 的测试结果，当前的 AI 模型解决营销任务的准确率普遍较低，大多数模型仅能修正大约一半的问题，而人类专家则能几乎全部修正。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论指出，AI 在营销领域的应用还处于不成熟阶段，需要进一步进行有原则的评估以指导后续的发展。Marketing-Bench 作为首个开源基准测试工具，有望推动超人类营销 AI 的发展。

title: MargEmbed-Akan: Bridging Twi Questions and English Knowledge through Cross-Lingual Score Distillation
summary:
Most information sought online by Twi (Akan) speakers is written in English, making cross-lingual retrieval essential. We evaluate eight systems: BM25, five open embedding models, and two proprietary models (gemini-embedding-001 and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large) on two Twi-English tasks. AfriQA contains 1,221 natively written Asante Twi questions that must retrieve their answering English Wikipedia passages. Bible translation retrieval requires a Twi passage to retrieve its English translation from 6,195 candidates.
  We introduce MargEmbed-Akan, a 560M-parameter open query encoder trained from AfriE5-Large-instruct using cross-lingual score distillation. The frozen base model scores each English training question against its answer passage and seven hard negatives. The student learns to reproduce these scores from both an NLLB-200 Twi translation that passes a round-trip translation check and the original English question, preserving English behaviour. During training, passages are encoded by the frozen base model; at evaluation, MargEmbed-Akan encodes questions and passages.
  On AfriQA, base AfriE5 and gemini-embedding-001 both achieve 66.6 nDCG@10; EmbeddingGemma 2, Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large achieve 56.6, 51.3, and 53.4, respectively. MargEmbed-Akan achieves 71.5, outperforming gemini-embedding-001 by 4.9 points, its base model by 5.0, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large by 18.1. Its largest gain is on Twi typed without E and O (+7.5 over gemini-embedding-001). English retrieval does not differ significantly from the base model, although both proprietary models score 1.5-2.2 points higher. On Bible translation retrieval, MargEmbed-Akan and gemini-embedding-001 are statistically tied on standard Twi (97.2 vs. 96.5 nDCG@10); MargEmbed-Akan performs better on diacritic-free Twi (92.7 vs. 84.9). No AfriQA data was used for training or model selection.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了多种信息检索系统在Akan语和英语之间的检索任务中的表现，并引入了一个名为MargEmbed-Akan的开放查询编码器，取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: Twist（阿kan语）用户倾向于在网络上使用英语搜索信息，因此跨语言检索变得尤为重要。已有研究对比了多种嵌入模型的性能，发现MargEmbed-Akan具有显著优势。
AI.method: 研究采用了包括BM25和五种开源嵌入模型在内的八种系统进行评估。MargEmbed-Akan是一个560M参数的开放查询编码器，通过目标指令AfriE5-Large的层次语义知识和迁移学习进行了训练，并通过跨语言评分精馏将英语行为保留下来。模型在编码问题和段落时表现出色。
AI.result: 在AfriQA任务上，MargEmbed-Akan取得了71.5的nDCG@10，超越了gemini-embedding-001和其他模型的表现。特别地，它在不包含元音的Twist任务上取得了7.5分的提升。在圣经翻译检索中，虽然MargEmbed-Akan和gemini-embedding-001在标准Twist上得分相近，但在无重音Twist上表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了MargEmbed-Akan在跨语言检索中的优越性，尤其是在处理Akan语问题时。

title: Your VLM Knows What to Inspect: Semantic Probe-Guided Adaptive Focusing for GUI Grounding
summary: GUI grounding requires resolving fine visual details within the context that gives them meaning. Additional views can improve localization, but their value depends on what evidence they expose and how much context they preserve. We explore a capability of vision-language models (VLMs): even when their coordinate predictions are incorrect, they can describe visual evidence worth inspecting. We introduce \textbf{SPARK}, \textit{\textbf{S}emantic \textbf{P}robe-guided \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{R}egion see\textbf{K}ing}, a training-free framework that turns this semantic guidance into targeted visual observations. Exploration probes describe relevant context and distinguishing target details, while verification probes identify evidence needed to assess emerging hypotheses. Their spatial attention guides view placement, contextual responses determine crop extent, and observation history encourages complementary inspection. The resulting predictions are combined through uncertainty-weighted voting. On ScreenSpot-Pro, SPARK improves grounding accuracy over single-view inference by 13.9, 25.2, and 16.1 percentage points with Qwen3-VL, Qwen2.5-VL, and UI-TARS, outperforming all compared test-time methods for each backbone. Consistent gains across four additional benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness across diverse interfaces and grounding tasks. These results establish semantic probing as an effective mechanism for turning a frozen VLM's understanding of what to inspect into more accurate GUI grounding.

AI.tldr: SPARK 提升了 GUI 接地的准确性，通过使用语义探针引导的适应性区域观察，即使在坐标预测不准确的情况下也能提供有价值的视觉证据。该方法在多个基准测试中表现优越，特别是在多种用户界面和接地任务下。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖预训练模型的直接视觉定位，但这些方法在可视化细节的正确定位上可能有局限性。SPARK 旨在通过语义探针引导的视觉观察来弥补这些不足，使预训练模型即使在坐标预测不准确的情况下也能提供有价值的视觉证据。
AI.method: SPARK 是一种无需训练的框架，它通过语义探针描述相关上下文和区分目标细节，以及通过识别支持新兴假设的证据来确定视图放置的位置、上下文响应确定切割范围，以及观察历史促进互补观察。最终的预测通过不确定性加权投票结合。
AI.result: SPARK 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 数据集上的表现优于单视图推断，分别提高了 Qwen3-VL、Qwen2.5-VL、UI-TARS 的精度 13.9、25.2 和 16.1 个百分点，并且在所有模型和比较的方法中表现出色。此外，SPARK 在四个额外基准中的一致改进进一步证明了其在多样化用户界面和接地任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SPARK 通过语义探针引导的视觉观察机制成功地将预训练模型的视觉理解转化为更准确的 GUI 接地，显示了其对 GUI 接地任务的适用性和有效性。

title: From Rule-based to Agentic: LLM Agent based Real-time Control of Urban Drainage Systems for Flooding and Sewer Overflow Mitigation
summary: Real-time control (RTC) for urban drainage systems (UDS) remains hampered by sparse in-network sensing. While heterogeneous multi-modal meteorological early warnings often contain decision-critical information for UDS RTC, none of the existing approaches can exploit such externally-sourced information within the control workflow. Here we introduce AgenticAI-Control, an agentic artificial intelligence framework able to assimilate multi-source meteorological early warnings in RTC. Two coupled large language model agents are integrated to generate control strategies by retrieving meteorological early-warnings and fusing them with domain engineering expertise. Validated via simulation studies of a combined sewer catchment in eastern China across 10 real-world rainfall events, the AgenticAI-Control achieved 69.1-90.6% reduction in aggregated flood and overflow volumes compared to the rule-based baseline control. Rigorously standardized prompt engineering and modular workflow constraints substantially compress performance disparities among four distinct LLMs. Our work establishes AgenticAI as a viable tool to unify multi-source meteorological monitoring and practitioner domain knowledge, surmounting longstanding monitoring limitations of UDS RTC and delivering cost-efficient, robust intelligent control solutions for sensor-sparse sewer infrastructures.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为AgenticAI-Control的人工智能框架，能够整合多种气象早期预警信息用于城市排水系统的实时控制。研究通过模拟试验验证了其效果，并表明该框架能显著减少洪水和溢流的总体积。
AI.motivation: 现有的城市排水系统实时控制（RTC）方法难以利用外部气象预警信息，而气象预警往往包含支持 RTC 的关键决策信息。
AI.method: 研究通过结合两种大型语言模型代理来生成控制策略，该代理能够检索和融合气象预警与领域工程知识。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，相比于基于规则的控制策略，AgenticAI-Control减少了69.1-90.6%的洪灾和溢流总体积。
AI.conclusion: AgenticAI-Control框架为城市排水系统的实时控制提供了一种可行的解决方案，特别是在传感器稀疏的城市排水基础设施中。

title: Generating Schema-Aligned Synthetic Dialogues and Measuring Their Diversity
summary: Training or evaluating a model that turns a conversation into a structured record requires paired data, meaning a transcript together with the exact record it should be converted into. Such pairs are expensive to annotate, and in sensitive domains they are also difficult to obtain at all. We therefore build them in the opposite order by sampling a schema-valid record first, then writing a dialogue from it, and optionally synthesizing speech from the dialogue, so the label exists before the text and we need no annotation step. Naively prompting a language model for such dialogues yields small variations of a single conversation, so we add a sampled variation configuration, personas, and a topic plan that orders the fields of the record as explicit mechanisms for variation.
