However, LLMs are prone to errors, and so a semantically unfaithful FOL formula could corrupt downstream reasoning. We present FOL-Proof, a semantic firewall pipeline that validates LLM-generated FOL translations against independently derived linguistic interpretations. FOL-Proof operates by deterministically obtaining a pool of candidate translations via semantic analysis tools, such as the English Resource Grammar and Minimal Recursion Semantics; then applying an SMT solver to check each derived reading for logical equivalence to the LLM-generated formula. If the translation is faithful it is accepted; otherwise, it is rejected, or optionally repaired via repeated invocations to the LLM. The procedure is conservative: incomplete search, unsupported constructions, or inconclusive checks yield abstention rather than false rejection. We evaluated FOL-Proof on established benchmarks (ProofWriter, RuleTaker and PrOntoQA), and also on a new adversarial benchmark (LongFaithCheck). Our experiments show that FOL-Proof attains near perfect selective accuracy, while direct LLM judges and round-trip baselines show substantially worse performance.

AI.tldr: FOL-Proof is a pipeline designed to validate the semantic correctness of Large Language Models' (LLMs) translations from natural language to First-Order Logic (FOL). It uses deterministic tools and an SMT solver to ensure the generated FOL formulas are logically equivalent to the intended meaning before acceptance, or allows for repeated LLM calls for repair when necessary.
AI.motivation: To enhance the reliability and accuracy of translations made by Large Language Models (LLMs) from natural language to First-Order Logic (FOL), thus preventing semantically unfaithful translations from corrupting downstream reasoning processes.
AI.method: FOL-Proof works by first generating a pool of candidate FOL translations using semantic analysis tools like the English Resource Grammar and Minimal Recursion Semantics. It then uses an SMT solver to check each translation for logical equivalence to the generated FOL formula. If the translation is faithful, it is accepted; if not, it can either be rejected or repaired through repeated LLM calls.
AI.result: FOL-Proof demonstrated near perfect selective accuracy in experiments on established benchmarks (ProofWriter, RuleTaker, and PrOntoQA) and a new adversarial benchmark (LongFaithCheck). Compared to direct LLM judgments and round-trip baselines, FOL-Proof showed significantly improved performance.
AI.conclusion: FOL-Proof is an effective approach to ensure semantic fidelity in the translations from natural language to FOL, which aids in improving the quality and trustworthiness of downstream logical reasoning tasks.

title: InCue: Making Better Use of What Multimodal LLMs Already See at Test Time
summary: Even when multimodal large language models (MLLMs) answer incorrectly, their internal cues often point to the relevant region. A widely used remedy re-presents the cue-selected region as an enlarged crop to supply finer detail. However, we find that much of its gain requires no new detail: it largely survives when the crop comes from the already-seen low-resolution input, and partly even when the region's cached tokens are merely copied. Part of re-presentation's gain thus comes from drawing attention to evidence the model already holds. We propose InCue, a test-time framework that makes better use of this evidence without additional visual input. InCue treats visual attention and predictive-entropy gradients as Internal Cues, couples them into a spatial target, and optimizes only an offset on the existing visual tokens to steer attention toward it. Under matched visual-token budgets, InCue achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming recent test-time methods and improving four MLLMs by up to 8.9% on V$^*$ and 23.4% on its hard samples. Its gains carry over to eight general benchmarks. Code will be available at https://github.com/paul-swu/InCue.

AI.tldr: InCue 提出了一种无需额外视觉输入就能更好地利用模型已有证据的测试时框架，通过优化现有视觉令牌的偏移来引导注意力，从而在多个基准测试中显著提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法重呈现通过选择内部线索并提供放大后的区域以增加细节来提高模型性能，但实际增益可能并不需要额外细节。然而直接利用已有视觉信息的效果尚未充分挖掘。
AI.method: InCue 采用了一种新颖的方法，结合视觉注意和预测熵梯度作为内部线索，形成一个空间目标，并仅优化现有视觉令牌的偏移来引导注意力。
AI.result: 在与视觉令牌预算匹配的条件下，InCue 达到了最新的测试时方法的最先进性能，对四种 MLLMs 的提升达到 8.9%，在 V* 和其更难样本上的提升达到 23.4%。此外，它的成果扩展到八个通用基准测试中。
AI.conclusion: InCue 成功地展示了一种有效利用模型已知信息的方法，提高了模型在多模态任务中的表现，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: The Control-Flow Tax: Specialized Decision Routing for LLM Agent Workflows
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Shuanghu Wang and Li Jiang share second authorship
summary: An agent can spend almost as much deciding what to do as doing it. In our documentation workflow, control-flow routing accounts for 42.5% of baseline reference cost on the initial task. Lower token prices alone do not solve this control-flow tax: inexpensive general-purpose routers can trigger additional calls to the expensive generator. We evaluate a heterogeneous architecture in which Jev, a specialized System 1 decision model, controls finite actions while Sol generates documents. Across four software tasks, 480 valid runs comprise 470 completions and ten request-limit endpoints. Jev full routing achieves the lowest mean cost and elapsed time on every task, completing all 40 specialist-controlled runs along the shortest trajectory. On the initial task, mean cost falls by 49.6% (95% paired-bootstrap interval: 42.9% to 56.3%) and elapsed time by 33.2% (19.6% to 46.7%). Across three further tasks, cost reductions are 40.5% to 42.9% and concurrent elapsed-time reductions are 12.9% to 14.4%. Existence-only specialization saves just 1.8% on the initial task. Separately, Sol and Jev each select accepted actions on 100/100 reviewed retail states, with Jev using 97.88% less reference cost and 72.30% less mean request time. The results identify two requirements for efficient agent control: inexpensive decisions and trajectories that preserve those savings.

AI.tldr: 在文档工作流中，控制流路由占初始任务基础成本的42.5%。单纯降低令牌价格无法解决此控制流税。我们评估的异构架构中，Jev（特殊的系统1决策模型）控制有限行动，而Sol生成文档。相比基线，全面路由实现所有专家控制任务的最低平均成本和最短时间。
AI.motivation: 研究如何通过优化控制流路由来提高文档生成的效率。
AI.method: 提出了一个异构架构，在这个架构中，Jev作为专门的系统1决策模型控制具体动作，而Sol负责生成文档。通过比较不同任务中的成本和时间变化来评估这种架构的效果。
AI.result: 在四个软件任务中，包含480个有效运行和470个完成任务以及10个请求限制端点。Jev的全面路由在每个任务中实现了最低的平均成本和最短时间，并完成了所有40个专家控制的运行，这是沿着最短路径完成的。与基线相比，初始任务的平均成本降低了49.6%，执行时间减少了33.2%。在后续的三个任务中，成本和时间的节约分别在12.9%到14.4%之间。仅存在专家化的节省在初始任务中仅为1.8%。
AI.conclusion: 有效的代理控制需要低成本的决策和保留这些节省下来的资源的行动轨迹。Jev能够比Sol在决策上节省更多的时间和成本，这表明专门化的决策模型对于优化控制流是有益的。

title: AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design
summary: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. They debug against public tests under fixed budgets; their frozen designs are graded on held-out token sequences, resets, memory stalls, and synthesis, and a second track asks them to speed up a correct design at nearly fixed area. Across 9,136 attempts by four coding agents, the difficulty lies in stored state. Feedback that points to the first state mismatch raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent--task cells of a matched study, by 25.0 to 46.9 percentage points, and halves the agent-hours per accepted design. Regraded on new sequences and conditions, 45 of 69 accepted designs fail within the 32 steps their tests required. More than a third of attempts to speed up a correct design end without one. An overall score ranks Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5, and both halves of the instances give this order in all 200 random splits. Hardware agents therefore need debugging feedback that exposes stored state, and their benchmarks need final tests well beyond the development cases.

AI.tldr: AIChipBench 要求语言模型的硬件实现必须正确处理存储状态，通过量化和实施多个解码器，并使用特定的评估标准和反馈机制，检查了硬件正确性的方法。实验结果显示，仅输出反馈无法有效调试复杂的存储状态问题，而使用状态不匹配的反馈能够显著提高设计的接受率。
AI.motivation: 通过分析不同语言模型的硬件实现，验证硬件设计是否能够正确处理存储状态，这有助于提高大型语言模型在实际硬件上的运行效果，避免潜在的错误。
AI.method: AIChipBench 对比了多个语言模型解码器的实现，并使用特定的RTL代码实现来测试硬件的设计。在实验中，使用了固定预算下的调试、性能测试以及合成验证等评估手段。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用状态不匹配的反馈可以显著提高设计接受率，从某些解码器中成功得出了一些能够满足所有测试条件的正确设计方案。但仍有超过三分之一的尝试未能加速正确的设计。
AI.conclusion: 实验结论得出，硬件设计师在调试语言模型时需要关注存储状态的正确性，并建议未来的测试基准应该具有更广泛的最终测试案例。

title: Describe, Don't Decide: Correcting Answer Bias in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Comparing two entities in an image, multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) often answer wrongly. We find that the answer bias enters not when the model sees, but when it decides with the image in view: the model's own descriptions of the two entities often already hold the right answer. We therefore propose D$^3$ (Describe, Don't Decide): the model describes each entity alone, decides from these descriptions without the image, and merges this decision with its direct answer. Without any training, D$^3$ improves all 79 model-benchmark pairs across ten benchmarks and eight 7-9B MLLMs. On held-out GQA comparison questions, the mean accuracy of these models rises from 72.4% to 83.2% (up to +21.5% per model), higher than that of Qwen2.5-VL-32B answering directly (82.8%). Code will be available at https://github.com/paul-swu/describe-dont-decide.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种称为D³的新方法，通过模型单独描述图像中的每个实体，然后基于描述而不是直接从图像中做出判断，从而提高双实体比较任务上的准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统的多模态LLMs在进行图像中的双实体对比时常常给出错误的回答。研究者发现，问题的答案偏差并不是在模型看到图像时产生的，而是在模型基于图像进行决策时产生。因此，提出了一种新的方法D³，旨在通过让模型先描述每个实体再基于描述做出判断来减少这些偏差。
AI.method: D³ 方法包括三个步骤：1）模型单独描述每个实体；2）模型基于描述来进行判断，不参考实际的图像；3）将基于描述的判断与模型直接从图像中得到的答案结合起来形成最终答案。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，D³ 方法可以在不经过任何训练的情况下显著提升 79 个模型-基准模型对在十个基准和八个模型上的表现，在 GQA 持有变量集的对比问题上，模型的平均准确率从 72.4% 提升到了 83.2%，甚至超过了模型 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 直接回答所达到的 82.8%。
AI.conclusion: D³ 方法为解决多模态LLMs在双实体比较任务中的表现不佳问题提供了一种有效的解决方案。

title: Can AI Design a Better nnU-Net? A Hypothesis-Driven Architecture Discovery Loop from Failures to Design Rules
summary: Neural architecture search and LLM-driven evolution often reduce evaluation to a scalar fitness score, discarding failures that could explain why designs succeed or fail. We present a hypothesis-driven architecture discovery loop in which LLM agents diagnose structured error patterns, formulate falsifiable hypotheses, test counterfactual controls under a frozen nnU-Net pipeline, and distill validated mechanisms into executable trigger-to-action rules. Across eight search waves, the loop identifies two principles for 3D medical image segmentation. First, reallocating computation from high-resolution decoders to the mid-encoder preserves thin-anatomy boundaries while reducing cost. Second, support-confined region contrast addresses errors between nested anatomical compartments, with anatomy-dependent triggers selecting when the rule applies. These principles produce LeanNeXt (0.78 MACs and 0.92 training-step time relative to nnU-Net; +1.63 Dice points on four-fold KiTS23 cross-validation) and trigger-routed LeanNeXt+. The latter improves all 15 evaluated CT/MRI settings over nnU-Net and exceeds the 3.3 larger ResEnc-M on 12 of 15 benchmarks at 0.30 its parameter count. Relative to random sampling, one-shot LLM generation, and score-selected agent search, the loop shows how failure analysis can yield reusable design rules across modalities.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于假设的神经架构发现循环，通过LLM诊断错误模式、提出可证伪的假设，并在固定nnU-Net管道中测试反事实控制，最终将验证的机制转化为可执行的动作规则。这种方法在8轮搜索中发现了3D医学图像分割的两个原则，提高了LeanNeXt和LeanNeXt+的性能，超过了对手方法。
AI.motivation: 当前的神经架构搜索和预训练语言模型驱动的进化经常仅将评价简化为单一的适应度得分，忽视了可能导致设计成功或失败的失败情况。因此，该研究旨在开发一种新的错误分析循环，以促进设计原理的发现。
AI.method: 研究首先通过LLM诊断结构化错误模式，然后提出可证伪的假设，接下来在固定住nnU-Net流水线中测试反事实控制；最后，将验证的机制转化为可执行的动作规则。
AI.result: 这种错误分析方法在8轮搜索中发现了两个关于3D医学图像分割的原则。第一，从高分辨率解码器重新分配计算到中层编码器可保持薄组织界限并降低成本。第二，支持限制区域对比可解决嵌套解剖区域之间的错误，使用解剖结构依赖触发器指定该规则的适用情况。基于这些原则，作者提出了LeanNeXt和trigger-routed LeanNeXt+，分别在四折KiTS23上提高了1.63个Dice分数，并且在15个评价值标中，有12个超越了ResEnc-M模型。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可以通过仔细分析设计的失败，生成具有广泛适用性的设计规则。与随机采样、单次LLM生成和基于得分选择代理搜索相比，该方法在跨模态中表现出更高的可重用性和有效性。

title: SAG-Mem-1.0 Technical Report
summary: Long-term conversational memory requires retrieving complementary facts scattered across dialogue sessions, including intermediate evidence with limited similarity to the original question. Existing approaches often rely on derived memory representations or persistent relational structures, introducing construction costs and potentially losing source details. We present SAG-Mem, a conversational memory framework that preserves complete dialogue messages in non-overlapping chunks and discovers complementary evidence through query-time lexical expansion. Memory construction requires no model inference, using a lexical index without LLM-based extraction, summarization, or semantic relation construction. At query time, BM25 retrieves initial candidates, an evidence evaluator identifies useful chunks, and lexical cues from selected evidence guide an additional retrieval round. Retrieved dialogue is further annotated with calendar interpretations of supported relative-time expressions, preserving the original wording and temporal granularity. We also introduce SAG-Mem-Lite, an alternative configuration that replaces evidence scoring with embedding-based candidate scoring, achieving lower operational cost than Full Context and all memory-based baselines across both benchmarks with low query latency. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval, SAG-Mem achieves overall scores of 83.08 and 80.20, respectively, the highest among the evaluated methods on both benchmarks. On LongMemEval, it exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 7.20 points. SAG-Mem-Lite achieves scores of 77.09 and 77.20, respectively. These results support dialogue preservation and evidence-guided retrieval expansion as an effective design for long-term conversational memory.

AI.tldr: SAG-Mem框架通过非重叠存储完整的对话消息并在查询时通过词汇扩展发现互补证据。这种方法无需模型推理，使用词汇索引进行初始候选检索，将对话进一步注解为日历解析，保持原词和时间粒度。SAG-Mem-Lite版本在两个基准测试上的表现也优于其他记忆相关基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖于衍生的记忆表示或持久的关联结构，这会引入构建成本并可能导致丢失原始细节。SAG-Mem旨在提供一种方法，以确保完整的对话信息保存下来，并通过查询时的词汇扩展发现互补证据，同时避免复杂的模型推理。
AI.method: SAG-Mem框架不依赖于模型推理，而是使用词汇索引在初始查询中检索候选，随后通过证据评估器识别有用的片段，再根据选定证据的词汇线索进行额外的检索。该系统还包含了对相对时间表达式的日历解析，并保持原始的单词及时间细节。SAG-Mem-Lite版本则替代证据评分，采用基于嵌入的候选评分机制。
AI.result: SAG-Mem在两种基准测试LoCoMo和LongMemEval上获得83.08和80.20的总分，分别是最优方法中最高的得分。SAG-Mem-Lite也显示出在两个基准测试上超越其他所有基线的能力，尽管性能稍低一些。
AI.conclusion: SAG-Mem和SAG-Mem-Lite被证明可以使对话保存和证据导向的检索扩展成为长期对话记忆的有效设计，特别是SAG-Mem在保持原始语言和时间详细信息方面表现出色，这些结果支持了这种设计的有效性。

title: Reconstructing Natural Images from Brain Activity during Natural Vision
comment: 40 pages, 18 figures, 4 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Reconstructing images from brain activity has two broad goals. The first is to build brain-computer interfaces. The second is to understand how the brain sees. The eyes deliver incomplete, noisy input, so the brain must fill in the gaps with its expectations of what natural scenes look like. This filling-in relies on the brain's prior over natural images. Image reconstruction lets us test which natural image prior best matches the brain's natural image prior. However, most previous work on image reconstruction relies on an unnatural condition: subjects must hold their eyes still. In reality, primates constantly move their eyes to see the world. We introduce a framework for reconstructing images from neural activity while a primate freely views a static natural scene. We record from five monkeys with high-density electrode arrays in the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN) and primary visual cortex (V1). The recorded receptive fields cover only a small part of the image. Thus, we combine neural activity across eye movements, trials, and sessions to reconstruct the full image. We first present a simple linear method with a 1/f prior. We then scale this approach up with modern deep learning. We train a decoder by tokenizing spiking activity and measured gaze; these tokens are fed into a transformer and diffusion model to reconstruct the full scene. Three factors determine reconstruction quality: the amount of neural evidence combined over viewing time, the accuracy of eye tracking, and the choice of image prior. Our method sets a new state-of-the-art performance in reconstructing natural images from brain activity, across brain recording modalities: fMRI, EEG, MEG and electrophysiology.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种从灵长类动物自由观看静态自然场景时的神经活动重建图像的方法，通过结合神经活动、眼球跟踪和现代深度学习技术，提出了新的图像重建方法，提高了大脑活动重建自然图像的性能。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在解决从大脑活动重建自然图像的问题，以理解大脑如何视觉感知，并通过比较自然图像先验来测试大脑的视觉机制。
AI.method: 首先，文章使用简单的线性方法结合1/f先验；随后，采用现代深度学习技术，通过将刺发活动和测量眼动进行分词，输入变压器和扩散模型重建全图。
AI.result: 文章的方法在各种神经成像技术研发的自然图像重建中达到了新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过改进图像重建方法，文章提出了新的先验和分析框架，提升了解码图像的能力，促进了对大脑视觉机制的理解。

title: VISE: Verifier-Independent Skill Self-Evolution with Feedback from Tool Implementations
summary: Agent skills provide reusable workflows that guide LLM agents in using tools. Refining these workflows requires feedback on missing or incorrect instructions, but task-specific verifiers are not always available. We propose VISE (Verifier-Independent Skill Evolution), a scripts-first approach that uses tool implementations to guide skill revision. It extracts tool capabilities, input requirements, usage conditions, and output formats from source code. Using the task request and execution trace, it compares this information with current workflow instructions to identify missing or conflicting steps. It then recommends specific edits to SKILL.md, linking each change to the relevant implementation and usage conditions. We evaluate VISE as an additional revision stage for four evolution methods on SkillsBench and SkillLearnBench. Compared with the corresponding No-verifier conditions, it improves overall average task success by 9.14-13.35 percentage points. The proportion of tasks solved in all three runs increases by 12.36-18.29 points. A case study shows how revised instructions connect tool outputs to later steps. These results support tool implementations as a practical feedback source for skill self-evolution.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为VISE的新方法，通过工具实现来指导技能修订，从而提高技能的执行成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有技能优化方法依赖于特定任务的验证器，但往往不可用。因此，该研究探索了一种新的技能改进方法，利用工具的实现来提供反馈。
AI.method: VISE方法首先从工具的源代码中抽取其功能、输入需求、使用条件和输出格式，然后与任务请求和执行轨迹中的现有工作流指令进行比较，识别缺失或冲突的步骤，最后提出具体的修订建议。
AI.result: 在SkillBench和SkillLearnBench上对四种进化方法进行的评估表明，与未使用验证器的条件相比，VISE方法提高了任务成功率9.14-13.35个百分点，解决的任务比例提高了12.36-18.29个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 总的来说，研究表明，利用工具的实现作为技能自改进的反馈源是实际可行的。

title: CoT-Proxy: Cross-Format Transfer for Distilling Long-Horizon Policies
summary: Reasoning models become long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning or, more cheaply, through fine-tuning on a stronger teacher's trajectories, which contain the teacher's chain-of-thought as well as its actions. The standard fine-tuning approach imitates both, yet the strongest teachers are closed models whose chain-of-thought is hidden behind an API. We show that the chain-of-thought can be left out altogether and that the long-horizon policy can be distilled from the teacher's actions alone. The student is trained on these trajectories with its reasoning block left empty, while a KL loss on a replay buffer of its own generations limits drift from its initial model. Surprisingly, the policy learned from these trajectories with an empty reasoning block carries over to inference with thinking enabled, where the student reasons in its own style while acting like the teacher, an effect we call cross-format transfer. Distilling the actions of Qwen3.6-27B raises the task success of Qwen3-4B on AppWorld from 7% to 18% and that of Qwen3-32B from 12% to 25%. We further introduce CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher's reasoning placed after the empty reasoning block, which raise Qwen3-4B further, to 35%. Since neither actions nor CoT-proxies need the hidden chain-of-thought, the recipe applies unchanged to closed teachers. Distilling GPT-5.6 Luna from its visible outputs and the reasoning summaries its API returns raises Qwen3-4B from 7% to 48% on AppWorld and from 3% to 28% on SWE-bench Verified.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过直接提取教师模型的行为而非其思维过程，实现了长时距代理的训练，并通过策略蒸馏有效提升了目标模型在特定任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 随着研究进展，长时距代理的训练通常需要教师模型的思维过程，但许多强教师模型的思维过程隐藏于API后不可获取。因此，研究者提出了一种新的策略，即通过教师模型的行为直接训练学生模型，而无需依赖其思维过程。
AI.method: 研究者首先从教师模型的行为中提取策略，然后在训练学生模型时，仅利用这些策略而将思维模块留空。为了控制学生模型学习初期的过度拟合，研究引入了KL损失以限制学生模型与初始模型之间的差距。进一步地，研究提出了使用简短的思维代理（CoT-proxies），辅助学生模型更好地学习。
AI.result: 研究展示了通过策略蒸馏直接从教师行为中训练学生模型的有效性。具体而言，Qwen3-4B模型在AppWorld任务上的成功率从7%提升至48%，在SWE-bench Verified任务上的成功率则从3%提升至28%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明了可以从隐藏思维过程的强教师模型中提取策略以训练学生模型，且无需额外思维信息，这扩大了策略蒸馏的应用范围。

title: Change the Base, Change the Game: Rethinking Pan-sharpening
comment: The first two authors contributed equally to this work (equal contribution). Please visit our project page at this https://kaist-viclab.github.io/PanBase_site/
summary: Many pan-sharpening (PS) networks reconstruct high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) images by adding learned residuals to 4$\times$-interpolated low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) inputs, incorporating panchromatic (PAN) detail only through these residual corrections. This raises a simple question: Why start with a blurry base when sharp spatial detail is already available? We propose PanBase, a sharper multispectral starting point designed for more effective residual learning. Guided by physical sensor characteristics, PanBase combines PAN spatial detail with LRMS spectral information while enforcing consistency with the LRMS observations under sensor-specific blur. We construct this base without neural network training, estimating only nine coefficients per spectral band through closed-form calibration. Our PanBase can be easily integrated into existing backbones with a global residual skip through two simple changes: (i) replacing the skip base with PanBase and (ii) concatenating it as an additional input. Using each backbone's original training recipe and matched training budgets, PanBase improves most reduced- and full-resolution metrics on WorldView-3, QuickBird, and GaoFen-2, while achieving 4.4$\times$ faster training convergence on average. In zero-shot evaluation on WorldView-2, standalone PanBase achieves competitive reconstruction without target-sensor fitting or neural refinement.

AI.tldr: 文章提出了一种名为PanBase的新方法，用于增强多光谱图像的起点，通过将PAN的空间细节与LRMS的光谱信息结合，同时保持传感器特定的模糊一致性。无需神经网络训练，仅需估算每个光谱带的九个系数，PanBase可以快速集成到现有网络中，并在多种图像上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 许多现有的pan-sharpening网络通过在低分辨率多光谱输入上增加残差来重建高分辨率多光谱图像，但这些网络忽视了可用的锐化空间细节。作者提出PanBase作为更有效的残差学习起点，有效利用PAN的细节信息。
AI.method: PanBase 方法是结合了 PAN 的空间细节与 LRMS 的光谱信息，并利用闭形式算法仅需估计每个光谱带的九个系数。将其与现有神经网络融合的方法为：替换跳越基础层为 PanBase，并将其作为额外输入进行串联。
AI.result: PanBase 的表现优于原网络，对多种图像（如 WorldView-3, QuickBird, GaoFen-2）改善了大多数分辨率指标，且平均训练收敛速度提高 4.4 倍。在 WorldView-2 的零样本评估上，未经过其他传感器校准或神经细化的 PanBase 也能取得令人满意的效果。
AI.conclusion: PanBase 提出了一种新的起点方法来提高 pan-sharpening 性能，它的简单性和高效使它易于集成到现有的神经网络架构中。

title: RecurSciBench: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement in Data-Driven Scientific Research
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are advancing the automation of data-driven scientific research. Recent advances in recursive self-improvement (RSI) offer the potential for these agents to continuously improve through experience, but evaluating transfer across scientific tasks requires executable, scientifically verifiable tasks and independent assessment of self-improvement gains. We introduce RecurSciBench, a scalable benchmark for evaluating RSI in data-driven scientific research. Its RecurSciPipe framework automatically constructs scientific modeling and data analysis tasks from raw datasets, with execution-based verification and scientific validity checks. RecurSciBench spans four scientific domains, multiple data modalities, and varied scientific objectives. We evaluate four RSI systems by comparing their initial and evolved states on independent tasks after evolution on source tasks, covering within-type, cross-type, and cross-domain transfer. Experiments show that the benefits of self-improvement vary across agent systems and scientific domains. Positive overall gains can coexist with regressions on individual tasks. Experience can transfer across task types and benefit other domains even without measurable gains in the source domain.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了RecurSciBench，一个用于评估递归自改进（RSI）在数据驱动科学研究中的能力的基准测试。通过自动构造科学建模和数据分析任务，该框架提供了执行验证和科学有效性检查。
AI.motivation: 递归自改进技术可以使得语言模型代理不断改进，但对科学研究任务的迁移评估需要可执行且科学验证的任务和独立评估的改进收益。
AI.method: RecurSciBench包含RecurSciPipe框架，能够从原始数据集中自动构建科学建模和数据分析任务，同时提供基于执行的验证和科学有效性检查。
AI.result: 研究通过对比四个RSI系统的初始状态和进化状态在不同独立任务上的表现，评估了RSI在同类型、跨类型和跨领域的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，不同代理系统和科学领域的自我改进收益存在差异，整体收益可能与单个任务上的退步共存，经验可以在不同任务类型间传递并为其他领域带来益处，即使在原领域没有可测量的收益。

title: Distractors are the Real Enemy: Visual Distraction Adversarial Perturbations on SAM2-Based Video Tracking and Segmentation
summary: Promptable video trackers such as SAM2 achieve accurate and robust performance through strong temporal consistency, making them important foundations for downstream video understanding and tracking applications. As their use continues to expand, understanding their robustness to adversarial perturbations becomes increasingly important. Existing attacks on SAM2 largely focus on local mask degradation and short-term temporal feature disruption, leaving its longer-term dynamics and competing object interferences (Distractors) insufficiently explored. We observe that SAM2 itself exposes useful distractor cues when tracking becomes uncertain. Based on these observations, we propose DistractAttack, a white-box attack that uses background distractors to disrupt target tracking persistently. Its core procedure, Counterfactual Distractor Search (CDS), propagates clean and attacked trajectories in parallel to discover plausible competing regions and identify those that become increasingly effective under perturbation. The discovered evidence is accumulated over time to weaken target support and promote recurrent alternatives or disappearance predictions. Extensive experiments under video-level and one-shot perturbations across Visual Object Tracking and Video Object Segmentation demonstrate strong attack effectiveness, raising DRE to $4.4\times$ and NRE to $7.3\times$ their nearest baselines under video perturbation, while transferring effectively across model scales and tracker variants in black-box settings. Project page: https://adonaydem.github.io/sam2-da-page/

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了DistractAttack，一种利用背景干扰物持续破坏目标跟踪的白盒攻击方法。通过对比干净和受攻击的轨迹来发现有效的干扰区域，逐步削弱目标支持并促进重复替代或消失预测。
AI.motivation: 随着提示型视频追踪器如SAM2的使用范围扩大，理解它们对对抗性扰动的鲁棒性变得至关重要。现有攻击方法主要针对局部掩码降级和短时特征干扰，对长时间动态和干扰目标的干扰作用研究不足。
AI.method: DistractAttack的核心流程是Counterfactual Distractor Search (CDS)，它同时传播干净和受攻击的轨迹，以发现可能的竞争区域并识别在扰动下效果增强的区域。随着时间的推移，发现的证据将逐渐削弱目标的支持度，促进重复的替代预测或消失预测。
AI.result: 实验结果表明DistractAttack具有强大的攻击效果。在视频级和单帧扰动下的视觉对象跟踪和视频对象分割任务中，DRE提高了4.4倍，NRE提高了7.3倍，且在黑盒设置中能够跨模型规模和追踪器变体进行有效转移。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了关于提示型视频追踪器对长时间动态和干扰目标干扰作用理解的空白，提出了一个新的攻击角度，并展示了其显著的效果。

title: A Text-to-SQL Benchmark for Official Statistics
summary: Official statistics are critical datasets for a wide variety of actors, including policymakers and businesses. For providers of official statistics, improving accessibility, governance, and disclosure of their data is of key importance. This can be improved by providing question-answering systems based on text-to-SQL approaches. However, existing text-to-SQL benchmarks do not resemble this setting. Official statistics are published as open-domain catalogs of thousands of wide tables whose columns and values are codes, and whose meaning is recorded in separate metadata rather than in a relational schema. To address this gap, we introduce LOCuST, a text-to-SQL benchmark that pairs over two thousand English and Dutch tables from Statistics Netherlands with a semantic knowledge graph. The graph describes the tables, measures, and dimension codes through labels, definitions, hierarchies, and units, and is the external knowledge a system needs to find the right tables and ground a question in the right codes. The benchmark includes expert-annotated questions for different query and aggregation types, including raw value retrieval, summations, proportion calculations, and joins. Alongside standard evaluation measures, we introduce an observation F1 metric that measures how close a query is to the ground truth even when the answers are different. We evaluate a variety of state-of-the-art LLMs and find that they struggle to write SQL that answers the questions correctly.

AI.tldr: LOCuST 是一个基准测试，旨在通过提供基于 Text-to-SQL 方法的问题回答系统来改进官方统计数据的可访问性、治理和披露。基准测试包括来自荷兰中央统计局的超过两千个英语和荷兰语表格，以及一个语义知识图谱，后者描述了表格、度量标准和维度代码的标签、定义、层次关系和单位。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试未能准确模拟官方统计数据的公开领域目录中的宽表。为了改进这一现状，引入了 LOCuST，该基准测试结合了来自荷兰中央统计局的大量表格和语义知识图谱，提供了一种问题与正确答案相对的数据库表知识表示方式。
AI.method: LOCuST 标准化的构建过程需要将多个英文和荷兰文的表格与语义知识图谱配对。基准测试将不同类型的查询和聚合问题与专家标注的语义解析相结合。
AI.result: 研究展示了不同类型的查询和聚合问题下的基准测试结果以及现有的先进 LLMs 的表现。研究发现，这些模型写 SQL 以正确回答问题的能力非常有限。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，在改进数据可访问性、治理及披露方面，LOCuST 基准测试可以提供重要的指导和验证。

title: DynaCue: Comparing Motion and Timing Between Groups of Videos
summary: A score that distinguishes videos with different temporal-consistency ratings can miss differences associated with motion preference. VideoScore's temporal consistency score distinguished higher- from lower-rated Pika videos in 95% of comparisons with 15 videos per group, yet could not detect the difference between preferred videos and their same-prompt alternatives in any of the 200 comparisons of 41 VideoGen-RewardBench pairs. We introduce DynaCue, a two-sample permutation test that combines complementary measurements of motion, frame continuity, and appearance to compare groups of videos without choosing a single cue in advance. DynaCue measures local changes in optical flow both before and after accounting for each clip's usual activity, captures interruptions through frame differences and freeze counts, and incorporates scores for motion and appearance. In controlled experiments, DynaCue detected group differences across five interventions affecting playback continuity, displacement, or rhythm. In real-world evaluations of generated videos where viewers rated temporal consistency or chose which of two videos they preferred for its motion, DynaCue detected group differences in at least 80% of resampled comparisons on each of the three datasets at the smaller sample sizes studied. Every other method evaluated on all three had a detection rate of 60% or less on at least one dataset.

AI.tldr: DynaCue 是一种结合运动、帧连续性和视觉特征的两样本排列测试，可以在不需要预先选择单一指标的情况下比较视频组。DynaCue 在检测视频组差异方面表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有评分体系可能忽略与运动偏好的差异，为了提高视频评价的准确性，研究引入了 DynaCue 方法。
AI.method: DynaCue 使用排列测试，结合了局部光流、帧差异和停止帧数量等测量指标，同时加入了运动和视觉得分。
AI.result: DynaCue 在五个影响播放连续性、位移或节奏的干预措施中均能检测到组间差异。在真实视频评价实验中，DynaCue 在三个数据集的小样本研究中至少80%的重新抽样比较中都能检测到组间差异。现有其他方法在至少一个数据集上的检测率不超过60%。
AI.conclusion: DynaCue 有能力更准确地比较视频组，优于现有其他方法，特别是在真实世界的视频评价中。

title: GeoSurge: Geometry-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning for Auditable Liver Resection Planning
summary: Surgical resection planning centers on generating executable resection surfaces from anatomical evidence and operative constraints. Medical multimodal foundation models enable anatomical understanding, and segmentation models predict resection regions, but neither translates these capabilities into explicitly constrained, executable resection surfaces. We present GeoSurge, an anatomy-grounded framework that combines mask-derived metrics with structure-aware point-cloud tokens to generate executable, editable resection surfaces. To make resection geometry learnable and editable, GeoSurge maps actions to parametric geometry through a surface-action grammar. Using this grammar, anatomy-oriented and tumor-centered templates generate candidates, which are filtered by hard constraints and semantic deduplication. Training supervision is then derived from candidate-expert geometric agreement and independently recomputed feasibility metrics. At inference, the reasoner uses patient evidence and surgical requirements to select or revise an action, which an independent geometry engine subsequently materializes and verifies. GeoSurge achieves the best overall scores on DeepTumour Liver and CRLM-QA, improving the constraint satisfaction rate from 73% to 100% on CRLM and from 56% to 99% on GeoSurge-Bench.

AI.tldr: GeoSurge 是一个以解剖学为基础的框架，它结合了掩码提取的度量和结构感知的点云标记来生成可执行和可编辑的切除非洲。
AI.motivation: 现有的医学多模态基础模型和分割模型虽然能理解解剖结构并预测切除区域，但无法将这些能力转化为受限制的可执行切除表面。GeoSurge 凭借其基于解剖学的方法，旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: GeoSurge 通过将动作映射到参数几何体来使切除几何结构可学习和可编辑。它使用解剖导向和肿瘤中心的模板生成候选方案，由硬约束和语义去重筛选。几何监督来自于候选专家几何的一致性和独立重新计算的可行性指标。
AI.result: 在 DeepTumour Liver 和 CRLM-QA 上，GeoSurge 达到了最佳的整体得分，在 CRLM 上约束满足率从 73% 提高到 100%，在 GeoSurge-Bench 上从 56% 提高到 99%。
AI.conclusion: GeoSurge 在手术切除规划中展示出了显著的改进，使其更加精确、可编辑且能满足更高的约束条件。

title: Learning Agent States for Latent Action Modeling
comment: 27 pages, 12 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://agent-state-lam.github.io
summary: Latent action models (LAMs) learn action-like latents from unlabeled video by coupling frame-pair inference with latent-conditioned prediction, enabling policy and world-model pretraining. However, what the latent must explain depends on the representation space used for action inference and transition prediction. When this space entangles the agent's evolving physical state with visual context, such as background and persistent agent appearance, inferred latents can encode information unrelated to the agent's actions. To address this challenge, we propose Agent-State LAM, which jointly learns a compact agent-state representation and latent actions modeling its transitions. The compact state aggregates dense visual features into a shared space for both action inference and forward prediction. To guide what this state retains, we introduce spatially matched temporal discrimination (SMTD), which trains the state to distinguish its source frame from nearby frames through spatially flexible matching with frozen local visual features. Rather than comparing global frame representations, SMTD scores each frame by emphasizing its strongest local feature matches across spatial locations. This scoring allows background and persistent agent appearance to remain matched across frames despite displacement, making these shared cues less informative for identifying the source frame and encouraging the representation to capture the agent's evolving physical state. Extensive experiments on distracting control tasks and six real robot video datasets demonstrate improved action recovery, downstream control, and world-model prediction. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Mid-Push/Agent-State-LAM.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个算法，称为Agent-State LAM，旨在从未标注视频中学习能解释代理物理状态的行为潜变量，通过一个紧凑的代理状态表示和SMTD方法提高了动作恢复、下游控制和世界模型预测的效果。
AI.motivation: 当前的LAMs方法可能会因为联合动作推理与状态转移预测的空间纠缠问题而导致潜变量无法精确反映代理的行为。为了克服这个问题，作者提出了Agent-State LAM以更准确地提取代理的行为潜变量。
AI.method: Agent-State LAM 通过将密集视觉特征聚集到共享空间中来学习一个紧凑的代理状态表示，并通过引入SMTD训练状态以区分其来源帧和附近的帧。SMTD强调每个帧的最佳局部特征匹配，从而让背景和持久的代理外观具有匹配性，虽然帧位置发生变化仍可识别，促使表示捕捉代理的演变物理状态。
AI.result: 在各种任务上的广泛实验表明，与传统的LAMs相比，Agent-State LAM在动作恢复、下游控制和世界模型预测方面表现出更好的性能。
AI.conclusion: 综上所述，该研究提出的方法能够更准确地学习并预测代理的动作，为未来的研究提供了有价值的参考和改进方向。

title: Economic World Model
summary: Can artificial intelligence reproduce the economic dynamics that emerge as households, firms and governments interact and adapt through markets and institutions? To answer this question, we define an economic world model (EWM) as an agent's internal representation of how an economic system works, enabling counterfactual simulation and decision-making under resource constraints. We then propose a general framework for studying EWMs that links three tasks: simulating agent behaviour, learning economic transitions and systematically evaluating the dynamics. As an initial implementation, we learn household policies from microeconomic data and calibrate a structural economic transition model using macroeconomic data, linking individual decisions to aggregate dynamics. Our micro-to-macro evaluation framework compares simulated individual actions and group distributions with observed microdata and assesses macroeconomic dynamics through forecasting and counterfactual experiments. Results show that simulated and observed household consumption distributions overlap by 94.9%, while EWM forecasts closely track real GDP and several other aggregate levels. In government-borrowing counterfactuals, the EWM reproduces the benchmark life-cycle model's short-run transmission from borrowing to consumption. For ex ante planning, the EWM enables an LLM agent to achieve 10.29% higher simulated GDP under the epidemic shock than direct LLM decisions. This initial EWM is only a starting point. We invite economists and AI researchers to build a stronger EWM together. Economists can contribute richer economic models and knowledge, while AI researchers can develop stronger data-driven methods for simulating agent behaviour and learning economic transitions. Together, we aim not only to reproduce real economic dynamics, but also to discover and test new mechanisms that support better decisions and benefit society.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过定义经济学世界模型(EWM)并提出一种框架来模拟代理行为、学习经济过渡和系统地评估动力学，结合微观经济与宏观经济数据，展示了EWM在预测实际GDP和消费分布方面有较高准确性。
AI.motivation: 探究人工智能是否能够模拟和预测由家庭、企业与政府在市场和制度下交互产生的经济动态。
AI.method: 定义EWM作为代理内部的经济系统模型，结合微观与宏观数据，通过学习代理行为、经济过渡及评估动力学来实施。
AI.result: EWM的模拟结果与实际观察结果高度一致，如消费品分布吻合度达94.9%；在政府借贷情景下，EWM再现了基准生命周期模型对借债到消费的影响；对疫情防控假设，EWM使LLM代理的模拟GDP提高10.29%。
AI.conclusion: EWM作为一种初步框架展示了其在经济预测方面的潜力，未来仍需经济学者和AI研究者共同努力以完善和发展EWM。

title: HuluOPD: Unifying Heterogeneous Medical Specialists into One Lightweight Model with Unlabeled Prompts
summary: Specialist medical vision-language models (VLMs) are strong within their specialties but hard to unify: their training data are often private, and independently developed specialists cannot be assumed to share an architecture. Deploying these large models separately is costly. We present HuluOPD, an on-policy distillation recipe that unifies heterogeneous specialists into one lightweight VLM using only unlabeled prompts, without requiring reference answers or the specialists' training data. The lightweight model answers each prompt, and the specialist of the prompt's modality supervises its response; a continuation-aligned cross-tokenizer loss makes this possible even when they differ in architecture and tokenizer. We apply HuluOPD to five specialists, for ultrasound, pathology, optical coherence tomography, fundus photography, and dental imaging. To distill and evaluate them, we build HuluOPDCorpus, 914k unlabeled prompts, and HuluOPDBench, 47k held-out test items, from over 90 public datasets, and score all models under one protocol on 132k test items, including third-party benchmarks. A single model with 10% of the five specialists' combined parameters retains 94% of their question-answering performance, and one with 2% retains 89%. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of unifying heterogeneous medical specialist VLMs without requiring their training data or a shared architecture.

AI.tldr: HuluOPD提出了一种策略，利用仅有的未标记提示统一不同领域医疗专业知识的语言-视觉模型，显著降低了部署成本，同时也展示了前所未有的无需共享架构和训练数据就能联合多医疗专业知识的轻量级模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的医学语言-视觉模型在各自的专业领域表现优异，但由于数据和模型架构的私有性，难以实现统一，阻碍了更广泛的应用。HuluOPD旨在解决这一问题，通过仅使用未标记提示来训练这些模型，降低了部署成本，同时也展示了无需共享架构和训练数据就能联合多医疗专业知识的轻量级模型。
AI.method: HuluOPD采用了一种在线策略蒸馏方法，利用未标记提示，无需参考答案或专业知识模型的训练数据。模型根据提示的模态由相应的专业知识模型进行监督，使用延续对齐的交叉标记损失来适应不同架构和标记器的专业知识模型。
AI.result: HuluOPD应用到五个领域：超声、病理学、光学相干断层扫描、眼底摄影和牙科成像。构建了HuluOPDCorpus，包含914,000个未标记提示；HuluOPDBench，包含47,000个保留测试项；并对超过90个公开数据集进行评价。单一模型使用五个专业知识模型参数的10%保持了94%的问答性能，而使用2%的参数则保持了89%的性能。
AI.conclusion: HuluOPD展示了通过仅使用未标记提示和在线策略蒸馏在不同医疗领域跨领域专业知识模型间实现知识整合的可能性，这为未来医学诊断和辅助决策提供了更加灵活和高效的模型基础。

title: CAPTA: Identifying LLMs Behind AI Agents
summary:
Large language model (LLM)-based agents access remote services through tools to complete user tasks, often via API calls. In this setting, a remote service may want to identify the backend LLM of an agent to launch model-specific attacks, including prompt injection or selective delivery of manipulated content. However, the service cannot directly query the backend model and must instead collect observable responses through its interactions with the agent, making identification challenging.
  In this paper, we present Completely Automated Preference Test to tell LLMs Apart (CAPTA), a model identification approach inspired by CAPTCHA (Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart), which distinguishes humans from automated programs. CAPTA presents multiple-choice questions as verification challenges, using differences in models' selection preferences to identify the backend LLM. It selects questions based on cross-model option-generation diversity and uses LLM-guided search to optimize their option sets. Our evaluation shows that CAPTA achieves 99.0% mean identification accuracy with only 10 questions across 25 LLMs from 10 model families. We further evaluate CAPTA with four widely used agents and seven representative LLMs, achieving 99.7% mean identification accuracy across all 28 agent-LLM combinations with 30 submitted answers.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为CAPTA的方法，用于通过多个选择题区分大语言模型。该方法基于不同模型在选项生成上的偏好差异，并通过LLM引导搜索优化选项集。评估结果表明，使用10个问题，该方法在25个不同模型家族中的25个模型上达到了99%的识别准确率。
AI.motivation: 为了防止远程服务对后端大语言模型发起特制的攻击，例如提示注入或有选择地传递篡改内容，研究团队提出了CAPTA方法，以鉴别出大语言模型。
AI.method: CAPTA方法使用多个选择题作为验证挑战，依据不同模型在选项生成上的偏好差异来识别后端大语言模型。它通过交叉模型选项生成多样性来挑选问题，并使用大语言模型引导搜索优化选项集。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，使用10个问题，CAPTA在25个大语言模型上的平均识别准确率为99%。进一步的评估表明，在使用30个提交的答案下，针对四种常用代理和七种代表性大语言模型的所有28种组合，平均识别准确率达到了99.7%。
AI.conclusion: CAPTA方法展示了高效率的后端大语言模型识别能力，能够在有限的问题数量下实现高度准确的辨别。

title: Beyond Before-and-After Images: Evaluating Temporal Grounding in a Lightweight VLM for Disaster Assessment
comment: 13 pages (4 main + references + supplementary), 4 figures, 14 tables. Accepted at the CV4EO Workshop, WACV 2027
summary: Bi-temporal satellite imagery is central to disaster assessment: deciding what was damaged requires comparing a pre-event scene with its post-event counterpart. A vision-language model (VLM) can nonetheless appear to answer change questions while relying mainly on the post-event image or on the prompt's temporal framing. We present a controlled diagnostic of temporal grounding and apply it to one lightweight VLM, InternVL3-2B, on DisasterM3: 1,659 optical and SAR image pairs from 41 events and nine disaster types, in event-disjoint partitions, with 9,031 reasoning questions. We compare post-only input, the true pre/post pair, the post image repeated twice, reversed image order, and an unrelated pre-event image. The true pair scores $+0.5$ accuracy points above the repeated-post control (95\% paired bootstrap CI $[-0.2, +1.2]$), and reversing the order changes accuracy by $-0.2$ points ($[-0.8, +0.5]$). Under this protocol we therefore find no measurable benefit from the content of the true pre-event image and little sensitivity to temporal order. The model is not blind to the first image, however: the true pair scores $2.5$ points above a pair whose pre-event image comes from another event ($[+1.6, +3.4]$). State-transition and multi-hop questions remain hard, and optical and SAR inputs show different profiles. We outline temporal scene graphs as a testable next step, not a validated solution, and argue that temporal benchmarks for Earth observation should report whether answers depend on the intended evidence, not only how often they are right.

AI.tldr: 研究通过控制实验评估了基于视觉-语言模型在灾难评估中的时间定位能力，发现模型对真实前事件图像的依赖度不高，但对事件相关性有明显偏好。
AI.motivation: 利用双时态卫星图像进行灾难评估是关键，但模型可能依赖于提示的时间框架而非前事件图像。
AI.method: 使用一个轻量级的视觉-语言模型InternVL3-2B，对1,659对光学和SAR图像，共9,031个推理问题进行了测试。
AI.result: 真实的前/后图像对比重复的后图像对多0.5个准确点，但按相反顺序显示图像则降低0.2个准确点。与来自另一个事件的前图像对相比，真实的前/后图像对多2.5个准确点。光学和SAR图像的输入表现出不同的模式。
AI.conclusion: 模型从真实前事件图像中获益有限，且对时间顺序敏感性较小，但对事件相关性表现出明显偏好，提出测试下一个步骤是通过时间场景图进行验证。

title: EviCraft: Can Minecraft Agents Find What They Cannot See?
summary: In Minecraft, a common testbed for embodied agents, semantic tools such as mineBlock pick targets from the simulator's loaded world state without a visibility test, so a buried ore the agent has never seen is one call away, and scores cannot show whether the agent searched. We formalize the missing requirement as evidence closure: every decision of an agent system, including those inside its tools, may depend on the world only through facts for which the agent holds evidence. EviCraft is a runtime and benchmark that enforces closure below the agent and makes the admission rule an experimental variable: a perception-grounded regime (G) admits only what is in line of sight or returned by the agent's own actions, and a loaded-state regime (L) reproduces standard tool stacks, with agents, tools, and worlds held fixed. On Survival, the regime effect exceeds the strongest agent's lead: under G, three mid-sized agents reach the diamond in 32%-40% of runs, against 76%-94% under L, and the strongest agent under G scores below each of them under L. In two models, removing only the line-of-sight test closes 93%-96% of the score gap, and loading state only inside tools recovers 70%-98%, so safeguards on observations and queries leave most of the leak open. In open-ended acquisition, the gain from L concentrates in items that depend on buried resources or mobs. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/AllenReder/EviCraft

AI.tldr: EviCraft 是一款运行时和基准测试，它通过确保智能体及其工具仅依赖可见信息或由智能体自身动作返回的信息来实现证据闭合。在 Minecraft 的生存模式测试中，这种做法显著改变了智能体的表现，特别是对于依赖埋藏资源或敌人的物品。
AI.motivation: 在 Minecraft 中，智能体的工具如 mineBlock 可以不经过视野测试直接选定目标，这使得智能体可能因为未见过的埋藏资源而表现不佳。EviCraft 的目的是通过引入证据闭合来提升智能体的表现，确保智能体的决策仅基于其拥有的证据，从而改变了标准工具栈对性能的影响。
AI.method: EviCraft 定义了感知导向（G）和加载状态（L）两种模式。感知导向模式只允许智能体和工具依赖视线范围内的信息或自身行为返回的信息；加载状态模式则复制了标准工具栈行为，保持智能体、工具和世界不变。该方法通过对比两种模式下的智能体表现，分析了不同观测和查询约束对智能体学习和决策的影响。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在生存模式下，感知导向模式下的智能体表现明显不如加载状态模式。而在开放获取模式中，采用加载状态模式的智能体对依赖埋藏资源或敌人的物品表现更好。移除视线范围测试可以减少93%-96%的分数差距，而仅加载工具的状态可以恢复70%-98%的损失。
AI.conclusion: EviCraft 模型强调了智能体决策过程中的透明度和可预测性，对于评估智能体的搜索和决策机制具有重要意义。通过改变智能体与环境互动的方式，EviCraft 可以揭示不同查询模式对智能体性能的影响。

title: View Management with Gaussian Placement and Opacity Regularization for Online 3DGS
summary: The realistic rendering of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has drawn interest from real-time applications that require maps to be built online. This led to coupling 3DGS with SLAM, providing camera poses and initial Gaussians for the map. However, the map is still optimized with designs inherited from conventional SLAM, which train only on keyframes selected for localization and regularize geometry with uncertain frontend depth. These designs overlook the model complexity of a 3DGS map: with millions of parameters but few views of each region, the map overfits to sparse inputs. Resolving this is challenging, as every view and Gaussian added to the map competes for the same real-time budget. We close this gap from both sides. To add views while keyframes preserve the structure of the map, we progressively admit non-keyframe images as mapping updates complete and allocate the limited updates across different groups of frames according to the supervision each group provides. To control the model complexity of the map, edge-guided initialization places new Gaussians where image detail requires them. To complement the uncertain frontend depth, Self-Referenced Opacity Regularization (SOR) uses accumulated rendering evidence, at no extra rendering cost, to suppress the opacity of Gaussians that persistently contribute in front of a map-derived surface reference. Together, these designs improve both the appearance and the geometry of online maps within the real-time budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）方法，通过逐步引入非关键帧图像、边引导初始化以及自参照透明度正则化（SOR）来优化地图的外观和几何结构，同时控制模型的复杂度，以适应实时预算。
AI.motivation: 当前3DGS方法在实时应用中存在模型复杂度过高、易过拟合于稀疏输入的问题，影响了地图的质量。
AI.method: 引入非关键帧图像更新、边引导初始化以及自参照透明度正则化（SOR）来优化3DGS模型。
AI.result: 该方法在保持地图结构的同时逐步添加视图，通过边引导的初始化方法合理定位新高斯分布，并使用SOR方法减少在已知表面参考前持久存在的高斯分布的透明度，从而优化了实时地图的外观和几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能改善在线构建地图的实时性能，同时保持较高的地图质量和几何准确性。

title: RubikSQL-HB: Agentic Text-to-SQL with Knowledge in the Loop
summary: Database agents need more than schema structure: business meanings, stored values and reference queries supply knowledge that becomes relevant at different points in reasoning. We introduce RubikSQL-HB, which exposes these materials through queryable, database-specific knowledge workspaces built on the HeavenBase platform. Its knowledge interface remains available as an agent constructs and investigates an answer. Candidate agents interleave knowledge access with SQL construction and execution; a downstream Judge can reuse the same interfaces to investigate disagreements. A two-stage example interface separates discovering a reference question from expanding its SQL. On a 500-question BIRD Mini-Dev evaluation, the full pipeline reaches 75.2% execution accuracy, against 71.2% for first-candidate selection and 70.4% for execution-majority voting, with a correct candidate available on 79.0% of questions. The raw-knowledge condition, which also regenerates candidates without the built workspace, is 3.0 points lower, and adjudication with tools and revision accounts for most of the gain over selection baselines. A recorded execution probe shows how continued investigation resolves a candidate disagreement. Separate archived runs show semantic revision recovering answers absent from their original candidate pools. A versioned development study further illustrates how recurring corrections become reusable execution checks. The system and results connect knowledge-interface design to agent decision quality: queryable knowledge supports the construction of useful alternatives, and evidence-aware adjudication connects those alternatives to a final answer. Keeping knowledge in the loop lets agents acquire relevant observations as their reasoning develops.

AI.tldr: RubikSQL-HB 通过一个由 HeavenBase 平台构建的可查询知识工作区，提供业务含义、存储值和查询引用，从而支持数据库代理的构建和验证过程。系统展示了如何将知识接口设计与代理决策质量关联，提高候选答案的准确性和最终答案的一致性。
AI.motivation: 数据库代理需要不止于模式结构的知识，例如业务含义、存储值和引用查询，这些在推理的不同阶段变得相关。RubikSQL-HB 的引入旨在通过为代理提供可查询的知识接口，解决这一问题。
AI.method: RubikSQL-HB 通过在一个由 HeavenBase 平台支持的可查询知识工作区中整合业务含义、存储值和引用查询，来提供额外的知识材料。代理可以与 SQL 查询和执行交错地访问这些知识。系统设计了两级界面，分别用于发现参考问题和扩展其 SQL。
AI.result: 在 BIRD Mini-Dev 测试集上的实验表明，RubikSQL-HB 系统能够达到 75.2% 的执行准确性，这比最初的候选答案选择（71.2%）和执行多数投票（70.4%）都要高。通过记录执行探针和版本化开发研究，还展示了知识接口对候选答案准确性和最终答案一致性的影响。同时，知识再生和调整工具显著提高了决策质量。
AI.conclusion: RubikSQL-HB 系统展示了如何将知识接口设计与代理决策质量联系起来，通过持续地整合知识并且让代理能够在推理过程中获取相关观察，从而支持构建有用的选择并将其连接到最终答案。这种设计有助于提高代理的决策质量和执行准确性。

title: Do Occupancy World Models Really Follow Actions?
summary: Occupancy world models predict future 3D scenes conditioned on ego actions, yet their predictions may not faithfully follow the specified trajectory under counterfactual actions. Because driving datasets provide sparse coverage of alternative trajectories for each scene, existing models learn the spatial effect of ego motion implicitly from observed scene--trajectory combinations, which may entangle action effects with scene--trajectory correlations. We propose ReCast, an ego-trajectory-guided transformer that grounds future prediction in action-induced geometric correspondence across ego-centric frames. ReCast decouples historical encoding from future decoding and aligns deformable interactions using relative ego transformations, while retaining flexibility for non-rigid scene evolution. We also introduce a counterfactual action-faithfulness benchmark covering in-distribution, tail, and out-of-distribution trajectories. On Occ3D-nuScenes, ReCast achieves competitive standard forecasting performance while improving counterfactual forecasting, with particularly clear gains under out-of-distribution trajectories.

AI.tldr: ReCast 提出了一种基于 ego 轨迹的 transformer 模型，用于预测未来 3D 场景。该模型通过结合动作引起的几何对应性来解耦历史编码和未来解码，从而提高在分布外场景下的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有模型通过观察场景-轨迹组合隐式地学习动作的空间效果，这可能会将动作效果与场景-轨迹相关性纠缠在一起。ReCast 通过引入基于 ego 轨迹的相对变换和空间对齐，来解耦动作效果和场景-轨迹相关性，从而提高预测的准确性。
AI.method: ReCast 使用了 transformer 结构，并结合了相对 ego 变换来解耦历史编码和未来解码，同时利用动作引起的几何对应性来解决场景变形问题，保证了非刚性场景演化的灵活性。
AI.result: 在 Occ3D-nuScenes 数据集上，ReCast 达到了与现有模型相当的标准预测性能，同时在反事实预测方面有所改进，尤其在分布外场景下的预测性能得到了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: ReCast 提供了一种新颖的方法来预测未来 3D 场景，成功地解除了动作效果对场景演化的影响，尤其是在处理复杂、非刚性场景变化方面表现更佳。

title: Learning World Models through Contrastive Identification of Actions
summary: Latent world models enable goal-directed planning from offline visual data, but prediction alone does not specify which action-related distinctions their representations should preserve. Inverse dynamics provides auxiliary supervision, yet squared-error action regression rewards additional information only through changes in the conditional action mean. We propose Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA), which identifies the executed action among alternatives sampled from a history-conditioned behavior proposal. Comparing actions plausible in the same context targets information supplied by the next latent beyond history. Under exact behavior matching, we show that CIA can reward action information that leaves optimal inverse-regression error unchanged, and verify this distinction through a controlled learning example. CIA achieves higher planner-averaged mean success than the base world model and a regression inverse-dynamics baseline across five visual control benchmarks, without modifying the planner.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为CIA的方法，通过对比策略执行的动作来识别动作信息，这种方法在五个视觉控制基准测试中提高了规划者的平均成功率，而无需修改规划器。
AI.motivation: 传统的 latent world 模型虽然能够从离线视觉数据中进行目标导向的计划，但仅预测不足以明确代表中需要保留的动作相关区别。本文通过引入一种新的方法 CIA 来解决这一问题。
AI.method: CIA 方法通过比较在相同上下文中可行的动作，来确定执行的动作，这有助于识别动作信息，方法基于对比学习。
AI.result: 在五个视觉控制基准测试中，CIA 方法在规划者的平均成功率为方面超过了基础的世界模型和回归逆动力学基线，即使不用修改规划器。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，CIA 方法在多个视觉控制任务中表现出了更高的性能，即使在不需要修改规划器的情况下也能够提升目标成功率。

title: BodyWeave: Native Body-Conditioned 3D Garment Generation
summary: Generating 3D garments for digital characters requires preserving a reference design while adapting the garment to the target body's shape and pose. Sewing-pattern methods can struggle to reproduce unfamiliar designs and fine details, while image-to-3D generators offer rich shape priors but typically lack explicit 3D body context. We present \textbf{BodyWeave}, a framework that unifies garment generation and fitting through native 3D body conditioning. Building on 3D generative priors, BodyWeave uses the body as a spatial reference throughout geometry generation: a \textbf{Global Body Adapter} guides garment placement and extent in the shared coordinate frame, while \textbf{Local Body Attention} guides surface refinement using nearby body geometry. A \textbf{Surface Penetration Loss} supervises decoded surfaces to reduce body intersections, and the resulting geometry conditions material synthesis to produce garments with physically based rendering attributes. To support learning across designs and wearers, we construct \textbf{GarmentWeave3D} with 293K aligned garment--body observations, including 114K same-design cross-body pairs. Evaluations on out-of-domain \textbf{Artist-Created Garments} demonstrate high geometric fidelity and low body penetration. Cross-body evaluations demonstrate accurate adaptation to new wearers with consistent garment--body spacing, while appearance comparisons show faithful fabric reproduction. Additional results and resources are available at https://gavin-jy.github.io/bodyweave-page/

AI.tldr: BodyWeave框架通过直接将3D身体作为几何生成的空间参考，实现了服装生成与调整的统一，在保持参考设计的同时适应目标身体的形状和姿态，具有高几何保真度和低身体穿透性。
AI.motivation: 为了在数字角色上生成3D服装时，既能保留参考设计，又能适应目标身体的形状和姿态，同时克服传统缝纫图案方法和图像到3D生成方法各自的缺点。
AI.method: BodyWeave框架首先使用全局身体适配器引导在共享坐标系中的服装放置和扩展; 然后使用局部身体注意力来利用附近的身体几何结构进行表面细化; 最后通过表面穿透损失监督解码表面以减少与身体的交集，并使生成的几何图形调节材料合成以产生具有基于物理渲染属性的服装。
AI.result: 在不同设计和佩戴者上的评估显示了高几何保真度和低身体穿透性。身体间的评估展示了对新佩戴者的准确适应，服装与身体之间间距保持一致，同时外观比较显示了面料的忠实再现。
AI.conclusion: BodyWeave框架提供了一种统一的3D服装生成和适应方法，通过直接将3D身体作为几何生成的参考，实现了丰富的形状先验和明确定义的3D身体上下文之间的结合，有望在数字角色设计中更真实地展示服装。

title: Accuracy of Noise Ceiling Estimators for Brain Scores
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 35 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables
summary: The internal activations of modern machine learning models align surprisingly well with the activities recorded in real brains. In the last five years, the alignment between encoding models and brain activities, often called brain scores, has steadily increased. Because brain recordings are noisy, there exists an upper bound to the brain scores that any model can achieve. This bound, called the noise ceiling, is crucial for two reasons: it determines whether further improvements in model performance are possible, and it enables meaningful comparisons of brain scores across benchmarks. The field has developed multiple approaches to estimate noise ceilings, but the statistical properties of existing estimators remain poorly understood, leaving it unclear in which experimental settings they provide reliable estimates. Here, we introduce a unified mathematical framework for brain recordings, use it to derive closed-form expressions for four commonly used noise ceiling estimators, and provide theoretical predictions for the behavior of each estimator. We validate the theoretical predictions with simulations that we compare to noise ceiling estimates in existing fMRI and EEG datasets. We find that the existing methods underestimate the true noise ceiling in different settings. We conclude with recommendations for best practice in different situations.

AI.tldr: 文章分析了现代机器学习模型内部激活与真实大脑活动之间的对齐情况，提出了一个新的统一数学框架来估算噪声天花板，并验证了当前方法在不同情况下的表现。
AI.motivation: 近年来，机器学习模型的激活模式与大脑活动之间的对齐程度不断提高，但噪声天花板的存在限制了这一对齐程度进一步提升，因此需要了解噪声天花板及其估算方法。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个新的统一数学框架来估算噪声天花板，然后对四种常用的噪声天花板估算器进行理论推导，并通过模拟和实际数据集的比较来验证这些建议的准确性。
AI.result: 模拟结果表明，当前的噪声天花板估算方法在多种背景下低估了真实噪声天花板。作者还根据实验情境提出了最佳实践建议。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为理解和改善机器学习模型和脑活动之间的对齐提供了新的理论工具，有助于促进跨研究领域的可比性和模型性能评估。

title: DeCo-Attention: Decompose to Compensate for Low-Precision Attention
summary: Self-attention over tens of thousands of tokens dominates the generation time of video diffusion transformers, because its cost grows quadratically with sequence length. The FP4 matrix products of modern GPUs can speed up attention, but the 4-bit rounding of the queries Q and the keys K introduces large errors. We show that the exponential in softmax amplifies the error of their product QK, which therefore dominates the attention error. We propose DeCo-Attention, a co-design of algorithm and system for low-precision attention. DeCo-Attention is training-free and compensates the rounding error of Q and K along a few principal directions found by a per-head eigendecomposition. The lightweight compensation terms are appended to Q and K as extra channels, so the FP4 matrix product corrects its own rounding error while it computes the attention scores. Once the products run in FP4, the softmax bounds the kernel, and we optimize the softmax so that the gain of FP4 computation translates into realized speedup. With QK in FP4, we implement DeCo-Attention with the rest of attention in FP8 on GB300 and VR200 and in FP4 on RTX PRO 6000. On Wan2.2, these kernels run 2.13x, 2.49x, and 2.82x faster than BF16 attention, and the whole generation runs 1.55x, 1.68x, and 1.80x faster. On four video generation models, the FP8 configuration achieves LPIPS comparable to prior 8-bit QK methods, and the fully FP4 configuration lower LPIPS than prior fully 4-bit kernels.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过提出DeCo-Attention，利用低精度计算和系统的协同设计，显著加速了视频扩散变换器中注意力机制的生成过程，同时保持了图像质量。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散变换器中，自注意力机制处理大量token时效率低下，尤其在高精度计算时，矩阵乘法的计算开销巨大。为此，研究提出了解决方案，通过改进低精度处理来优化注意力机制的效率。
AI.method: research proposed DeCo-Attention，一种算法和系统的协同设计方法，利用4位浮点数（FP4）进行矩阵乘法计算，并对查询（Q）和键（K）的四舍五入误差进行补偿，补偿时利用每个头的奇异值分解找到几个主方向。
AI.result: DeCo-Attention方法在GB300和VR200上分别比BF16注意力机制快2.13倍、2.49倍和2.82倍，在推理过程中整体制作速度分别提高了1.55倍、1.68倍和1.80倍。此外，FP8配置实现了与之前的8位QK方法相似的LPIPS，而全4位配置的LPIPS优于之前的完全4位核。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过显著优化低精度注意力机制的实现，实现了更快速、高效的视频生成过程，在保持图像质量的同时提高了整体性能。

title: Interactive Neural Computers
summary: Computers and their interfaces are usually treated as fixed, so a person, or increasingly an AI agent, must adapt to whatever the operating system presents. This is limiting when someone needs a different workflow, or an interface suited to hands-free use or a disability. We explore an overlooked alternative. Rather than training an agent to operate an existing computer, we train a generative model to be the computer, predicting each next screen from past screens and the user's mouse and keyboard actions. Treating a desktop as an interactive world model raises problems that natural-video world models largely avoid. Without a camera pose to index memory, the model must remember content that has left the screen without any geometric cues. Arithmetic in a terminal has to be exactly right, not merely plausible. Small interface text must also stay legible at interactive frame rates. Our Interactive Neural Computer is structured like a Neural Turing Machine and starts to address these problems with three modules trained end to end from pixels and actions. A surprise-gated slot memory, supervised by latent next-frame prediction (MEMORY-JEPA), stores what is off screen. An exploratory query bridge brings in the reasoning of a pretrained VLM, and a residual renderer predicts only the latent changes between frames. In long closed-loop rollouts, our model recalls occluded files in 64.2% of trials (chance is 33.3%), compared with at most 56.0% for recurrent and sliding-window baselines. It also raises terminal-text OCR accuracy from 1.3% to 50.1%. Finally, because the memory is explicit, it can be transplanted at test time to causally change what the model renders.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种使用生成模型作为计算机的方法，将桌面视为交互式世界模型。这种方法能够根据过去的屏幕和用户的鼠标、键盘行为预测下一张屏幕，特别适用于需要不同工作流程、手势操作或面对无障碍问题的场景。
AI.motivation: 现有的计算机及其界面通常是固定的，用户需要适应操作系统所呈现的内容，这在用户需要不同的工作流程或适应无手操作以及无障碍环境时显得限制性。而通过训练生成模型作为计算机，允许模型根据用户的过去屏幕和操作预测下一张屏幕，从而使得计算机更加易用和灵活。
AI.method: 研究团队开发了一种交互式神经计算机，该系统类似于神经图灵机，设计了三个模块：包含惊喜门控插槽记忆的模块memory-jepa、探索性查询桥以及残差渲染器。memory-jepa通过与潜在的下一张帧预测监督来存储屏幕之外的內容。探索性查询桥引入预训练的视觉语言模型来帮助推理，残差渲染器仅预测帧间的变化。
AI.result: 在长时间闭环的滚动测试中，该模型能够召回被遮挡的文件成功率达64.2%（仅33.3%的概率），这与循环和滑动窗口基线的最大成功率56.0%相比有了显著提升。另外，此方法也提高了终端文本的OCR准确性，从1.3%提高至50.1%。此外，由于内存是显式的，该模型在测试时可以在因果上改变其渲染的内容。
AI.conclusion: 此研究表明，通过训练生成模型成为计算机的方法，可有效解决用户在不同工作流程或无障碍环境中遇到的问题。这种方法不仅展示了更高的性能，也提供了更多的应用场景和灵活性。未来的研究可通过进一步优化模型，提升其处理复杂任务的能力，以更好地满足用户的多样性需求。

title: Instant LiDAR: Feed-Forward Gaussian Reconstruction for LiDAR Simulation
summary: LiDAR reconstruction supports closed-loop autonomous driving simulation, but hours of per-scene optimization make large asset libraries costly to build and maintain. We present Instant LiDAR, a feed-forward pipeline that reconstructs multiple LiDAR scans as reusable Gaussian assets in minutes without per-scene optimization. LiDAR measurements provide strong geometric priors, but directly initializing Gaussians from them yields poor reconstruction due to nonuniform sampling and a limited field of view. Sparse returns leave surface gaps, while combining scans expands coverage but introduces redundant primitives. To address these challenges, Instant LiDAR combines measurement-anchored Gaussian prediction, sampling-aware Gaussian scales, and multi-frame consolidation. The predictor refines attributes anchored to recorded returns, while the scales adapt spatial support to LiDAR sampling. Multi-frame consolidation merges overlapping predictions into a compact asset spanning the driving log. Compared with NuRec, Instant LiDAR reconstructs scenes approximately 46 times faster on Physical AI (PAI) and 70 times faster on Waymo. It also achieves comparable downstream 3D detection accuracy on Waymo.

AI.tldr: Instant LiDAR 提出了一种能够在几分钟内重建多个 LiDAR 扫描并生成可重复使用的高斯资产的前馈管道，无需场景优化。该方法通过结合基于测量的高斯预测、采样感知的高斯尺度和多帧合并来解决非均匀采样和有限视野带来的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 LiDAR 重建方法需要大量时间和计算资源进行场景优化，导致大规模资产库建设与维护成本较高。Instant LiDAR 的引入旨在克服这一挑战。
AI.method: Instant LiDAR 方法包括基于测量的高斯预测、采样感知的高斯尺度和多帧合并三个主要步骤。具体来说，首先根据 LiDAR 测量数据预测高斯参数；其次，根据 LiDAR 传感器的采样特性调整高斯尺度；最后，将来自不同帧的数据合并成一个紧凑的模型结构。
AI.result: 与 NuRec 方法相比，Instant LiDAR 在 PAI 和 Waymo 数据集上分别快了约 46 倍和 70 倍。尽管重建速度显著提高，其 3D 检测精度也与 NuRec 相媲美。
AI.conclusion: Instant LiDAR 提供了一种快速构建可重复使用的 LiDAR 资产库的方法，大幅减少了重建时间并保持了较高的检测精度。

title: Measurement Artifacts in Trustworthiness Evaluations of Quantized Small Language Models
summary: Evaluations of quantized language models attribute the change in a benchmark score to quantization. We write the measured change as the true change plus a term contributed by the instrument. Instrument error that is the same at every precision can shrink a paired comparison but cannot create or reverse an effect. Error that interacts with quantization can do both, and it is reported as an effect of quantization. We estimate this interaction for four measurement choices in 8 instruction-tuned models below two billion parameters, at float16, LLM.int8() and NF4, on identical items. Measured against labels from two human annotators, the 4-bit rise in harmful compliance is about half to two-thirds of the rise in non-refusal that a corrected key word detector records. Cloze and lettered multiple-choice scoring disagree about the effect of quantization far more than their noise allows: their estimates correlate at \r{ho} = 0.10, against a ceiling of about 0.77. LLM.int8() answers and generations depend on which items share a batch, and padding alone changes its answers. Rounding activations to 8 bits is enough to produce this dependence. NF4 is batch-invariant. The two largest reported calibration losses are response-bias shifts. We release item-level predictions, option scores and human annotations, and give recommendations for evaluating compressed small models.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了量化语言模型在不同精度下对基准分值的影响，并发现4位量化使有害合规性增加了约一半到三分之二，而不同的评分方法对量化效果的估计相关性很低。此外，LLM.int8()的批次依赖性和NF4的批次不变性值得注意。
AI.motivation: 量化语言模型在保持模型大小不变的情况下提升了模型精度，但这些模型在量化过程中的表现可能因量化精度的不同而有所差异。
AI.method: 研究者在8个参数量少于20亿的指令调优模型中选择了4种量化精度（float16、LLM.int8()、NF4）进行比较，通过人工标注的结果对模型进行评估。
AI.result: 研究发现4位量化会使有害合规性增加一半至三分之二，而不同评分方式对量化效果的估计相关性很低。LLM.int8()的表现因批次的不同而不同，而NF4则不受批次影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究建议在评估压缩小型模型时应小心量化方法的选择，并提供了一些建议。

title: SegPFN: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation with Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Networks
comment: 18 pages, including 8 pages of supplementary material
summary: In-context segmentation (ICS) uses one or a few annotated reference images to specify what to segment in a target image. Existing training-free ICS approaches typically rely on manually designed inference procedures, which may limit how flexibly reference information is combined. Learned in-context inference offers an adaptive alternative, but acquiring this capability through segmentation-specific training can compromise generalization to unseen domains. We therefore ask: can a pretrained in-context learner infer what to segment from annotated references without segmentation-specific training? We introduce SegPFN, a training-free framework that reformulates ICS as tabular classification over frozen visual features. A frozen tabular prior-data fitted network (PFN) uses labeled reference patches as context to classify patches in the target image. We comprehensively benchmark SegPFN against major existing ICS methods across 11 datasets spanning semantic, part, and personalized segmentation. SegPFN improves overall mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) by 4.7 points over the strongest overall baseline and achieves the highest average mIoU in four of five task-shot settings. Further analyses show that hard-negative reference patches improve fine-grained target discrimination, while joint conditioning enables SegPFN to use multiple references effectively. These results show that SegPFN offers a simple and effective paradigm for training-free in-context segmentation.

AI.tldr: SegPFN 提出了一种无需特定分割训练的框架，通过冻结视觉特征并使用标记的参考片段作为上下文来分类目标图像中的片段，从而在多种分割任务中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有训练免费的上下文分割方法通常依赖手动设计的推理过程，而 Learn-In-Context 方法虽然具有适应性，但可能会在未见领域中降低泛化能力。因此提出了 SegPFN，以验证是否可以在无需特定分割训练的情况下从标注的参考信息中推断出要分割的内容。
AI.method: SegPFN 利用了一个冻结的特征提取器（PFN），并通过对标记的参考片段进行训练来适应上下文分类任务。
AI.result: SegPFN 在多项基准测试中表现出色，尤其在多个任务和样本设置下的平均 mIoU 提升了 4.7 个百分点，并在四种五种任务样本设置中达到了最高的平均 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: SegPFN 提供了一种简单的无需特定分割训练的上下文分割方法，证明了该方法的有效性。

title: Lazy Agents Answer Against Their Own Beliefs: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs Teaches Them to Act on What They Believe
summary: AI agents working on long tasks often commit to an answer before they have enough evidence, a behavior called laziness. In our evaluations, they frequently commit even while their stated belief still names several possible answers. An outcome reward at the end of the episode scores only the final answer, so it cannot teach the agent when to commit, because a lucky guess receives the same reward as an answer backed by evidence. During training, however, the simulator can compute the exact posterior over the answer at every step and tell whether the evidence is already enough. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs (RLVB), which rewards the agent for taking further steps while this posterior still allows several answers and for committing once the evidence is sufficient. The reward needs no judge, critic or reward model, and it never reads the belief line the agent writes before each action. We also introduce Pro Worlds, a benchmark of visual puzzles where the agent views a large world through a small window. We evaluate three vision-language models on three benchmarks, two of which are never seen in training. RLVB improves the base model in all nine settings, by 17.1% on average. Under the outcome reward, GRPO and PPO fall below the base model on average. RLVB also outperforms PPO with a process reward from an LLM judge by 9.3% on average while using 1.6 times fewer GPU-hours. The trained agent answers with sufficient evidence in 51%, 12% and 74% of the episodes on the three benchmarks, against 8%, 0.4% and 36% for the base model. Its accuracy gain therefore comes from answering more often at high levels of evidence. The belief line shows how the agent reaches this evidence: it acts on its own belief. It commits at only 0.1 to 2.2% of the turns at which the evidence is insufficient and its line still names several answers, against 3 to 68% for the base model.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为RLVB的新方法，鼓励智能体在有足够证据时才做出决定，而不会过早做出决定。在Pro Worlds基准测试中，这种方法在所有九个设置中都提高了基模型的表现。
AI.motivation: 当前的奖励机制不能有效地教智能体何时做出决定，因为即使做出正确的猜测也会获得与有证据支持的答案相同的奖励。新的RLVB方法旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: RLVB通过计算每个步骤后潜在答案的后验概率，奖励智能体在有多种可能答案时继续探索，并在证据充分后才做出决定。这种方法不需要外部的评判者、批评者或奖励模型。
AI.result: 该方法在三种基准测试中均优于基模型，并在未见过的两种基准上取得了更好的表现。相较于使用过程奖励的PPO方法，RLVB方法不仅提升了性能，还减少了计算资源的使用。
AI.conclusion: 这表明了RLVB在提高智能体决策能力和计算效率方面的优越性。

title: SurgGenesis: A Generative Surgical World Model for Future-Aware Surgical Understanding
summary: Surgical scene understanding is constrained by data scarcity and long-tail class imbalance, as annotating surgical videos demands scarce clinical expertise while rare procedural events remain underrepresented. We tackle this through data generation and propose SurgGenesis, a generative surgical world model that learns future surgical state transitions in a latent space from visual observations and textual procedural descriptions, serving as a scalable surgical data engine. To adapt a large-scale video diffusion model to the data-scarce surgical domain without catastrophic forgetting, we introduce a three-stage progressive LoRA strategy that incrementally injects endoscopic visual priors, procedural semantics, and spatial motion cues. Rather than judging generation by visual fidelity alone, we validate SurgGenesis along two axes that separate a world model from a generic generator: (i) future-awareness, by comparing predicted futures against the real future through a GT-latent prediction gap and temporal-horizon analysis, and (ii) action-faithful usefulness, by checking that generated clips contain the commanded surgical triplet and that using them to rebalance long-tail events and drive downstream understanding (segmentation, triplet recognition, 3D reconstruction) yields action-specific gains. Conditioned futures therefore complement conventional long-tail sampling. Code: https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis

AI.tldr: 该研究通过提出SurgGenesis生成模型，利用视频扩散模型生成手术视频，解决手术视频数据稀缺和类别不平衡的问题。模型通过三个阶段逐步引入内窥镜视觉先验、程序语义和空间运动线索，验证模型通过未来意识和动作忠实有用性两个维度进行评估。
AI.motivation: 手术视频数据稀缺且类别不平衡，传统的数据标注成本高昂且难以覆盖所有情况。因此，通过生成模型创建数据以解决这些限制是非常必要的。
AI.method: 研究提出了一种基于生成模型的方法，包括SurgGenesis生成模型和一个用于手术视频生成的三阶段LoRA策略。SurgGenesis能够从视觉观察和文本程序描述中学习手术状态的未来转换，并应用到大量数据稀缺的手术领域。
AI.result: 研究成果证实了生成模型在手术视频未来预测和动作忠实性方面的有效性，能够显著改善长尾事件的重平衡并促进下游任务的理解。
AI.conclusion: SurgGenesis模型通过生成手术视频解决了数据稀缺问题，并为手术视频未来预测和动作忠实性提供了新方法。这种方法有望在医疗领域产生广泛影响。

title: InstructReplay: Replaying Assistant Turns to Preserve General Behavior During Factual Fine-Tuning
comment: Project page at https://xiaofengshi.github.io/InstructReplay/ and code at https://github.com/xiaofengShi/InstructReplay
summary: Fine-tuning an instruction-tuned language model on new facts often erodes its general abilities. We find that standard fine-tuning lowers instruction-following, reasoning and coding benchmarks by 35 points on average, and that these losses track a collapse in answer length: fine-tuned models at least halve their responses, and the further a response drifts from the initial model's length, the more often it fails. We propose InstructReplay: the initial model answers a set of general instructions once, and during fine-tuning the model is kept close to the initial model on these answers. Across three model families and two domains, InstructReplay reduces the average decline on five general benchmarks from 28.1 to 2.4 points and keeps answer length close to the initial model's, while learning the new facts as well as standard fine-tuning. It balances learning and retention better than seven adaptation methods in all six settings. Controlled comparisons attribute the gain to replaying the model's own answers to general instructions rather than to the form of the loss.

AI.tldr: InstructReplay通过让模型在指令上保持接近初始模型的表现，减少了细调过程中的泛化能力下降，同时保持了回答长度接近初始模型，从而在多个模型系列和领域中提高了泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 细调经过指令调整的语言模型时，通常会导致模型的泛化能力下降。为了克服这个问题，研究人员提出了InstructReplay方法。
AI.method: 在初始化模型回答一系列通用指令之后，将该模型用于细调过程。通过保持模型在这些答案上的表现接近初始模型，InstructReplay在多个设置中平衡了学习和保留。
AI.result: 研究显示，与标准细调方法相比，InstructReplay将五个通用基准的平均下降幅度从28.1降至2.4，同时保持了回答长度的稳定性。此外，它在所有六个条件下都优于七种适应方法。
AI.conclusion: InstructReplay方法通过重现模型自己的回答，有效减少了在细调过程中模型泛化能力的下降，提高了模型的泛化性能。

title: ARS-VLM: Visually Aligned Augmented Random Search for Vision-Language Models
summary: First-order reinforcement learning, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is widely used to post-train Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for multimodal reasoning. However, it incurs heavy memory and system overhead from backpropagation, optimizer states, and a reference model. Forward-only zeroth-order (ZO) methods, such as Evolution Strategies (ES) and its top-k variant Augmented Random Search (ARS), avoid these overheads via reward-guided weight perturbations, yet remain unexplored for VLM reasoning. We find that directly applying standard ES or vanilla ARS to VLMs suffers from two fundamental failure modes: (i) patch-grid overfitting, fitting fragile grid-specific visual token artifacts while ignoring spatial invariants, and (ii) catastrophic forgetting, degrading general perception and out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks due to unbounded high-rank parameter and policy drift. We propose ARS-VLM, a visually aligned Augmented Random Search framework for forward-only VLM post-training. First, ARS-VLM extracts a contrastive visual basis from bilinearly paired cross-grid views, concentrating perturbations on shared visual signals while suppressing patch-shift artifacts. Second, ARS-VLM anchors shallow visual-fusion layers with a soft subspace prior while freeing deep reasoning layers, restraining policy drift without a reference model. Third, ARS-VLM scores perturbations on paired views to discard view-fragile directions during top-k selection. We evaluate ARS-VLM on Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B on multimodal reasoning tasks. On 8B, ARS-VLM reaches 61.0% validation accuracy in 20 steps versus 150 for GRPO (7.5x fewer optimization steps) and avoids the late OOD collapse of vanilla ARS and ES. Moreover, ARS-VLM achieves 75.41% single-view micro accuracy across seven OOD vision reasoning benchmarks, compared with 75.31% for full-parameter GRPO, using forward-only post-training.

AI.tldr: 文章提出了一种名为ARS-VLM的前向仅优化框架，用于视觉语言模型的后训练。该框架通过优化视觉基础、约束策略漂移和评估共视图的扰动来解决视觉网格过拟合和灾难性遗忘问题，从而在多模态推理任务中达到高效的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的第一阶强化学习方法如GRPO虽然有效，但存在高昂的内存和系统开销。前向仅零阶方法如进化策略（ES）和其改进版增强随机搜索（ARS）虽然避免了这些开销，但尚未应用于视觉语言模型的推理。文章旨在解决标准ES或AR斯应用于VLM的两个固有问题，即视觉网格过拟合和灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 文章提出了一个名为ARS-VLM的框架，通过从双线性配对的跨网格视图中提取对比的视觉基底来集中优化对共享视觉信号的扰动，同时抑制视觉网格偏移；通过软子空间先验固定浅视觉融合层，而深度推理层自由的策略漂移使得不依赖参考模型；同时在top-k选择中评估共视图的扰动以丢弃视图脆弱的方向。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-4B和Qwen3-VL-8B上测试ARS-VLM，其在20步骤内达到了61.0%的验证准确度，比GRPO少7.5倍的优化步骤，且避免了ES和AR斯的晚期分布外（OOD）崩溃。进一步在七个分布外视觉推理基准测试中，ARS-VLM的单视图微准确度达到75.41%，接近全参数GRPO的75.31%。
AI.conclusion: 文章证明了ARS-VLM的有效性，在保持低开销的同时提高了视觉语言模型的泛化能力和分布外任务的表现，为前向仅优化方法在VLM中的应用提供了新的解决方案。

title: LoopDVR: Looped Transformer for Efficient Dense Visual Recognition
summary: We propose LoopDVR, a framework for converting pretrained Transformer-based dense visual recognition models into parameter-efficient looped networks. Rather than reducing the network width or depth directly, LoopDVR reuses Transformer blocks across layers in both the ViT backbone and Transformer decoder, reducing the number of parameters while retaining the original computational structure. However, naively sharing parameters can disrupt the distinct transformations learned at different depths. To address this challenge, we identify suitable sharing groups based on inter-layer representation dissimilarity and keep the final backbone block independent for multi-scale feature construction. We then initialize each shared backbone block with the pretrained weights of its group's terminal layer to better preserve the learned representations. An independent Loop Adapter at each layer further helps retain depth-specific transformations within shared blocks. Subsequently, we distill visual representations into the looped backbone and integrate it with a looped decoder for task-specific training. Experiments demonstrate that LoopDVR achieves the best accuracy--parameter trade-offs across dense recognition tasks. Compared with the reference models, it reduces parameters by approximately 28% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Notably, LoopDet-S achieves 50.9 box AP with only 7.0M parameters, highlighting its effectiveness in compact models.

AI.tldr: LoopDVR 是一种将预训练的Transformer密集视觉识别模型转换为参数高效的循环网络的框架。通过在ViT骨干网和解码器中重用Transformer块，减少参数数量同时保留原始计算结构。实验表明，LoopDVR 在密集识别任务中实现了最好的准确度-参数权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的密集视觉识别模型通常具有较大的参数量，这限制了模型在资源受限环境下的应用。因此，提出LoopDVR来减少模型参数数量，同时保持较高的识别准确度。
AI.method: LoopDVR框架通过重用Transformer块来减少参数数量，同时创新地解决了参数共享可能破坏不同深度学习得独特变换的问题。具体方法包括：基于层间表示差异识别合适的参数共享组，保持末端块独立以支持多尺度特征构建，并通过终端层的预训练权重初始化共享骨干块，以更好地保留学习到的特征表示。此外，每个层上的独立Loop Adapter辅助共享块保留深度特定的变换。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，LoopDVR框架在一系列密集识别任务中实现了最优的准确度-参数折衷。相比于参考模型，LoopDVR 减少了约28%的参数量，同时保持了竞争性的识别准确度。特别地，LoopDet-S仅使用7.0M参数就达到了50.9盒AP，展示了其在紧凑模型中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LoopDVR提供了一种有效减小密集视觉识别模型参数量的方法，同时保持了良好的识别性能，并在多个密集识别任务中进行了验证。该方法具有广泛的应用前景，特别是在需要高效率模型的场景中。

title: Reading Decisions Before Spans: Efficient Generative Verification
