summary: Satellite-based 3D reconstruction is limited by sparse observations and changes across acquisition dates. Existing methods use generative priors to recover missing visual detail, but ghosting, streaking, and blur persist in their Gaussian scenes. These artifacts become particularly apparent in low-elevation renderings. We introduce CityRecast to suppress these artifacts through Gaussian scene repair and supervision calibration. To correct the Gaussian distributions that produce these artifacts, we first use multi-angle warm-up to constrain their spatial extent. This reduces the initial ghosting carried into progressive refinement. Surface-guided replacement then continues to repair the Gaussian distribution while preserving existing appearance. To provide more reliable supervision for this process, observation calibration mitigates interference from multi-temporal observations. Joint refinement further reduces conflicts among generated views. Experiments on DFC2019 and IARPA demonstrate reduced artifacts in low-elevation renderings while maintaining satellite-view fidelity. Compared with Skyfall-GS, CityRecast reduces FID-CLIP by 25.3% on DFC2019 and 51.8% on IARPA. MUSIQ increases by 14.54 and 24.95 points, respectively.

AI.tldr: CityRecast 通过解决高斯分布和观测修正，减少了卫星基于3D重建中的低洼视角中的伪影现象，保持了卫星视角的真实性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法使用生成先验来恢复缺失的视觉细节，但仍然存在鬼影、拖尾和模糊。这些伪影在低仰角渲染中尤为明显，因此引入CityRecast来矫正这些问题。
AI.method: CityRecast 方法首先使用多角度预热来约束高斯分布在空间上的范围，减少初始鬼影，并通过表面导向替换持续进行高斯分布修复，同时保留已有外观。接下来，观测校正减轻多时态观测的干扰，提供更可靠的监督，实现视图的一致性增强。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比于Skyfall-GS，CityRecast 在低仰角渲染中减少伪影现象，同时保持卫星视角的真实性。具体地，在DFC2019 和 IARPA 上，CityRecast 将 FID-CLIP 分别降低了 25.3% 和 51.8%，并且 MUSIQ 分数分别增加了 14.54 和 24.95 分。
AI.conclusion: CityRecast 通过高斯场景的修复和观测的校正改进了卫星基于3D重建，显著减少了伪影并保持了真实视角，表现出良好效果。

title: MemHand: Memory-Enhanced World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos
summary: Recovering the continuous world-space motion of both hands from egocentric video is essential for applications such as human-to-robot policy transfer and augmented reality. Achieving this goes beyond reconstructing the hands from each individual frame, as the context that a frame needs is often spread over time, especially around occlusions or when a hand moves out of sight. Recent works have explored how to exploit temporal context, yet they mostly draw it from fixed-length windows. Such windows cannot guarantee that every frame has the context required to reconstruct the hands in world space with accurate poses and metric scale. To address this limitation, we introduce MemHand, a memory-enhanced framework for world-space hand motion reconstruction. MemHand maintains two complementary forms of memory. The Short-Term Event Memory keeps the context of the well-observed hand around each occlusion or out-of-sight event and supplies it to frames with weak or missing visual evidence. In addition, since the metric scale holds over the whole recording, the Long-Term Scale Memory retains the most reliable observations across the video as scale anchors within a bounded state. Across benchmarks featuring severe occlusions and frequent out-of-sight intervals, MemHand achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and generalizes well to unseen domains. Benefiting from the synergy of both memories, it cuts W-MPJPE by 57\% on ARCTIC and 70\% on HOT3D relative to StableHand, delivering continuous and metrically accurate world-space hand poses and trajectories. We will release our code and models at the project page: https://irmvlab.github.io/memhand.github.io

AI.tldr: MemHand 提出了一种新的记忆增强框架，用于从第一人称视频中重建双手在世界空间中的连续运动。该框架利用短时事件记忆和长时尺度记忆来处理遮挡和视线外的问题，从而在多种基准测试中的 W-MPJPE 指标上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的手部重建方法无法保证每个帧都有足够的遮挡前后的时间上下文，以在世界坐标系中精确重建手部姿势和尺度。MemHand 旨在通过引入记忆增强机制来解决这一问题，尤其是在处理严重遮挡和频繁视线外情况时。
AI.method: MemHand 使用两种互补的记忆形式来处理手部重建中的遮挡和视线外问题：短时事件记忆（保存手部在遮挡事件发生前后的时间上下文）和长期尺度记忆（保存视频中的可靠观察作为尺度锚点）。这两种记忆确保了在存在遮挡或视线外的情况下，手部重建的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在包含严重遮挡和频繁视线外情况的基准测试中，MemHand 在 ARCTIC 和 HOT3D 数据集上分别实现了 57% 和 70% 的 W-MPJPE 性能提升，精度显著优于 StableHand 等其他方法，能够连续且精确地重建手部在世界坐标系中的姿态和轨迹。
AI.conclusion: MemHand 通过结合短时事件记忆和长期尺度记忆，提高了在世界坐标系中重建双手运动的精度和稳健性，在多个复杂场景中取得了最先进的结果，并为相关领域的研究和应用提供了新的解决方案。

title: Simultaneously Boosting Efficiency and Capability for Linear Attention via Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification
summary: Self-attention's quadratic complexity constitutes a core bottleneck for Vision Transformers (ViTs). Existing efficiency-oriented optimizations, including softmax-based and linear attention (LA) variants, generally compromise model representational capacity, leading to inevitable performance degradation. We propose a novel linear attention which alleviates this efficiency-capability dilemma. For the first time, we embed an Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification (ACCAP) mechanism into the QKV projection of linear attention, which enables the model to retain high-dimensional feature information while performing computations with reduced channels. We further fuse a focused kernel function and a self-gating module into ACCAP to construct a lightweight linear attention module (ACCAP-LA). Our theoretical analysis shows that, compared to standard linear attention, ACCAP-LA reduces the attention module's parameter count by 79.17% and FLOPs by 77.5%. Extensive experiments demonstrate ACCAP-LA's effectiveness: when applied to ViT, it achieves 79.4% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K with only 5.8M parameters, and more notably, it boasts strong cross-architecture compatibility, boosting EfficientViT-b1 and PVT-T by 3.3% and 3.4% respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个新颖的线性注意力模块ACCAP-LA，它通过自适应通道压缩和激活净化机制结合聚焦内核和自门控模块，减轻了效率与表示能力之间的冲突，使得ViT在保持高精度的同时减少了参数量和计算量。
AI.motivation: 现有的视图变换器优化方法虽然提高了效率，但往往会牺牲模型的表现能力，导致性能下降。因此，旨在找到一种能够在保持模型表示能力的同时减少计算复杂度的机制是必要的。
AI.method: 提出了一个自适应通道压缩和激活净化机制（ACCAP），结合聚焦内核和自门控模块，形成一个轻量级的线性注意力模块（ACCAP-LA）。该模块通过减少参数和计算量来提高效率。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，与标准线性注意力相比，ACCAP-LA将注意力模块的参数数量减少了79.17%，FLOPs减少了77.5%。实验结果显示，ACCAP-LA能够提高ViT在ImageNet-1K上的Top-1精度至79.4%，并具有跨架构的兼容性，分别提升了EfficientViT-b1和PVT-T 3.3%和3.4%的性能。
AI.conclusion: ACCAP-LA通过减少参数量和计算量的有效机制，不仅提高了模型的效率，还保持了高精度，展示了其在多种架构中的广泛应用潜力。

title: 3D Tracking Any Point with Events and Frames
summary: Tracking a fast-moving point in 3D is prohibitive when RGB frames are blurred or too far apart to reveal its motion. Event cameras record brightness changes between frames, providing measurements inside these temporal gaps. We introduce TrackAnyMotion, which combines monocular RGB frames and events to track arbitrary points in 2D and 3D, including at times when no RGB frame is available. The motion expected for a static point, given scene geometry and camera motion, provides a reference for identifying independently moving objects. An independent-motion decoder combines geometric motion cues with event guidance and 2D tracks, feeding its predictions back into iterative 2D and 3D refinement. We also introduce HyperEvent, a synthetic RGB--Event dataset with high-frequency 3D trajectories, geometry, and independent-motion labels. At RGB frame timestamps on this benchmark, TrackAnyMotion reduces 3D and 2D endpoint errors by 70\% and 32\%, respectively.

AI.tldr: TrackAnyMotion 使用 RGB 图像和事件相机数据结合几何线索和独立运动解码器，即使在没有 RGB 帧的情况下也能追踪 2D 和 3D 中任意点的运动。在 HyperEvent 数据集上，3D 和 2D 端点误差分别减少了 70% 和 32%。
AI.motivation: 当前追踪方法在 RGB 图像模糊或帧间距离过大时无法有效追踪运动点，TrackAnyMotion 通过结合 RGB 信息和事件相机的数据，填补了这一空白，特别是在没有 RGB 帧的情况下。
AI.method: 该方法通过将静态点的预期几何运动作为参考，利用独立运动解码器结合几何线索和事件引导进行 2D 和 3D 的迭代优化。
AI.result: 在 HyperEvent 数据集上，TrackAnyMotion 的 3D 和 2D 端点误差分别减少了 70% 和 32%。
AI.conclusion: TrackAnyMotion 是一种创新的方法，通过结合 RGB 和事件相机的数据，即使在没有 RGB 帧的情况下也能有效追踪点的运动，显著提高了运动估计的准确性。

title: Biomechanically Grounded Prediction of Selective Motor Control and Clinical Outcomes from Infant Video
comment: Submitted as a full contributed paper to IEEE International Conference on Rehabilitation Robotics (ICORR) 2027
summary: Early identification of cerebral palsy (CP) relies on observational assessments of spontaneous infant movement, such as the General Movement Assessment (GMA) and the Baby Observational Selective Control AppRaisal (BabyOSCAR), which require trained raters and substantial scoring time. Existing automated approaches derive hand-engineered features from two-dimensional keypoints, which describe image-plane motion rather than the three-dimensional behavior of individual joints. We present Baby Biomechanical 3D Body (BB3D), an infant-adapted, biomechanical pipeline that estimates joint-angle trajectories from single-camera video. Against a multi-view markerless motion capture reference in 17 infants, BB3D's median Procrustes-aligned error was 17.5~mm for joint centers and 20.4~mm for marker sites. A spatio-temporal transformer, pretrained on BB3D joint-angle trajectories from 1k+ single-camera recordings, and fine-tuned on 550 videos from 350 infants, predicted each individual BabyOSCAR item with a mean within-site AUC of 0.79 and the BabyOSCAR total with a Spearman correlation of 0.86 on held-out recordings. Without being trained on diagnosis, the predicted total separated infants with CP from those without CP with an AUC of 0.86, exceeding a replicated two-dimensional feature classifier (0.67) but below the expert clinician rater's total (0.97). Predicted scores also carried information about functional ability and body distribution, though less than expert clinician scores. These results show that biomechanically grounded representations of monocular video can support scalable, joint-level assessment of selective motor control in infancy

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为BB3D的婴儿适应于生物力学的管道，可以从单相机视频中估计关节角度轨迹，与多视图无标记动作捕捉参考的误差较小。使用预训练并在同一数据集上微调的时空变换器能较好地预测婴BabOSCAR项目和总分，没有训练诊断信息也能区分CP患儿和非CP患儿。
AI.motivation: 现有的脑瘫早期识别方法通常需要有经验的评分员和大量的时间，而本文希望提出一种新的方法，即BB3D，可以自动识别婴儿动作，以减少人工评分的需求。
AI.method: 该方法利用单相机视频来估计关节角度轨迹，并使用了预训练的时空变压器模型，该模型在BB3D的关节角度路径上进行了微调。
AI.result: 该方法在与多视图无标记动作捕捉参考17名婴儿的数据上，其关节中心的中位数Procrustes对齐误差为17.5毫米，标记点的误差为20.4毫米。模型在预测每个婴儿的BabyOSCAR项目和总分方面表现良好，AUC和Spearman相关系数分别为0.79和0.86。不依赖诊断数据，预测的总分能够区分CP患儿与非CP患儿，AUC为0.86，超过了基于两个维度特征的分类器（0.67），但低于专家评分者的总分（0.97）。预测分数还包含有关功能性能力和身体分布的信息，但不如专家得分。
AI.conclusion: 这种基于单相机视频的生物力学表示方法能够支持婴儿选择性运动控制的大规模、关节级别的评估，进而有助于脑瘫的早期识别。

title: DualSpec: Spectral Reconstruction with Optimized Stereo Cameras
summary: Spectral imaging captures information that ordinary RGB sensors cannot, but dedicated spectral cameras can be expensive and bulky. Recovering dense spectra from RGB images offers an accessible alternative, but distinct spectra can produce the same camera response, generating an ambiguity that even more advanced recovery algorithms cannot always resolve. Therefore, increasing the spectral information captured at acquisition is essential. We propose DualSpec, a stereo acquisition framework that jointly optimizes two external optical filters and a reconstruction network. Each filter is placed in front of a standard RGB camera, and the two are designed to produce six responses that provide complementary information for the network. Experiments across reconstruction architectures and spectral ranges show that DualSpec reduces mean spectral angle error by 36-72% relative to a single RGB camera and by 11-29% relative to stereo pairs selected from commercial filters. Cross-dataset evaluations, including a new benchmark of spectral images captured from displaced viewpoints, show that the method generalizes and remains robust to viewpoint misalignment, while analyses of thin-film approximations support optical feasibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DualSpec的立体采集框架，旨在优化两个外部光学滤光片和一个重建网络，通过使用两个滤光片在前方的标准RGB相机产生六个互补响应，从而提高捕获的光谱信息量，实验结果表明，这种方法在减轻光谱角度误差方面表现出色，特别是在使用单个RGB相机和从商业滤光片中选择的立体对时。
AI.motivation: 传统的RGB传感器无法提供丰富的光谱信息，而专业的光谱相机则成本高昂且体积较大。因此，从RGB图像中恢复密集的光谱信息成为了一个有吸引力的替代方案，但不同光谱可能会导致相同的相机响应，这会引入歧义。尽管更高级的恢复算法可以缓解这一问题，但完全解决问题仍具有挑战性。因此，提高采集时的光谱信息量至关重要。
AI.method: 提出的DualSpec框架通过联合优化两个外部光学滤光片和一个重建网络，解决了上述问题。两个滤光片分别放置在一个标准RGB相机前，设计目的是产生六个互补的响应，这些响应提供了网络所需的额外信息。
AI.result: 通过实验，该方法在减轻光谱角度误差方面表现出显著的优越性，与单个RGB相机相比，误差降低了36-72%；与商业滤光片中选择的立体对相比，误差降低了11-29%。此外，在不同重建架构和光谱范围上的评估结果表明，该方法具有良好的泛化能力和鲁棒性，即使在不同视角采集的数据集上也保持了有效性。
AI.conclusion: DualSpec框架为提高光谱信息的捕获提供了新思路，并展示了其在减轻光谱角度误差和提高光谱信息恢复性能方面的实际应用潜力。

title: Label leakage through file headers: geometry and batch confounds in public mammography datasets, and a pre-training acceptance gate
comment: 27 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Under review at DMLR. Code and derived tables: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24372683
summary: A dataset whose diagnostic label can be recovered from non-diagnostic information yields high, reproducible and uninformative model performance. We applied pre-training controls that see only image geometry, global texture, a sub-collection identifier or one covariate to six public mammography datasets, against a stop threshold of AUC 0.60. In KAU-BCMD, geometry alone predicted the BI-RADS class at AUC 1.0000 in a local copy and at a mean of 0.979 in a public Kaggle archive; after resizing, texture alone gave 0.847. In CMMD, the sub-collection prefix predicted malignancy at 0.7753; the restricted sub-collection passed geometry (0.5000) and texture (0.5810) but failed an identifier-order control added post hoc (test AUC 0.9926). CBIS-DDSM exceeded the stop on geometry (pooled mean 0.654 over 20 splits), a verdict statistic chosen post hoc; its official mass and calcification splits did not. M-SYNTH, INbreast and a partial VinDr-Mammo copy passed the few controls run. We release the code and derived tables. There is no quantum component in the inference path.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，仅从图像几何形状或全局纹理等非诊断信息中，就能获得高且可复现但无信息性的模型性能。研究在六个公共乳腺X光成像数据集中进行了预训练控制，结果显示了几何形状和纹理对诊断标签的显著预测能力。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在通过仅利用非诊断性的图像信息来检验模型性能，从而揭示深度学习模型在乳腺影像诊断中可能存在的非必要依赖。
AI.method: 研究人员在六个公共乳腺X光成像数据集（KAU-BCMD、CMMD、CBIS-DDSM、M-SYNTH、INbreast和VinDr-Mammo的部分数据集）中应用了预训练控制，其中包括仅暴露图像几何形状、全局纹理、子集标识符或一个协变量等信息，直至AUC（ receiver operating characteristic area under the curve）达到0.60的停止阈值。
AI.result: 结果显示，在某些数据集中，仅图像几何形状就能准确预测BI-RADS分类（1.0000和0.979），而仅纹理就能预测0.847；在CMMD数据集中，子集前缀能有效地预测恶性和0.7753的AUC；CBIS-DDSM数据集中的几何形状超过停止阈值，而其官方的密度和钙化分组未达到标准。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论认为，对于某些乳腺影像数据集，模型的高AUC可能源于非诊断性的图像特征，而不仅仅是病理信息。这提示在模型训练中需要警惕避免不必要的特征依赖，确保模型的有效性和泛化能力。

title: IMPACT-Seg: Consistent Anatomical Segmentation and Representation Learning Across CT, CBCT, and MRI
summary:
Computed tomography (CT), cone-beam CT (CBCT), and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provide complementary representations of the same underlying anatomy, yet substantial differences in image appearance challenge consistent segmentation and deformable registration in adaptive radiotherapy. We investigate whether dense anatomical segmentation supervision can promote cross-modality correspondence without explicit feature alignment. We introduce IMPACT-Seg, which segments 126 structures across CT, CBCT, and MRI using shared network parameters. A collection of 8,290 volumes was assembled from public cohorts through label harmonization, model-assisted pseudo-label completion, iterative refinement, and 2,864 physics-based CBCT simulations with voxel-aligned CT labels. Unpaired images were used to jointly train 2.5D and 3D residual-encoder networks.
  On 139 real CBCTs, IMPACT-Seg 3D achieved a mean Dice of 0.842 versus 0.671 for the strongest comparator. On 497 voxel-aligned CT-simulated-CBCT pairs, the CT-to-CBCT Dice decrease was 0.022 versus 0.153-0.178 for competing methods. On independent pancreatic radiotherapy CBCTs, gastrointestinal Dice was 0.735 versus 0.634 for TotalSegmentator. Prediction agreement reached 0.881 on registered CT-CBCT and 0.790 on CT-MRI pairs. Adding MRI training data reduced CT-MRI encoder feature retrieval error from 36.8 to 3.2 mm. Registration pipelines incorporating IMPACT-Seg features ranked first on two multimodal Learn2Reg benchmarks. The 3D model segmented a whole-body CT in 15 s.
  These findings show that dense anatomical segmentation supervision can support consistent anatomical representations across modalities, with applications to both segmentation and registration. Code, datasets, and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/HEMONCedric/IMPACTSeg.

AI.tldr: IMPACT-Seg 通过密集解剖分割监督，能够促进跨模态的一致表示，无需显式的特征对齐，在多种模态间实现了高质量的分割和注释，提高了注册结果.
AI.motivation: 目前CT、CBCT和MRI虽然提供了互补的解剖信息，但由于图像外观差异，容易造成分割和变形匹配的不一致，特别是在适形放射治疗中，因此需要找到一种方法促进这些模态之间的跨模态一致性。
AI.method: 该研究使用IMPACT-Seg网络进行跨模态分割，从不同模态中共同学习参数，进行2.5D和3D残差编码器网络的联合训练，并利用公共部分群体和基于物理的CBCT模拟验证了方法的有效性。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，3D模型在真实CBCT和CT仿真CBCT上的分割表现显著优于现有技术，同时在独立胰腺放疗CBCT上的胃肠分割Dice值也优于TotalSegmentator。此外，通过增加MRI训练数据，CT-MRI编码特征检索误差显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 研究确认了密集的解剖分割监督支持在各个模态间的一致解剖表示，对分割和配准都有重要应用。

title: HARI4D: Hand-Articulation Aware 4D Reconstruction of Human-Object Interaction
summary: Reasoning about human-object interaction from RGB cameras is important for gaming, VR environments, and robot learning. Yet 4D reconstruction from a monocular RGB camera is challenging, especially when articulated hands are involved. Prior full-body works neglect hands during reconstruction, causing them to penetrate into, or float from the object. We present HARI4D, a hand-articulation-aware method for reconstructing spatially and temporally consistent 4D human-object interaction from monocular RGB video. We introduce a history-aware object tracker that provides robust and stable tracking. Based on these tracks, we improve the interaction configuration through coarse-to-fine reasoning that follows the order of object manipulation: ReachNet first brings the full body and arms to the object during contact, and TouchNet then finalizes hand articulation according to temporal context and local object geometry. On ARCTIC, unseen in training, our method reduces the object error by 56% and improves hand contact F1 from 0.866 to 0.921 over prior art. Our method recovers accurate full body-object interaction with coherent hand articulations and applies to online videos. Our code and pretrained models will be released.

AI.tldr: HARI4D通过引入历史感知物体追踪和精细推理算法，有效解决了单目RGB摄像机下人体与物体4D交互的重建问题，特别是在处理手部动作的连贯性方面。在ARCTIC数据集上的实验证明，该方法显著提高了物体交互的准确性和手部接触的F1分数。
AI.motivation: 由于4D重建从单目RGB摄像机非常具有挑战性，特别是在物体上存在运动的手时。现有的方法往往忽略了手部的重建，导致手部部分与其他物体发生穿插或分离的情况。因此，提出了一种新的解决策略HARI4D来解决这个问题。
AI.method: HARI4D通过引入历史感知的物体追踪方法，为人体和物体间的4D交互提供稳定且持久的跟踪。基于这些追踪，利用粗到细的推理算法根据物体操作的先后顺序提升手部姿势的连续性。
AI.result: 在ARCTIC数据集上，与前人的方法相比，HARI4D显著降低了物体误差（减少56%）并且提升了手部接触的F1分数（0.866提升至0.921）。方法恢复了准确的全身体与物体交互，且手部动作连贯。
AI.conclusion: HARI4D方法在处理单目RGB摄像机下的4D人体与物体交互重建方面表现出色，特别是在手部动作的连贯性重建上取得了重要进展。该研究成果有望应用于增强现实、虚拟现实环境以及机器人学习中。

title: ProX-MAD: Aggregating Spatial Context into Representative Proxies for Few-shot Medical Anomaly Detection
summary: Few-shot medical anomaly detection (MAD) has largely followed a dataset-specific "one-for-one" paradigm, leaving unified "one-for-many" modeling underexplored. Naively extending existing methods to this setting causes substantial performance degradation, especially at the pixel level. We attribute this to their detection mechanisms: a shared decision boundary becomes unreliable across heterogeneous lesion definitions, whereas a normal-only memory bank cannot adequately cover diverse normal distributions with few references. We propose ProX-MAD, a proxy-based framework that aggregates spatial context into compact, learnable, state-specific proxies for unified few-shot MAD. Its Masked Proxy Infusion Attention (MPIA) module cross-attends proxy tokens to reference patch features and applies proxy-wise masking to retain high-confidence correspondences, mitigating proxy collapse and encouraging diverse proxies that summarize both normal and abnormal references. Across six medical datasets, ProX-MAD exhibits only a marginal performance drop from one-for-one to one-for-many training. Despite being trained only once as a unified model, it also outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods on average even when they use their more favorable one-for-one protocol, demonstrating the practicality of unified multi-dataset MAD.

AI.tldr: ProX-MAD 提出了一种代理为基础的框架，用于统一的少样本医学异常检测，通过代理掩码注意力模块（MPIA）整合空间上下文，得到紧凑的学习状态特定代理，从而在六种医学数据集上实现了良好的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的少样本医学异常检测方法大多针对特定数据集，而未充分利用统一的多数据集模型。这导致在像素级别性能显著下降。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于代理的框架，包含Masked Proxy Infusion Attention（MPIA）模块，该模块能够跨注意代理令牌和参考补丁特征，并通过代理掩码保持高置信度对应关系，防止代理的崩溃并鼓励多样化的代理。
AI.result: 在六个医学数据集上，ProX-MAD 的性能在统一少样本和单数据集模式之间仅有轻微下降。即使训练一次作为统一模型，它仍然优于前最先进的方法，特别是在单数据集模式下。
AI.conclusion: ProX-MAD 框架展示了统一的多数据集少样本医学异常检测方法的实际可行性。

title: OmniHarness-RSI: Modality-Aware Harness Evolution for Omnimodal Understanding
summary: Recent advances in harness-based recursive self-improvement (RSI) have improved video understanding by evolving executable agent workflows without updating foundation model parameters. However, extending this paradigm to omnimodal understanding remains challenging, as the heterogeneous and interdependent nature of multimodal perception and reasoning creates a complex evolution space, making targeted harness optimization difficult. To address these challenges, we propose OmniHarness-RSI, a modality-aware framework for evolving agent harnesses. Specifically, we factorize the evolution space into three capability dimensions: modality routing and collaboration, modality-aware evidence localization, and modality-specific perception. Based on this factorization, we construct a Factorized-Harness Agent integrating specialized perception experts and audio-video retrieval tools. We further introduce modality-guided harness evolution, which identifies deficiencies through structured modality-capability attribution and refines corresponding harness strategies through interactive code revisions and execution feedback. Validation-guided selection and held-out evaluation assess generalization within and across datasets. Experiments on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, and OmniVideoBench demonstrate test accuracy improvements of 8.86, 8.13, and 6.23 percentage points, respectively, consistently outperforming modality-agnostic RSI. The evolved harnesses also demonstrate cross-dataset transfer without adaptation, while reducing planner calls and viewed frames.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的跨模态理解框架OmniHarness-RSI，通过分解进化空间为三个维度：模态路由协作、模态感知和模态特定感知，结合专门的感知专家和音频-视频检索工具，通过目标导向的进化策略提升了跨模态理解的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的RSI方法在跨模态理解上存在挑战，因为多模态感知和推理的异构性和相互依赖性导致了复杂的空间优化。因此，开发了OmniHarness-RSI来解决这个问题。
AI.method: 文中构建了一个模态感知框架，通过将进化空间分解为模态路由协作、模态感知和模态特定感知三个维度，并结合专有的感知专家与音频-视频检索工具，提出了模态导向的框架进化策略，经过反馈修改并验证。
AI.result: 在WorldSense、Daily-Omni和OmniVideoBench基准实验中，与模态无关的RSI方法相比，该方法分别在测试准确率上提高了8.86、8.13和6.23个百分点。此外，进化后的框架在跨数据集上表现出良好的迁移性，减少了规划者调用和查看的帧数。
AI.conclusion: OmniHarness-RSI框架通过改进多模态理解中的特定感知和协作，证明了显著的性能提升，并展示了跨数据集的有效迁移。

title: FedTumor-IoMT: Federated Learning-Aided Brain Tumor Diagnosis on Resource-Constrained Edge IoMT Devices
summary: Joint brain tumor segmentation and classification models are computationally intensive, limiting their training on resource-constrained edge platforms and restricting privacy-preserving Federated Learning FL in the Internet of Medical Things IoMT. Existing approaches either perform both tasks on GPU-equipped workstations or support only classification on edge devices. To address this gap, this work proposes a lightweight multitask FL framework for joint segmentation and classification through local edge training. A shared pretrained LiteMedSAM encoder with TinyViT extracts features for a coordinate-attention-based segmentation decoder and a segmentation-guided classification head, eliminating a separate feature extractor. Selective encoder freezing retains 95\% trainable parameters while reducing on-device training costs. The proposed framework is experimentally validated on a laboratory testbed of five resource-constrained edge clients using 1,200 T1-weighted MRI samples. It achieves 94.20\% classification accuracy, 88.53\% DSC, 83.68\% IoU, and 99.87\% ROC-AUC. Its classification accuracy remains within 0.6\% of the GPU-trained baseline of 95.21\% across five FL rounds. The attention and feature refinement modules improve DSC and IoU by 3.82\% and 4.60\%, respectively, with 0.74 GFLOPs of additional computation. On edge hardware, the framework achieves 46.54 s inference latency, 52.8\% CPU utilization, and a peak temperature of 65$^\circ$C without thermal throttling. Its inference latency is observed to be 6.4--10.5 times lower than that of existing frameworks. These results demonstrate the feasibility of privacy-preserving joint brain tumor segmentation and classification on resource-constrained edge platforms.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种轻量级的多任务联邦学习框架，用于资源受限边缘设备上的脑肿瘤联合分割和分类。通过利用共享预训练的LiteMedSAM编码器和TinyViT，该框架实现了高效的局部边缘训练。实验结果表明，该框架在资源受限的边缘设备上的分类准确率达到94.20%，DSC 88.53%，IoU 83.68%，ROC-AUC 99.87%，同时在边缘硬件上的推理延迟比现有框架低6.4-10.5倍。
AI.motivation: 目前，用于脑肿瘤联合分割和分类的联邦学习模型在边缘设备上的训练和推断成本较高，且难以保护患者隐私。为了解决这一问题，作者提出了一种新的框架，能够在资源受限的边缘设备上高效执行任务。
AI.method: 该框架采用共享的LiteMedSAM编码器与TinyViT相结合的方式，提取特征并进行分割和分类任务。利用坐标注意力机制和分割引导的分类头，减少了单独特征提取的需要。同时，通过选择性冻结编码器参数，保留了95%的可训练参数，降低了设备上的训练成本。
AI.result: 该框架在实验室测试平台上，使用1,200个T1加权MRI样本进行实验验证，分类准确率为94.20%，DSC为88.53%，IoU为83.68%，ROC-AUC为99.87%。与GPU训练的基线相比，分类准确度仅下降0.6%。此外，通过引入注意力和特征精炼模块，DSC和IoU分别提高了3.82%和4.60%，额外计算量为0.74 GFLOPs。在边缘硬件上，推理延迟为46.54秒，CPU利用率52.8%，最大温度65°C，无需热限制。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的方法为在资源受限的边缘平台上进行隐私保护的脑肿瘤联合分割和分类提供了可行性，并显著提高了设备上的计算效率和推理性能。

title: VidForce: Predicting Force-Aware Articulation by Observing Humans
summary: People can anticipate how an object moves and the effort an interaction may require by watching others. How can embodied agents acquire this understanding from video? Force measurements provide direct sensory supervision, but require specialized equipment and remain limited in quantity. We introduce VidForce, which estimates an interaction trajectory together with a force profile from a third-person RGB video; 2D contact clicks and textual object-action prompts are optional. Our approach makes limited instrumented measurements useful for interpreting human interactions through learned physical prototypes as a prior. The prototypes share learned force levels and temporal profiles across interactions of comparable effort, with visual and semantic cues determining their contribution to each observation. Geometric and vision-language features adapt this prior to the observed interaction, while a joint conditional flow refines an initial tracked trajectory together with the force profile. Paired human and instrumented-gripper recordings provide measured force references for supervising human video, and a separately trained torque model demonstrates that the formulation extends to other sensory quantities. We evaluate trajectory recovery and force estimation through baseline comparisons and controlled ablations on held-out interactions from the Hoi! dataset. On this evaluation subset, VidForce achieves 6.6 cm ATE, peak-force MAE and RMSE of 4.81 N and 5.92 N, respectively, and force-profile RMSE of 5.52 N. On real-world videos, VidForce infers motion and force reliably and consistently despite the variability in human execution. We further deploy VidForce on a Spot robot, where trajectories and force profiles estimated from human demonstrations drive real-world articulated-object manipulation, and report success rates across repeated trials. Project page: https://rafaymhddn.github.io/vidforce

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为VidForce的方法，可以通过观看第三方的RGB视频来估算交互运动轨迹和力廓线，无需专门设备，仅需2D接触点击和文本对象动作提示作为可选监督，借助学习到的物理原型先验，使有限的仪器测量有助于解释人类交互。
AI.motivation: 人们可以通过观察他人如何移动物体和估计互动所需的努力。为了使具备物理原型推理能力的体形代理能够理解这一现象，人们希望有一种方法可以从视频中学习并估算互动运动轨迹和力廓线，无需昂贵的专用设备。
AI.method: VidForce方法主要利用第三方RGB视频来估计交互轨迹与力廓线。方法引入了学习到的物理原型先验，使得有限的仪器测量变得有用。借助几何和视觉-语言特征，该先验得以适应于给定的交互，而一个联合条件流则进一步精炼了初始跟踪的运动轨迹。在验证了VidForce方法对轨迹恢复和力估计的有效性之后，该方法被应用到一个Spot机器人上，通过人类演示生成的轨迹和力廓线来执行实际操作。
AI.result: 在包含Hoi!数据集中的保留交互的评估子集上，VidForce的评价结果如下：平移误差（ATE）为6.6厘米，尖峰力的MAE和RMSE分别为4.81牛顿和5.92牛顿，力廓线的RMSE为5.52牛顿。在真实世界视频中，VidForce能够可靠而一致地估算运动和力，尽管人体执行的变异性较大。进一步将VidForce部署于Spot机器人上，其估计出的轨迹和力廓线推动了对物体的精准控制与操作。
AI.conclusion: VidForce方法为体形代理提供了一种新颖的方法，以估算视频中的运动轨迹和力廓线，有助于让机器更好地理解和模仿人类的交互行为，为未来的机器人与人类互动的实现提供了可能。

title: FocusAnchor: Zero-Shot Metric Depth by Anchoring a Depth Foundation Prior to Focus Cues
summary: Existing depth-from-focus methods can struggle with weak focus cues, new cameras, or fewer focal slices. We present FocusAnchor, a recurrent model that uses focus-volume lookups to refine metric depth and repeatedly aligns a relative depth prior from a frozen foundation model to the current depth estimate. The aligned prior guides subsequent refinement in a feedback loop, carrying metric scale recovered from textured regions into regions where focus cues are weak while preserving scene structure. To support transfer across cameras, we synthesize training stacks with randomized camera parameters and focus distances. However, stack synthesis blurs existing image noise differently across slices, creating artificial depth cues even on textureless surfaces. We add independent per-slice noise to suppress these cues. We also introduce variable-stack training to improve robustness with fewer focal slices and support more practical mobile capture. Compared with FOSSA ViT-B, FocusAnchor reduces AbsRel by 36% on NYU Depth V2 and by 9% on DDFF-12 after fine-tuning. In zero-shot evaluation, FocusAnchor and its variable-stack variant, FocusAnchor-flex, achieve the two lowest AbsRel values on all five benchmarks. On ZEDD test, FocusAnchor achieves 9% lower AbsRel than the best competing method, FOSSA ViT-B, while FocusAnchor-flex achieves lower AbsRel with 40% fewer focal slices on ZEDD validation.

AI.tldr: FocusAnchor 引入了循环模型和新的训练策略，通过聚焦体素查询和反复对齐冻结的基础模型中的相对深度先验，提高了深度从焦距估计的鲁棒性，特别是在弱特征场景和较少焦点切片的情况下。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度从焦距方法在处理弱焦距线索、新型相机或更少的焦点切片时表现不佳。为了解决这些问题，作者提出了一种新的方法 FocusAnchor，旨在提高深度从焦距估计的准确性。
AI.method: FocusAnchor 使用循环机制，结合聚焦体素查找来精炼深度估计，并反复对齐从冻结的基础模型中提取的相对深度先验。通过这种方法，能够更好地处理无纹理区域的深度估计，并引入训练策略以提高模型的跨相机迁移性能。
AI.result: 与 FOSSA ViT-B 相比，FocusAnchor在NYU Depth V2 和 DDFF-12 上的 AbsRel 分别降低了 36% 和 9%。在零样本评估中，FocusAnchor 和其变体 FocusAnchor-flex 在所有五个基准上均实现了最低的 AbsRel 值。特别是在 ZEDD 测试和验证集上，FocusAnchor 和 FocusAnchor-flex 分别实现了比 FOSSA ViT-B 低 9% 和 40% 的 AbsRel。
AI.conclusion: FocusAnchor 显示出在深度从焦距估计中具有显著改进的潜力，特别是在处理弱焦距线索和更少焦点切片的情况下，表明该方法可以实现更具实用性的移动捕获。

title: Teaching Time Without Losing General Retrieval: Adapting Multimodal Embeddings for Time-Sensitive Video Retrieval
summary: In text-to-video retrieval, MLLM-based embedding models do well when the text describes the scene (general retrieval), but poorly when it describes actions and their direction (time-sensitive retrieval). TARA, a pioneering work, fine-tunes such a model on text triplets with temporal hard negatives; it improves time-sensitive retrieval but lowers general retrieval (mean R@1 over six benchmarks in our rerun on Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B: 58.4->44.8), and its released model keeps general retrieval only when ensembled with Qwen3-VL-Embedding. Our goal is strong general and time-sensitive retrieval with one model and one vector per clip. Three findings lead to three simple components. Keep loss: general retrieval follows how far the output embeddings drift from the base model, not how far the weights move; we therefore keep them near the base model, which keeps most general retrieval even without general-domain data. Pair loss: the text embeddings of an action description and its reversed-direction version are well separated, but the video embeddings of a clip and its reversed copy are close; we therefore widen the gap between the video embeddings of each clip and its reversed copy, in the direction of the difference between their two text embeddings. Middle-layer LoRA: frames are combined in the middle layers, and temporal information peaks in or just after them; we therefore train LoRA only on these layers, which nearly matches training all weights on most time-sensitive benchmarks with 0.15% of the parameters and keeps general retrieval better. General R@1 stays at 58.4, while R@1 with each clip's reversed copy in the gallery rises from 55.5 to 63.2; the gains carry over to unseen benchmarks and InternVL2-8B-RA. The keep loss is also a remedy for the TARA recipe (general R@1: 44.8->57.8), and ensembling TARA with Ours gives the highest scores on RTime and unseen CiA among the compared models.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的三成分方法来改进文本到视频检索中的通用检索和时间敏感检索。通过保持损失，配对损失和中间层LoRA，实现了在不使用通用领域数据的情况下保持通用检索，同时提高了时间敏感检索的效果。
AI.motivation: 尽管MLLM模型在描述场景的文本检索中表现良好，但在描述动作及其方向的时间敏感检索中表现不佳。因此，研究旨在通过一个新的三成分方法共同提高通用检索和时间敏感检索。
AI.method: 提出了保持损失保持模型输出嵌入接近基线模型；配对损失增加视频片段与其反转版本之间的嵌入间距，同时考虑动作描述及其反转版本之间的文本嵌入差异；中间层LoRA仅在包含时间信息的中间层训练，大大减少了参数量，同时保持了通用检索的效果。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，通用R@1保持在58.4，而加入每个剪辑的反转版本后R@1从55.5提升到63.2。这些增益在未见过的基准测试中也得到了体现。保持损失还改进了TARA的通用R@1（44.8到57.8）。与TARA结合后，该方法在RTime和未见过的CiA基准测试中获得最高分。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的方法有效提升了文本到视频检索在通用检索和时间敏感检索中的性能，为未来改进这些任务提供了有益的参考。

title: NEST: Uncovering and Nesting Unknown Objects in Open-World Object Detection
summary: Open-world object detectors aim to localize objects of classes not covered by their training annotations, but most label them only as "unknown". This label tells a system that an object is present but not what it is, while its broader category would allow a more informed decision. We therefore address both uncovering unknown objects and assigning them to the broader categories of a given class taxonomy. For uncovering, we find that most unknown objects are already localized and labeled "unknown" in our base detector, but are discarded during final top-k selection because background receives higher scores. To mitigate this, we propose a class-agnostic ranker that estimates how well each predicted box fits an object and uses these scores to select the final predictions. Across three benchmarks, our detector improves unknown recall by 3.8% to 195.1% relative to the strongest baseline in each task, while maintaining competitive known-class detection. For categorizing, we draw on Euler diagrams, in which the region of a category contains the regions of its members. Our categorizer builds each category's region from the known classes and learns how much room to leave for members it has never seen. On the same detections, it categorizes unknown objects more accurately than existing hierarchical methods. Code is available at https://github.com/TUM-AVS/NEST.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了两个主要解决方案：首先，通过改进排名机制提高未知对象的召回率；其次，使用Euler图模型进行未知对象的分类，其性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 当前的对象检测器在遇到未训练类别的对象时只能将其标记为“未知”，而这些未知对象应被正确分类以进行更准确的决策。因此，研究提出了解决未训练类别对象未知性和分类问题的新方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的类无分类器，采用类无关的排名机制根据每个预测框拟合对象的能力来调整最终预测选择。此外，通过Euler图模型将已有类构建分类区域，并学习为未见过的成员留出空间。这种方法在多个基准测试中证明了其有效。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，新的未知对象召回率相比基线模型提高了3.8%至195.1%，同时保持了已知类别的检测性能。在分类任务上，研究的分类器比现有分层方法更准确地对未知对象进行了分类。
AI.conclusion: 提出的类无分类框架显著提高了未知对象的发现和分类性能，为开放世界的对象检测任务提供了更有效的解决方案。

title: Decision-Native Multimodal Clinical Modeling via Anatomical Grounding and Confidence Calibration
summary: Structured clinical decisions from volumetric computed tomography (CT) require anatomically grounded predictions and calibrated confidence estimates. However, existing 3D medical multimodal models often suffer from uncalibrated autoregressive decoding and shortcut reliance on irrelevant anatomical regions. We introduce Radev, a decision-native multimodal model that integrates anatomy-guided visual compression, direct candidate prediction, and counterfactual confidence supervision. To bridge global context with fine-grained slice details, a frozen 3D encoder extracts reusable organ-level features, which are dynamically selected by the query to attend to 2D slice features within predicted anatomical bounds. The resulting compact visual tokens enable the language backbone to estimate candidate probabilities in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding. We further propose Counterfactual-Calibrated Training (CCT) to compare predictions under intact and intervened organ representations. CCT encourages confidence to decrease when removing target-organ evidence degrades decision quality, while penalizing excessive confidence drops under unrelated-organ removal. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we construct CT-Verdict, a comprehensive benchmark spanning binary finding presence, multiple-choice questions, and ordinal severity assessment across both in-distribution and external cohorts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Radev significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both decision accuracy and confidence calibration, while generalizing robustly under distribution shifts. Project page at https://juntaojianggavin.github.io/projects/Radev/

AI.tldr: Radev 是一种决策导向的医学多模态模型，它结合了解剖导向的视觉压缩、直接候选预测和反事实置信度监督，以提高3D CT临床决策的准确性和置信度校准。
AI.motivation: 现有3D医学多模态模型常出现不校准的自回归解码和对不相关信息区域的依赖，Radev旨在解决这些问题，旨在从CT图像中生成结构化的临床决策，并提供精确且可信任的预测。
AI.method: Radev通过冻结3D编码器提取器官级别特征，并动态选择关注所预测解剖区域内的2D切片特征。模型使用紧凑的视觉tokens估算候选概率，无需自回归解码。同时，通过对比未改变器官和被干预器官的预测，采用反事实校准训练(CCT)提高置信度。
AI.result: 实验表明，Radev在临床决策准确性及置信度校准方面显著优于现有方法，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Radev提供了一种有效的解决方案，用于生成基于CT的结构化临床决策，同时提高了预测的准确性及置信度的可靠性。

title: PAVE: Preference-Aligned Visual Egocentric Learning for the Blind and Low-Vision Users
summary: Egocentric video question answering enables blind and low-vision (BLV) users to query their immediate surroundings through natural language. However, existing benchmarks and models primarily optimize for semantic agreement with reference answers, reducing visual assistance to a purely factual matching task. In real-world scenarios, a factually correct response remains practically unhelpful if it lacks the spatial orientation, actionable detail, or conciseness required by the immediate task of the user. Drawing upon real BLV egocentric videos and authentic user queries from EgoBlind, we construct the PA-EgoQA, a preference-aligned dataset that reconstructs reference answers according to empirical BLV communication criteria. Based on this dataset, we introduce Preference-Aligned Visual Egocentric Learning (PAVE), a unified learning and inference framework that couples structured answer-policy fine-tuning with deterministic question-conditioned routing to adapt response formulation directly to the surface form of the query at inference time. We further align the model via Filter-GRPO, which pairs a hierarchical correctness-quality reward with contrast-based candidate-group filtering to extract learning signals from both factual accuracy contrasts and fine-grained quality variations among correct answers. Extensive experiments across three vision-language backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in factual accuracy alongside substantial gains in assistive response quality. These results establish a concrete paradigm for translating human-centered response requirements into egocentric supervision, generation policies, and post-training objectives. Code will be provided at https://github.com/shawnliang420/PAVE.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了PA-EgoQA数据集以及PAVE框架。PA-EgoQA数据集根据盲人和低视力用户的交流标准重构参考答案，PAVE框架则旨在结合结构化答案策略微调与确定性问题条件路由，直接针对查询表层形式调整响应生成。通过Filter-GRPO，在多个视觉语言模型上进行的实验显示，该方法在保持事实准确性的同时显著提高了辅助性响应质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的自视点视频问答研究主要关注语义一致性，这在实际场景中往往无法提供足够的帮助。因此，研究者旨在通过PA-EgoQA数据集和PAVE框架，更好地满足盲人和低视力用户的需求。
AI.method: 首先，研究人员基于真实自视点盲人视频和实际用户查询构建了PA-EgoQA数据集。然后，开发了PAVE框架，该框架结合了结构化答案策略的微调和确定性问题条件路由，以便直接根据查询的表面形式调整响应生成。研究人员还引入了Filter-GRPO策略，利用层次正确性-质量奖励和对比度基元的候选组筛选来提取学习信号。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，PA-EgoQA数据集和PAVE框架在多个视觉-语言模型上，不仅保持了事实准确性，还在辅助性响应质量方面取得了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了将以人为本的需求转化为自视点监督、生成策略和后训练目标的具体范式。

title: First-Hit Photoconsistency for Neural Surface Reconstruction
summary: Recent neural implicit and Gaussian splatting approaches have achieved impressive results in multi-view surface reconstruction. However, jointly optimizing geometry and appearance introduces ambiguities. A parametric appearance model can compensate for geometric errors, reproducing the input images accurately without an accurate surface. We demonstrate accurate neural implicit surface reconstruction using only multi-view patch photoconsistency with geometry-based visibility, without volumetric rendering or parametric appearance models. For each reference ray, sphere tracing computes the first surface intersection. Its position and normal define a local patch whose photoconsistency is evaluated across visible neighboring views using colors sampled directly from the input images. For efficient sphere tracing, we use a 1-Lipschitz multi-layer perceptron. We use a single photoconsistency loss, without foreground masks or auxiliary geometric regularization. Experiments show that our method achieves the lowest mean Chamfer distance on BlendedMVS (BMVS) among compared methods and matches the geometric accuracy of leading reconstruction methods on DTU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种仅使用多视图补丁光一致性进行神经隐式表面重建的方法，无需体积渲染或参数化外观模型，即使在几何重建有误差的情况下也能准确复现输入图像。
AI.motivation: 传统方法在多视图表面重建的同时优化几何和外观，容易引入歧义。本文提出的方法使用参数化外观模型来补偿几何错误，从而能够在没有精确表面的情况下准确复现输入图像。
AI.method: 该方法使用球追踪计算每个参考射线的第一个表面交点。该位置和法线定义一个局部补丁，该补丁的光一致性在可见的邻视图中使用从输入图像直接采样的颜色进行评估。为了高效地进行球追踪，使用了一种1-Lipschitz多层感知机。使用单一的光一致性损失，不使用前景遮罩或辅助几何正则化。
AI.result: 实验表明，本文的方法在BlendedMVS（BMVS）数据集上的平均Chamfer距离最低，并且在DTU数据集上的几何精度与领先重建方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法来处理多视图表面重建中的几何与外观优化的难题，展示了一种无需体积渲染或参数化外观模型的神经隐式表面重建技术的有效性。

title: Train What You Run: Probabilistic Convolutions for Learning Token Compaction in State Space Models
summary: Visual token compaction reduces inference cost by passing only selected image patches or video tokens to later layers. In sequence models with local convolutions, each removal changes which tokens are neighbors. Learning which tokens to keep therefore requires a training signal that accounts for the new neighborhoods. We introduce ProbConv, which computes the exact expected convolution before activation at a kept position under independent keep decisions. The operator is differentiable in the keep probabilities. With binary decisions, ProbConv and step gating reproduce the compacted Mamba block. Across image, vision--language and video backbones, ProbConv is strongest under strong compaction: its advantage over matched training controls grows as more tokens are removed. In Cobra, it also outperforms adaptations of published vision--language pruning methods at matched inference budgets. ProbConv also improves over matched zero-mask training in video frame selection and speech frame dropping. Our code is available at: https://github.com/gmum/probconv

AI.tldr: ProbConv 通过计算在保留位置下激活前的确切期望卷积来决定哪些 token 被保留，在强压缩情况下表现出色，相较于其他剪枝方法提升显著，尤其在图像、多模态和视频模型中。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉和多模态模型复杂度高，推理成本大。为了降低推理成本，研究一种新的方法来决定哪些 token 被保留，从而在保证模型准确性的前提下减少计算量。
AI.method: 作者提出了 ProbConv 方法，它通过计算在保留位置下激活前的确切期望卷积，在 token 被保留的概率中可导，这种方法可以在保留位置的选择上引入依赖关系，从而帮助模型学习有效 token 的选择。
AI.result: 在图像、多模态和视频模型中，特别是在强压缩情况下，ProbConv 显示出明显的优势，超过了其他的训练控制方法，尤其是在Cobra 中，它还击败了之前的多模态剪枝方法和零掩码训练方法。
AI.conclusion: ProbConv 是一种基于概率卷积的 token 保留方法，能够在减少复杂性的同时保持模型的性能，尤其适用于需要大量计算的视觉和多模态任务。

title: MESSI: Multi-Expert Soccer Skill Integration for Physics-Based Character Control
summary: Physics-based soccer characters must perform diverse motor skills and transition smoothly between them, such as dribbling into a shot. However, skills that perform well in isolation may fail when executed sequentially, as preceding behaviors can leave the character and ball in unfamiliar states. We present MESSI (Multi-Expert Soccer Skill Integration), a framework that enables multiple soccer skill transitions through shared adaptation while preserving the original skill policy outside transitions. MESSI first trains eight task-competent experts using motion priors and task rewards, then distills them into a unified, skill-conditioned Transformer. Rather than retraining individual experts for different transitions, we train a shared, context-conditioned low-rank adapter on the frozen student through online reinforcement learning. Activated upon skill switching, the adapter helps the target skill handle unfamiliar entry states, while a learned exit mechanism determines when to return control to the original student. By disabling the adapter during native skill execution, MESSI preserves the original student policy by construction. Experiments across individual skills, skill transitions, and continuous skill chains demonstrate substantial improvements over direct switching, including an increase in dribbling-to-shooting success from 19.8% to 61.8%.

AI.tldr: MESSI框架通过共享适应器实现跨技能过渡，同时保持原技能政策不变，显著提升了技能链的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有技能在独立执行时可能表现良好，但在连续执行时可能会因前一个行为导致的不熟悉状态而失败。因此，需要一种方法来确保技能之间的平滑过渡。
AI.method: 首先训练八个任务专家，然后将它们提炼为一个统一的、基于技能条件的Transformer。之后训练一个共享的、上下文条件下的低秩适配器，该适配器仅在切换技能时激活，帮助目标技能处理不熟悉的状态，同时学习返回控制的机制。
AI.result: 在单个技能、技能转换和连续技能链上的实验表明，与直接切换相比，该方法在带球射门成功率方面等指标上有了显著提高，带球射门成功率从19.8%提升至61.8%。
AI.conclusion: MESSI框架通过共享适应器解决了技能间的平滑过渡问题，实现了更高的技能链表现。

title: RFW-W: Scaling Physical Asset Universes for Generative Embodied Simulation
summary: Scaling embodied simulation requires diverse objects with executable physical representations. We present RFW-W, a physical asset universe connecting rigid, articulated, and deformable asset sources to task-conditioned scene composition. Its reported inventories comprise 1,010,386 asset records: 524,611 rigid assets in 1,212 categories (RFW-R), 402,410 articulated assets in 531 categories (RFW-A), and 83,365 jointly verified deformables in 485 categories (RFW-S). These taxonomies contribute 2,228 dataset--category entries. RFW-R couples category-guided generation with collision geometry, composed physical properties, and interaction annotations; RFW-A uses reusable agent-authored procedural generators with explicit part and joint structure; RFW-S uses structure-aware simulation representations, calibration, and independent testing. A common interface preserves physical requirements specific to each asset type for retrieval and scene assembly. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate that RFW-R provides broader asset coverage and stronger scene-fulfillment capabilities than existing datasets. Across five RoboTwin tasks, using 100 demonstrations per task for each asset source, policies trained on RFW-R achieve macro success rates of 71.2% in clean settings and 41.8% under randomization, exceeding the strongest baseline by 15.8 and 10.6 percentage points, respectively. RFW-W provides a scalable and unified asset foundation for generating physically grounded, task-conditioned embodied worlds.

AI.tldr: RFW-W 提供了一个包含 100 万多种刚性、可变形和柔软物体的物理资产宇宙，能够支持任务条件下的场景构建。在五个 RoboTwin 任务上，使用 RFW-W 训练的政策的宏观成功率显著高于基准线。
AI.motivation: 当前需要一个庞大的物理资产宇宙来支持大规模的机器人模拟场景构建，并提供更多样化的物体以实现更强的场景构建能力。
AI.method: RFW-W 使用了多种方法来构建物理资产宇宙，包括：(1) 对刚性、可变形和柔软物体分类并生成相应的物理数据；(2) 设计通用接口以适应不同类型的物理要求；(3) 在多个模拟基准测试中评估其性能。
AI.result: RFW-W 在广泛使用的 RoboTwin 任务中表现出色，训练基于 RFW-W 的政策的宏观成功率达到 71.2%（清洁环境）和 41.8%（具有随机化环境），显著超越了基准线。
AI.conclusion: RFW-W 提供了一个强大的基础，可以生成真实世界背景下的任务导向的机器人模拟环境。

title: Training Lightweight Gaze Models without Target Gaze Annotation: What Makes a Good Teacher?
summary: Model-generated labels offer a scalable route to training lightweight vision models, but what makes a model a good teacher, and can we tell before training a student? We study this in gaze target estimation, where interactive robots need models that are both accurate and efficient. In a controlled comparison of eleven supervision conditions, we vary only the source of gaze-point labels, keeping the student, training protocol and 361k training samples fixed, across three video datasets, two student sizes and three seeds; every student is evaluated against human annotation. Three findings emerge. First, imperfect model-generated labels can replace human annotation: Gaze-LLE, never trained on the target datasets' gaze annotation, trains students that match annotation-trained ones on ViT-Tiny and are significantly more accurate on ViT-Small (average distance error 0.187 vs 0.196), and the ViT-Tiny student runs 32$\times$ faster than its teacher on a laptop CPU. Second, apparent competence can conceal unreliable supervision: given another person's face centre in the prompt, InternVL3 and Qwen3-VL return it on 93.4% and 81.1% of test samples, and a copy-the-coordinate baseline matches InternVL3's labels and students. Without that coordinate, both models fall far behind the specialist. Third, good teachers can be identified before training: validation label error ranks student test error (Spearman's $ρ= 0.91$), and ten annotated clips single out the two specialist teachers in 95% of draws. These findings give practical principles for assessing supervision, exposing shortcuts and selecting teachers for lightweight models.

AI.tldr: 研究展示了模型生成的标签可以作为轻量级视觉模型训练的有效替代，可以用于评估监督质量，并在训练前识别优秀的教师模型。
AI.motivation: 在精度与效率之间寻找平衡以训练交互式机器人的视觉模型，特别是在目标注视估计中，需要高效且准确的模型。
AI.method: 进行了控制实验，比较了11种监督条件，固定学生模型、训练协议和训练样本，分析不同监督来源的效果。
AI.result: 实验结果表明模型生成的标签可以替代人工标注，部分模型在未见过目标数据集的情况下也能达到甚至超过人工标注的效果，并且训练出的学生模型在能耗上具有较大优势。此外，某些模型可能表现出色的表面效果，但在无明确监督信息时会出现较大的误差。
AI.conclusion: 通过这些发现，提出了评估监督质量、识别有效教师模型的具体原则，有助于减少对人工标注的依赖，并优化轻量级模型的训练过程。

title: RePix-VFI: Re-rendering Observed Pixels for Video Frame Interpolation with Generative Priors from One-Step Diffusion
comment: Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/RePix-VFI_site
summary: Multi-frame video frame interpolation (VFI) aims to reconstruct dense video from sparse keyframes, requiring accurate intermediate motion and faithful appearance. As temporal gaps grow, flow-based methods can retain observed textures but misplace them under ambiguous motion, whereas iterative latent-diffusion models can synthesize plausible content but incur substantial sampling costs and may alter details during reconstruction with a variational autoencoder (VAE). We present RePix-VFI, named for Re-rendering observed Pixels, a multi-frame VFI framework that couples draft-conditioned one-step video diffusion with reconstruction from observed keyframes. A pretrained video diffusion model refines a flow-rendered draft of the whole window in a single forward pass. For each target frame, our generative readback matches its two bounding keyframes to the generated prediction using an optical-flow estimator. The resulting correspondences guide re-rendering of original keyframe RGB pixels outside the VAE. A lightweight appearance fusion head combines these renderings with generated appearance. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate significant improvements in reconstruction and perceptual quality. On SNU-FILM at $\times$8 and $\times$16, RePix-VFI achieves the highest PSNR and the lowest LPIPS, FloLPIPS, and tOF among the compared methods, exceeding the best evaluated diffusion-based baseline by 1.71 and 1.48dB in PSNR, respectively. It also runs 32--42$\times$ faster than the state-of-the-art multi-frame VFI diffusion model.

AI.tldr: RePix-VFI通过结合一帧生成式视频扩散与关键帧重建，提升了多帧视频插帧的重建精度与感知质量。
AI.motivation: 多帧视频帧插帧(VFI)旨在从稀疏关键帧中重建密集视频，要求准确的中间运动和忠实的视觉表现。随着时间间隔的增加，基于流动的方法可以保留已观察到的纹理，但可能在模糊运动下定位错误。
AI.method: 提出了RePix-VFI框架，结合了一帧生成式视频扩散和基于观察的关键帧重建。预训练的视频扩散模型在单次前向传递中为整个窗口生成流动渲染的草图。对于每个目标帧，使用光流估计器匹配其两个相邻的关键帧到生成的预测。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的实验显示了重建和感知质量的显著提高。在SNU-FILM数据集上，RePix-VFI在$	imes$8和$	imes$16比例下，获得了最高的PSNR和最低的LPIPS、FloLPIPS和tOF。相比最新的基于扩散的多帧VFI模型，它分别在PSNR上提高了1.71和1.48dB。
AI.conclusion: RePix-VFI框架在多帧视频插帧任务中展示了优异的性能，同时具有较高的效率。

title: E-MAPS: Event-Based Promptable Video Segmentation with Memory-as-Prompt
summary: RGB-based video object segmentation (VOS) remains brittle under fast motion and adverse illumination. Event cameras preserve signal under blur and challenging exposure, but provide little evidence when motion slows. Interaction can restore object state for subsequent propagation, yet promptable event methods merely address single windows. We formalize event-based Promptable Video Segmentation (ePVS), where prompts at arbitrary windows initialize, correct, or introduce objects and predictions. We present Event Memory-As-Prompt Segmentation (E-MAPS), which transfers a pretrained promptable segmenter to event streams and learns propagation and correction. Event-to-Token (E2T) aligns recurrent event features with pretrained representations while preserving prompt-conditioning priors. Memory-Aware Prompting (MAP) converts object-conditioned history into sparse prompts, allowing memory and user inputs to share one decoder pathway efficiently. We construct Event-View Masklets (EViM) from 206K aligned RGB-event pairs and 620K masks for two-stage representation transfer and native event-video learning, and establish three training-disjoint benchmarks. E-MAPS leads prompt-once and interactive ePVS across all three benchmarks while being more efficient. It further demonstrates strong performance on zero-shot object tracking benchmarks. Project page: https://github.com/adonaydem/emaps-wacv

AI.tldr: E-MAPS通过将预训练的可提示分割器转移到事件流中，并学习事件传播和修正，实现了事件驱动的提示视频分割（ePVS），并在多种基准测试中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 传统RGB视频对象分割方法在快速运动和复杂光照下表现不佳。事件相机在模糊和复杂曝光下能保持信号，但运动减缓时提供的证据有限。事件记忆作为提示分割（E-MAPS）旨在解决这些问题，通过在任意窗口进行提示初始化、修正或引入对象和预测，增强分割效果。
AI.method: E-MAPS通过将预训练的提示分割模型应用于事件数据流，并学习事件传播与修正。E2T模块将循环产生的事件特征与预训练表示对齐，同时保留提示条件先验。MAP模块将物体条件的历史信息转换为稀疏提示，使内存和用户输入能够高效共享解码器路径。
AI.result: E-MAPS在三个训练不关联的基准上达到了一次提示和交互的ePVS效果，同时展现出更高的效率，并在零样本目标跟踪基准上表现出强大性能。构建了含有206K对齐的RGB-事件和620K掩码的EViM，用于二阶段表示转换和原生事件-视频学习。
AI.conclusion: E-MAPS模型在提示视频分割中表现优异，并为未来研究提供了新的解决方案。

title: GRAPE-Bench: When Vision Degrades, Does Video Reasoning Hold?
summary: Despite strong performance on standard benchmarks, video reasoning models remain vulnerable to visual degradation, raising concerns about their reliability in safety-critical scenarios. Existing benchmarks address this concern in part by simulating visual degradation or probing model reasoning with challenging questions, leaving open how well models handle naturally degraded video and whether they can make the simpler judgments that matter for safe driving. To this end, we introduce GRAPE-Bench, which jointly evaluates video reasoning across visual degradation conditions and question difficulty. It combines a synthetic set spanning twelve corruption types across daily-life and driving videos with real-world footage of driving at night or in rain, snow, or fog. Each video is paired with three progressively challenging questions, from fundamental judgments with potential safety implications to demanding reasoning stress tests. Across open-weight and frontier models, we observe ranking reversals between synthetic and real-world conditions and level-specific weaknesses obscured by overall accuracy. Synthetic-data fine-tuning improves Qwen3.5-9B's real-world accuracy from 76.7% to 81.1%, while clean-privileged on-policy distillation reaches 80.4% in a separate reasoning-enabled setting. Through preference steering, we further demonstrate continuous control over a frozen model's trade-off between safety-relevant judgments and challenging reasoning, with little change in overall accuracy. Together, GRAPE-Bench provides a unified testbed for evaluating, improving, and controlling video reasoning under degraded visual conditions.

AI.tldr: GRAPE-Bench 通过结合合成和真实世界视频数据，以及具有不同难度的问题，对视频推理模型在视觉退化条件下的性能进行了全面评估，揭示了模型在真实世界情况下的弱点，并展示了通过特定方法可以优化模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基准在一定程度上解决了视觉退化问题，但未全面考察模型在真实自然退化视频中的表现及处理更简单但关乎安全的判断能力。
AI.method: GRAPE-Bench 结合了合成数据和真实世界车辆夜间或恶劣天气条件下的驾驶视频，每个视频配以三个递增难度的问题，评估视觉退化和问题难度对模型性能的影响。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，合成数据微调提升了 Qwen3.5-9B 在真实世界环境下的准确性，而清洁特权在线调整在另一设置中达到较高准确率。偏好引导显示出在安全相关判断与复杂推理之间进行连续权衡的可能。
AI.conclusion: GRAPE-Bench 作为一个统一的评估框架，促进了视觉退化条件下视频推理模型的评估、改进与控制，提高了这类模型在实际应用中的可靠性。

title: SHARPnP: Self-Supervised and Plug-and-Play Hyperspectral Super-Resolution from Real Noisy Unaligned Camera Measurements
summary: Affordable snapshot hyperspectral cameras capture spectral images in a single exposure but suffer from limited spatial resolution and sensor noise. Low-cost RGB cameras provide fine visible details to guide NIR reconstruction, but introduce spatially varying cross-camera misalignment. Supervised fusion methods require relatively large datasets of clean, high-resolution hyperspectral images, are sensitive to sensor noise, and generalize poorly across new sensors. We introduce SHARPnP, an interpretable, flexible framework coupling registration and reconstruction for RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution from noisy, unaligned measurements without clean references. We adapt a pretrained registration model via a cross-view loss backpropagated through a fixed plug-and-play fusion module. Temporal and recorrupted pairs enable reference-free self-supervision on noisy inputs. At test time, we calibrate cross-camera radiometry and refine alignment. Plug-and-play fusion employs sequential three-band denoising. On the REAL benchmark, SHARPnP outperforms supervised fusion baselines at $4\times$, $8\times$, and $16\times$ on clean inputs and at $4\times$ under Gaussian noise ($σ=5/255, 10/255$). On native RGB-HSI snapshot measurements, it reconstructs all 51 VIS-NIR bands, beyond the conventional 31-band VIS setting, without high-resolution references.

AI.tldr: SHARPnP是一种无需良好对齐参考或干净高分辨率参考的无监督融合框架，通过联合注册和重建从噪声和未对齐的RGB测量中实现高质量的高维高光谱图像重建。
AI.motivation: 传统的监督融合方法依赖于大规模的高分辨率干净数据集，对噪声敏感且跨传感器泛化效果差。而使用低成本RGB相机作为一种指导，解决了高光谱相机成本高空间分辨率低的问题，但带来了相机间位置校准的不确定性和不一致性。
AI.method: SHARPnP框架结合了注册和重建过程，通过预训练的注册模型和一个固定的插件融合模块来适应，并通过交叉视图损失反向传播来进行监督。利用时域和重新伪影对实现无参考的自我监督学习。通过序贯三频带去噪的插件融合方法来进一步提高图像质量。
AI.result: 在REAL基准测试中，SHARPnP在干净输入和含高斯噪声条件下（σ=5/255, 10/255），在4倍、8倍和16倍分辨率下均展示了优秀的性能，超越了监督融合基准。此外，能够重建51个可见光-近红外波段的高维高光谱信号，超过了传统的31波段可见光设置。
AI.conclusion: SHARPnP提供了一种新颖的方法解决了高光谱成像中面临的一些关键挑战，表现出在多种不同条件下的优越性能，对于推动低成本高光谱技术的应用具有重要意义。

title: Linear Probes Can Guide: Training-Free Control of Representation Generators
summary: Representation-space generative models, such as Representation Autoencoders (RAEs), leverage pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) primarily to accelerate training and improve sample fidelity. Yet VFMs are more than reconstruction tokenizers, as they feature rich representation spaces that are highly organized and linearly readable. We observe that this removes a key obstacle of post-hoc guidance: by linearity of expectation, a clean probe applied to an ideal denoiser's prediction yields the exact posterior mean of the probe scores at any noise level. This regime, which we call Semantic Mean-Space, turns semantic guidance into a Bayesian linear inverse problem, bypassing the need for training-time conditioning. With this foundation, we propose LiSM, a unified framework for Linear Guidance in Semantic Mean-Space. To validate the framework, we developed and adapted different solvers, and characterized them based on how they estimate probe-space uncertainty and propagate the correction through the representation. In addition, we propose Fit-Path, a solver designed to achieve strong global and local control. Our results in four control setups (class, attributes, foreground, and keypoints) show that LiSM methods, and Fit-Path in particular, provide effective, lightweight control across global and local tasks, outperforming noise-aware and pixel-space guidance.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为LiSM的统一框架，利用语义均值空间（Semantic Mean-Space）进行线性指导，通过解决贝叶斯线性逆问题来实现语义指导，无需在训练时进行条件处理，从而实现图像的轻量级全局与局部控制。
AI.motivation: 本文的主要动机是利用富于组织性的视觉基础模型（VFMs）的表示空间来简化后处理引导，并通过将语义指导转换为贝叶斯线性逆问题，直接应用于预测，从而绕过训练时的条件处理需求，增强了控制的 effectiveness 和 lightness。
AI.method: 该方法首先识别出语义均值空间允许通过线性期望进行引导，然后使用该特点提出了LiSM框架，通过不同的求解器来估计探针空间的不确定性并传播纠正。特别地，Fit-Path求解器被设计用来实现强大的全局和局部控制。
AI.result: 在四个控制任务（类别、属性、前景和关键点）下，LiSM方法以及具体提出的Fit-Path方法在全局和局部任务上都显示出了有效的、轻量级的控制效果，优于噪声感知和像素空间的引导。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，利用语义均值空间进行线性引导是有效且轻量级的，而具体提出的Fit-Path方法在多个控制任务上表现尤为突出，展现了巨大的应用潜力。

title: Spectrify: Framework for Hyperspectral Image Generation Using Computer Graphics
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables; includes supplementary material
summary: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) record the full spectrum of light at every pixel, so projecting an HSI through a camera's spectral sensitivities gives that camera's RAW image, and one HSI can supply training data for hyperspectral reconstruction and camera-pipeline methods. Real HSIs, however, are slow and expensive to capture, and the largest datasets hold only about 1,000 images. High-level vision commonly replaces scarce real data with images rendered from 3D scenes. Low-level tasks, however, need physically correct spectra, which requires spectral rendering with a measured spectrum for every material in a scene, and existing spectral renderings cover only a handful of scenes, mostly with a simplified image formation model. We present Spectrify, a framework that converts 3D scene datasets into HSIs, together with a library of reflectance spectra labeled by material and compiled from close-range hyperspectral datasets and spectrophotometer measurements. In Spectrify, spectra follow the material: each object receives a physically based optical model and measured reflectance spectra or optical constants from its material category, each lamp an emission spectrum of its type and the sky a modeled daylight spectrum, and Mitsuba 3 path-traces the full light transport of each scene per wavelength. We show that a hyperspectral reconstruction network trained only on our synthetic HSIs generalizes to unseen real datasets better than networks trained on the largest real HSI datasets on most test sets, and that assigning spectra by material category instead of by color alone improves this transfer on every test set. RAW images projected from our HSIs are also useful training data for color constancy, performing on par with existing synthetic RAW generators. We release the 4,500 rendered HSIs, the code of Spectrify and its material-labeled reflectance library.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Spectrify的新框架，用于将3D场景数据集转换为高光谱图像（HSI），并通过物理测量数据和3D路径跟踪技术生成具有材料标签的反射光谱库。实验表明，基于合成HSI的高光谱重建网络在多种测试集上的表现优于基于最大真实HSI数据集训练的网络，且按材料类别分配光谱比仅按颜色分配可以更好地泛化到未见的真实数据。
AI.motivation: 由于获得真实的高光谱图像（HSI）数据集速度慢且成本高昂，现有的HSI重建和相机流水线方法受限于小规模的数据集。因此，本文提出了一种物理正确的3D渲染方法，用于生成可以作为训练数据的合成HSI，以克服真实数据的稀缺性。
AI.method: Spectrify框架通过物理模型和测量数据生成3D场景的合成HSI。具体方法包括使用MIT路径跟踪软件Mitsuba 3实现每个场景的全光传输计算，根据不同物体的材质类别提供物理基础光学模型和测量的反射光谱或光学常数，以及根据不同光源类型提供对应的发射光谱，最后渲染生成HSI数据。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用合成HSI训练的高光谱重建网络在大多数测试集上的泛化性能优于使用实际HSI数据集训练的网络。此外，基于材料分类分配光谱的方法比仅根据颜色分配光谱在所有试验集上表现更佳。合成HSI的投影图像还可以作为训练数据用于色度恒定性，其性能与现有合成RAW生成器相当。
AI.conclusion: Spectrify框架为高光谱图像处理和相关领域提供了一种新的合成数据生成方法，并展示了这种合成数据在实际HSI数据分析任务中的应用潜力。

title: SUPRA: Synthesizing Amyloid PET from MRI and Plasma Biomarkers with an Explicit Regional SUVR Prior
summary: Amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) quantifies brain amyloid-$β$ as a standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR), but is costly and not widely available. Structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is routine, and plasma biomarkers such as phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) are becoming practical. Synthesizing amyloid PET from MRI alone is ill-posed, because brain anatomy reveals little about amyloid burden. We present SUPRA (SUVR prior-guided amyloid synthesis), which divides this task between MRI and plasma biomarkers. A regression maps the plasma panel to regional SUVR levels, painted onto the subject's MRI segmentation as an explicit prior. A 3D network then adds a residual correction guided by MRI. The output is in absolute SUVR, and the model also runs on p-tau217 alone. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort (111 test pairs), SUPRA reaches a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 23.4 dB, against at most 20.7 dB for four published models, and rank correlations of 0.56 to 0.67 with true SUVR in the composite cortex, an early-accumulation region and the striatum, against at most 0.24. In a second, cognitively unimpaired cohort with other plasma platforms (143 test pairs), it reaches 22.8 dB and 0.32 to 0.61, against at most 21.4 dB and 0.20. Its area under the curve for amyloid positivity is 0.91 and 0.82, against at most 0.63. Ablations show that plasma supplies the amyloid information and the network the image quality. Combining MRI with a blood test yields synthetic amyloid PET that is realistic and tracks burden across regions.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了SUPRA方法，结合MRI和血液生物标志物（特别是磷酸化Tau 217），在假性淀粉样变性成像（PET）重建中取得了显著成果。
AI.motivation: 鉴于PET显像昂贵且不广泛可用，该研究旨在通过结合常规MRI和血液生物标志物来实现淀粉样蛋白显像。
AI.method: SUPRA方法利用回归模型将血液生物标志物信息转化为MRI图像上的区域SUVR水平，作为MRI分割的先验信息。随后，3D网络基于MRI数据进行残差修正。此外，该模型也能单独基于磷酸化Tau 217运行。
AI.result: 在阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（ADNI）队列中，该模型达到了23.4 dB的最高信噪比，在多个脑区的皮尔逊相关系数（如皮层、早期积累区域和纹状体）达到0.56至0.67，优于其他已发表模型。在认知未受损队列中，得到了22.8 dB的信噪比和0.32至0.61的皮尔逊相关系数，比大多数其他模型表现更好。
AI.conclusion: SUPRA方法提供了现实的合成淀粉样变性PET成像，并能跟踪不同区域的淀粉样变性负担，对于阿尔茨海默病的早期诊断和研究具有重要意义。

title: The Radar-based Activities of Daily Living (R-ADL) Dataset
summary: Monitoring Activities of Daily Living (ADLs) supports safety and well-being for people living at home, especially older adults, and radar sensing is gaining increasing attention in the field of activity recognition for its ability to ensure privacy in the home while also surpassing technical limitations of other sensing modalities. However, radar-based activity recognition remains constrained by the limited availability of large-scale datasets. We introduce the Radar-based Activities of Daily Living (R-ADL) dataset to addresses the gaps identified in existing work: 1) it expands the scale of available data by providing over eight hours of annotated recordings in which a person performs eight distinct activities; 2) it overcomes room configuration limitations by recording from five different locations in a two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment; and 3) it extends beyond primitive actions to focus on high-level ADLs. In addition to the dataset, this paper introduces practical guidance for future ADL dataset construction. We conducted a detailed analysis of how ADLs are prioritized across academic research, health survey tools, and clinical trials to identify clinically significant ADLs. Furthermore, we provide our experimental design, data collection and annotation strategies, post-processing pipeline for forming the R-ADL dataset from raw data, and baseline results on standard machine learning architectures. The R-ADL dataset serves as a valuable resource for advancing ADL recognition systems as we continue building larger and more diverse datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了R-ADL数据集，通过提供超过八小时的注释记录、不同房间配置和高阶ADL活动，解决了现有ADL数据集规模小、配置单一的问题，同时提供了数据收集和注释策略，以及基础的机器学习模型结果。
AI.motivation: 现有ADL数据集规模小、配置单一，无法全面覆盖日常活动。本文旨在通过扩大量化分析，解决这些问题，确保隐私同时提高ADL识别系统的性能。
AI.method: 该方法包括构建R-ADL数据集，收集、注释数据，并应用机器学习方法进行评估。
AI.result: 本文成功构建了一个包含超过八小时注释记录的数据集，涵盖八个不同活动，记录地点从五个不同的位置覆盖一个两卧室两浴室的公寓，同时关注高阶ADL活动。此外，本文还提供了实验设计、数据收集与注释策略，并对其基础机器学习模型性能进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: R-ADL数据集的构建和验证将促进ADL识别系统的发展，为其提供必要的数据支持，以便开发出更高效、更全面的ADL识别系统。

title: RenGen: Generating Images with as Many Tokens as the Scene Needs
summary: We present RenGen, a latent diffusion model that generates simple scenes from a few tokens and busy scenes from many, saving time and compute on simple scenes without losing realism. Most latent generators represent every image as a fixed grid of patch tokens, so a simple image costs as much to generate as a complex one. Prior methods that vary the token count through content-adaptive tokenization lose image quality as the count shrinks. RenGen instead trades scene complexity, rather than image quality, for fewer tokens. It does so by generating in the latent space of a pretrained region encoder, where each token represents one region of the image, and a decoder renders these region tokens back into pixels. Unlike patch tokens, region tokens cover areas of varying shape and position, so each token must capture both what its region contains and where it lies on the image canvas. We encode this spatial extent by adding positional embeddings to the encoder features before pooling, and we generate it by anchoring each token to a single randomly sampled point, from which the generator infers the region's shape, size, and content. At sampling time, the number of anchor points sets the trade-off between scene complexity and compute. On ImageNet $256{\times}256$, RenGen reaches a gFID of 1.34 with 88 tokens per image on average, the best among methods that vary their token count. It approaches the quality of RAEv2, a state-of-the-art patch-based model, at $2.5{\times}$ lower latency, advancing the Pareto frontier of generation quality versus compute. RenGen's gFID stays flat across scene complexity while latency varies by $2.4{\times}$ between simplest and busiest scenes, and its autoencoder reconstructs nearly as well as RAEv2 (rFID 0.32 vs. 0.30) with $2.9{\times}$ fewer tokens.

AI.tldr: RenGen 是一种生成模型，能够根据场景的复杂程度调整所需的 token 数量，从而节省在简单场景上花费的时间和计算量，同时保持较高的图像真实感。
AI.motivation: 现有的许多图像生成模型将每个图像表示为固定大小的 token 网格，这导致简单图像和复杂图像在生成时消耗资源相同，而一些先前的方法通过内容自适应的 token 数量减少虽然降低了计算成本，但会导致图像质量下降。因此，研究提出了一种名为 RenGen 的生成模型，它可以在保持图像质量的同时，根据场景的复杂程度动态调整所需的 token 数量。
AI.method: RenGen 采用从先训练的区域编码器的潜在空间进行生成，其中每个 token 表示图像中的一个区域。它通过在池化之前向编码器特征添加位置嵌入来编码空间范围，并通过将每个 token 锚定到一个随机采样的点来生成区域 token，以推断出区域的形状、大小和内容。在采样时，token 的数量决定了场景复杂度和计算成本之间的权衡。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 256x256 上，RenGen 使用平均每张图像 88 个 token 达到 1.34 的 gFID，这是可变 token 数量方法中的最佳表现。它在 2.5 倍更高的速度下接近 RAEv2 的质量，这是最先进的基于 patch 的模型。在保持良好的重建性能的同时，RenGen 使用的 token 数量只有 RAEv2 的四分之一。
AI.conclusion: RenGen 通过根据场景的复杂性动态调整所需的 token 数量，在保持高质量图像生成的同时，大大提高了生成速度，展示了在计算效率和生成质量之间的良好权衡。

title: Physicl Scenes: An Artist-created 3D Dataset for Learning Perception and Action
summary: We present Physicl Scenes, a high-quality artist-created and curated dataset of 6,499 3D scenes spanning household rooms, public interiors, and outdoor spaces. The dataset combines detailed geometry, physically based materials, and carefully composed environments with object- and part-level semantic annotations, providing rich, joint supervision for visual and embodied learning. We demonstrate its value as training data across inverse rendering, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, and mobile manipulation. Across these tasks, training state-of-the-art methods with our scenes improves performance over alternative synthetic datasets. In addition, we introduce a mobile manipulation benchmark, evaluating vision-language-action models performing physical pick and place in diverse 3D scenes with realistic layouts, and using our part annotations to also score where each object is grasped. Our dataset will be released publicly to facilitate research in visual and embodied AI.

AI.tldr: 该数据集包含6,499个3D场景，涵盖了家庭房间、公共室内和户外空间，具有详细几何结构、基于物理的材料和语义标注，适用于视觉和物理学习。其性能优于其他合成数据集。
AI.motivation: 为了提供一种训练视觉和物理学习模型的新方法，特别是对于逆渲染、3D重建、场景理解和移动操纵任务。
AI.method: 通过艺术家创建并精心挑选的数据集，提供详细几何、基于物理的材料以及细粒度的对象和部分语义标注。
AI.result: 与使用其他合成数据集训练的方法相比，使用该数据集训练的方法在多个任务上表现出更好的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集还将公开发布，以促进视觉和物理人工智能领域的研究。

title: Lost on Campus: Evaluating Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in the Wild
summary: Embodied Spatial Reasoning (ESR) is central to deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in real-world embodied tasks, yet remains inadequately evaluated. Existing benchmarks primarily assess spatial reasoning in static images or synthetic indoor environments, where semantic shortcuts often suffice, making it difficult to faithfully evaluate spatial reasoning capabilities in the wild. In light of this, we present Lost on Campus, a benchmark for evaluating ESR in large-scale real-world outdoor 3D environments reconstructed by 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our benchmark introduces a unified reasoning-action evaluation framework that seamlessly integrates diagnostic QA for isolated reasoning with closed-loop interactive navigation for active reasoning under multimodal instructions. To enable fine-grained diagnosis, we evaluate six capability aspects of ESR: action grounding, spatial foresight, metric awareness, goal-directed planning, ego-allocentric localization, and spatio-temporal consistency. Extensive experiments reveal that: (i) Compared to indoor settings, real-world outdoor environments impose substantially higher demands on spatial reasoning, where existing models exhibit poor performance; (ii) VLMs still struggle with fine-grained visual alignment, with failures in spatial foresight and ego-allocentric localization emerging as primary bottlenecks; (iii) Improving multimodal interaction capabilities and long-term spatial reasoning is crucial for advancing embodied intelligence. These findings highlight that faithful evaluation of ESR demands benchmarks tightly coupling perception, reasoning and action within realistic and continuous environments.

AI.tldr: 文章提出了一种新的基准测试 Lost on Campus，用于评估Vision-Language模型在真实世界的大型户外3D环境中的体态空间推理能力。研究发现，与室内环境相比，户外环境对空间推理提出了更高的要求，现有模型表现不佳；同时也指出了当前模型在视觉对齐、空间前瞻和自我中心定位上的不足，强调了改进多模态交互和长期空间推理的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试主要评估静态图像或合成室内环境中的空间推理，这使得难以在真实环境中准确评估空间推理能力。Lost on Campus旨在提供一个更现实、更准确的评估环境，以更好地评估体态空间推理。
AI.method: Lost on Campus构建了一个综合推理-行动评估框架，整合了独立推理的诊断型QA和闭环互动导航，以评估体态空间推理的六个方面：动作锚定、空间前瞻性、度量意识、目标导向规划、自我中心定位和时空一致性。
AI.result: 在Lost on Campus上的实验结果表明，与室内环境相比，真实世界的户外环境对空间推理的要求更高，现有模型的表现较差；同时，现有的VLMs在视觉对齐、空间前瞻性以及自我中心定位方面存在困难，最主要的瓶颈是在空间前瞻性与自我中心定位方面的失败。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论认为，改进多模态交互能力和长期空间推理是推动体态智能发展的重要方向。未来亟需开发紧密结合感知、推理和行动的真实、连续环境的评估基准。

title: One Take, Many Cameras: Audio-Grounded Shot Synthesis for Dialogue Re-Cinematography
summary: Creating a dialogue scene typically requires cutting between multiple views (e.g., close-ups, medium shots, and over-the-shoulder shots) of the actors. Yet capturing such coverage is costly and in many settings unavailable. We study dialogue re-cinematography: synthesizing additional shots from a single wide-angle dialogue video. Existing video generators can synthesize new shots, but rely on visual cues alone, so when the source video barely shows the lips, the generated lip motion fails to match the speech. Our key observation is that the speech audio is view-invariant: it constrains lip motion in any target view. Building on this insight, we adapt a pretrained audio-visual diffusion model to generate the new shot from a target frame that specifies the view, a source video that contains the performance, and the speech audio that drives lip motion. In multi-person scenes, however, pretrained audio-visual models drive every visible face with the same speech, causing speech leakage, where silent listeners mouth the speaker's words. We therefore introduce speaker-aware audio gating, a training-free module that lets the audio drive only the faces that speak in the target shot. On a cinematic paired-view benchmark spanning diverse viewpoints and framings, our method lowers perceptual error by 59%, landmark error by 56%, and speech leakage by 97% relative to the strongest baseline, Wan 3.0. Our method also remains robust on in-the-wild scenes, highlighting its potential for film post-production.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种从单一全景对白视频合成额外视角的新方法，通过适应预训练的音频-视觉扩散模型，并引入说话者感知的音频门控模块，显著降低了视觉错误、关键点错误和对话语音溢出。这种方法在多种自然场景中保持了鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统的对话场景需要多个视角（如特写、中景和肩上镜头），但这种拍摄方式在许多情况下成本高且不可行。作者旨在通过利用音频的视角不变性，提出一种有效方法来合成额外视角，从而降低对多视图对话场景的高昂拍摄成本。
AI.method: 本文采用了预训练的音频-视觉扩散模型来适应特定的目标帧、原始视频表演和引导语音。并引入了一个说话者感知的音频门控模块，以确保只有说话者的面部才由语音驱动，从而避免了背景人物的对话语音溢出。
AI.result: 在电影对多视角基准测试中，本文方法在视觉误差、关键点误差和对话语音溢出上分别降低了59%、56%和97%，相比最强基线Wan 3.0。此外，该方法在实际场景中也保持了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法不仅降低了对多视角对话场景的合成误差，同时也提高了方法的实用性和适应性，特别是在自然场景下的应用表现出较大潜力。

title: BioLoom: Scaling Biomedical Vision-Language Models by Learning from the Structure of Scientific Articles
summary: The development of biomedical vision-language models (VLMs) with contrastive image-text pretraining has been driven by scaling to increasingly large and diverse image-text datasets. Beyond scaling, further progress can come from learning richer representations from existing data. We hypothesize that the structure of scientific literature itself provides an additional source of supervision: figures, panels, captions, and accompanying article text encode rich relationships across modalities. Yet, treating these as independent image-text pairs overlooks their relationships. To address this limitation, we incorporate these structural relationships into contrastive image-text supervision. We preserve exact image-text matches while introducing weaker positive supervision for related pairs, such as a panel and the caption of a sibling panel. We upweight cross-article negatives of the same content type to encourage finer discrimination. We also enrich panel descriptions using visual content, original figure captions, and mentioning paragraphs. Pairing panels with these descriptions and whole figures with their original captions yields Loom52M, a dataset of 52.4 million image-text pairs spanning scientific charts and biomedical images. Using Loom52M, BioLoom (DFN-2B) achieves 56.82% domain-balanced mean accuracy across 67 zero-shot classification tasks from 43 datasets in 10 domains, compared with 48.77% for MedPMC-CLIP. On BioLoomBench with concise captions and BioMedFlickr, it achieves bidirectional mean Recall@1 of 63.20% and 10.59%, versus 46.37% and 7.55% for the respective strongest evaluated baselines, BiomedCLIP and MedPMC-CLIP. Code, datasets, benchmarks, and models are available at https://bioloom-clip.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用结构化的科学文献数据来增强对比视觉-文本预训练模型，构建了Loom52M数据集，并用此数据训练了BioLoom模型，提高了零样本分类任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）主要依赖于大规模的数据集进行对比式的预训练，但这种方法未能充分利用已有的数据结构信息。研究者认为，科学文献中的图表、子图和注释具有丰富的跨模态关系，这种关系处理不当将导致模型性能受限。
AI.method: 研究者提出了在跨模态对比监督中加入结构性标注的方法。具体来说，他们不仅保留了完全匹配的图像-文本对，还引入了较弱的相关正样本监督，例如子图与其相邻图片的注释对。同时，他们增加了跨文章内相同内容类型的负样本权重，以促进更精细的区分。此外，研究者使用视觉信息丰富了面板描述，增强了原图描述与完整图和面板描述之间的匹配对。以此方法构建了Loom52M数据集。
AI.result: 基于Loom52M数据集训练的BioLoom模型在跨领域的67个零样本分类任务中表现优异，特别是在BioLoomBench和BioMedFlickr基准测试中，其双向召回率分别达到了63.20%和10.59%，超越了现有最强 baseline BiomedCLIP 和 MedPMC-CLIP。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过利用科学文献中的内部结构信息，显著提高了视觉-语言模型在跨模态理解能力上的表现。

title: PointX: Multi-View Consistent Intrinsics by Querying Surface Points
summary: The appearance of a scene is determined by the albedo, roughness, metallicity and normal of every point on its surface, and by the light that reaches it, its irradiance. Recovering these intrinsics from images is ambiguous, and methods that predict them per pixel give the same surface point a different decomposition in every view. We introduce PointX, a simple feed-forward model that predicts intrinsics per 3D surface point instead. A multi-view transformer encodes a set of unposed images, and for any queried surface point, PointX pools the point's tokens across the views in which it appears and decodes the point's intrinsics once. Each point of a 3D reconstruction of the scene, such as a point cloud or a mesh, thus receives a single prediction, which is exactly consistent across views by construction and enables view-consistent relighting and editing. The same model also predicts per-view maps, from one image or many, by querying the point seen at every pixel. These maps agree across views up to the precision of the estimated geometry and correspondences. PointX is significantly more consistent than existing methods, while remaining competitive in accuracy from a single image and improving as views are added. Project page: https://pointx-paper.github.io/

AI.tldr: PointX 是一种简单前向模型，能够为场景中的每个 3D 表面点预测内在属性，而不是每个像素，从而实现视图一致的重新照明和编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有的方法通过预测每个像素的内在属性，在不同视图中会导致相同的表面点有不同的分解。PointX 通过预测每个 3D 表面点的内在属性来解决这个问题，从而实现视图一致的效果。
AI.method: PointX 使用一个多视图变压器编码一系列无拍图像，并根据表面点在各个视图中的出现情况，对点 tokens 进行池化，然后解码表面点的内在属性。该方法同时预测每个视图的映射图。
AI.result: PointX 在视图一致性方面显著优于现有方法，同时保持单张图像准确性竞争水平，并随着视图数量的增加而提高。
AI.conclusion: PointX 为场景中每个 3D 表面点提供了视图一致的内在属性预测，改进了视图一致性问题，提升了重新照明和编辑的效果。
